We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

</details>


### [88] [LoopDVR: Looped Transformer for Efficient Dense Visual Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32067)
*Sirui Liang,Xuanlong Yu,Longfei Liu,Xiaodong Cun,Xi Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LoopDVR 框架，通过跨层复用 Transformer 块把预训练密集视觉识别模型转为参数高效的循环网络，在精度基本不变下减少约 28% 参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接裁剪宽度或深度会破坏原有计算结构；而简单共享参数又会影响不同深度学到的差异化变换，因此需要一种既减参又保留表示能力的方案。

Method: 基于层间表示差异度划分共享组，ViT 主干和 Transformer 解码器均跨层复用块；保留最后一个主干块独立以构建多尺度特征；共享块用组内末端层预训练权重初始化；每层设独立 Loop Adapter 保留深度特化变换；再将视觉表示蒸馏进循环主干并与循环解码器联合做任务训练。

Result: 在多种密集识别任务上取得最佳精度—参数折中，相比参考模型减少约 28% 参数且精度具竞争力；LoopDet-S 仅用 7.0M 参数达到 50.9 box AP。

Conclusion: 跨层循环共享结合分组策略、末端层初始化与逐层适配器，是一种可行的 Transformer 密集识别模型压缩范式，在小模型场景尤为有效。

Abstract: We propose LoopDVR, a framework for converting pretrained Transformer-based dense visual recognition models into parameter-efficient looped networks. Rather than reducing the network width or depth directly, LoopDVR reuses Transformer blocks across layers in both the ViT backbone and Transformer decoder, reducing the number of parameters while retaining the original computational structure. However, naively sharing parameters can disrupt the distinct transformations learned at different depths. To address this challenge, we identify suitable sharing groups based on inter-layer representation dissimilarity and keep the final backbone block independent for multi-scale feature construction. We then initialize each shared backbone block with the pretrained weights of its group's terminal layer to better preserve the learned representations. An independent Loop Adapter at each layer further helps retain depth-specific transformations within shared blocks. Subsequently, we distill visual representations into the looped backbone and integrate it with a looped decoder for task-specific training. Experiments demonstrate that LoopDVR achieves the best accuracy--parameter trade-offs across dense recognition tasks. Compared with the reference models, it reduces parameters by approximately 28% while maintaining competitive accuracy. Notably, LoopDet-S achieves 50.9 box AP with only 7.0M parameters, highlighting its effectiveness in compact models.

</details>


### [89] [Not the Scalar, but Its Evolution: Robust Source Attribution for Generated Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32074)
*Chao Wang,Zijin Yang,Yaofei Wang,Yuang Qi,Weiming Zhang,Kejiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SpCon 框架，利用重建残差能量的"频率分辨演化"（谱收缩现象）对潜生成模型图像做来源归属，仅需目标模型 VAE，在有无参考条件下均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜生成模型广泛部署，生成的图像需要来源归属以支持版权审计与数据治理；但实际中图像常经过后处理与平台处理。现有基于重建的方法把响应压缩为单一全局标量（重建误差或两步误差之比），丢弃了通道-频率结构，导致内容与后处理变化掩盖来源证据，传播后难以归属。

Method: 发现更稳定的判别线索：同一重建算子重复作用时残差能量的频率分辨演化，并称之为 Spectral Contraction。据此构建 SpCon：仅访问目标模型 VAE，通过两次确定性重建获得相邻残差，由其频率分辨的相对能量变化构造谱收缩表征，再对有限个拟合参考成分按源条件对聚合 Student-t 响应密度。根据非归属参考是否可得，支持三种设定：Target-Only（仅归属参考）、External-Reference（外部域外源）、Known-Reference（已知域内竞争者）。

Result: 在七个 LGM、35 个条件下，TO/ER/KR 平均 AUROC/AP 为 0.8786/0.6344、0.9404/0.7886、0.9652/0.8626，均超过最强基线（0.8154/0.5277）；在三个社交平台上分别为 0.8581/0.5507、0.9369/0.7549、0.9734/0.8773。

Conclusion: 频率分辨的残差能量演化是后处理与平台传播下更稳健的来源判别线索；SpCon 仅依赖目标 VAE 即可在三种参考可得性设定下显著优于既有方法，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: The widespread deployment of latent generative models (LGMs) makes generated image source attribution essential for copyright auditing and data governance, yet practical attribution should remain reliable under common post-processing and platform-induced processing. Existing reconstruction-based attribution methods summarize an image's reconstruction response to a single global scalar, such as the reconstruction error or the ratio of two consecutive errors. These summaries discard channel-frequency structure, allowing image content and post-processing variation to obscure source evidence and making attribution after spreading difficult. We instead uncover a more stable source-discriminative cue under post-processing: the frequency-resolved evolution of residual energy across repeated applications of the same reconstruction operator. Motivated by this insight, we characterize a phenomenon we term Spectral Contraction and use it to build SpCon, a source-attribution framework that accesses only the target model's VAE. SpCon obtains adjacent residuals through two deterministic reconstructions, builds a spectral-contraction representation from their frequency-resolved relative energy change, and aggregates Student-t response densities for each source-condition pair over a finite set of fitted reference components. The same representation supports three settings according to non-belonging reference availability: none (Target-Only, TO; belonging references only), external out-of-domain sources (External-Reference, ER), or known in-domain competitors (Known-Reference, KR). Across seven LGMs, TO, ER, and KR attain average AUROC/AP of 0.8786/0.6344, 0.9404/0.7886, and 0.9652/0.8626 over the 35 conditions, all outperforming the strongest baseline (0.8154/0.5277), and achieve 0.8581/0.5507, 0.9369/0.7549, and 0.9734/0.8773 on the three social platforms.

</details>


### [90] [Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32094)
*Yang Bai,Yingzhi Xia,Ling Lin,Jun Cheng,Lin Fu,Huazhu Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出Clinical3D-Bench医院空间推理基准（3,368题/8类型/373个病房布局）及训练集Clinical3D-45K，发现35个MLLM表现远低于医生，并证明输入3D地图几乎无效，转而提出GeoJeV方法，让模型"用3D计算"，取得所有评估模型中的最高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院空间推理需要识别相似设备、理解患者相对方位、判断通道宽度，但现有基准对这些能力覆盖有限；同时现有MLLM是否真正利用3D信息存疑。

Method: 构建基于373个符合医院设计规范的病房布局的仿真基准（视频逼真、答案由3D场景计算、成对场景状态检验证据敏感性、十位医生审核）；提供44,750题训练集Clinical3D-45K；并提出GeoJeV——从视频重建场景记忆，依据问题状态选择3D操作及其参数，将其证据注入选项打分。

Result: 最佳开源/闭源模型宏观准确率为45.7%和53.6%，答案先验达40.8%，医生为79.0%；32个开源模型中27个在患者相对方位题低于40%；微调可使两个MLLM超出最佳闭源模型16–20点；给微调模型输入3D地图几乎不被利用（替换为其他视频地图也几乎不改变准确率）；GeoJeV达全部评估模型最高准确率。

Conclusion: 现有MLLM在医院空间推理上显著不足，且无法有效利用直接输入的3D表示；显式让模型基于3D进行计算（GeoJeV）更有效，缩小了与医生的差距。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

</details>


### [91] [Rethinking Post-Training Quantization for Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32096)
*Minchan Kang,Kyeonghye Park,Seoyoung Cho,Junhee Lee,Daeshik Kim,Yucheol Cho*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RRQ：用局部Hadamard变换+组量化替代校准优化，解决LVLM低比特PTQ中离群值主导量化范围的问题，W4A4下8B保留96%+性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LVLM训练后量化（PTQ）即使校准策略愈发精细，在低比特权重-激活量化下仍严重掉点。作者定位误差集中处并分析分布，发现少量离群值主导了per-channel权重与per-token激活共享的量化范围，压缩了正常值的表示分辨率，大量数值被映射为0。

Method: 将关注点从"校准精修"转向"量化表示"本身：提出Rotate-and-Refine Quantization（RRQ），结合局部Hadamard变换（抑制离群值、均衡分布）、组量化（group quantization），并配套高效的组感知执行实现。

Result: 在8个多模态任务及多种量化设置下显著优于基线，同时降低推理时间与显存占用。W4A4时，8B模型保留超过96%全精度性能，32B模型超过99%，而基线不足8%。

Conclusion: 离群值是LVLM低比特PTQ掉点的关键来源，简单的旋转+组量化即可作为强基线，远超复杂的校准类方法，说明表示层面的改造比校准优化更具收益。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses large vision-language models (LVLMs) by calibrating quantization parameters on a small dataset without retraining. However, despite increasingly sophisticated calibration strategies, prior methods suffer substantial performance degradation under low-bit weight--activation quantization. To understand this degradation, we locate where quantization error is concentrated and examine the corresponding weight and activation distributions. We observe that a few outliers dominate the ranges shared by per-channel (PC) weights and per-token (PT) activations, leaving insufficient resolution for most values and mapping many of them to zero. These findings motivate a shift in focus from calibration refinement to the underlying quantization representation. We therefore present Rotate-and-Refine Quantization (RRQ) as a simple, effective baseline for LVLM PTQ, combining local Hadamard transforms with group quantization and efficient group-aware execution. Across 8 multimodal tasks and diverse quantization settings, RRQ substantially outperforms baselines while reducing inference time and memory usage. At W4A4, it retains over 96\% of full-precision performance on 8B models and over 99\% on a 32B model, compared with less than 8\% for these baselines. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/kmc3661/RRQ

</details>


### [92] [GUI-PRISM: Efficient Action Decoding for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32097)
*Enqi Liu,Zhi Gao,Liu Liu,Lifeng Fan,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GUI-PRISM 是一种混合动作解码器，直接预测 GUI 动作类型与结构化参数，仅对开放式文本保留语言生成，从而在提升准确率的同时大幅降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI 智能体多依赖视觉语言模型以文本形式自回归生成动作，推理延迟高。已有空间解码方法只关注目标定位，未覆盖动作类型及其参数的完整预测。

Method: 提出字段专用查询（field-specific queries）从共享多模态特征库提取动作相关语义与空间信息；用条件查询建模动作各组件间的依赖；再以门控残差交叉注意力利用细粒度多模态信息精化预测。结构化部分直接预测，开放式文本仍用语言生成。

Result: ScreenSpot-v2 上达 95.1% 准确率，比最强 head-based 空间解码方法高 2.0 个百分点，推理比基线快 3.8 倍；AndroidControl-v2 与 MM-Mind2Web-v2 完整动作准确率分别提升 4.8 和 0.7 个百分点，推理加速 2.7 倍和 3.9 倍。

Conclusion: 将直接预测扩展到动作类型与参数可实现完整 GUI 动作预测，在准确率与效率上均优于基线，代码已开源。

Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate screenshots and user instructions into executable actions. Most existing approaches rely on vision-language models to generate actions as text, often leading to substantial inference latency due to autoregressive decoding. To address this inefficiency, we propose GUI-PRISM, a hybrid action decoder that directly predicts action types and structured arguments while retaining language generation for open-ended text. Unlike existing spatial decoding methods that primarily focus on target localization, GUI-PRISM extends direct prediction to action types and their associated arguments, enabling complete GUI action prediction. Specifically, GUI-PRISM employs field-specific queries to extract action-relevant semantic and spatial information from a shared multimodal feature bank. It further models dependencies among action components through conditional queries. Gated residual cross-attention refines these predictions using fine-grained multimodal information. GUI-PRISM achieves 95.1\% accuracy on ScreenSpot-v2, outperforming the strongest head-based spatial decoding method by 2.0 percentage points while delivering a 3.8$\times$ inference speedup over the baseline. On AndroidControl-v2 and MM-Mind2Web-v2, it improves complete-action accuracy by 4.8 and 0.7 percentage points while achieving 2.7$\times$ and 3.9$\times$ inference speedups over the baseline, respectively. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>


### [93] [PreferenceScene: Personalized Indoor Scene Synthesis from Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32099)
*Seongrae Noh,RyunHa Lee,HyeongYeop Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PreferenceScene通过多轮交互和渲染图像反馈推断隐藏的室内设计偏好，LLM维护显式的场景属性偏好估计并整体修订，场景实例化模块将每个偏好值落成独立场景部件，在320实例基准上优于五个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户对房间的偏好往往难以用语言完整表达，只有在看到具体房间并指出喜好与不满时才会显现；且偏好涉及物件之外的整体外观与氛围（表面、光照、织物、家具及布局），要求系统能改动房间的所有部分。

Method: 多轮交互设定：系统展示3D场景的渲染图像，用户给出简短自由文本反馈与满意度评分。方法包含两部分：(1) LLM为房间每个设计属性维护显式的用户偏好估计，每轮从反馈推断潜在品味并修订整体估计（包括反馈未提及的部分）；(2) 场景实例化模块将每个估计值构建为房间的独立部件，使各部分可分别贴合偏好。

Result: 在含10种房间类型、320个实例的基准测试集上，使用模拟用户与基于渲染的评估器，PreferenceScene优于五个适配同一交互的已发表text-to-scene基线，且匹配度随轮次上升；在基线被直接给予偏好信息时仍超过它们；视觉语言模型将其场景评为最真实、最实用。

Conclusion: 显式维护并按反馈整体修订的属性级偏好估计配合细粒度场景实例化，能有效从局部反馈逼近隐藏的整体偏好，实现个性化室内场景合成。

Abstract: Text-to-scene methods turn a short instruction into a furnished 3D room, but the room that a particular person wants rarely comes across fully in words: many preferences surface only when the person sees a concrete room and can point to what they like and dislike in it. We therefore study personalized indoor scene synthesis under hidden user preferences: over several turns, a system shows a 3D scene, and the user, who sees only rendered images of the scene, replies with brief free-form feedback and a satisfaction score. The system must therefore bring the whole room toward the user's preferences from feedback that comments on only part of it at a time. It must also be able to change every part of the room, because a preference concerns not only single objects but the look and atmosphere that surfaces, lighting, textiles, furniture and their arrangement create together. We present PreferenceScene, in which a large language model keeps an explicit estimate of the user's preferences for every design attribute of the room and, after each turn, infers the taste behind the feedback and revises the whole estimate, including the parts that the feedback does not mention. A scene instantiation module builds every estimated value as its own part of the room, so that each of these parts can follow the user's preferences. We evaluate on the test set of a benchmark with 320 instances in ten room types, with a simulated user and a render-based evaluator. PreferenceScene matches the hidden preferences better than five published text-to-scene baselines adapted to the same interaction, and its match rises with every turn. It even surpasses them when they are given the preferences directly, and a vision-language model rates its scenes as the most realistic and functional.

</details>


### [94] [RISE: Reasoning with Implicit State Embeddings for GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32102)
*Enqi Liu,Zhi Gao,Liu Liu,Lifeng Fan,Liyuan Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RISE 提出一种隐式框架，将动作相关推理融入隐状态表示来指导 GUI 动作预测，在 OSWorld-G 上以 8B 规模达到 70.6% 的 SOTA 准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GUI agent 训练依赖显式推理（如 CoT），容易过度依赖特定推理模式，而难以泛化出真正与动作相关的信息。

Method: 通过三个互补监督目标将动作相关推理编码进隐状态：(1) 全 CoT 状态对齐，保留整个推理过程的信息；(2) 动作分布对齐，编码动作偏好；(3) 推理到动作的边界对齐，捕捉动作生成前一刻的表示；从而提升下一个动作 token 预测的准确性。

Result: 在 OSWorld-G 上达到 70.6% 准确率，在所比较的 8B 模型中为 SOTA，较其骨干模型提升 4.3 点；在两个不同骨干和六个基准上的实验验证了其在 GUI grounding 与动作预测上的有效性。

Conclusion: 隐式地对齐推理与动作表示，比显式推理训练更有效且更可泛化，为 GUI agent 的动作预测提供了新范式。

Abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents translate user instructions and screenshots into executable actions. To learn executable actions, existing approaches often rely on explicit reasoning during training, which encourage over-reliance on specific reasoning patterns rather than generalizable action-relevant information. In this paper, we propose an implicit framework, RISE, which integrates action-relevant reasoning into implicit state representations to guide GUI action prediction. To this end, action-relevant reasoning is captured through three complementary supervision objectives: full-CoT state alignment preserves information across the reasoning process, action-distribution alignment encodes action preferences, and reasoning-to-action boundary alignment captures the representation immediately before action generation. In this case, our RISE effectively learns informative implicit representations, thereby improving the accuracy of next-action token prediction. RISE achieves 70.6\% accuracy on OSWorld-G, establishing state-of-the-art performance among compared 8B models with a 4.3-point gain over its backbone. Results across two distinct backbones and six diverse benchmarks further demonstrate its effectiveness in GUI grounding and action prediction. Our code is available on our project page.

</details>


### [95] [An Automated Framework Integrating Deep Learning and Anatomical Reasoning for Cardiac Phenotyping From CCTA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32114)
*Hien Minh Tran,Thi-Thu-Hien Pham,Le Duy Tan,Hieu Xuan Nguyen,Tuong-Anh Mai-Phan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出结合深度学习与解剖推理的心脏CT定量表型框架，可分割冠脉并测量PCAT、EAT与冠脉钙化，在多个公开数据集上取得优于已发表基线的分割表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CCTA可显示冠脉解剖与心脏脂肪，但仅靠分割无法保证测量在解剖上一致；临床与人群研究需要标准化、可解释、可核查的定量流程。

Method: 框架由解剖测量模块（利用图几何、分支身份与周围结构定义血管特异性PCAT采样区及EAT替代腔室，并无需专家心包轮廓即可生成训练标签）和配套的平扫CT冠脉钙化定量模块组成；在ImageCAS、ImageCAS-X、COCA、Visual Lab、MultiD4CAD五个公开数据集上做组件级基准测试。

Result: ImageCAS-X Test-160上管腔分割Dice 0.9133、clDice 0.940，超过CAS-Net已发表点估计；四折ImageCAS中四模型集成优于单一ResEnc-L；800对扫描显示全血管与管腔参考下的PCAT衰减不同；外部EAT评估体积相关性高、空间重叠良好。

Conclusion: 显式解剖规则使测量可解释、可检查，框架为心脏CT队列提供处理与钙化、PCAT、EAT定量的标准化管线，适用于人群层面分析和跨研究比较；代码已开源。

Abstract: Coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) depicts coronary anatomy and cardiac fat, but segmentation alone does not ensure anatomically consistent measurements. We propose an automated framework that combines deep learning with anatomical reasoning for quantitative cardiac phenotyping. Its anatomical measurement module uses graph geometry, branch identity, and surrounding structures to define vessel-specific pericoronary adipose tissue (PCAT) sampling and a surrogate epicardial adipose tissue (EAT) compartment. The latter also generates training targets without requiring expert pericardium contours. A companion module quantifies coronary calcium on non-contrast CT. Component-wise benchmarking was conducted on five public datasets: ImageCAS, ImageCAS-X, COCA, Visual Lab, and MultiD4CAD. On ImageCAS-X Test-160, lumen segmentation with validation-selected post-processing achieved a Dice score of 0.9133 and a clDice score of 0.940, exceeding the corresponding published CAS-Net point estimates. In the four-split ImageCAS evaluation, the four-member ensemble outperformed the single ResEnc-L model. Analysis of 800 paired scans showed that PCAT attenuation measurements differed between whole-vessel and lumen references. External EAT evaluation showed strong volume correlation and good spatial overlap. Explicit anatomical rules make the resulting measurements interpretable and inspectable. In practice, the framework provides a standardized pipeline for processing cardiac CT cohorts and quantifying coronary calcium, PCAT, and EAT for population-level analysis and comparison across studies. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/HarryTRAN207/CardiacCT-Research

</details>


### [96] [The Old Scene Lives in the Cache: Diagnosing and Shedding Stale History in Streaming Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32116)
*Hao Zhou,Ziyang Xu,Chenhan Jin,Hao Qin,Shengze Xu,Tieyong Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 流式视频生成中切换场景时，缓存历史既保留主体又残留旧场景物体；作者提出免训练的 Molt Forcing，用目标场景冷启动重建历史并选择性保留主体 token，兼顾去旧物体与主体一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频生成需在保持原主体的同时切换场景，但二者存在冲突：缓存的历史帧有助于维持主体，却也会延续应消失的旧场景物体。作者希望厘清缓存视觉历史究竟如何保留这些过时内容。

Method: 通过对文本条件、去噪步数、局部窗口和 attention sink 的受控干预定位缓存机制；发现 KV flush 与 sink 重计算无效，而用目标场景历史替换可去物体但改变主体。据此提出 Molt Forcing：在冷启动目标场景上重建场景历史，同时从原缓存中选择性保留主体 token，全程无需训练。

Result: 在 16 个场景族上，Molt Forcing 去除旧场景物体的可靠性与 Echo-Forcing 硬切相当，且主体外观与切换前的人脸相似度显著更高。

Conclusion: 缓存历史是旧场景残留的根源，单纯清理 KV/sink 不够；将场景历史与主体 token 分离处理（冷启动重建+选择性保留）是实现免训练场景切换的有效途径。

Abstract: Switching scenes while preserving the original subject in streaming video generation exposes a conflict: cached history helps maintain the subject but also sustains old-scene objects that should disappear. Through controlled interventions on text conditioning, denoising steps, the local window, and the attention sink, we identify how cached visual history keeps this obsolete content. When the original frames remain in the cache, KV flush and sink recomputation still leave old-scene objects in the generated videos. Replacing this history with target-scene history largely removes those objects, but also changes the subject, reducing face similarity to the pre-switch subject. We then propose Molt Forcing, a training-free method that rebuilds scene history from a cold-start target scene while selectively retaining subject tokens from the original cache. Across 16 scene families, Molt Forcing removes old-scene objects at least as reliably as an Echo-Forcing hard cut while keeping the subject much closer to its pre-switch appearance.

</details>


### [97] [EditText: Structure-Aware Generation and Selective Visual Transport for Fine-Grained Text Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32134)
*Zhaobin Chu,Guandong Li,Xin Lv,Zhiwei Zeng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EditText 是一个统一的细粒度文本编辑框架，结合目标字符生成与源图视觉传输，通过双条件 Fill 输入和 Attention Transport 机制，实现文本替换同时保持字体、颜色、纹理及未编辑区域一致性，并发布 TBench 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度文本编辑需在指定区域准确替换文本，同时保留原字体、颜色、纹理，并保证未编辑区域的视觉一致性，现有方法在这两方面难以兼顾。

Method: 采用双条件 Fill 输入：掩码图像（隐藏原文本、保留未编辑内容作为源画布）与源文本风格参考，两者均与目标图共享空间参照。提出 Attention Transport 框架，以 Source Weight 表示对条件的注意力权重、Spatial Aggregation Kernel 表示其内部空间注意力分布；对选定的非编辑查询，保持分配给掩码图像的总注意力权重，但将其重新分配到空间对应邻域，实现选择性视觉传输。结合多阶段训练与针对局部目标字符结构的 Glyph-aware Structural Loss。

Result: 在自建 TBench（覆盖字母、表意文字、阿拉伯数字）上，EditText 取得最优的非编辑区域 SSIM 0.9769 与全图 LPIPS 0.0460。

Conclusion: EditText 通过注意力传输与结构损失有效统一了字符生成与视觉传输，兼顾文本准确性、外观保持和未编辑细节保留，并提供 TBench 基准推动细粒度文本编辑评测。

Abstract: Fine-grained text editing aims to accurately replace text in a specified region while preserving the source text's font, color, and texture, as well as visual consistency in unedited regions. We present EditText, a unified framework for fine-grained text editing that combines target character generation with visual transport from the source image. The model uses dual-condition Fill inputs: a masked image and a source text style reference, both sharing a spatial reference with the target image. The masked image hides the original text and retains unedited content as a source canvas; the style reference supplies appearance cues that guide new character generation together with the target text. We introduce an Attention Transport framework in which Source Weight describes the attention allocated to a condition and the Spatial Aggregation Kernel describes its internal spatial attention distribution. Accurate transfer of source details depends on attention strength, the retention of details in condition features, and spatially accurate aggregation. For selected non-edit queries, we therefore preserve the total attention weight assigned to the masked image while redistributing its attention toward spatially corresponding neighborhoods, enabling selective visual transport. Multi-stage training, combined with a Glyph-aware Structural Loss on local target character structure, teaches the model to generate accurate text, preserve source text appearance, and retain unedited details. We also introduce TBench, a fine-grained text editing benchmark covering Alphabetic, Logographic, and Arabic numerals, to evaluate character updates, appearance preservation, and the preservation of unedited details. On TBench, EditText achieves state-of-the-art non-edit-region SSIM (0.9769) and full-image LPIPS (0.0460).

</details>


### [98] [ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32147)
*Xiangwei Wang,Jianyuan Lin,Peng Wang,Saman Halgamuge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ARS-VLM 是一种仅前向的零阶强化学习框架，通过视觉对齐的 Augmented Random Search 对 VLM 进行后训练，避免反向传播与参考模型开销，并克服 patch 网格过拟合与灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一阶方法（如 GRPO）在 VLM 多模态推理后训练中内存和系统开销大（反传、优化器状态、参考模型）；而仅前向的零阶方法（ES/ARS）尚未在 VLM 推理中探索。直接套用 ES/ARS 会出现两个失效模式：(i) patch 网格过拟合，拟合脆弱的网格特定视觉 token 伪影而忽略空间不变性；(ii) 灾难性遗忘，无界高秩参数与策略漂移损害通用感知和 OOD 任务。

Method: 1) 从双线性配对的跨网格视图提取对比视觉基，将扰动集中于共享视觉信号并抑制 patch 位移伪影；2) 用软子空间先验锚定浅层视觉融合层、放开深层推理层，在无参考模型下约束策略漂移；3) 在配对视图上对扰动打分，top-k 选择时剔除视图脆弱方向。

Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B/8B 上评估。8B 模型 20 步达到 61.0% 验证准确率，GRPO 需 150 步（优化步数少 7.5 倍），且避免了 vanilla ARS/ES 的后期 OOD 崩溃。七个 OOD 视觉推理基准单视图微平均准确率 75.41%，与全参数 GRPO 的 75.31% 相当。

Conclusion: 视觉对齐的零阶后训练可在显著降低步数与系统开销的同时，达到与全参数 GRPO 相当的 OOD 表现，并保持训练稳定性。

Abstract: First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

</details>


### [99] [Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32135)
*Onkar Jadhav,Tim French*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Med-PODiff，一种基于分块本征正交分解（POD）的扩散框架用于脑MRI超分辨率，在紧凑可解释的局部系数空间生成重建，并将预测不确定性分解为总/粗/细分量，据此定义逐像素幻觉风险分数 H_p。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型用于医学图像重建/超分时，可能产生看似合理但难以仅凭重建图像识别的细尺度幻觉，缺乏可解释的不确定性来定位这些幻觉。

Method: 采用分块POD将低秩解剖变化与细细节残差分离，在POD系数空间做扩散生成；利用该结构把预测不确定性分解为总体、粗尺度、细尺度三部分，并定义强调细细节不确定性主导区域的像素级幻觉风险分数 H_p。

Result: 重建质量优于代表性扩散基线且预测区间校准良好，总不确定性检测高误差区域AUROC 0.954；不确定性具尺度选择性，H_p 定位细误差AUROC 0.906；注入实验与回顾性笛卡尔k空间欠采样验证细细节定位与退化鲁棒性；丢弃的POD尾部仅为保留细误差幅度的3.8%；下游分割一致性提升且推理时间显著少于像素空间扩散。

Conclusion: 在可解释POD系数空间做扩散，可实现高质量脑MRI超分，并提供尺度选择性、可定位幻觉风险的不确定性，兼顾效率与下游任务一致性。

Abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used for medical image reconstruction and super-resolution, but their samples may contain plausible fine-scale hallucinations that are difficult to identify from the reconstructed image alone. We propose Med-PODiff, a patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) diffusion framework for brain MRI super-resolution that performs generative reconstruction in compact and interpretable local coefficient spaces. Unlike pixel-space or learned-latent diffusion models, Med-PODiff uses the POD structure to separate low-rank anatomical variation from fine-detail residual variation, enabling predictive uncertainty to be decomposed into total, coarse, and fine components. Building on this decomposition, we define a pixel-wise hallucination-risk score, $H_p$, that emphasizes regions where fine-detail uncertainty dominates coarse structural uncertainty. On brain MRI, Med-PODiff outperforms representative diffusion baselines in reconstruction quality while producing well-calibrated predictive intervals, with total uncertainty detecting high-error regions at AUROC 0.954. More importantly, the decomposed uncertainty is scale-selective: coarse and fine uncertainty preferentially predict errors at the corresponding scales, with $H_p$ localizing fine error at AUROC $0.906$. Controlled injections and retrospective Cartesian $k$-space undersampling further support fine-detail localization and degradation robustness. The discarded POD tail is only $3.8\%$ of the retained fine-error magnitude, and Med-PODiff improves downstream segmentation consistency while requiring substantially less inference time than pixel-space diffusion.

</details>


### [100] [ThinkMorph-SSL: Scaling Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning with Pretext Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32183)
*Jiawei Gu,Linjie Li,Yiming Liu,Yunzhuo Hao,Huichen Wang,Guanzheng Chen,Zhichao Peng,Luxin Xu,Xinyu Zhang,Li Luo,Disen Lan,Zican Hu,Mingyang Song,David Valente,Alex Jinpeng Wang,Yafu Li,Ganqu Cui,Zhengyuan Yang,Qizhe Xie,Yejin Choi,Ranjay Krishna,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ThinkMorph-SSL 两阶段训练方案，用图像本身作为监督信号来训练模型的交错多模态推理能力，平均提升 11.33 个准确率点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通过生成中间图像来引导推理的交错多模态推理能力很有价值，但训练此类能力通常依赖难以收集的任务专属演示数据。

Method: 两阶段训练。第一阶段"预文本推理"：将上色、去噪等视觉预任务转化为无指令的交错推理轨迹，模型描述损坏/变换图像、生成复原或规范图像并解读结果。第二阶段用自动构建的演示进行问题驱动的指令微调。

Result: 相同指令微调预算下，经预文本推理训练的模型优于仅用指令微调；完整方案在十二个基准上平均超过基座模型 11.33 个准确率点。

Conclusion: 源自图像的自监督可构建交错推理所需的视觉技能，并提升从任务专属演示中的学习效果。

Abstract: People reason with pictures as well as words. Interleaved multimodal reasoning gives models a similar way to solve problems by creating intermediate images and using them to guide further reasoning. Training models with this ability usually relies on task-specific demonstrations, which are difficult to collect. We introduce ThinkMorph-SSL, a two-stage training recipe that uses images themselves as a source of supervision. The first stage, pretext reasoning, converts visual pretext tasks, such as image colorization and denoising, into instruction-free interleaved traces. Models describe a corrupted or transformed image, generate a restored or canonical image, and interpret the result. The second stage uses automatically constructed demonstrations for question-driven instruction tuning. At the same instruction-tuning budget, models trained with pretext reasoning outperform those trained with instruction tuning alone. The full recipe improves over the base model by an average of 11.33 accuracy points across twelve benchmarks. These results show that supervision derived from images can build the visual skills needed for interleaved reasoning and improve learning from task-specific demonstrations.

</details>


### [101] [VIDE : Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection via Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32138)
*Kevin D. Nguetche,Atif Belal,Lilian Hollard,Eric Granger,Marco Pedersoli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练的VIDE框架，用冻结的clip嵌入为每个测试视频自适应调整基于文本的异常打分，缓解异常偏置和提示选择敏感问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于嵌入的视频异常检测中，正常片段可能与异常文本描述高度相似（异常偏置），导致误报；PRISM等方法依赖文本导出的、跨视频共享的常态参考与异常方向，但正常活动和异常外观因场景而异，且得分对提示选择敏感。

Method: VIDE为免训练框架：用低初始异常分数的片段估计正常场景内容，并部分校正文本参考；重标定类别响应，惩罚跨类别强响应片段；用高分片段精炼异常方向；在多个提示视图上平均得分以降低提示敏感性；并融合两个冻结编码器的分数。

Result: 融合两编码器后，相对最佳PRISM结果，AUC在UCF-Crime、XD-Violence、MSAD上分别提升1.5、1.9、3.5个百分点；AP在XD-Violence提升6.5点、MSAD提升9.3点。在三个基准上均为对比的无训练方法中AUC最高，在XD-Violence和MSAD上为所有对比方法中报告的最高AUC。

Conclusion: 通过视频自适应的文本打分校正与多视图、多编码器融合，VIDE在无需训练的情况下有效提升视频异常检测性能，代码将公开。

Abstract: In embedding-based video anomaly detection (VAD), normal clips can have high similarity to anomalous descriptions, an anomaly bias that leads to false positives. Methods such as PRISM mitigate this bias by measuring deviations from a normality reference along anomaly directions. Both the normality reference and the anomaly directions are derived from text and shared across videos, although normal activity and the appearance of anomalies vary across scenes. The resulting scores are also sensitive to prompt selection. To address these limitations, we propose Visual Intrinsic Distribution Estimation (VIDE), a training-free framework that adapts text-derived scoring to each test video using frozen clip embeddings. VIDE estimates normal scene content from clips with low initial anomaly scores and uses this estimate to partially correct the textual reference. It then rescales category responses, penalizes clips with strong responses across categories, and refines the anomaly directions using high-scoring clips. VIDE averages scores across prompt views to reduce sensitivity to prompt selection and fuses scores from two frozen encoders. With both encoders, VIDE improves AUC over the best PRISM result by $1.5$, $1.9$, and $3.5$ points on UCF-Crime, XD-Violence, and MSAD, respectively, and AP by $6.5$ points on XD-Violence and $9.3$ points on MSAD. VIDE yields the highest AUC among the compared training-free methods on all three benchmarks and the highest reported AUC among all compared methods on XD-Violence and MSAD. Our code is included in the supplementary material and will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [102] [LiteSTAR: Low-Rank Channel Modulation for Temporally Consistent CVD Video Compensation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32140)
*Peiyang Lin,Sichen Lin,Yipeng Liao,Liqun Lin,Xu Wang,Tiesong Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级时空自适应重着色方法 LiteSTAR，核心是即插即用的低秩通道自适应解码器 LiCaD，用低秩状态空间滤波替代跨帧对齐，仅 0.05M 参数即达优异性能，并发布首个第一视角 CVD 视频基准 EgoCVDSet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 色觉缺陷（CVD）人群庞大，重着色需在设备端连续运行。逐帧处理会产生颜色闪烁，而现有方法依赖像素或特征空间的跨帧对齐，代价高昂。

Method: 观察到颜色闪烁与通道响应变化相关、且颜色敏感变化集中于低秩子空间。据此设计 LiCaD：在低秩状态空间中以学习的过程与观测不确定性进行时序滤波，再调制特征通道实现时序一致性，无需显式空间对齐；LiteSTAR 另用自适应 patch 路由提升颜色区分度并避免过度增强。同时构建 EgoCVDSet 基准。

Result: 定量与定性实验表明 LiteSTAR 在仅 0.05M 参数下取得更优性能；LiCaD 在不同任务与网络架构上泛化良好。

Conclusion: 通过低秩状态空间通道级时序滤波取代跨帧对齐，可在极低参数下实现稳定且有效的视频重着色，具备良好的可插拔性与推广潜力。

Abstract: Color Vision Deficiency (CVD) affects a large population worldwide, yet practical recoloring must run continuously on-device. Frame-wise video recoloring produces color flickering, while existing methods rely on costly cross-frame alignment in pixel or feature space. We observe that color flickering correlates with variations in channel-wise responses, with color-sensitive variations concentrated in a low-rank subspace. Based on this observation, we propose Lightweight Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Recoloring (LiteSTAR), built around LiCaD, a plug-and-play Lightweight Channel-Adaptive Decoder. LiCaD performs temporal filtering in a low-rank state space with learned process and observation uncertainties. It then modulates feature channels to achieve temporal consistency without explicit spatial alignment. LiteSTAR further employs adaptive patch routing to improve color discrimination for CVD users while avoiding unnecessary over-enhancement. We also introduce EgoCVDSet, the first egocentric video benchmark for CVD recoloring. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that LiteSTAR achieves superior performance with only 0.05M parameters. LiCaD further demonstrates strong generalization across different tasks and network architectures. The code, models, and dataset will be released after review.

</details>


### [103] [ASTERISM: Do Multimodal LLMs Actually Look at All the Images?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32316)
*Chanseul Cho,Dongwoo Kim,Noori Bae,Seungjae Moon,Seongsu Lee,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 多图基准中约24.2%的题可凭单图解决（"单图捷径"），MLLM对此产生依赖。作者构建了需多图推理的ASTERISM基准，并提出CICA方法使奖励更关注跨图证据，提升2.6–6.0分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多图基准本意是测试模型跨图整合证据的能力，但许多题目仅凭单张图片即可回答。这种"单图捷径"被MLLM广泛利用，甚至在单图不充分时仍依赖之；而常用的RLVR训练同样只奖励正确结果，不论是否真正跨图推理，因此无法纠正该问题。

Method: 1) 对19个公共基准约33k题进行审计，并用两阶段单图过滤检测捷径；2) 据此筛选需要多图的题目，构建ASTERISM（18.7k题，统一格式、评分器与七类任务，其中2.0k题经修正/重写），并发布ASTERISM-Train（49k训练题）与人工逐题验证的ASTERISM-Lite；3) 提出跨图像信用分配（CICA），在RLVR基础上把奖励信用更多地分配给真正需要多图信息的token。

Result: 审计发现24.2%的题目可由单图或问题本身解答；在这些题上，MLLM从单图获得的准确率中位数达到"全部图像相对纯文本增益"的78%。在单图不充分时，模型的多数错误答案重复了其单图答案，显著高于随机。ASTERISM-Lite上最强闭源模型仅得68%；现有通用与视觉专用RLVR目标均收益甚微。CICA在三个开源MLLM上使ASTERISM分数提升2.6–6.0分，超过同类RL方法增益的两倍。

Conclusion: 多图基准普遍存在单图捷径，会虚高评测结果并误导训练。ASTERISM提供了经过审计的多图评测与训练资源，CICA则从奖励分配层面抑制捷径，二者共同推动真正跨图推理能力的评估与提升。

Abstract: Multi-image benchmarks aim to test whether a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combines evidence across images, but many of their items can be answered from a single image. Across about 33k items from 19 public benchmarks, our audit and a two-stage single-image filter find that one image or the question alone settles 24.2% of them. On these items, MLLMs recover from one image a median 78% of the accuracy that all images add over the text alone, so these items reward answering from one image, which we call the single-image shortcut. MLLMs take this shortcut even on items where one image is not enough. On such items, most of their wrong answers repeat an answer they give from one image, at a rate well above chance. We build ASTERISM, to our knowledge the largest audited multi-image benchmark, from these 19 benchmarks by keeping their items that need more than one image. Its 18.7k items, 2.0k of them corrected or rewritten, share one format, one scorer and seven task categories. We also release ASTERISM-Train with 49k training items and ASTERISM-Lite, a hard subset whose items we manually verify one by one. On ASTERISM-Lite, the strongest proprietary MLLM scores 68%. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), now common in MLLM post-training, rewards the shortcut as well, because a correct answer read off one image earns as much reward as one that combines images. In line with this, existing RLVR objectives add little to the ASTERISM score. To stop rewarding the shortcut in training as ASTERISM does in evaluation, we propose cross-image credit assignment (CICA), an extension of RLVR that moves the credit toward the tokens that need more than one image. On three open-source MLLMs, CICA raises the ASTERISM score by 2.6 to 6.0 points, more than twice the gain of each general and vision-specific RL objective trained on the same data.

</details>


### [104] [CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32144)
*Iman Marivani,David Van Hamme,Jan Aelterman,Wilfried Philips*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 CSC-MAMBA，将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与 Vision Mamba 状态空间主干结合，用于多对比度 MRI 超分辨，兼顾可解释融合与全局上下文建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯数据驱动网络融合机制（朴素拼接、黑箱交叉注意力）缺乏理论依据；模型驱动展开网络虽有显式先验，但展开步骤局限于浅层卷积，难以捕获全局上下文。需弥合二者鸿沟。

Method: 把多对比度融合表述为卷积稀疏编码并深度展开，从参考模态中提取共享结构先验；再用 Mamba 状态空间主干对对比度特异的表示进行全局细化，形成可解释、模型引导的融合框架。

Result: 在 IXI 数据集上重建质量优于 SOTA，PSNR 最高提升 0.62 dB，且计算效率保持良好。

Conclusion: 展开稀疏编码与 Mamba 长程建模的结合可同时获得原理性融合与全局上下文，为多对比度 MRI 超分辨提供了高效可解释的方案。

Abstract: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.

</details>


### [105] [Factorized Context Attention: From Emulated to Native Grid Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32423)
*Mohamed Eltahir,Manar Eyad,Yara Alzahrani,Fatimah Albesher,Duaa M. Tahir,Tanveer Hussain,Naeemullah Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 将grid probing重新理解为"外部模拟的注意力"，提出免训练的块稀疏注意力FCA，用原生注意力一次性编码KV cache并以掩码批处理读取所有span，匹配grid probing精度与覆盖范围而成本大幅降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文单次前向会变慢、掉精度且受窗口限制；稀疏注意力虽高效但仍受这两点限制；grid probing免训练可恢复精度并扩展覆盖，但每个span都重复编码，计算代价高。

Method: 核心洞察：grid probing是"模拟注意力"——通过prompt限制问题可见输入范围，从外部复现注意力模式。FCA把同一模式作为模型自身注意力原生运行：输入只编码一次为KV cache，在单次批处理前向中把所有span作为掩码序列读取，并用阶梯式位置调度（stair position schedule）保证每个span落在训练位置范围内。免训练，适用于冻结的语言与视觉语言模型。

Result: 在长视频理解、长上下文文本推理、图像定位上，FCA以极小成本匹配grid probing的精度与覆盖：长视频上比单次前向高约10点，长篇小说上高9–14点；能在超千帧视频和4倍窗口长度的文本中找到needle；对同一输入的后续提问耗时仅为grid probing的约1/10。

Conclusion: 原生注意力可在不付出grid probing重复编码代价的前提下获得其收益，且无需任何训练，直接适用于现有冻结的LLM与VLM。

Abstract: Models read a book, an hour of video, or an image in one forward pass. As the context grows, this pass slows down, loses accuracy, and stops at the context window. Sparse attention is efficient, but keeps the other two limitations. Grid probing, a recent training-free method, recovers the accuracy and extends the reach by asking a frozen model the same question about short local and strided spans of the input, but every question repeats the whole computation, since each span is encoded again. Our insight is that grid probing is emulated attention, an attention pattern reproduced from outside the model through prompts, since each probe only restricts which part of the input the question can see. We introduce Factorized Context Attention (FCA), a training-free block-sparse attention that runs the same pattern natively, as the attention of the model itself. FCA encodes the input once into a KV cache, reads all spans as masked sequences in one batched forward, and uses a stair position schedule to keep every span inside the trained position range. Across long video understanding, long-context text inference and image grounding, FCA matches the accuracy and the reach of grid probing at a fraction of its cost. It gains about 10 points over the single pass on long video and 9 to 14 points on long novels, finds needles in videos of over a thousand frames and in texts four times the length of the window, and answers a later question about the same input in as little as a tenth of the time of grid probing. Native attention thus keeps what emulated attention gains without its cost, all with existing frozen language and vision-language models.

</details>


### [106] [MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32462)
*Yifan Dai,Daili Hua,Bohan Zeng,Yuran Wang,Jialing Liu,Bozhou Li,Chengzhuo Tong,Yang Shi,Kai Zeng,Liu Yang,Xinyu Liu,Shujie Li,Yiyan Ji,Bingyin Mei,Yushuo Guan,Yuanxing Zhang,Fangcheng Fu,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MAGPIE 将多参考图像生成中的构图意图表示为可执行的 Blender 3D 场景程序，由编码智能体校验与修正，再用代理渲染作为视觉规划指导生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多参考生成与构图控制方法虽提供构图引导，但计划中的主体关系并未被显式实例化，无法在合成前进行检查与细化，因此可靠地把选定主体组织到目标场景中仍有困难。

Method: 用简化 3D 场景（Blender 程序）表示目标构图；编码智能体把每个场景实例链接到对应参考图，对照指令检查几何与渲染视图并修改程序；最终代理渲染作为图像生成器的视觉规划。另构建 MAGPIE-Instruct-3K 训练生成器遵循该规划、同时从参考图获取各主体外观。

Result: 在 DreamOmni2 和 SconeEval 上同时提升 Qwen 与 FLUX；FLUX 在 DreamOmni2 上总体成功率较原始骨干提升 28.21 个百分点，并在 SconeEval 上取得所评估模型中的最高总体得分。

Conclusion: 显式、可执行且可迭代修正的 3D 构图规划能有效提升多参考图像生成的可控性与成功率。

Abstract: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

</details>


### [107] [Let The Pixels Through: Rethinking Long Skip Connections for Scalable Pixel Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32151)
*Jiachen Lei,Jiahong Wu,XiangXiang Chu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PiT，一种简化的像素扩散Transformer。通过将U-Net中的长跳跃连接改为非对称长跳跃，并用adaGLU在解码层自适应过滤信息，克服了传统跳跃连接线性组合在不同噪声水平下的不足。模型从底层特征到解码层传递细粒度信息，可从头训练并平滑扩展到1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256/512上分别达到1.62和1.70 FID，同时原生支持文本/图像多模态输入并用于文生图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素扩散模型训练困难，依赖经验性训练配方与架构设计，且对超参数敏感。作者希望厘清现有像素原生设计中的关键要素，构建一个更简洁但更强的去噪器架构。

Method: 1) 重新审视U-Net长跳跃连接，发现其优化收益并非去噪收益所必需；2) 指出跳跃与主干特征的线性组合难以适应不同噪声水平；3) 提出非对称长跳跃，将输入嵌入的细粒度信息送入解码层；4) 提出adaGLU（类SwiGLU MLP块），在解码层自适应过滤嵌入信息后再与主支特征相加，形成简洁的像素扩散Transformer。

Result: 从头训练时可从小规模基线平滑扩展至1.6B参数，在ImageNet-256和ImageNet-512上分别取得1.62和1.70 FID；原生支持文本与图像等多模态输入，在文本到图像生成上表现有竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过精炼现有像素原生设计（非对称长跳跃+adaGLU），可获得简单且可扩展的像素扩散Transformer，兼具强生成质量与多模态能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Training pixel diffusion models remains less straightforward, owing to the ad hoc training recipes and architecture designs, along with the sensitivity to hyper-parameter choices. We show that strong denoisers can be built by refining existing pixel-native designs from the literature. Specifically, we revisit the long skip connection in U-Net and find that the optimization benefit commonly attributed to it is not necessary for its denoising benefit. We further find that the conventional linear combination of features from the skip and main backbone is inadequate for regimes of various noise levels. Motivated by these observations, we introduce two core modifications. First, we adopt asymmetric long skips, which propagate fine-grained information from input embeddings to decoder layers. Second, we introduce adaGLU, a SwiGLU-like MLP block, in decoder layers to adaptively filter information from the embeddings before being added to main-branch features. The above designs give a simple pixel diffusion transformer architecture. When trained from scratch, it scales smoothly from small-scale baselines up to 1.6B parameters, achieving 1.62 and 1.70 FID on ImageNet-256 and -512, respectively. Besides, it natively supports multimodal inputs, such as text and images, yielding competitive performance in text-to-image generation. We release our codes at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/PiT

</details>


### [108] [STAR: Counterfactual Dual-World Rollouts and Spatial Target Adaptive Reconstruction for Visual On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32472)
*Yi Zou,Zhuang Yan,Yudong Zhang,Xu Wang,Yang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STAR框架：用反事实双世界 rollout + 空间注意力引导的目标重建，实现视觉on-policy自蒸馏，让模型依赖局部证据而非语言先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型过度依赖全局上下文与语言先验，忽略决定答案的局部细节；诊断显示即使局部证据被完全遮挡，模型仍保留过半全图准确率，说明单图正确不代表真正依赖局部证据，且不同token所需视觉校正程度不同。

Method: STAR结合两项设计：（1）通过局部图像编辑构造问题与背景相同、但决定性事实不同的成对世界，共享学生独立采样轨迹，在图像一致前缀下暴露上下文捷径；（2）在每个世界内，教师对比真实crop与均值色crop确定视觉校正方向，并用学生图像注意力与教师质心空间参考的散度自适应控制逐token目标对数概率重建；无需辅助注意力损失或测试时工具开销。

Result: 在六个细粒度基准上，Qwen3.5各规模平均准确率相对初始化最高提升8.04个百分点；达到OPSD最终准确率的速度快4.7倍；并可泛化到域外推理任务。

Conclusion: STAR通过反事实双世界监督与注意力引导的token级重建，有效促使模型依赖局部视觉证据，兼具效果、效率与泛化性。

Abstract: Vision-language models often rely on global context and language priors while overlooking answer-determining local details. Privileged visual on-policy self-distillation supervises full-image student rollouts using a frozen teacher that views high-resolution evidence crops. Yet our cross-scale diagnostics show that models retain over half of their full-image accuracy when local evidence is completely masked, indicating that single-image correctness does not guarantee reliance on local evidence, while the need for visual correction also varies across tokens with their spatial attention states. We propose STAR, a visual on-policy self-distillation framework combining independent counterfactual dual-world rollouts with spatial-attention-guided target reconstruction. Local image editing constructs paired worlds with identical questions and backgrounds but distinct answer-determining facts, where a shared student samples trajectories independently to expose contextual shortcuts under image-consistent prefixes. Within each world, the teacher contrasts real and mean-color crops to determine the visual correction direction, while the divergence between student image attention and a teacher-centroid spatial reference adaptively controls token-wise target log-probability reconstruction. Without auxiliary attention losses or test-time tool overhead, STAR improves Qwen3.5 across scales by up to 8.04 percentage points in average accuracy over initialization across six fine-grained benchmarks, reaches OPSD's final accuracy $4.7\times$ faster, and generalizes to out-of-domain reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [109] [RoboProbe: Benchmarking Physical Plausibility of Robot World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32152)
*Zhuoying Yang,Jiachen Ni,Yichen Guo,Xiaoshan Wu,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出基于五条物理定律的评估指标（接触保真、物体持久性、固体性、机器人变形、物体变形），结合分割、跟踪、3D几何与VLM推理，构建智能体评估框架RoboProbe及RP-Bench基准，五项指标AUROC均超0.85。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成视频被用于世界模型中的机器人动作提案与可行性评估，但现有视频生成器常产生物理不合理交互，未被检测的物理违规会导致对动作可行性与安全性的错误判断。而VLM直接检测此类违规困难，因为物理验证需要基于证据的时空推理，超出高层语义理解。

Method: 设计五项定律特定指标：结合分割、跟踪、3D几何或外观比较等时空证据与针对性VLM推理；在此基础上提出RoboProbe智能体评估框架，协调指标执行并通过受约束动作选择性细化评估；构建RP-Bench，含761段人工标注生成视频与来自12个机器人数据集、239个操作任务的130个真实演示。

Result: 在RP-Bench上五项指标AUROC均超过0.85，优于所评估的学习型评判器、已有评估器及仅用帧的Gemini基线；应用于五种视频生成器后，揭示各模型在违规类型与频率上的明显差异模式。

Conclusion: 该工作为机器人世界模型的物理合理性评估提供了可证据支撑的指标套件、智能体框架与基准，能有效检测并区分不同生成器的物理违规模式。

Abstract: Evaluating the physical plausibility of generated videos is critical for reliable robotic planning with world models. These videos inform action proposal and assessment before real-world execution, so undetected physical violations can lead to erroneous assessments of action feasibility and safety. Yet current video generators often produce physically implausible interactions. Detecting such violations directly with vision-language models (VLMs) remains challenging as physical verification requires evidence-grounded spatiotemporal reasoning beyond high-level semantic understanding. We develop five law-specific metrics for evaluating physical plausibility by combining spatiotemporal evidence from segmentation, tracking, 3D geometry, or appearance comparisons with targeted VLM reasoning: Contact fidelity, Object persistence, Solidity, Robot deformation, and Object deformation. Building on this metric suite, we introduce RoboProbe, an agentic evaluation framework that coordinates metric execution and selectively refines evaluations through constrained actions. To evaluate the physical plausibility of robot world models, we further introduce RP-Bench, with 761 human-labeled generated videos and 130 real demonstrations of 239 manipulation tasks from 12 robot datasets. On RP-Bench, all five metrics achieve AUROCs above 0.85 and outperform the evaluated learned judges, prior evaluators, and a frames-only Gemini baseline. Applying these metrics to five video generators reveals distinct patterns of physical violations across models, in both violation types and frequencies.

</details>


### [110] [SoccerNarrate: Event-Grounded Streaming Soccer Commentary with Macro-Window Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32153)
*Zihan Jia,Zhilin Dai,Zhengming Zhang,Min Yang,Zhenpeng Huang,Jiaqi Li,Caixia Sun,Xi Chen,Liang Li,Junlan Feng,Gangshan Wu,Limin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 SoccerNarrate，从数据、训练和评测三方面将低延迟流式解说与事件锚定的专业足球解说结合，提升关键事件覆盖与对齐精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于片段的足球解说模型在未经剪辑的整场视频上解说延迟、重复、不同步；近期流式视频语言模型虽能低延迟整场解说，但倾向泛化描述，常漏报或错报进球、红黄牌、换人、越位等关键事件。

Method: 1）构建 SoccerNarrate-Data：大规模时间锚定数据，含词级 ASR 对齐、质量过滤与实体校准；2）宏窗口偏好对齐（MWPA）：对同一流式前缀的因果多步 rollout 进行比较，保持秒级推理不变地对齐完整事件级解说语义，并用事件错配的人类解说作为反事实负例；3）SoccerNarrate-Eval：基于时间约束事件蕴含的事件中心评测基准。

Result: 整场比赛实验表明，相较强离线与流式基线，SoccerNarrate 在事件覆盖率和事件对齐精确率上均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过数据、训练与评测的协同设计，可实现低延迟且事件锚定的专业足球整场解说；代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Existing clip-based soccer commentary models often produce delayed, repeated, or poorly synchronized narration on untrimmed full-match videos. Recent streaming video-language models make low-latency full-match narration feasible, but they often favor general descriptions rather than professional, event-grounded soccer commentary. They may describe nearby actions while failing to mention key events such as goals, cards, substitutions, and offsides correctly and on time. In this paper, we present SoccerNarrate to bridge low-latency streaming narration with event-grounded professional soccer commentary across data, training, and evaluation. First, we construct SoccerNarrate-Data, a large-scale time-anchored dataset with word-level ASR alignment, quality filtering, and entity calibration. Second, we perform macro-window preference alignment (MWPA), which aligns the model with complete event-level commentary semantics by comparing causal multi-step rollouts from the same streaming prefix while keeping second-level inference unchanged. We further use event-mismatched human commentaries as counterfactual negatives to emphasize event semantics over commentary style. Third, we introduce SoccerNarrate-Eval, an event-centric benchmark based on temporally constrained event entailment. Full-match experiments show that SoccerNarrate improves event coverage and event-aligned precision over strong offline and streaming baselines. Code and models are released at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/SoccerNarrate.

</details>


### [111] [Mind the Band: The Hidden Frequency Variable in Geometric RoPE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32171)
*Seonghyun Jin,Youngmin Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 几何RoPE(如RayRoPE)把3D相机几何引入多视图注意力,但每个坐标的"频带"设置无统一标准,本文证明该设置能反转基准排名,并给出频带设计准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有几何RoPE实现沿袭2D RoPE默认的高频或让频率跨度随头维度指数增长,缺乏标准化;作者发现这种未规范化的频带设定会改变基准结论,因此需要系统分析频带对性能的影响。

Method: 在RealEstate10K新视角合成与双视图深度估计上做受控实验:变化模型规模(47M/25M)、头通道数(144/48)、频率个数与跨度(如243倍范围用4个频率vs默认3倍),并分析过宽频带下"前向-反向不对称"——对预测深度区间平均旋转会抑制高频前向,却不抑制其对深度的梯度,通过屏蔽高频深度梯度验证。

Result: 48通道时用4个频率填充243倍范围恢复约0.9 dB(总差距1.2 dB);过窄频带一致模糊对应关系,而三种投影式编码在最高频率落于每8像素块0.3–3次旋转(256×256下10–90次)时均可靠;仅屏蔽高频深度梯度可恢复90–93%的损失PSNR。

Conclusion: 频带必须显式设计:在图像坐标中设定频带、小头中填充跨度、避免无条件的同视图阻尼;建议未来多视图基准报告并匹配频带设置。前向平滑不保证反向稳定。

Abstract: Geometric rotary position encodings (RoPE) incorporate 3D camera geometry into multi-view attention by rotating token features according to viewing rays, depths, and reprojected image coordinates. Each coordinate is rotated across a progression of frequencies--its frequency band--yet existing implementations leave this band to inherited defaults, either retaining standard 2D RoPE's top frequency or letting the frequency span grow exponentially with the attention head dimension. We show that this unstandardized setting can reverse benchmark rankings. In novel view synthesis on RealEstate10K, RayRoPE matches the strongest baseline in the 47M model (144-channel heads), yet trails by 1.2 dB in the 25M model (48-channel heads), and exhibits the same reversal when varying head size alone at fixed model width. Populating a 243x range with four frequencies instead of the 3x default at 48 channels recovers 0.9 dB of that gap. Across view synthesis and two-view depth estimation, overly narrow bands consistently blur correspondence, whereas all three projection-based encodings perform reliably when their top frequency lies within 0.3--3 rotations per 8-pixel patch (10--90 rotations across 256x256 RealEstate10K). At the opposite extreme, overly wide bands degrade RayRoPE through a forward-backward asymmetry: averaging rotations over a predicted depth interval damps high frequencies in the forward pass, yet leaves their gradients with respect to predicted depth undamped. Blocking only those high-frequency depth gradients recovers 90--93% of the lost PSNR, showing that forward smoothing does not guarantee backward stability. Guided by this analysis, we distill practical guidelines--setting bands in image coordinates, populating spans in small heads, and avoiding unconditional same-view damping--and advocate reporting and matching frequency bands in future multi-view benchmarks.

</details>


### [112] [MediaStormBench-CameraLog: Can Multimodal Models Identify a Camera's Log Curve?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32172)
*Ming Ma,Wenhao Hu,Qichao Wang,Yuhao Wang,Junpeng Zhao,Qiyi Wang,Fangrui Zhang,Zhiqian Lai,Shanxin Guan,Haoyi Pei,Hongan Chen,Rui Gong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 MediaStormBench 首个子集 CameraLogBench，用于在无元数据条件下从图像识别 Log 曲线；11 个多模态模型接近随机，暴露其依赖场景/品牌先验而非光度测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影视制作中 Log 曲线只记录在易丢失的元数据里，调色师需逐一试曲线；而从像素反推曲线很困难，因为各厂商曲线在码值上高度聚集且与未知曝光耦合，需检验多模态模型能否胜任。

Method: 基于专业拍摄素材构建基准；设计了去除正确选项的探针以检测猜测行为；由厂商公式推导四项控制实验：调色负样本、同场景合成帧、上下文规格摘要、免训练公式基线，用以解耦语义先验与光度测量。

Result: 11 个模型在真实素材上的准确率略高于“总选最常见曲线”的基线；移除正确选项后几乎不弃答，显示强依赖场景与品牌先验；提供厂商规格可在标定色卡上显著提升，但对无光度参考的自然图像几乎无效。

Conclusion: 当前多模态模型尚不能在真实影视流程中完成 Log 曲线识别，“读懂规格”与“测量像素”之间存在明显鸿沟，该基准为后续研究提供了诊断工具。

Abstract: MediaStormBench is a multimodal benchmark for real-world film and television production, with each subset drawn from MediaStorm's day-to-day work. We release its first subset, MediaStormBench-CameraLog (CameraLogBench), on a common foundational task in footage ingest and initial color grading: identifying the Log curve of a clip without metadata. Cameras record Log footage by compressing a wide range of scene light into code values with a vendor-defined logarithmic curve, and color can be restored correctly only once that curve is known. The curve, however, is recorded only in file metadata, easily lost in transcoding and team hand-offs. A colorist then has to try candidate curves one by one against a waveform scope, and a wrong choice shifts the tones and colors of the whole clip. Recovering the curve from the image alone is challenging, because vendor curves cluster tightly in code value and are coupled with unknown exposure. CameraLogBench is built on professionally shot footage and tests whether multimodal models can identify the curve, with a probe that removes the correct option to expose guessing from priors. Because every candidate curve is strictly defined by a published vendor formula, we derive four controls from one implementation of these formulas: graded negatives, synthetic frames of identical scenes, in-context specification digests, and a training-free formula baseline, which together decouple semantic priors from photometric measurement. Across 11 models, real-footage accuracy barely exceeds always guessing the most frequent curve; when the correct option is removed, models almost never abstain, revealing heavy reliance on scene and brand priors. Supplying the vendor specification sharply improves recognition on calibrated charts but hardly helps on natural images without a photometric reference, exposing a gap between reading a specification and measuring pixels.

</details>


### [113] [LoopFit: Retrofitting Pretrained Diffusion Transformers with Recurrent Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32175)
*Xiaocheng Lu,Haoxi Li,Dazhao Du,Tao Han,Jian Liu,Hao Chen,Bohai Gu,Siyu Yan,Jingcai Guo,Jie Zhang,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LoopFit，通过在推理阶段循环复用 Transformer 块来扩展 DiT 的计算深度，并用注意力调制、残差接力损失和噪声相关深度调度实现有效的迭代精炼。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增加采样步数只能延长去噪轨迹，却不增加每步预测的深度；希望在不重新预训练的前提下，通过循环复用已有块在单步内增加计算并进一步精炼隐表示。难点在于让固定深度训练出的块在自我重复应用时进行局部纠错，而不破坏此前迭代已建立的结构。

Method: 1) Residual Attention Modulation (RAM)：利用每个图像块在上一轮的特征变化来缩放和偏移其下一轮注意力输入，形成反馈式精炼；2) Residual Relay Loss (RRL)：训练时对跨轮持续存在预测误差的块赋予更大权重；3) 噪声相关深度调度：高噪声阶段用 4 次循环、低噪声阶段用 1 次，以加速采样。

Result: 在同等计算成本下，使用四轮循环的骨干网络比增加采样步数能解决更多问题。在 12 个视觉谜题设置中，LoopFit 解出 89.8% 的棋盘，而最强基线为 87.8%；主要增益来自迷宫和冰湖上的长路径追踪任务。

Conclusion: 通过循环复用预训练 DiT 块并配合反馈调制与误差加权损失，可有效扩展单步推理计算，优于单纯增加采样步数；深度调度进一步降低采样开销。

Abstract: Scaling inference computation offers a way to improve diffusion transformers (DiTs), but taking more sampling steps leaves the depth of each denoising prediction unchanged. Recurrently reusing Transformer blocks increases computation within each step, allowing further refinement of hidden representations. Retrofitting pretrained models enables this capability without repeating pretraining, but requires blocks learned for fixed-depth computation to refine states produced by their own repeated application. The challenge is to use each additional pass to correct local errors without disrupting the structure established by earlier passes. We introduce LoopFit, which uses feedback from earlier passes to guide refinement at each image patch. Residual Attention Modulation (RAM) uses each patch's feature change in one pass to scale and shift its input to attention in the next. During training, Residual Relay Loss (RRL) gives greater weight to patches whose prediction errors persist across passes. A noise-dependent depth schedule speeds up sampling by using four passes at high noise and one at lower noise levels. At comparable cost, backbones trained with four passes solve more problems using recurrent depth than extra sampling steps. Across 12 visual puzzle settings, LoopFit solves 89.8% of boards, compared with 87.8% for the strongest baseline evaluated on all 12. Most of the gain comes from tracing long paths on mazes and frozen lakes.

</details>


### [114] [DocPristine: Content-Aware Document Appearance Enhancement under Real-World Mixed Degradations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32176)
*Zihan Huang,Junle Liu,Zhonghao Ye,Yuyi Zhang,Peirong Zhang,Hanlin Li,Yongxin Shi,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DocPristine利用冻结文档视觉编码器在退化文档中仍关注文本区域这一发现，将其多层特征注入像素复原网络，实现文档外观增强并提升下游文档解析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机拍摄文档常出现高光、阴影、模糊等混合退化，破坏背景并遮挡文字细节。现有方法要么依赖在严重退化下不可靠的输入视觉线索，要么依赖缺乏空间引导的LLM退化诊断。

Method: 关键洞察是预训练文档视觉编码器在退化文档上仍能关注文本区域，提供内容感知引导。据此提出DocPristine：自适应融合冻结文档视觉编码器的多层特征并注入像素复原网络，具体包含自适应多层特征融合（AMFF）、分层门控条件注入（HGC）和移位窗口交叉注意力（SWCA），后者借助跨窗口边界的邻域结构线索恢复细粒度文字细节。同时构建DocACE，含合成混合退化训练集DocACE-Synthetic与带人工复原真值及文档解析标注的真实测试集DocACE-Real。

Result: 在三个基准上的综合实验表明，DocPristine取得最先进的增强质量，并持续提升下游文档解析性能。

Conclusion: 冻结文档视觉编码器的内容感知引导是文档外观增强的有效信号；DocPristine配合新数据集DocACE在增强质量与下游解析上均优于现有方法，代码、模型与数据将公开。

Abstract: Camera-captured documents often exhibit mixed degradations, such as highlights, shadows, and blur, that distort backgrounds and obscure text details. Document appearance enhancement (DAE) aims to mitigate these degradations and improve readability. Existing document appearance enhancement methods rely either on input-derived visual cues that can become unreliable under severe degradation or on LLM-based degradation diagnosis that lacks spatial guidance. Notably, we find that pretrained document visual encoders continue to attend to text regions in degraded documents, providing content-aware guidance. Based on this insight, we propose DocPristine, which adaptively fuses multi-layer features from a frozen document visual encoder and injects them into a pixel restoration network. To integrate these features into a pixel restoration network, DocPristine combines Adaptive Multi-Layer Feature Fusion (AMFF), Hierarchical Gated Conditioning (HGC), and Shifted-Window Cross-Attention (SWCA). Specifically, SWCA draws on structural cues from neighboring locations across window boundaries to recover fine text details.We also introduce DocACE, with a synthetic mixed-degradation training set (DocACE-Synthetic) and a real-world test set (DocACE-Real) containing manually restored ground-truth images and document parsing annotations. Comprehensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate that DocPristine achieves state-of-the-art appearance enhancement quality and consistently improves downstream document parsing. Code, models, and data will be publicly available.

</details>


### [115] [When Repair Accuracy Misleads: Training a VLM on Its Own Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32982)
*Ang Qi,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文通过"验证的失败驱动修复"(VFR)方法研究视觉语言模型微调中的陷阱：挖掘出的失败样本存在标签错误与措辞捷径，需验证与最小对偶设计才能真修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在模型自身失败样本上微调是修复VLM的直接方法，但以留出失败准确率为衡量指标会产生误导：(1)挖出的失败中大量并非模型错误（100例人工审计中37例为标签错误）；(2)失败样本存在措辞规律性，仅凭问题文本的分类器就能答对73.2%的对偶。

Method: 提出VFR：类型化最小对偶失败挖掘、由三位LLM裁判在未见存储标签的情况下作答进行验证、答案优先的纠正目标、结合replay的LoRA微调。

Result: VFR修复82.8%的留出失败（基线10.0%）；在独立标注的无条件对上总体准确率87.4%→92.4%，空间关系66.7%→96.8%。但否定类在无条件对上88.7%→79.7%（尽管留出失败修复88.9%）；无验证降至80.8%（低于基线），无失败筛选仅92.0%且修复降至73.4%；双图关系准确率74.3%→49.6%；改写空间问题保留大部分增益（87.3% vs 62.0%），但留出修复92.9%→76.8%；What'sUp上yes/no准确率84.5%→26.4%。

Conclusion: 以留出失败准确率衡量修复会掩盖标签噪声与措辞捷径两类陷阱；必须引入裁判验证与失败筛选，同时需警惕否定、多图关系等能力退化及分布外泛化失败，提示修复评估需采用独立标注、多样改写的基准。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads. Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37. And mined failures share wording regularities: question-only classifiers get both answers right on 73.2% of held-out failure pairs. We study both traps with verified failure-driven repair (VFR): typed minimal-pair failure mining, verification by three LLM judges that answer without seeing the stored labels, answer-first corrective targets, and LoRA fine-tuning with replay. VFR repairs 82.8% of held-out failures (base model: 10.0%), and on independently labeled, unconditioned pairs it raises overall accuracy from 87.4% to 92.4% through spatial relations, whose accuracy rises from 66.7% to 96.8% even where the wording points to the wrong answer. Yet on negation, of which it repairs 88.9% of held-out failures, its accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls from 88.7% to 79.7%: it breaks negations about absent objects, rare in its training set. Without verification, accuracy on unconditioned pairs falls to 80.8%, below the base model's 87.4%, through a negation shortcut our development benchmarks miss; without failure selection, it stays at 92.0% (one seed) while repair falls to 73.4%. Training also lowers two-image relation accuracy (74.3% to 49.6%; replay data alone: 48.4%); multi-image replay partly and unevenly reverses this. Paraphrasing the spatial questions keeps most of the gain (87.3% vs. the base model's 62.0%), though rewording lowers spatial repair on held-out failures from 92.9% to 76.8%. On What'sUp's independent photos of objects under others, caption choice stays perfect while accuracy on our yes/no pairs falls from 84.5% to 26.4%.

</details>


### [116] [SolarFilNet-V4: Multi-Scale Transformer Vision with Physics-Informed Adaptive Post-Processing for Solar Filament Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32193)
*Indra Agustian,Ruvita Faurina*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SolarFilNet-V4 是一个面向 GONG H-alpha 日珥/暗条分割的轻量框架，结合 PVT-v2-B1 主干、各向异性曲线条带卷积与双频前馈块，并在 MAGFiLO 1.0 基准上取得 OOF PQ 0.4340、公榜 0.380，参数 15.46M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地面 GONG H-alpha 观测（2048×2048）中单个暗条分割困难：对比度低、纤维结构湍乱、barb 精细、标注边界不一致；且日珥失稳会触发日冕物质抛射与空间天气灾害，需要可靠的自动分割。

Method: 主干采用轻量 PVT-v2-B1，配合 k=15 的各向异性曲线条带卷积与双频前馈块（DFFN）以跟踪延展磁绳并捕捉细中心脊；增加 1024×1024 全分辨率浅层卷积分支保留高频边缘、缓解 Transformer 下采样损失。训练使用掩码、中心线脊、barb 边界与像素对比表征的多任务监督；测试时采用 8 折二面体（D4）TTA、双线性上采样至 2048×2048，并施加按静日/活动日自适应校准形态学连接参数的后处理。

Result: 官方基准上折外验证 Panoptic Quality 为 0.4340，Public Leaderboard 得分 0.380；模型参数 15.46M，单次前向 224.34 GFLOPs，相比标准 ResNet-34 U-Net 基线参数减少 36.8%。

Conclusion: 该项技术报告表明，将轻量 Transformer 主干与曲线卷积、高分辨率细节分支及多任务监督、活动自适应后处理结合，可在低对比度 H-alpha 数据上实现有效的暗条分割，并在显著压缩参数量的同时取得可用的基准性能。

Abstract: Solar filaments are cool, dense chromospheric plasma structures held by magnetic field lines above polarity inversion lines. Their destabilization triggers coronal mass ejections and severe space weather hazards. Segmenting individual filaments from ground-based GONG H-alpha observations (2048 x 2048 pixels) is challenging due to low contrast, turbulent fibrils, delicate barb structures, and annotator boundary variance. In this technical report, we describe SolarFilNet-V4, a targeted segmentation framework developed for the MAGFiLO 1.0 benchmark (Solar Filament Segmentation Challenge 2026). Our method couples a lightweight Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT-v2-B1) backbone with anisotropic curvilinear strip convolutions (k=15) and dual-frequency feed-forward blocks (DFFN) to follow extended flux ropes while capturing thin central spines. A shallow full-resolution convolutional branch operating at 1024 x 1024 preserves high-frequency edge details and mitigates transformer downsampling. We train the network using multi-task supervision over masks, centerline spines, barb boundaries, and pixel-contrastive representations. At test time, we apply 8-fold dihedral test-time augmentation (D4), bilinearly upscale predictions to the native 2048 x 2048 grid, and apply an activity-adaptive post-processing routine that calibrates morphological joining parameters for quiet versus active solar disks. On the official benchmark, SolarFilNet-V4 achieves an out-of-fold validation Panoptic Quality of 0.4340 and a Public Leaderboard score of 0.380. The model contains 15.46M parameters and requires 224.34 GFLOPs per forward pass, reducing parameter count by 36.8% compared to standard ResNet-34 U-Net baselines.

</details>


### [117] [What to Change, What to Keep: Experience-Evolving Agents for Video Recasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32196)
*Shiying Zhang,Yuxia Zhu,Huaze Xue,Shengqi Dang,Yizhen Wu,Yijie Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RecastAgent，一个在冻结模型权重下、以经验引导的智能体框架，实现源条件视频重铸，并构建了评测基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频重铸（将现有视频的实体与环境转换为新视觉世界，同时保留核心动作与交互）中，协同编辑易破坏原始事件结构，难以实现连贯变换。

Method: 框架包含经验引导规划器（Experience-Guided Planner），在定性视觉批评下选择编辑提示和输入视频状态，支持在部分进展上继续或回退以保留源结构；另有经验积累模块（Experience Accumulation），将完成轨迹蒸馏为条件化、证据关联的原则，记录编辑策略及其有效范围。

Result: 在 Bernini 和 Ditto 上优于单次生成与智能体重写基线；累积经验在留出测试视频上提升性能，并零样本迁移至 FiVE-Bench 和 VE-Bench。

Conclusion: 经验引导的智能体框架可在不训练模型的情况下有效提升视频重铸的一致性与泛化能力；同时构建了含 67 个源视频、134 个配对规格任务、覆盖六类创意类别的基准。

Abstract: Video recasting aims to transform the entities and environments of existing videos into new visual worlds while preserving their essential actions and interactions. However, achieving coherent transformations remains challenging, as coordinated edits can disrupt the original event structure. In this paper, we introduce RecastAgent, an experience-guided agentic framework for source-conditioned video recasting that operates under frozen model weights. Our framework employs an Experience-Guided Planner to choose edit prompts and input video states under qualitative visual critique, allowing the agent to build upon partial progress or backtrack to preserve source structure. Across tasks, an Experience Accumulation module distills completed trajectories into conditional, evidence-linked principles that record both an editing strategy and its scope of validity. We additionally construct a benchmark of 67 source videos with 134 paired-specification tasks across six creative categories for evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that RecastAgent outperforms single-pass and agentic rewriting baselines across Bernini and Ditto. Furthermore, accumulated experience improves performance on held-out test videos and transfers zero-shot to external benchmarks like FiVE-Bench and VE-Bench.

</details>


### [118] [MoGe-4D: Efficient, Flexible, and Unified Dense 4D Reconstruction and Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32198)
*Ruicheng Wang,Linlin Xin,Sicheng Xu,Jianfeng Xiang,Zelong Lv,Yu Deng,Yue Dong,Guangzhong Sun,Tong Zhang,Jiaolong Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MoGe-4D 用一个前馈框架，通过成对的对偶点图（allocentric + egocentric）有序查询，统一了动态场景的几何重建与运动/跟踪预测，并用 RigIDTrack 数据管线解决稠密 4D 监督问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从 RGB 视频重建动态场景需要同时推理 3D 几何与跨视角运动，但现有方法要么把重建和跟踪拆成碎片化流水线，要么面临不可承受的稠密时空解码开销；同时稠密 4D 查询的监督需要连续 3D 对应，原始轨迹存储代价过高。

Method: 提出有序查询的成对点图：每个查询将源像素映射到目标时间、并在相机坐标系与自我坐标系两种表达下同时给出，可闭式求解相对相机位姿，并灵活支持深度、动态配准和稠密 3D 跟踪。效率上将场景建模与查询解码解耦：大容量上下文编码器一次性缓存粗粒度全局时空特征，轻量查询编码器以灵活分辨率快速解码稠密点图。监督方面引入 RigIDTrack 合成数据管线与数据集，将表面动态压缩为刚性正则化的仿射体，从而以约 15%（相对 RGB-D 视频）的存储开销恢复任意帧的精确 3D 轨迹。

Result: 在多个基准上，MoGe-4D 取得 SOTA 的稠密 3D 跟踪性能，重建精度与专用 3D 基础模型持平，且运行速度显著快于既有 4D 基线。

Conclusion: 通过成对点图查询统一几何与运动、解耦式编码-解码实现高效稠密查询，并配合低成本高保真的合成 4D 监督数据，MoGe-4D 为动态场景重建与跟踪提供了一个高效且可扩展的前馈方案。

Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from RGB video requires reasoning about both 3D geometry and motion across viewpoints, yet existing methods either split reconstruction and tracking into fragmented pipelines or face prohibitive dense spatiotemporal decoding costs. We introduce MoGe-4D, a feed-forward framework that unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps. Each query maps source pixels to a target time simultaneously in both camera frames, resolving relative camera pose in closed form while flexibly serving depth, dynamic registration, and dense 3D tracking. For efficient dense querying, MoGe-4D decouples scene modeling from query decoding: a high-capacity context encoder caches coarse global spatiotemporal features once, while a lightweight query encoder rapidly decodes dense point maps at flexible resolutions. Furthermore, as supervising dense 4D queries demands continuous 3D correspondences whose raw trajectory storage is prohibitive, we introduce RigIDTrack, a synthetic data pipeline and dataset that compresses surface dynamics into rigidity-regularized affine bodies, recovering exact arbitrary-frame 3D trajectories with $\sim15\%$ storage overhead over RGB-D video. Across diverse benchmarks, MoGe-4D achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking, matches dedicated 3D foundation models in reconstruction, and runs substantially faster than prior 4D baselines.

</details>


### [119] [SplatTok: Data-Driven Compression of 3D Gaussian Splats with Scene-Level Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32202)
*Sai Karthikey Pentapati,Shashank Nelamangala Sridhara,Birendra Kathariya,Peng Yin,Guandao Yang,Alan C. Bovik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SplatTok 是一个学习式场景重合成编解码器：用 transformer 将输入高斯泼溅编码为紧凑、空间锚定的潜变量 tokens，共享解码器重新合成一套全新的标准高斯原语，并通过量化感知的潜变量搜索进一步降低误差，实现 75–110 倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D Gaussian splats 支持实时渲染但存储开销巨大。现有压缩方法要么只编码给定原语，要么为每个场景单独优化紧凑表示，忽略了"一个高斯泼溅只是场景的一种实现"这一事实——不同原语排布可产生几乎相同的渲染视图，这一自由度为解码端优化提供了空间。

Method: 在数千个真实场景上训练：transformer 编码器将现有 splat 编码为紧凑的空间锚定潜 tokens；共享解码器合成新的标准高斯原语集合，不要求与输入保持对应关系；以渲染监督而非原语重建学习表示。压缩时进行量化感知潜变量搜索，仅优化场景码、冻结网络，弥补编码器剩余误差。

Result: 仅用输入 splat 的渲染图（不用原始训练图像）做潜搜索时，PSNR 与前馈编解码器 FCGS 相当，文件小 4–6.5 倍，对输入 splat 压缩约 75–110 倍；使用训练图像时，PSNR 超过逐场景方法 HAC++，文件小 13–41%。在 DL3DV 上训练的单一模型可泛化到含数百万高斯的未见场景，并支持多目标码率而无需重训练。

Conclusion: 借助渲染等价性在解码端重新合成原语，SplatTok 以单一泛化模型同时取得高压缩率与高保真度，优于前馈与逐场景压缩方法，并支持免重训练的多码率适配。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian splats enable real-time rendering but require substantial storage. Existing compression methods either encode the primitives of a given splat or optimize a compact representation independently for each scene. Yet a Gaussian splat is only one realization of a scene: different arrangements of primitives can produce nearly identical rendered views. We exploit this freedom on the decoding side with SplatTok, a learned scene-resynthesis codec. Trained across thousands of real-world scenes, a transformer encodes an existing splat into compact, spatially anchored latent tokens, and a shared decoder synthesizes a new set of standard Gaussian primitives without preserving correspondence to the input. The representation is learned through rendering supervision rather than primitive reconstruction. At compression time, a quantization-aware latent search refines only the scene code, keeping the networks frozen, and closes most of the encoder's remaining error. On standard benchmarks, using only renders of the input splat for the latent search, without the original training images, SplatTok matches the PSNR of the feed-forward codec FCGS with 4 to 6.5 times smaller files, compressing input splats about 75 to 110 times. With the training images, it exceeds the PSNR of the per-scene method HAC++ with 13 to 41% smaller files. A single model trained on DL3DV generalizes to unseen scenes with millions of Gaussians and supports multiple target rates without retraining.

</details>


### [120] [Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32206)
*Qing Zhang,Xuesong Li,Zhaoyuan Yang,Changlin Song,Xinyu Tian,Jing Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示视觉-语言-动作模型(VLA)存在"看见却不触及"现象：物体被移动后仍伸向训练位置，源于场景捷径与指令捷径；通过分离掩码证明视觉接地已被引导但常被指令捷径覆盖，并提出无需训练的Pathway-Separated Guidance(PSG)缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型被期望继承视觉-语言模型的视觉接地能力，但在物体移动后常伸向原训练位置。作者想弄清这种视觉接地是完全未被使用，还是被其他通路覆盖。

Method: 在六个VLA上识别两类捷径(场景捷径、指令捷径)；分别掩码"图像介导的接地通路"和"指令直连动作通路"来分析机制；提出Pathway-Separated Guidance(PSG)，放大接地并抑制捷径，无需训练或外部目标位置。

Result: 掩码接地通路后，对移动目标的伸向消失；掩码直连通路后反而增加。在π0.5中指令捷径持续存在，尽管物体名称注意力跟随移动目标。LIBERO-PRO Object位置扰动下，PSG将目标到达率从22.0%提升至52.6%，任务成功率从16.6%提升至40.8%，且基本保持原任务性能。
