Result: 在OceanSim合成基准上，点云Chamfer距离较双目重建降低60%；相比匹配的纯点云补全骨干，5mm缺失区域恢复率由16.27%提升至24.16%；共享CAD后端下外部接受率由6/19升至14/19；真实水下采集上定性恢复了六件3D打印物体的主要结构。

Conclusion: 保留并利用原始视图的多视角证据可显著提升水下重建的几何质量与CAD可编辑性，验证了该方法在合成与真实场景中的有效性。

Abstract: Recovering editable computer-aided design (CAD) models from underwater stereo images requires accurate and complete geometry, yet stereo reconstruction produces displaced points and missing regions. The original views retain cross-view disagreement and ray evidence lost during point-cloud fusion. Aqua2CAD exploits this evidence in two stages: view-conditioned correction and quality filtering establish reliable geometric support, while multi-view observations condition a learned shape prior to infer missing surfaces in the original metric frame. The recovered points support surface fitting and solid assembly with manually revised face groups. On an OceanSim-based synthetic benchmark, Aqua2CAD reduces point-cloud Chamfer distance by 60% relative to the stereo reconstruction. Compared with a matched point-only completion backbone, it improves missing-region recovery at 5,mm from 16.27% to 24.16%. With a shared CAD backend, exterior acceptance increases from 6/19 to 14/19. Qualitative results on selected real underwater captures demonstrate recovery of the main structures of six 3D-printed objects.

</details>


### [225] [DOPER: Deep Object Pose Estimation Revisited](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32846)
*Hugo Hadfield,Alperen Degirmenci,Jonathan Tremblay*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DOPER 是一个基于 RGB 的 6D 位姿估计框架，通过共享视觉骨干联合学习目标检测、分割与关键点预测，结合合成训练与真实多视图几何约束进行适配，在多个数据集上达到 SOTA 检测 AP 并实现实时运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 6D 位姿估计方法往往依赖深度输入或学习式位姿精化模块，且需要完整精确的 CAD 模型；同时合成数据到真实场景的域差距导致关键点监督不足，对应关系模糊问题难以解决。

Method: 采用共享视觉骨干联合完成目标检测、分割与关键点预测，并用 PnP 恢复 6D 位姿；从合成数据训练出发，利用标定多视图观测提供几何约束作为部分监督适配真实数据，同时保留合成关键点标签；推理时可选热图精化，将刚性位姿直接拟合到预测关键点分布以消除模糊对应；从欠规范 CAD 模型出发逐步精化物体表示与位姿估计器。

Result: 在 SPEED+ 和 SHIRT 上表现出对光照变化的有效适配与准确时序位姿估计；在 HANDAL、HOPEv2、HOT3D、T-LESS 的单视图与多视图配置下均取得 SOTA 检测 AP，仅用 RGB 且在单块 GB300 上每物体模型达 35 Hz 实时性能。

Conclusion: 联合学习检测与位姿关键点、并结合真实观测与几何约束是有效的；无需深度与学习式位姿精化即可实现实时、高精度的 6D 位姿估计。

Abstract: We present DOPER, an RGB pose estimation framework that shares a visual backbone across object detection, segmentation, and keypoint prediction to recover the 6D pose of known objects through Perspective-n-Point. Starting from synthetic training, DOPER adapts to real observations using partial supervision while retaining synthetic keypoint labels. Calibrated multi-view observations provide geometric constraints for keypoint supervision. During inference, optional heatmap refinement fits a rigid pose directly to the predicted keypoint distributions, resolving ambiguous correspondences without depth input or a learned pose refiner. Starting from underspecified CAD models, DOPER progressively refines the object representation and pose estimator. Results on SPEED+ and SHIRT further demonstrate effective adaptation to illumination changes and accurate temporal pose estimation. Across the evaluated single-view and multi-view configurations, DOPER achieves state-of-the-art detection AP results on HANDAL, HOPEv2, HOT3D, and T-LESS while using only RGB and running in real time (35 Hz per object model on one GB300). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly learning detection and pose keypoints, with real observations and geometric constraints.

</details>


### [226] [CityRecast: Suppressing Persistent Artifacts in Generative Satellite 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32863)
*Shuo Cui,Yingyan Hou,Wanxuan Lu,Hongfeng Yu,Daobing Zhang,Xian Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CityRecast通过高斯场景修复与监督校准抑制卫星三维重建中的伪影，尤其改善低仰角渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 卫星观测稀疏且跨日期变化大，现有生成先验方法恢复的Gaussian场景仍存在鬼影、条纹和模糊，在低仰角渲染中尤为严重。

Method: 1) 多角度预热约束高斯空间范围，减少初始鬼影；2) 表面引导替换在保留外观的同时修复高斯分布；3) 观测校准缓解多时相观测干扰，提供更可靠监督；4) 联合细化减少生成视图间冲突。

Result: 在DFC2019和IARPA上低仰角渲染伪影减少且保持卫星视图保真度；相比Skyfall-GS，FID-CLIP下降25.3%（DFC2019）和51.8%（IARPA），MUSIQ分别提升14.54和24.95分。

Conclusion: 结合高斯修复与监督校准可有效抑制卫星三维重建伪影，显著提升低仰角渲染质量。

Abstract: Satellite-based 3D reconstruction is limited by sparse observations and changes across acquisition dates. Existing methods use generative priors to recover missing visual detail, but ghosting, streaking, and blur persist in their Gaussian scenes. These artifacts become particularly apparent in low-elevation renderings. We introduce CityRecast to suppress these artifacts through Gaussian scene repair and supervision calibration. To correct the Gaussian distributions that produce these artifacts, we first use multi-angle warm-up to constrain their spatial extent. This reduces the initial ghosting carried into progressive refinement. Surface-guided replacement then continues to repair the Gaussian distribution while preserving existing appearance. To provide more reliable supervision for this process, observation calibration mitigates interference from multi-temporal observations. Joint refinement further reduces conflicts among generated views. Experiments on DFC2019 and IARPA demonstrate reduced artifacts in low-elevation renderings while maintaining satellite-view fidelity. Compared with Skyfall-GS, CityRecast reduces FID-CLIP by 25.3% on DFC2019 and 51.8% on IARPA. MUSIQ increases by 14.54 and 24.95 points, respectively.

</details>


### [227] [MemHand: Memory-Enhanced World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32876)
*Junyi Ma,Zhangshuo Qi,Erhang Zhang,Mingjie Li,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MemHand 用"短期事件记忆+长期尺度记忆"两种互补记忆替代固定长度时间窗口，在遮挡/出视野情况下实现连续、米制准确的世界坐标双手运动重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从第一视角视频恢复双手在世界空间中的连续运动，对机器人策略迁移和AR很重要。单帧重建不足，因为重建所需上下文常随时间分散（尤其在遮挡或手移出视野时）。现有方法虽利用时间上下文，但多取自固定长度窗口，无法保证每帧都获得准确位姿和米制尺度所需的上下文。

Method: 提出 MemHand 记忆增强框架，维护两种互补记忆：(1) 短期事件记忆（Short-Term Event Memory），保存每个遮挡或出视野事件前后"观测良好手"的上下文，供给视觉证据薄弱或缺失的帧；(2) 长期尺度记忆（Long-Term Scale Memory），利用米制尺度在整段视频中保持一致的性质，在有限状态内保留全视频最可靠的观测作为尺度锚点。

Result: 在存在严重遮挡和频繁出视野的基准上达到SOTA精度，并对未见域泛化良好。相比 StableHand，ARCTIC 上 W-MPJPE 降低 57%，HOT3D 上降低 70%，输出连续且米制准确的世界空间手部位姿与轨迹。

Conclusion: 两种记忆协同有效弥补固定窗口的不足；代码与模型将在项目页面 https://irmvlab.github.io/memhand.github.io 发布。

Abstract: Recovering the continuous world-space motion of both hands from egocentric video is essential for applications such as human-to-robot policy transfer and augmented reality. Achieving this goes beyond reconstructing the hands from each individual frame, as the context that a frame needs is often spread over time, especially around occlusions or when a hand moves out of sight. Recent works have explored how to exploit temporal context, yet they mostly draw it from fixed-length windows. Such windows cannot guarantee that every frame has the context required to reconstruct the hands in world space with accurate poses and metric scale. To address this limitation, we introduce MemHand, a memory-enhanced framework for world-space hand motion reconstruction. MemHand maintains two complementary forms of memory. The Short-Term Event Memory keeps the context of the well-observed hand around each occlusion or out-of-sight event and supplies it to frames with weak or missing visual evidence. In addition, since the metric scale holds over the whole recording, the Long-Term Scale Memory retains the most reliable observations across the video as scale anchors within a bounded state. Across benchmarks featuring severe occlusions and frequent out-of-sight intervals, MemHand achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and generalizes well to unseen domains. Benefiting from the synergy of both memories, it cuts W-MPJPE by 57\% on ARCTIC and 70\% on HOT3D relative to StableHand, delivering continuous and metrically accurate world-space hand poses and trajectories. We will release our code and models at the project page: https://irmvlab.github.io/memhand.github.io

</details>


### [228] [Simultaneously Boosting Efficiency and Capability for Linear Attention via Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32877)
*Senqi Guan,Xianchao Zhang,Moyan Tian,Linlin Zong,Wenxin Liang,Xinyue Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种嵌入自适应通道压缩与激活纯化机制（ACCAP）的轻量线性注意力模块 ACCAP-LA，在降低参数与计算量的同时保持视觉Transformer的表征能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自注意力的二次复杂度是ViT的核心瓶颈，而现有softmax与线性注意力优化普遍牺牲模型表征能力，导致性能下降，形成效率与能力的矛盾。

Method: 首次在QKV投影中嵌入ACCAP机制，使模型在低通道计算的同时保留高维特征信息；并将聚焦核函数与自门控模块融入ACCAP，构成轻量线性注意力模块ACCAP-LA。

Result: 理论分析显示，相比标准线性注意力，ACCAP-LA使注意力模块参数量减少79.17%、FLOPs减少77.5%。应用于ViT时仅5.8M参数即在ImageNet-1K上达79.4% Top-1准确率；在EfficientViT-b1和PVT-T上分别提升3.3%和3.4%，展现良好跨架构兼容性。

Conclusion: ACCAP-LA有效缓解效率与能力的两难问题，兼具轻量高效与强表征能力，并具备跨架构通用性。

Abstract: Self-attention's quadratic complexity constitutes a core bottleneck for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Existing efficiency-oriented optimizations, including softmax-based and linear attention (LA) variants, generally compromise model representational capacity, leading to inevitable performance degradation. We propose a novel linear attention which alleviates this efficiency-capability dilemma. For the first time, we embed an Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism into the QKV projection of linear attention, which enables the model to retain high-dimensional feature information while performing computations with reduced channels. We further fuse a focused kernel function and a self-gating module into ACCAP to construct a lightweight linear attention module (ACCAP-LA). Our theoretical analysis shows that, compared to standard linear attention, ACCAP-LA reduces the attention module's parameter count by 79.17% and FLOPs by 77.5%. Extensive experiments demonstrate ACCAP-LA's effectiveness: when applied to ViT, it achieves 79.4% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K with only 5.8M parameters, and more notably, it boasts strong cross-architecture compatibility, boosting EfficientViT-b1 and PVT-T by 3.3% and 3.4% respectively.

</details>


### [229] [3D Tracking Any Point with Events and Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32883)
*Roberto Pellerito,Zijia Dai,Laurent Kneip,Davide Scaramuzza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TrackAnyMotion 融合单目 RGB 帧与事件相机数据，实现任意点在 2D/3D 上的连续追踪，即使没有 RGB 帧的时刻也能追踪，并发布 HyperEvent 合成数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB 帧模糊或帧间隔过大时难以追踪快速运动点，事件相机可记录帧间亮度变化，填补时间空白，但需与 RGB 有效融合以同时处理几何与独立运动。

Method: 利用场景几何与相机运动计算静态点的期望运动作为参考，识别独立运动物体；提出独立运动解码器，融合几何运动线索、事件引导与 2D 轨迹，并将预测反馈至迭代式 2D/3D 细化流程。

Result: 在 RGB 帧时刻，3D 与 2D 端点误差分别降低 70% 和 32%（基于其提出的 HyperEvent 基准）。

Conclusion: 结合 RGB 与事件数据的多模态追踪方案可显著提升快速运动点的 2D/3D 追踪精度，HyperEvent 数据集为相关研究提供高频率轨迹、几何与独立运动标注。

Abstract: Tracking a fast-moving point in 3D is prohibitive when RGB frames are blurred or too far apart to reveal its motion. Event cameras record brightness changes between frames, providing measurements inside these temporal gaps. We introduce TrackAnyMotion, which combines monocular RGB frames and events to track arbitrary points in 2D and 3D, including at times when no RGB frame is available. The motion expected for a static point, given scene geometry and camera motion, provides a reference for identifying independently moving objects. An independent-motion decoder combines geometric motion cues with event guidance and 2D tracks, feeding its predictions back into iterative 2D and 3D refinement. We also introduce HyperEvent, a synthetic RGB--Event dataset with high-frequency 3D trajectories, geometry, and independent-motion labels. At RGB frame timestamps on this benchmark, TrackAnyMotion reduces 3D and 2D endpoint errors by 70\% and 32\%, respectively.

</details>


### [230] [Biomechanically Grounded Prediction of Selective Motor Control and Clinical Outcomes from Infant Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32890)
*Divya Joshi,Ruize Yang,Colleen Peyton,R. James Cotton*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BB3D：从单摄像头视频估计婴儿3D关节角度轨迹的生物力学流程，配合时空Transformer预测BabyOSCAR各项评分，在无诊断标签训练下以AUC 0.86区分脑瘫患儿，优于2D特征方法但低于专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脑瘫早期识别依赖GMA、BabyOSCAR等观察性评估，需训练有素的评分者且耗时。现有自动化方法基于二维关键点的手工特征，只描述图像平面运动，无法反映单个关节的三维运动行为。

Method: 构建婴儿适配的生物力学pipeline，从单目视频估计3D关节角度轨迹；以17名婴儿的多视角无标记动捕为参考做验证；用1k+单摄录音预训练时空Transformer，再在350名婴儿的550段视频上微调，逐项预测BabyOSCAR评分及总分。

Result: 关节中心Procrustes对齐误差中位数17.5 mm、标记点20.4 mm；逐项预测平均站点内AUC 0.79，总分Spearman相关0.86；未用诊断训练，预测总分区分脑瘫AUC 0.86，高于复现的2D特征分类器(0.67)，低于专家评分(0.97)；预测分数亦携带功能能力与身体分布信息但弱于专家。

Conclusion: 生物力学基础的单目视频表征可支持可扩展、关节级别的婴儿选择性运动控制评估。

Abstract: Early identification of cerebral palsy (CP) relies on observational assessments of spontaneous infant movement, such as the General Movement Assessment (GMA) and the Baby Observational Selective Control AppRaisal (BabyOSCAR), which require trained raters and substantial scoring time. Existing automated approaches derive hand-engineered features from two-dimensional keypoints, which describe image-plane motion rather than the three-dimensional behavior of individual joints. We present Baby Biomechanical 3D Body (BB3D), an infant-adapted, biomechanical pipeline that estimates joint-angle trajectories from single-camera video. Against a multi-view markerless motion capture reference in 17 infants, BB3D's median Procrustes-aligned error was 17.5~mm for joint centers and 20.4~mm for marker sites. A spatio-temporal transformer, pretrained on BB3D joint-angle trajectories from 1k+ single-camera recordings, and fine-tuned on 550 videos from 350 infants, predicted each individual BabyOSCAR item with a mean within-site AUC of 0.79 and the BabyOSCAR total with a Spearman correlation of 0.86 on held-out recordings. Without being trained on diagnosis, the predicted total separated infants with CP from those without CP with an AUC of 0.86, exceeding a replicated two-dimensional feature classifier (0.67) but below the expert clinician rater's total (0.97). Predicted scores also carried information about functional ability and body distribution, though less than expert clinician scores. These results show that biomechanically grounded representations of monocular video can support scalable, joint-level assessment of selective motor control in infancy

</details>


### [231] [DualSpec: Spectral Reconstruction with Optimized Stereo Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32896)
*Luca Cogo,Marco Buzzelli,Simone Bianco,Raimondo Schettini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 DualSpec，一种联合优化两块外置光学滤光片与重建网络的立体RGB采集框架，用六个响应互补地恢复稠密光谱，显著降低光谱角误差并具备跨数据集泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专用光谱相机昂贵笨重，而从RGB图像反演稠密光谱存在根本歧义：不同光谱可产生相同相机响应，现有先进算法也难以完全消除。因此在采集阶段增加光谱信息至关重要。

Method: DualSpec 采用立体采集：两台标准RGB相机前各放置一块外置滤光片，两块滤光片与重建网络端到端联合优化，使六个通道响应为网络提供互补信息；并在不同重建架构与光谱范围上验证。

Result: 平均光谱角误差相对单台RGB相机降低36–72%，相对从商用滤光片中挑选的立体组合降低11–29%。跨数据集评估（含新建的位移视点光谱图像基准）显示方法可泛化且对视点错位具有鲁棒性，薄膜近似分析支持光学可实现性。

Conclusion: 通过在采集端主动设计滤光片来注入互补光谱信息，可有效缓解RGB反演光谱的病态性，是一种低成本、可落地且鲁棒的光谱成像方案。

Abstract: Spectral imaging captures information that ordinary RGB sensors cannot, but dedicated spectral cameras can be expensive and bulky. Recovering dense spectra from RGB images offers an accessible alternative, but distinct spectra can produce the same camera response, generating an ambiguity that even more advanced recovery algorithms cannot always resolve. Therefore, increasing the spectral information captured at acquisition is essential. We propose DualSpec, a stereo acquisition framework that jointly optimizes two external optical filters and a reconstruction network. Each filter is placed in front of a standard RGB camera, and the two are designed to produce six responses that provide complementary information for the network. Experiments across reconstruction architectures and spectral ranges show that DualSpec reduces mean spectral angle error by 36-72% relative to a single RGB camera and by 11-29% relative to stereo pairs selected from commercial filters. Cross-dataset evaluations, including a new benchmark of spectral images captured from displaced viewpoints, show that the method generalizes and remains robust to viewpoint misalignment, while analyses of thin-film approximations support optical feasibility.

</details>


### [232] [Motion Conditioned World Modeling for Embodied Visual Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32900)
*Jiahao Zhang,Xuan Yao,Junyu Gao,Changsheng Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出运动条件化世界模型(Motion-Conditioned World Modeling)，将目标运动分布与机器人自运动编码进潜状态转移，用几何-进度模块建模路径选择与进度不确定性，并以未来视觉特征重建监督运动预测，在三个具身跟踪基准上以0.5B轻量骨干取得更优跟踪性能与跨环境泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身视觉跟踪中，目标运动不确定且机器人视角变化共同影响观测，导致未来状态预测困难；现有世界模型缺乏对目标运动不确定性与机器人自运动的显式建模。

Method: 构建运动条件化世界模型：预测目标运动分布与机器人自运动并注入潜状态转移；Geometry–Progress模块通过共享运动模式与路径条件化进度分布，联合建模几何路径与单步移动距离；利用动作诱导的坐标变换将预测路径映射到下一机器人坐标系作为几何条件；以未来视觉特征重建经条件化转移分支监督运动预测；联合运动似然、特征重建与专家动作监督优化策略。

Result: 在三个具身跟踪基准上实验，跟踪性能与跨环境泛化能力均有提升，且仅使用0.5B轻量骨干网络。

Conclusion: 将显式运动表示与几何条件引入世界模型的潜状态转移，可有效桥接运动预测与后续观测，为具身视觉跟踪提供兼顾不确定性与泛化性的轻量化方案。

Abstract: World models support embodied decision-making by predicting future environment states. In embodied visual tracking, uncertain target motion and robot-induced viewpoint changes jointly affect visual observations, making future-state prediction challenging. We propose Motion-Conditioned World Modeling, which incorporates predicted target-motion distributions and robot ego-motion into latent state transitions. A Geometry--Progress module jointly models geometric paths and single-step travel distances through shared motion modes and path-conditioned progress distributions. This formulation captures uncertainty in route selection and motion progress while preserving their dependence. Action-induced coordinate transformations express predicted paths in the next robot frame, providing geometrically grounded conditions for future visual-state prediction. Future visual feature reconstruction supervises the motion predictor through the conditioned transition branch, linking explicit motion representations to subsequent observations. The model is jointly optimized with motion likelihood, feature reconstruction, and expert-action supervision, enabling the tracking policy to combine visual context with predictive motion cues.Experiments on three embodied tracking benchmarks demonstrate improved tracking performance and cross-environment generalization with a lightweight $0.5$B backbone.

</details>


### [233] [Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32940)
*Dohoon Kim,Taesup Moon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视觉语言模型（VLM）大多无法预先知道自己种类层面的视觉弱点，但在实际解题时（答案概率）会隐性地体现出自身特有的弱点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 元认知不只是判断单个答案对错，还包括知道自己"在哪些类型任务上弱"。作者想检验VLM能否事先了解哪些视觉任务和图像条件对自己困难，并区分"所有模型共同的难度"与"模型自身特有的弱点"。

Method: 在大量开源与闭源VLM上测试其对任务类型和图像退化条件的预先自我预测；把共同难度与模型特有难度分离；再训练模型预测自身准确率；并考察模型在解答若干无标签同类型问题后赋予自身答案的概率。

Result: VLM对自身视觉弱点事先知之甚少：误判整体准确率，甚至不知道哪些任务对所有模型都难；多数误判图像退化的影响。训练其预测准确率，只能学到训练中未见任务类型上的自身准确率水平，学不到"哪些类型难"。但一旦开始解题，答案概率能反映出模型特有的弱点（跨任务类型与图像条件）。

Conclusion: VLM持有关于自身弱点的信息，但其显式预测未反映出来；将模型特有与普遍难度分离可构成评估"教模型认识自身弱点"方法的测试，而答案概率可作为起点信号。

Abstract: Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. However, information about these weaknesses appears once a model starts solving. On a few unlabeled questions of a kind, the probability a model assigns to its own answers follows weaknesses particular to the model, across kinds of tasks and image conditions. VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that their stated predictions do not yet reflect. By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our evaluation offers a test for methods that aim to teach VLMs their own weaknesses, and the answer probability offers them a signal to start from.

</details>


### [234] [IMPACT-Seg: Consistent Anatomical Segmentation and Representation Learning Across CT, CBCT, and MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32903)
*Cédric Hémon,Valentin Boussot,Matthew McCormick,Lukas Zimmermann,Christopher Kurz,Guillaume Landry*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IMPACT-Seg 用统一的稠密解剖分割监督（126 个结构，跨 CT/CBCT/MRI 共享参数）来获得跨模态一致的解剖表征，无需显式特征对齐，同时在分割与形变配准任务上取得领先结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT、CBCT 与 MRI 提供互补解剖信息，但外观差异大，导致自适应放疗中分割与形变配准的一致性难以保证。作者想验证：仅靠稠密解剖分割监督是否足以诱导跨模态对应关系，而不必依赖显式特征对齐。

Method: 构建 8,290 例体数据：公共队列经标签协调、模型辅助伪标签补全与迭代精修，并加入 2,864 例基于物理仿真的 CBCT（带体素对齐的 CT 标签）。用非配对图像联合训练 2.5D 与 3D 残差编码器网络，共享参数分割 126 个结构。

Result: 139 例真实 CBCT 上 3D 模型平均 Dice 0.842（最强对比方法 0.671）；497 对体素对齐 CT-仿真 CBCT 上 Dice 下降仅 0.022（对比方法 0.153–0.178）；胰腺放疗 CBCT 上胃肠道 Dice 0.735 vs TotalSegmentator 0.634；配准 CT-CBCT 预测一致性 0.881、CT-MRI 0.790；加入 MRI 训练后 CT-MRI 编码器特征检索误差由 36.8mm 降至 3.2mm；含该特征的配准流程在两个 Learn2Reg 多模态基准上排名第一；全身 CT 分割耗时 15 秒。

Conclusion: 稠密解剖分割监督可支撑跨模态一致的解剖表征，并同时服务于分割与配准；代码、数据与预训练模型已开源。

Abstract: Computed tomography (CT), cone-beam CT (CBCT), and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provide complementary representations of the same underlying anatomy, yet substantial differences in image appearance challenge consistent segmentation and deformable registration in adaptive radiotherapy. We investigate whether dense anatomical segmentation supervision can promote cross-modality correspondence without explicit feature alignment. We introduce IMPACT-Seg, which segments 126 structures across CT, CBCT, and MRI using shared network parameters. A collection of 8,290 volumes was assembled from public cohorts through label harmonization, model-assisted pseudo-label completion, iterative refinement, and 2,864 physics-based CBCT simulations with voxel-aligned CT labels. Unpaired images were used to jointly train 2.5D and 3D residual-encoder networks.
  On 139 real CBCTs, IMPACT-Seg 3D achieved a mean Dice of 0.842 versus 0.671 for the strongest comparator. On 497 voxel-aligned CT-simulated-CBCT pairs, the CT-to-CBCT Dice decrease was 0.022 versus 0.153-0.178 for competing methods. On independent pancreatic radiotherapy CBCTs, gastrointestinal Dice was 0.735 versus 0.634 for TotalSegmentator. Prediction agreement reached 0.881 on registered CT-CBCT and 0.790 on CT-MRI pairs. Adding MRI training data reduced CT-MRI encoder feature retrieval error from 36.8 to 3.2 mm. Registration pipelines incorporating IMPACT-Seg features ranked first on two multimodal Learn2Reg benchmarks. The 3D model segmented a whole-body CT in 15 s.
  These findings show that dense anatomical segmentation supervision can support consistent anatomical representations across modalities, with applications to both segmentation and registration. Code, datasets, and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/HEMONCedric/IMPACTSeg.

</details>


### [235] [Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32964)
*Nhat Ha Nguyen,Sudipta Chowdhury,Lokesh Das*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 DriveAnswer 基准（20,151 题、7 类推理族），通过"强证据/弱证据"配对设置，联合评测驾驶 VLMs 的语义正确性、证据充分性判断（弱证据下应弃答）与视觉定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测将"视觉定位"和"可回答性"分开测量，无法区分"有充分证据支撑的预测"与"定位到相关但不足以支撑答案的证据"。可靠驾驶 VLM 需判断现有视觉证据是否足以支持回答。

Method: 构建 DriveAnswer 基准：覆盖 7 个推理族共 20,151 题，采用匹配的强/弱证据配置成对设计——保持场景事实与语义答案不变，仅改变观测是否足以支撑作答，使弱证据下弃答成为正确行为；并采用受控适配（controlled adaptation）提升模型能力。

Result: 六族评测中，最强零样本基线强证据准确率 67.31%，但仅 21.55% 的配对问题同时满足"答/弃答行为正确 + 完整定位"。受控适配后 Gemma-4-12B 联合能力达 63.29%（近三倍于零样本），Qwen3-VL-8B 在证据敏感作答与定位上同样大幅提升。

Conclusion: 语义正确性、证据充分性与视觉定位是三种独立能力，应联合评测；现有模型在证据敏感决策上仍有显著差距。

Abstract: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.

</details>


### [236] [HARI4D: Hand-Articulation Aware 4D Reconstruction of Human-Object Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32932)
*Semin Kim,Xianghui Xie,Chuqiao Li,Jongyoo Kim,Gerard Pons-Moll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HARI4D: 从单目RGB视频重建手部关节感知的4D人-物交互，通过历史感知物体跟踪与"先够到后触控"的粗到细推理提升一致性与接触精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目RGB的4D人-物交互重建困难，尤其是含关节化手部的情形；已有全身方法在重建中忽略手部，导致手穿透物体或悬浮于物体之外。

Method: 提出HARI4D：引入历史感知（history-aware）的物体跟踪器以获得稳健稳定的轨迹；基于轨迹采用符合操作顺序的粗到细推理——ReachNet先将全身与手臂带到接触时的物体位置，TouchNet再依据时序上下文与局部物体几何确定手部关节姿态。

Result: 在训练中未见的ARCTIC数据集上，相比现有方法物体误差降低56%，手部接触F1从0.866提升至0.921；可恢复准确的全身体-物交互与连贯手部关节，并适用于在线视频。

Conclusion: HARI4D实现了时间与空间一致、含精细手部关节的单目4D人-物交互重建；代码与预训练模型将开源。

Abstract: Reasoning about human-object interaction from RGB cameras is important for gaming, VR environments, and robot learning. Yet 4D reconstruction from a monocular RGB camera is challenging, especially when articulated hands are involved. Prior full-body works neglect hands during reconstruction, causing them to penetrate into, or float from the object. We present HARI4D, a hand-articulation-aware method for reconstructing spatially and temporally consistent 4D human-object interaction from monocular RGB video. We introduce a history-aware object tracker that provides robust and stable tracking. Based on these tracks, we improve the interaction configuration through coarse-to-fine reasoning that follows the order of object manipulation: ReachNet first brings the full body and arms to the object during contact, and TouchNet then finalizes hand articulation according to temporal context and local object geometry. On ARCTIC, unseen in training, our method reduces the object error by 56% and improves hand contact F1 from 0.866 to 0.921 over prior art. Our method recovers accurate full body-object interaction with coherent hand articulations and applies to online videos. Our code and pretrained models will be released.

</details>


### [237] [One, No One and One Hundred Thousand CTs: Testing Anatomical Control in Text-to-CT Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33003)
*Francesca Pia Panaccione,Eugenio Lomurno,Matteo Matteucci*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CtrlCT评测工具，从"可信度"与"可控性"两方面统一评测Text-to-CT生成器，揭示现有方法难以发现的真实性-可控性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Text-to-CT生成器评测在预处理和指标上各不相同，难以横向比较；且评测协议几乎从不检验"编辑报告如何改变CT"（甚至同种子下也不检验），报告是否真正控制解剖结构缺乏证据。

Method: 提出CtrlCT工具包，测试两类属性：(1) Credibility——将生成CT作为群体与真实CT及报告比较；(2) Control——采用蜕变测试，无需参考CT：固定种子下编辑某一征象应按要求改变、被否定的征象应保持缺失、远处解剖变化不超过换种子带来的变化，且变化应跨种子稳定。用Report Card汇总各生成器的所有指标与洞见。

Result: 在940例胸部CT、687次胸水与心脏增大编辑上基准测试5个公开生成器，并留出第6个验证工具。结果显示：最可信的生成器几乎不响应新增胸水，而最敏感的生成器生成的CT真实性更低、多样性更差；文献中已有的分析未能揭示这一现象。

Conclusion: CtrlCT揭示了可控性与真实性之间的权衡，为Text-to-CT生成器提供统一、可复现的评测框架；作者承诺录用后公开工具、编辑数据、种子及30,525张合成CT。

Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning and the public availability of computed tomography (CT) datasets with paired reports have enabled many Text-to-CT generators. However, their evaluations almost always differ in preprocessing and metrics, which hinders comparison. Moreover, their protocols almost never test how editing the report changes the CT, not even at the same seed, so the report is often assumed to control the anatomy without evidence of how much and how consistently it does. We therefore propose CtrlCT, a toolkit that tests two properties of a generator, Credibility and Control. Credibility tests compare generated CTs, as a population, with real CTs and reports; Control tests are metamorphic and need no reference CT: at a fixed seed, editing one finding should change it as requested, keep negated findings absent and shift distant anatomy no more than a new seed, and the change should hold across seeds. A Report Card summarises all measures and insights for each generator. We benchmark five public generators on 940 chest CTs and 687 edits of pleural effusion and cardiomegaly, holding out a sixth to test the toolkit. Among them, the most credible generators barely respond to an added effusion, while the most responsive produce less realistic and less diverse CTs. The analyses proposed in the literature do not reveal this. We release CtrlCT, its edits, seeds and 30,525 synthetic CTs after acceptance.

</details>


### [238] [ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32941)
*Seunghyun Oh,Seongsu Lee,Seunghye Chae,Youngmin Ro*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ProX-MAD：用可学习的状态专属"代理"聚合空间上下文，实现统一的少样本医学异常检测（one-for-many），缓解从单数据集到多数据集的性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少样本医学异常检测多采用"一数据集一模型"（one-for-one）范式，统一"one-for-many"建模研究不足；直接将现有方法扩展到该设定会导致尤其是像素级的显著性能下降。原因是：共享决策边界在异构病灶定义下不可靠，而仅使用正常样本的记忆库在少样本下无法覆盖多样的正常分布。

Method: ProX-MAD 是一个基于代理的框架，将空间上下文聚合为紧凑、可学习、状态专属的代理，用于统一少样本 MAD。其核心模块 Masked Proxy Infusion Attention（MPIA）让代理 token 与参考图像块特征进行交叉注意力，并进行逐代理掩码以保留高置信度对应关系，从而缓解代理坍缩，促使代理多样化，并同时概括正常与异常参考。

Result: 在六个医学数据集上，ProX-MAD 从 one-for-one 到 one-for-many 训练仅有边际性能下降；仅训练一次的统一模型，其平均表现仍优于先前 SOTA 方法，即使这些方法采用更有利的 one-for-one 协议。

Conclusion: 基于代理的统一建模能有效支持多数据集少样本医学异常检测，证明统一多数据集 MAD 的实用性。

Abstract: Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.

</details>


### [239] [Embodied AI Fails the Mirror Test: How a Simple Mirror Breaks Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33010)
*Xuanchen Liu,Hejun Zhang,Boxuan Dong,Ying Wu,Heshuai Li,Wen Gao,Yonghong Tian,Weihao Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，借鉴动物镜面自我识别测试，评估机器人操作策略在含镜面反射场景中的表现，发现各类策略在反射环境下成功率显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作策略的评估多在不含反射的常规环境中进行，而镜面等反射面在真实场景中普遍存在。作者想探究这些策略能否在存在物体镜像的场景中可靠操作物理对象，即是否具备对反射的"自我识别"与区分能力。

Method: 基于 RoboDojo 构建 RoboDojo-Mirror 基准，保持任务目标、成功标准和策略检查点不变，对比无镜面基线与单镜、双镜、镜面桌面三种条件；测试五类策略（VLA 模型、世界动作模型、智能体策略）。并设置几何匹配的非反射面板作对照以排除碰撞干扰，结合轨迹与接触分析、抓取/推动/遮挡诊断，以及 π0.5 与 FastWAM 的真机实验。

Result: 各镜面条件下聚合成功率均下降，三种条件平均降幅为 10.8~56.7 个百分点，镜面桌面最高达 62.5 点；50-88% 的镜面特异性失败无机器人-面板接触记录，说明碰撞不能解释性能退化；轨迹分析显示幻觉式瞄准反射物体与真实目标空间定位错误；真机实验同样出现成功率下降。

Conclusion: 多种机器人策略普遍存在对反射环境的脆弱性，这并非碰撞所致而是源自反射感知混淆，呼吁在具身智能评估中引入反射感知的测试维度。

Abstract: Can a simple mirror expose the limitations of today's robotic manipulation policies? Inspired by the mirror self-recognition test in animal cognition, we investigate whether robot policies can reliably manipulate physical objects in scenes containing their reflections. We introduce RoboDojo-Mirror, a benchmark built on RoboDojo that preserves task objectives, success criteria, and policy checkpoints while comparing a mirror-free baseline with single-mirror, dual-mirror, and mirrored-tabletop conditions. Across five policies spanning Vision-Language-Action models, World Action Models, and agentic policies, every mirror condition reduces aggregate success rates: averaged over the three conditions, the drop ranges from 10.8 to 56.7 percentage points across policies, and it reaches 62.5 points on the mirrored tabletop. Because a mirror is also a physical obstacle, we compare it against geometrically matched non-reflective panels; 50--88\% of mirror-specific failures occur without recorded robot--panel contact, so direct collisions alone do not explain the degradation. Trajectory and contact analyses instead reveal recurring behaviors consistent with phantom targeting of reflected objects and spatial mislocalization of real ones. Targeted diagnostics further characterize grasping near reflections, policy-dependent pushing progress, and physical-target interaction under main-camera occlusion. Real-robot experiments with $π_{0.5}$ and FastWAM also show lower overall success rates under the upright-mirror and mirrored-tabletop conditions. These findings reveal a shared vulnerability to reflective environments across diverse robot policies and motivate reflection-aware evaluation of embodied intelligence. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/robodojo-mirror.

</details>


### [240] [OmniHarness-RSI: Modality-Aware Harness Evolution for Omnimodal Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32951)
*Shilin Ma,Xingming Shui,Jinglin Chen,Zetong Zhao,Jingqi Tian,Deyi Zhu,Yansong Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 OmniHarness-RSI，一种模态感知的 agent harness 进化框架，将进化空间分解为三个能力维度并配合模态引导进化，在三个多模态理解基准上显著超越模态无关的 RSI 方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 harness 的递归自我改进（RSI）在视频理解中已有效，但扩展到全模态理解时，多模态感知与推理的异构性和相互依赖造成复杂进化空间，难以进行有针对性的 harness 优化。

Method: 将进化空间分解为三个能力维度：模态路由与协作、模态感知的证据定位、模态特定感知；据此构建 Factorized-Harness Agent，集成专门感知专家与音视频检索工具；引入模态引导的 harness 进化，通过结构化的模态-能力归因定位缺陷，并借助交互式代码修订与执行反馈改进策略；采用验证引导的选择与留出评估检验泛化性。

Result: 在 WorldSense、Daily-Omni、OmniVideoBench 上测试准确率分别提升 8.86、8.13、6.23 个百分点，持续优于模态无关的 RSI；进化后的 harness 无需适配即可跨数据集迁移，同时减少 planner 调用次数与查看帧数。

Conclusion: 模态感知的 harness 分解与进化能有效应对全模态理解的复杂搜索空间，在提升准确率的同时降低计算开销并具备跨数据集泛化能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in harness-based recursive self-improvement (RSI) have improved video understanding by evolving executable agent workflows without updating foundation model parameters. However, extending this paradigm to omnimodal understanding remains challenging, as the heterogeneous and interdependent nature of multimodal perception and reasoning creates a complex evolution space, making targeted harness optimization difficult. To address these challenges, we propose OmniHarness-RSI, a modality-aware framework for evolving agent harnesses. Specifically, we factorize the evolution space into three capability dimensions: modality routing and collaboration, modality-aware evidence localization, and modality-specific perception. Based on this factorization, we construct a Factorized-Harness Agent integrating specialized perception experts and audio-video retrieval tools. We further introduce modality-guided harness evolution, which identifies deficiencies through structured modality-capability attribution and refines corresponding harness strategies through interactive code revisions and execution feedback. Validation-guided selection and held-out evaluation assess generalization within and across datasets. Experiments on WorldSense, Daily-Omni, and OmniVideoBench demonstrate test accuracy improvements of 8.86, 8.13, and 6.23 percentage points, respectively, consistently outperforming modality-agnostic RSI. The evolved harnesses also demonstrate cross-dataset transfer without adaptation, while reducing planner calls and viewed frames.

</details>


### [241] [FedTumor-IoMT: Federated Learning-Aided Brain Tumor Diagnosis on Resource-Constrained Edge IoMT Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32952)
*Pranshu Jena,Prajnyajit Mohanty,Umesh C. Pati*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出轻量级多任务联邦学习框架，在资源受限的边缘设备上本地训练完成脑肿瘤分割与分类，精度接近GPU基线且隐私友好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联合分割与分类模型计算量大，难以在资源受限边缘平台训练，也限制了IoMT中的隐私保护联邦学习；现有方法要么在GPU工作站上完成双任务，要么只能在边缘设备上做分类。

Method: 共享预训练LiteMedSAM编码器（TinyViT）提取特征，接入坐标注意力分割解码器与分割引导分类头，省去独立特征提取器；采用选择性编码器冻结，保留95%可训练参数并降低端侧训练成本；以联邦学习方式在5个边缘客户端上训练。

Result: 在1200例T1 MRI样本、5个资源受限边缘客户端测试平台上：分类准确率94.20%、DSC 88.53%、IoU 83.68%、ROC-AUC 99.87%；五轮FL后与GPU基线95.21%差距在0.6%以内；注意力与特征精炼模块仅增加0.74 GFLOPs却带来DSC+3.82%、IoU+4.60%；边缘端推理延迟46.54 s、CPU占用52.8%、峰值温度65°C无降频，推理延迟比现有框架低6.4–10.5倍。

Conclusion: 验证了在资源受限边缘平台上实现隐私保护式脑肿瘤联合分割与分类的可行性。

Abstract: Joint brain tumor segmentation and classification models are computationally intensive, limiting their training on resource-constrained edge platforms and restricting privacy-preserving Federated Learning FL in the Internet of Medical Things IoMT. Existing approaches either perform both tasks on GPU-equipped workstations or support only classification on edge devices. To address this gap, this work proposes a lightweight multitask FL framework for joint segmentation and classification through local edge training. A shared pretrained LiteMedSAM encoder with TinyViT extracts features for a coordinate-attention-based segmentation decoder and a segmentation-guided classification head, eliminating a separate feature extractor. Selective encoder freezing retains 95\% trainable parameters while reducing on-device training costs. The proposed framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory testbed of five resource-constrained edge clients using 1,200 T1-weighted MRI samples. It achieves 94.20\% classification accuracy, 88.53\% DSC, 83.68\% IoU, and 99.87\% ROC-AUC. Its classification accuracy remains within 0.6\% of the GPU-trained baseline of 95.21\% across five FL rounds. The attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82\% and 4.60\%, respectively, with 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. On edge hardware, the framework achieves 46.54 s inference latency, 52.8\% CPU utilization, and a peak temperature of 65$^\circ$C without thermal throttling. Its inference latency is observed to be 6.4--10.5 times lower than that of existing frameworks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge platforms.

</details>


### [242] [EventDiffusion: Learning Native Event Stream Distribution from Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33096)
*Karthik Sundar Senthilkumar,Christopher Thirgood,Simon Hadfield*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EventDiffusion 用分层扩散生成框架直接从真实录制中学习原生异步事件流的条件分布，将生成分解为事件数量、空间分配、时间戳三个概率过程，并配套提出 CEFS 真实性评价指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机数据稀缺，而稀疏 RGB 观测无法唯一确定中间事件流（同样的帧可能对应活动、极性、时序不同的事件流）；现有模拟器依赖预设的传感器动态与估计的亮度轨迹，限制了生成事件流的多样性与保真度。

Method: 提出 EventDiffusion 分层生成框架，把条件生成拆为三步：Event Activity Diffusion (EAD) 学习随机离散事件计数；Event Spatial Allocation (ESA) 在保持基数不变的前提下将计数分配到各像素；Event Timing Diffusion (ETD) 学习连续异步时间戳分布。同时提出 CEFS 事件流真实性指标，综合事件活动与极性、多尺度时空结构及时间保真度。

Result: 在所有数据集上，EventDiffusion 的准确率约为 SOTA 方法的两倍，并在不同相机、任意分辨率下表现稳健。

Conclusion: 直接从真实事件数据学习生成分布、并把事件流的离散计数、空间分配与连续时序解耦建模，是提升事件流生成真实性与泛化性的有效途径；CEFS 为事件流真实性提供了多维度量化标准。

Abstract: Event cameras capture asynchronous brightness changes at high temporal resolution, but scarce recordings constrain data-driven research. Sparse RGB observations cannot uniquely determine intervening events since identical frames may correspond to streams with different activity, polarities, and timing. Existing simulators largely rely on prescribed sensor dynamics and estimated brightness trajectories, whose assumptions limit the diversity and fidelity of plausible event streams. We introduce EventDiffusion, a hierarchical generative framework that directly learns the conditional distribution of native asynchronous event streams from real recordings. EventDiffusion decomposes generation into three probabilistic processes: Event Activity Diffusion (EAD) learns stochastic discrete event counts; Event Spatial Allocation (ESA) distributes these counts to individual pixels while preserving cardinality; and Event Timing Diffusion (ETD) learns continuous asynchronous timestamp distributions. We also introduce CEFS, an event-stream realism metric combining event activity and polarity with multiscale space-time structure and temporal fidelity. Across all datasets, EventDiffusion achieves double the accuracy of SOTA methods and demonstrates robustness across different cameras at any resolution.

</details>


### [243] [VidForce: Predicting Force-Aware Articulation by Observing Humans](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32967)
*Rafay Mohiuddin,Jiaqi Chen,Marc Pollefeys,Hermann Blum*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VidForce 从第三人称 RGB 视频中估计人手交互轨迹与力剖面，借助少量仪器测量通过学习到的物理原型作为先验，并在 Spot 机器人上实现真实物体操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类可通过观察他人估计物体运动与交互所需力，但具身智能体难以从视频中获得这类理解；直接力测量依赖专用设备且数据稀少。

Method: 估计交互轨迹与力剖面；输入为第三人称视频（可选 2D 接触点与文本提示）。将有限仪器测量转化为可学习的物理原型先验（共享力水平与时间剖面，由视觉与语义线索决定权重），用几何与视觉语言特征自适应调整，再由联合条件流同时精化初始跟踪轨迹与力剖面；配对的人手与仪器夹爪录像提供监督，另有独立训练的力矩模型验证可推广性。

Result: 在 Hoi! 数据集留出交互上：ATE 6.6 cm，峰值力 MAE 4.81 N、RMSE 5.92 N，力剖面 RMSE 5.52 N；真实视频中能稳定推断运动与力；部署于 Spot 机器人，用人演示估计的轨迹与力剖面驱动物体操作并报告重复试验成功率。

Conclusion: 有限仪器数据结合物理原型先验，可有效从视频中推断交互力与轨迹，并迁移到真实机器人操作任务。

Abstract: People can anticipate how an object moves and the effort an interaction may require by watching others. How can embodied agents acquire this understanding from video? Force measurements provide direct sensory supervision, but require specialized equipment and remain limited in quantity. We introduce VidForce, which estimates an interaction trajectory together with a force profile from a third-person RGB video; 2D contact clicks and textual object-action prompts are optional. Our approach makes limited instrumented measurements useful for interpreting human interactions through learned physical prototypes as a prior. The prototypes share learned force levels and temporal profiles across interactions of comparable effort, with visual and semantic cues determining their contribution to each observation. Geometric and vision-language features adapt this prior to the observed interaction, while a joint conditional flow refines an initial tracked trajectory together with the force profile. Paired human and instrumented-gripper recordings provide measured force references for supervising human video, and a separately trained torque model demonstrates that the formulation extends to other sensory quantities. We evaluate trajectory recovery and force estimation through baseline comparisons and controlled ablations on held-out interactions from the Hoi! dataset. On this evaluation subset, VidForce achieves 6.6 cm ATE, peak-force MAE and RMSE of 4.81 N and 5.92 N, respectively, and force-profile RMSE of 5.52 N. On real-world videos, VidForce infers motion and force reliably and consistently despite the variability in human execution. We further deploy VidForce on a Spot robot, where trajectories and force profiles estimated from human demonstrations drive real-world articulated-object manipulation, and report success rates across repeated trials. Project page: https://rafaymhddn.github.io/vidforce

</details>


### [244] [FocusAnchor: Zero-Shot Metric Depth by Anchoring a Depth Foundation Prior to Focus Cues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32970)
*Ashkan Ganj,Hang Su,Tian Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FocusAnchor：用焦点体积查表与基础模型相对深度先验反复对齐的循环模型，提升弱焦点线索/少焦片场景的度量深度估计与跨相机迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 depth-from-focus 方法在焦点线索弱、新相机、焦片较少时表现不佳，且跨相机迁移困难；堆栈合成还会因不同切片的模糊差异在无纹理表面产生虚假深度线索。

Method: 提出 FocusAnchor 循环模型：通过焦点体积查表细化度量深度，并反复将冻结基础模型的相对深度先验对齐到当前深度估计，形成反馈闭环，把纹理区域的度量尺度传播到弱焦点线索区域并保持结构。为支持跨相机迁移，合成训练堆栈时随机化相机参数与对焦距离；针对合成导致的虚假线索，加入逐切片独立噪声抑制；并提出可变堆栈训练（FocusAnchor-flex）以增强少焦片鲁棒性并适配移动端采集。

Result: 相比 FOSSA ViT-B，微调后 NYU Depth V2 上 AbsRel 降低 36%，DDFF-12 上降低 9%；零样本下 FocusAnchor 与 FocusAnchor-flex 在全部五个基准上取得最低的两个 AbsRel。ZEDD 测试集上 AbsRel 比最佳对比方法 FOSSA ViT-B 低 9%；在 ZEDD 验证集上 FocusAnchor-flex 用少 40% 的焦片即达到更低 AbsRel。

Conclusion: 通过基础模型先验反馈对齐与针对性训练数据合成策略，FocusAnchor 在精度、跨相机泛化和少焦片实用性上均优于现有 depth-from-focus 方法。

Abstract: Existing depth-from-focus methods can struggle with weak focus cues, new cameras, or fewer focal slices. We present FocusAnchor, a recurrent model that uses focus-volume lookups to refine metric depth and repeatedly aligns a relative depth prior from a frozen foundation model to the current depth estimate. The aligned prior guides subsequent refinement in a feedback loop, carrying metric scale recovered from textured regions into regions where focus cues are weak while preserving scene structure. To support transfer across cameras, we synthesize training stacks with randomized camera parameters and focus distances. However, stack synthesis blurs existing image noise differently across slices, creating artificial depth cues even on textureless surfaces. We add independent per-slice noise to suppress these cues. We also introduce variable-stack training to improve robustness with fewer focal slices and support more practical mobile capture. Compared with FOSSA ViT-B, FocusAnchor reduces AbsRel by 36% on NYU Depth V2 and by 9% on DDFF-12 after fine-tuning. In zero-shot evaluation, FocusAnchor and its variable-stack variant, FocusAnchor-flex, achieve the two lowest AbsRel values on all five benchmarks. On ZEDD test, FocusAnchor achieves 9% lower AbsRel than the best competing method, FOSSA ViT-B, while FocusAnchor-flex achieves lower AbsRel with 40% fewer focal slices on ZEDD validation.

</details>


### [245] [Teaching Time Without Losing General Retrieval: Adapting Multimodal Embeddings for Time-Sensitive Video Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32971)
*Toya Oyama,Rainer Lienhart,Shin'ichi Satoh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出三个简单组件（保持损失、成对损失、中层LoRA），使单一MLLM嵌入模型在每段视频一个向量下同时实现强通用与时间敏感的文到视频检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM嵌入模型在场景描述检索上表现好，但在动作及方向描述的时间敏感检索上差；TARA微调虽提升时间敏感检索，却严重损害通用检索（58.4→44.8），且其发布模型需与Qwen3-VL-Embedding集成才能维持通用性能。

Method: 三点发现对应三组件：1）Keep loss——通用检索取决于输出嵌入相对基模型的漂移而非权重漂移，故将嵌入约束在基模型附近；2）Pair loss——文本嵌入对动作/反向方向区分明显而视频嵌入对原片/反向拷贝区分不足，故沿两文本嵌入之差方向拉大视频嵌入差距；3）Middle-layer LoRA——帧融合发生且时间信息峰值出现在中层，仅在这些层训练LoRA（约0.15%参数）。

Result: 通用R@1保持58.4不变，画廊含反向拷贝时的R@1由55.5升至63.2；提升可迁移至未见基准与InternVL2-8B-RA。Keep loss用于TARA配方亦可将通用R@1从44.8恢复至57.8；与TARA集成后在RTime和未见CiA上取得对比模型最高分。

Conclusion: 通过嵌入保持、方向对比与中层LoRA，可在单模型单向量设定下同时兼顾通用与时间敏感检索，且方法轻量、可迁移，并能作为既有TARA配方的补救方案。

Abstract: In text-to-video retrieval, MLLM-based embedding models do well when the text describes the scene (general retrieval), but poorly when it describes actions and their direction (time-sensitive retrieval). TARA, a pioneering work, fine-tunes such a model on text triplets with temporal hard negatives; it improves time-sensitive retrieval but lowers general retrieval (mean R@1 over six benchmarks in our rerun on Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B: 58.4->44.8), and its released model keeps general retrieval only when ensembled with Qwen3-VL-Embedding. Our goal is strong general and time-sensitive retrieval with one model and one vector per clip. Three findings lead to three simple components. Keep loss: general retrieval follows how far the output embeddings drift from the base model, not how far the weights move; we therefore keep them near the base model, which keeps most general retrieval even without general-domain data. Pair loss: the text embeddings of an action description and its reversed-direction version are well separated, but the video embeddings of a clip and its reversed copy are close; we therefore widen the gap between the video embeddings of each clip and its reversed copy, in the direction of the difference between their two text embeddings. Middle-layer LoRA: frames are combined in the middle layers, and temporal information peaks in or just after them; we therefore train LoRA only on these layers, which nearly matches training all weights on most time-sensitive benchmarks with 0.15% of the parameters and keeps general retrieval better. General R@1 stays at 58.4, while R@1 with each clip's reversed copy in the gallery rises from 55.5 to 63.2; the gains carry over to unseen benchmarks and InternVL2-8B-RA. The keep loss is also a remedy for the TARA recipe (general R@1: 44.8->57.8), and ensembling TARA with Ours gives the highest scores on RTime and unseen CiA among the compared models.

</details>


### [246] [NEST: Uncovering and Nesting Unknown Objects in Open-World Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32981)
*Yuchen Zhang,Yuan Gao,Sebastian Schmidt,Johannes Betz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种开放世界目标检测框架，既能发现未知类物体，又能将其归入给定类别taxonomy中的更宽泛类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开放世界检测器对未知物体仅标注"unknown"，只告知"有物体"却不告知"是什么"；而知道其更广泛的类别有助于做出更明智决策。且作者发现未识别物体其实已在基础检测器中被定位并标为unknown，只是因背景得分更高而在top-k选择中被丢弃。

Method: 针对发现未知物体：提出class-agnostic ranker，估计每个预测框与物体的匹配程度，用其得分替代原始分数做top-k筛选。针对类别归类：借鉴欧拉图思想（类别区域包含其成员区域），从已知类构建每个类别的区域，并学习为未见成员预留多大空间。

Result: 在三个benchmark上，相对各任务最强baseline，未知物体召回率提升3.8%~195.1%，同时保持有竞争力的已知类检测性能；在相同检测结果上，未知物体归类准确率高于现有层级方法。

Conclusion: 通过class-agnostic ranker解决未知物体被top-k丢弃的问题，并用欧拉图式的类别区域建模实现未知物体向taxonomy的归类，代码已开源。

Abstract: Open-world object detectors aim to localize objects of classes not covered by their training annotations, but most label them only as "unknown". This label tells a system that an object is present but not what it is, while its broader category would allow a more informed decision. We therefore address both uncovering unknown objects and assigning them to the broader categories of a given class taxonomy. For uncovering, we find that most unknown objects are already localized and labeled "unknown" in our base detector, but are discarded during final top-k selection because background receives higher scores. To mitigate this, we propose a class-agnostic ranker that estimates how well each predicted box fits an object and uses these scores to select the final predictions. Across three benchmarks, our detector improves unknown recall by 3.8% to 195.1% relative to the strongest baseline in each task, while maintaining competitive known-class detection. For categorizing, we draw on Euler diagrams, in which the region of a category contains the regions of its members. Our categorizer builds each category's region from the known classes and learns how much room to leave for members it has never seen. On the same detections, it categorizes unknown objects more accurately than existing hierarchical methods. Code is available at https://github.com/TUM-AVS/NEST.

</details>


### [247] [Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32993)
*Juntao Jiang,Wenqi Zhong,Guangyu Guo,Dexia Chen,Yilong Hu,Yunhao Bai,Zhenyu Yi,Jianwei Xu,Tony C. W. Mok,Muxuan Gao,Ling Zhang,Yong Liu,Jiangning Zhang,Zhongwei Qiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Radev是一种决策型3D医学多模态模型，通过解剖引导的视觉压缩、直接候选预测与反事实置信度监督，实现无需自回归解码的临床CT决策，并在准确性与置信度校准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体积CT的结构化临床决策需要解剖学有依据的预测和校准良好的置信度，但现有3D医学多模态模型存在自回归解码未校准、依赖无关解剖区域的捷径问题。

Method: 模型包含三部分：1) 冻结3D编码器提取器官级特征，由查询动态选择并在预测的解剖边界内关注2D切片特征，实现全局与细粒度结合，生成紧凑视觉token；2) 语言骨干单次前向传播直接估计候选概率，避免自回归解码；3) 提出反事实校准训练CCT，比较完整与干预器官表示下的预测，使去除目标器官证据导致决策质量下降时置信度降低，同时惩罚无关器官去除引起的过度置信下降。另构建CT-Verdict基准，涵盖二分类发现、多选问答与有序严重度评估，含分布内及外部队列。

Result: 大量实验表明Radev在决策准确率和置信度校准上显著优于最先进方法，并在分布偏移下稳健泛化。

Conclusion: Radev通过决策原生设计与反事实校准监督，有效提升3D医学多模态模型的临床决策质量与置信度可靠性，并配套CT-Verdict基准推动严谨评估。

Abstract: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

</details>


### [248] [PAVE: Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning for the Blind and Low-Vision Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32996)
*Nan Li,Shaofeng Liang,Shiyun Zhao,Keni Shi,Zhencheng Huang,Bowen Tian,Jiemin Wu,Wenshuo Chen,Kaishen Yuan,Runwei Guan,Yutao Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向盲人与低视力(BLV)用户的第一视角视频问答偏好对齐数据集PA-EgoQA及统一框架PAVE，通过结构化回答策略微调、问题条件路由与Filter-GRPO强化学习，使回答在事实正确性之外具备空间方位、可操作性与简洁性，在三类视觉语言骨干上均实现事实准确率与助残回答质量的双重提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有第一视角视频问答基准与模型仅优化与参考答案的语义一致性，把视觉辅助简化为纯事实匹配任务；但真实场景中，缺乏空间方位、可操作细节或简洁性的"事实正确"回答对BLV用户实际无用，因此需要将人类中心的回答需求转化为监督信号。

Method: 基于EgoBlind的真实BLV第一视角视频与用户查询，按BLV沟通经验标准重建参考答案，构建偏好对齐数据集PA-EgoQA；提出PAVE统一学习与推理框架，耦合结构化回答策略微调与确定性、问题条件路由，在推理时依据查询表层形式调整回答表述；并采用Filter-GRPO对齐，结合分层"正确性-质量"奖励与对比式候选组过滤，同时从事实正确性对比与正确回答间细粒度质量差异中提取学习信号。

Result: 在三种视觉语言骨干模型上开展大量实验，事实准确率稳定提升，同时助残回答质量显著改善。

Conclusion: 该工作为将人类中心的回答需求转化为第一视角监督、生成策略与后训练目标提供了具体范式，代码将开源于 https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE。

Abstract: Egocentric video question answering enables blind and low-vision (BLV) users to query their immediate surroundings through natural language. However, existing benchmarks and models primarily optimize for semantic agreement with reference answers, reducing visual assistance to a purely factual matching task. In real-world scenarios, a factually correct response remains practically unhelpful if it lacks the spatial orientation, actionable detail, or conciseness required by the immediate task of the user. Drawing upon real BLV egocentric videos and authentic user queries from EgoBlind, we construct the PA-EgoQA, a preference-aligned dataset that reconstructs reference answers according to empirical BLV communication criteria. Based on this dataset, we introduce Preference-Aligned Visual Egocentric Learning (PAVE), a unified learning and inference framework that couples structured answer-policy fine-tuning with deterministic question-conditioned routing to adapt response formulation directly to the surface form of the query at inference time. We further align the model via Filter-GRPO, which pairs a hierarchical correctness-quality reward with contrast-based candidate-group filtering to extract learning signals from both factual accuracy contrasts and fine-grained quality variations among correct answers. Extensive experiments across three vision-language backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in factual accuracy alongside substantial gains in assistive response quality. These results establish a concrete paradigm for translating human-centered response requirements into egocentric supervision, generation policies, and post-training objectives. Code will be provided at https://github.com/shawnliang420/PAVE.

</details>


### [249] [First-Hit Photoconsistency for Neural Surface Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32998)
*Gabriel Lenain,Edmond Boyer,Jean Ponce*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅用多视角光度一致性（无体渲染、无参数化外观模型）的神经隐式表面重建方法，通过球追踪与1-Lipschitz MLP实现几何精确重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经隐式与高斯泼溅方法联合优化几何与外观会引入歧义：参数化外观模型可补偿几何误差，从而在表面不准确时仍能精确复现输入图像，掩盖了几何问题。作者希望只依赖几何本身来重建精确表面。

Method: 对每条参考光线用球追踪求首次表面交点，由其位置与法向定义局部patch，利用基于几何的可见性在邻近视角间用直接从输入图像采样的颜色评估光度一致性。采用1-Lipschitz MLP保证球追踪高效。仅使用单一光度一致性损失，无需前景掩码或辅助几何正则。

Result: 在BlendedMVS（BMVS）上取得所比较方法中最低的平均Chamfer距离，在DTU上几何精度与领先重建方法相当。

Conclusion: 表明无需体渲染与参数化外观模型，仅靠多视角patch光度一致性与几何可见性即可实现高精度神经隐式表面重建，避免了外观-几何耦合带来的歧义。

Abstract: Recent neural implicit and Gaussian splatting approaches have achieved impressive results in multi-view surface reconstruction. However, jointly optimizing geometry and appearance introduces ambiguities. A parametric appearance model can compensate for geometric errors, reproducing the input images accurately without an accurate surface. We demonstrate accurate neural implicit surface reconstruction using only multi-view patch photoconsistency with geometry-based visibility, without volumetric rendering or parametric appearance models. For each reference ray, sphere tracing computes the first surface intersection. Its position and normal define a local patch whose photoconsistency is evaluated across visible neighboring views using colors sampled directly from the input images. For efficient sphere tracing, we use a 1-Lipschitz multi-layer perceptron. We use a single photoconsistency loss, without foreground masks or auxiliary geometric regularization. Experiments show that our method achieves the lowest mean Chamfer distance on BlendedMVS (BMVS) among compared methods and matches the geometric accuracy of leading reconstruction methods on DTU.

</details>


### [250] [MESSI: Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration for Physics-Based Character Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33011)
*Xiaogang Peng,Jiaqi Zou,Lei Zhong,Sirui Xu,Huaizu Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MESSI：通过共享适配器实现物理足球角色多技能平滑过渡，过渡外保持原技能策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理足球角色需执行多种运动技能并平滑切换（如带球转射门），但在孤立环境下表现良好的技能顺序执行时，前序行为会使角色与球进入陌生状态，导致失败。

Method: 先用运动先验和任务奖励训练8个专家，蒸馏为统一技能条件Transformer；在冻结学生上通过在线强化学习训练共享的上下文条件低秩适配器，技能切换时激活以处理陌生进入状态，并用学习的退出机制决定何时交还控制权；原生执行时关闭适配器以保持原策略。

Result: 单项技能、技能过渡与连续技能链实验均显著优于直接切换，带球转射门成功率从19.8%提升至61.8%。

Conclusion: 共享适配器+退出机制可高效实现多技能平滑过渡，且从结构上保证原技能性能不退化。

Abstract: Physics-based soccer characters must perform diverse motor skills and transition smoothly between them, such as dribbling into a shot. However, skills that perform well in isolation may fail when executed sequentially, as preceding behaviors can leave the character and ball in unfamiliar states. We present MESSI (Multi-Expert Soccer Skill Integration), a framework that enables multiple soccer skill transitions through shared adaptation while preserving the original skill policy outside transitions. MESSI first trains eight task-competent experts using motion priors and task rewards, then distills them into a unified, skill-conditioned Transformer. Rather than retraining individual experts for different transitions, we train a shared, context-conditioned low-rank adapter on the frozen student through online reinforcement learning. Activated upon skill switching, the adapter helps the target skill handle unfamiliar entry states, while a learned exit mechanism determines when to return control to the original student. By disabling the adapter during native skill execution, MESSI preserves the original student policy by construction. Experiments across individual skills, skill transitions, and continuous skill chains demonstrate substantial improvements over direct switching, including an increase in dribbling-to-shooting success from 19.8% to 61.8%.

</details>


### [251] [RFW-W: Scaling Physical Asset Universes for Generative Embodied Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33013)
*Jiawei Weng,Rui Zhang,Saining Zhang,Changjian Pan,Yuanbo Lyu,Jiarui Guo,Yongzhi Li,Guolin Liu,Jialu Liu,Jiankun Wang,Yi Yang,Peishuo Li,Zhiheng Li,Jiaying Wan,Junhao Chen,Weiqing Xiao,Jingrun Du,Wenyi Li,Weiyi Lin,Zenan Meng,Hu Wei,Lin Qu,Zongzheng Zhang,Hao Zhao,Chaojian Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RFW-W统一物理资产库，汇聚刚性、铰接及可变形资产共1,010,386条记录，并连接任务条件的场景组装，为具身仿真提供可扩展、可执行物理表示的资产基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规模化具身仿真需要大量带可执行物理表示的多样化物体，而现有资产数据在类型覆盖、物理属性与场景组装之间割裂，难以支撑任务条件化的场景生成。

Method: 构建RFW-W资产宇宙，含三部分：RFW-R（刚性，1,212类/524,611个，类别引导生成+碰撞几何+复合物理属性+交互标注）；RFW-A（铰接，531类/402,410个，可复用的智能体编写程序化生成器，显式部件与关节结构）；RFW-S（可变形，485类/83,365个，结构感知仿真表示、标定与独立测试）。通过统一接口保留各资产类型的物理要求，支持检索与场景组装。

Result: RFW-R资产覆盖更广、场景满足能力优于现有数据集；在5个RoboTwin任务上（每任务每资产源100条演示），RFW-R训练的策略在干净环境宏成功率71.2%、随机化下41.8%，分别超过最强基线15.8和10.6个百分点。

Conclusion: RFW-W为生成物理落地、任务条件的具身世界提供了可扩展且统一的资产基础。

Abstract: Scaling embodied simulation requires diverse objects with executable physical representations. We present RFW-W, a physical asset universe connecting rigid, articulated, and deformable asset sources to task-conditioned scene composition. Its reported inventories comprise 1,010,386 asset records: 524,611 rigid assets in 1,212 categories (RFW-R), 402,410 articulated assets in 531 categories (RFW-A), and 83,365 jointly verified deformables in 485 categories (RFW-S). These taxonomies contribute 2,228 dataset--category entries. RFW-R couples category-guided generation with collision geometry, composed physical properties, and interaction annotations; RFW-A uses reusable agent-authored procedural generators with explicit part and joint structure; RFW-S uses structure-aware simulation representations, calibration, and independent testing. A common interface preserves physical requirements specific to each asset type for retrieval and scene assembly. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that RFW-R provides broader asset coverage and stronger scene-fulfillment capabilities than existing datasets. Across five RoboTwin tasks, using 100 demonstrations per task for each asset source, policies trained on RFW-R achieve macro success rates of 71.2% in clean settings and 41.8% under randomization, exceeding the strongest baseline by 15.8 and 10.6 percentage points, respectively. RFW-W provides a scalable and unified asset foundation for generating physically grounded, task-conditioned embodied worlds.

</details>


### [252] [Training Lightweight Gaze Models without Target Gaze Annotation: What Makes a Good Teacher?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33014)
*Scott J. Lewis,Di Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究模型生成标签作为轻量视觉模型监督信号的质量问题：不完美模型标签可替代人工标注，但需警惕表面能力下的捷径，且教师质量可提前通过验证集标签误差预判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互机器人需要既准确又高效的视线目标估计模型，模型生成标签提供了可扩展的监督途径，但"什么样的模型是好教师"、能否在学生训练前就判断教师质量，尚不清楚。

Method: 在视线目标估计任务上做受控比较：固定学生模型、训练协议和361k训练样本，仅改变视线点标签来源，共11种监督条件，覆盖3个视频数据集、2种学生规模、3个随机种子，所有学生均以人工标注评估。

Result: 1) Gaze-LLE（从未在目标数据集标注上训练）训练的学生可匹敌人工标注训练的学生：ViT-Tiny持平，ViT-Small显著更准（平均距离误差0.187 vs 0.196），ViT-Tiny学生比教师CPU快32倍。2) 表面能力可能掩盖不可靠监督：给定提示中人脸中心，InternVL3和Qwen3-VL分别在93.4%、81.1%样本上原样返回，复制坐标基线即可匹配InternVL3的标签与学生，去掉该坐标则远落后于专家模型。3) 教师可提前识别：验证标签误差可排序学生测试误差（Spearman ρ=0.91），10段标注视频在95%抽样中能挑出两个专家教师。

Conclusion: 提出评估监督信号的实用原则：不完美模型标签可用，但须揭露坐标复制等捷径，并可通过少量验证标签误差在训练前选择教师。

Abstract: Model-generated labels offer a scalable route to training lightweight vision models, but what makes a model a good teacher, and can we tell before training a student? We study this in gaze target estimation, where interactive robots need models that are both accurate and efficient. In a controlled comparison of eleven supervision conditions, we vary only the source of gaze-point labels, keeping the student, training protocol and 361k training samples fixed, across three video datasets, two student sizes and three seeds; every student is evaluated against human annotation. Three findings emerge. First, imperfect model-generated labels can replace human annotation: Gaze-LLE, never trained on the target datasets' gaze annotation, trains students that match annotation-trained ones on ViT-Tiny and are significantly more accurate on ViT-Small (average distance error 0.187 vs 0.196), and the ViT-Tiny student runs 32$\times$ faster than its teacher on a laptop CPU. Second, apparent competence can conceal unreliable supervision: given another person's face centre in the prompt, InternVL3 and Qwen3-VL return it on 93.4% and 81.1% of test samples, and a copy-the-coordinate baseline matches InternVL3's labels and students. Without that coordinate, both models fall far behind the specialist. Third, good teachers can be identified before training: validation label error ranks student test error (Spearman's $ρ= 0.91$), and ten annotated clips single out the two specialist teachers in 95% of draws. These findings give practical principles for assessing supervision, exposing shortcuts and selecting teachers for lightweight models.

</details>


### [253] [RePix-VFI: Re-rendering Observed Pixels for Video Frame Interpolation with Generative Priors from One-Step Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33016)
*Dayeon Kim,Jeonghyeok Do,Munchurl Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RePix-VFI 将单步视频扩散的草稿精化与基于关键帧观测像素的重渲染结合，实现多帧视频插帧的高保真重建与高效生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多帧视频帧插值在大时间间隔下，光流法保留纹理但运动歧义时错位，迭代潜扩散法能合成合理内容但采样昂贵且 VAE 会改变细节。

Method: 预训练视频扩散模型单次前向精化流渲染的整窗草稿；对每个目标帧，用光流估计器将其两个边界关键帧匹配到生成预测，得到对应关系后在 VAE 之外重渲染原始关键帧 RGB 像素；最后用轻量外观融合头结合重渲染与生成外观。

Result: SNU-FILM ×8 与 ×16 上 PSNR 最高，LPIPS、FloLPIPS、tOF 最低，PSNR 分别超过最佳扩散基线 1.71 dB 和 1.48 dB，运行速度比最强多帧 VFI 扩散模型快 32–42 倍。

Conclusion: 以生成草稿引导加观测像素重渲染的方式，兼顾了感知质量与纹理保真，并显著提升多帧 VFI 效率。

Abstract: Multi-frame video frame interpolation (VFI) aims to reconstruct dense video from sparse keyframes, requiring accurate intermediate motion and faithful appearance. As temporal gaps grow, flow-based methods can retain observed textures but misplace them under ambiguous motion, whereas iterative latent-diffusion models can synthesize plausible content but incur substantial sampling costs and may alter details during reconstruction with a variational autoencoder (VAE). We present RePix-VFI, named for Re-rendering observed Pixels, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A pretrained video diffusion model refines a flow-rendered draft of the whole window in a single forward pass. For each target frame, our generative readback matches its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction using an optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB pixels outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction and perceptual quality. On SNU-FILM at $\times$8 and $\times$16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48dB in PSNR, respectively. It also runs 32--42$\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

</details>


### [254] [E-MAPS: Event-Based Promptable Video Segmentation with Memory-as-Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33017)
*Adonay Demewez Gebremedhin,Mohamad Alansari,Wessam Shehieb,Muzammal Naseer,Hasan AlMarzouqi,Sajid Javed,Naoufel Werghi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出事件相机可提示视频分割新任务ePVS与E-MAPS方法，通过事件到Token对齐与记忆感知提示，在三个基准上领先且更高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB视频目标分割在快速运动与恶劣光照下脆弱；事件相机在模糊/极端曝光时能保留信号但低速时证据不足；交互可恢复目标状态，而现有可提示事件方法仅处理单一窗口。

Method: 形式化事件基可提示视频分割ePVS（任意窗口提示可初始化、纠正或引入目标）。提出E-MAPS：将预训练可提示分割器迁移到事件流并学习传播与纠正。E2T对齐循环事件特征与预训练表示并保留提示条件先验；MAP将目标条件历史转为稀疏提示，使记忆与用户输入共享同一解码路径。构建EViM数据集（206K对齐RGB-事件对、620K掩码）与三个训练不相交基准。

Result: E-MAPS在三个基准的prompt-once与交互式ePVS中均领先，且更高效；在零样本目标跟踪基准上表现强。

Conclusion: 事件相机与交互式提示结合可构建高效、鲁棒的视频分割框架，E-MAPS验证了该范式的有效性与泛化性。

Abstract: RGB-based video object segmentation (VOS) remains brittle under fast motion and adverse illumination. Event cameras preserve signal under blur and challenging exposure, but provide little evidence when motion slows. Interaction can restore object state for subsequent propagation, yet promptable event methods merely address single windows. We formalize event-based Promptable Video Segmentation (ePVS), where prompts at arbitrary windows initialize, correct, or introduce objects and predictions. We present Event Memory-As-Prompt Segmentation (E-MAPS), which transfers a pretrained promptable segmenter to event streams and learns propagation and correction. Event-to-Token (E2T) aligns recurrent event features with pretrained representations while preserving prompt-conditioning priors. Memory-Aware Prompting (MAP) converts object-conditioned history into sparse prompts, allowing memory and user inputs to share one decoder pathway efficiently. We construct Event-View Masklets (EViM) from 206K aligned RGB-event pairs and 620K masks for two-stage representation transfer and native event-video learning, and establish three training-disjoint benchmarks. E-MAPS leads prompt-once and interactive ePVS across all three benchmarks while being more efficient. It further demonstrates strong performance on zero-shot object tracking benchmarks. Project page: https://github.com/adonaydem/emaps-wacv

</details>


### [255] [GRAPE-Bench: When Vision Degrades, Does Video Reasoning Hold?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33020)
*Ce Zhang,Junyi He,Tianshi Ming,Jinxi He,Jianshu Zhang,Xiyuan Yang,Jianuo Zhu,Yicheng Tao,Xiyu Luo,Minghao Fu,Jiahui Zhu,Kehan Guo,Yunzhong Xiao,Jingyang Lin,Wei Chow,Lingdong Kong,Katia Sycara,Yaqi Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GRAPE-Bench，联合评估视觉退化与问题难度下的视频推理，揭示合成/真实条件排名反转与层级化弱点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频推理模型在标准基准上表现强，但对视觉退化脆弱，安全关键场景可靠性存疑；现有基准仅模拟退化或仅用难题探测，未覆盖自然退化视频及安全驾驶所需的简单判断。

Method: 构建合成集（12类损坏，日常生活与驾驶视频）+真实夜间/雨雪雾驾驶数据；每段视频配3个递进难度问题（安全相关基础判断→高难推理）。评估开放权重与前沿模型，并尝试合成数据微调、干净特权在线策略蒸馏、偏好引导。

Result: 合成与真实条件下模型排名反转；整体准确率掩盖层级弱点。合成数据微调使Qwen3.5-9B真实准确率76.7%→81.1%，干净特权在线策略蒸馏达80.4%；偏好引导可连续调节安全判断与难题推理的权衡，总体准确率变化小。

Conclusion: GRAPE-Bench为退化视觉条件下的视频推理提供统一测试平台，支持评估、改进与控制。

Abstract: Despite strong performance on standard benchmarks, video reasoning models remain vulnerable to visual degradation, raising concerns about their reliability in safety-critical scenarios. Existing benchmarks address this concern in part by simulating visual degradation or probing model reasoning with challenging questions, leaving open how well models handle naturally degraded video and whether they can make the simpler judgments that matter for safe driving. To this end, we introduce GRAPE-Bench, which jointly evaluates video reasoning across visual degradation conditions and question difficulty. It combines a synthetic set spanning twelve corruption types across daily-life and driving videos with real-world footage of driving at night or in rain, snow, or fog. Each video is paired with three progressively challenging questions, from fundamental judgments with potential safety implications to demanding reasoning stress tests. Across open-weight and frontier models, we observe ranking reversals between synthetic and real-world conditions and level-specific weaknesses obscured by overall accuracy. Synthetic-data fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-9B's real-world accuracy from 76.7% to 81.1%, while clean-privileged on-policy distillation reaches 80.4% in a separate reasoning-enabled setting. Through preference steering, we further demonstrate continuous control over a frozen model's trade-off between safety-relevant judgments and challenging reasoning, with little change in overall accuracy. Together, GRAPE-Bench provides a unified testbed for evaluating, improving, and controlling video reasoning under degraded visual conditions.

</details>


### [256] [SHARPnP: Self-Supervised and Plug-and-Play Hyperspectral Super-Resolution from Real Noisy Unaligned Camera Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33032)
*Mohamad Jouni,Brayan Monroy,Jorge Bacca,Mauro Dalla Mura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SHARPnP是一个无需干净高分辨率参考、可解释且灵活的RGB引导高光谱超分辨框架，将配准与重建耦合，能在含噪、未对齐的测量上自监督训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低成本快照高光谱相机单次曝光成像但空间分辨率低、噪声大；RGB相机提供精细可见光细节但存在空间变化的跨相机错位。现有监督融合方法需大量干净高分辨率HSI数据、对噪声敏感、跨传感器泛化差。

Method: 通过跨视角损失经固定即插即用融合模块反向传播，微调预训练配准模型；利用时间/重损坏配对在噪声输入上做无参考自监督；测试时校准跨相机辐射并精化对齐；即插即用融合采用顺序三波段去噪。

Result: 在REAL基准上，干净输入下4×/8×/16×均优于监督融合基线，高斯噪声(σ=5/255、10/255)下4×也优于基线；在原生RGB-HSI快照测量上无需高分辨参考即重建全部51个VIS-NIR波段，超越常规31波段VIS设置。

Conclusion: 该框架在无干净参考条件下实现稳健的RGB引导高光谱超分辨，兼具可解释性与跨传感器灵活性。

Abstract: Affordable snapshot hyperspectral cameras capture spectral images in a single exposure but suffer from limited spatial resolution and sensor noise. Low-cost RGB cameras provide fine visible details to guide NIR reconstruction, but introduce spatially varying cross-camera misalignment. Supervised fusion methods require relatively large datasets of clean, high-resolution hyperspectral images, are sensitive to sensor noise, and generalize poorly across new sensors. We introduce SHARPnP, an interpretable, flexible framework coupling registration and reconstruction for RGB-guided hyperspectral super-resolution from noisy, unaligned measurements without clean references. We adapt a pretrained registration model via a cross-view loss backpropagated through a fixed plug-and-play fusion module. Temporal and recorrupted pairs enable reference-free self-supervision on noisy inputs. At test time, we calibrate cross-camera radiometry and refine alignment. Plug-and-play fusion employs sequential three-band denoising. On the REAL benchmark, SHARPnP outperforms supervised fusion baselines at $4\times$, $8\times$, and $16\times$ on clean inputs and at $4\times$ under Gaussian noise ($σ=5/255, 10/255$). On native RGB-HSI snapshot measurements, it reconstructs all 51 VIS-NIR bands, beyond the conventional 31-band VIS setting, without high-resolution references.

</details>


### [257] [Linear Probes Can Guide: Training-Free Control of Representation Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33037)
*Pengwei Wang,José Morano,Botond Fazekas,Hrvoje Bogunović*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 LiSM 框架，利用预训练视觉基础模型（VFM）表示空间的线性可读性，将语义引导转化为贝叶斯线性逆问题，实现无需训练的条件控制，并提出 Fit-Path 求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表示空间生成模型（如 RAE）仅把 VFM 用作加速训练和提升保真度的重建分词器，忽视了其表示空间高度结构化、线性可读的特性。该特性可消除事后引导（post-hoc guidance）的关键障碍，避免额外的训练时条件化。

Method: 基于线性期望性质：对理想去噪器预测施加干净的线性探针，可得到任意噪声水平下探针分数的精确后验均值（称为 Semantic Mean-Space）。据此将语义引导建模为贝叶斯线性逆问题，提出统一的 Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space（LiSM）框架，并开发/适配多种求解器，按其探针空间不确定性估计与修正传导方式分类。进一步提出兼顾全局与局部控制的 Fit-Path 求解器。

Result: 在类别、属性、前景、关键点四种控制设定下，LiSM 系列方法（尤其 Fit-Path）均实现有效且轻量的全局/局部控制，优于噪声感知引导与像素空间引导方法。

Conclusion: VFM 表示空间的线性结构使语义引导可转化为线性逆问题，从而无需训练即可实现高效、多粒度的生成控制；LiSM 提供了统一框架，Fit-Path 在实践中表现最佳。

Abstract: Representation-space generative models, such as Representation Autoencoders (RAEs), leverage pretrained vision foundation models (VFMs) primarily to accelerate training and improve sample fidelity. Yet VFMs are more than reconstruction tokenizers, as they feature rich representation spaces that are highly organized and linearly readable. We observe that this removes a key obstacle of post-hoc guidance: by linearity of expectation, a clean probe applied to an ideal denoiser's prediction yields the exact posterior mean of the probe scores at any noise level. This regime, which we call Semantic Mean-Space, turns semantic guidance into a Bayesian linear inverse problem, bypassing the need for training-time conditioning. With this foundation, we propose LiSM, a unified framework for Linear Guidance in Semantic Mean-Space. To validate the framework, we developed and adapted different solvers, and characterized them based on how they estimate probe-space uncertainty and propagate the correction through the representation. In addition, we propose Fit-Path, a solver designed to achieve strong global and local control. Our results in four control setups (class, attributes, foreground, and keypoints) show that LiSM methods, and Fit-Path in particular, provide effective, lightweight control across global and local tasks, outperforming noise-aware and pixel-space guidance.

</details>


### [258] [Spectrify: Framework for Hyperspectral Image Generation Using Computer Graphics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33042)
*Yasin Mamedov,Daniil Vladimirov,Sofiia Dorogova,Bakhtiyar Khalfin,Egor Ershov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Spectrify 将 3D 场景数据集转化为高光谱图像（HSI），并配套按材料标注的反射率光谱库，用 Mitsuba 3 逐波长路径追踪全光传输；仅用其合成的 4500 张 HSI 训练的高光谱重建网络在多数测试集上优于用最大真实 HSI 数据集训练的网络，RAW 投影图对颜色恒常性任务也有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实 HSI 采集慢且昂贵，最大数据集仅约 1000 张。高层视觉可用 3D 渲染场景替代稀缺真实数据，但低层任务需要物理正确的光谱，要求场景中每种材质都有实测光谱；已有光谱渲染仅覆盖少量场景且多用简化成像模型。

Method: 提出 Spectrify 框架：构建按材料类别标注的反射率光谱库（汇编近距离高光谱数据集与分光光度计测量）。光谱随材料走——每个物体按其材料类别获得基于物理的光学模型与实测反射率光谱或光学常数，每种灯具用其类型的发射光谱，天空用建模日光光谱；再用 Mitsuba 3 对每个场景逐波长路径追踪完整光传输，渲染出 HSI。

Result: 仅用合成 HSI 训练的高光谱重建网络在大部分测试集上对未见真实数据集泛化优于用最大真实 HSI 数据集训练的网络；按材料类别而非仅按颜色分配光谱，在所有测试集上均提升迁移效果。由 HSI 投影的 RAW 图在颜色恒常性任务上与现有合成 RAW 生成器表现相当。

Conclusion: 基于物理的光谱渲染加材料标注光谱库可有效缓解 HSI 数据稀缺，生成数据在重建与 RAW 任务上具备实用价值。作者公开 4500 张渲染 HSI、Spectrify 代码及材料标注反射率库。

Abstract: Hyperspectral images (HSIs) record the full spectrum of light at every pixel, so projecting an HSI through a camera's spectral sensitivities gives that camera's RAW image, and one HSI can supply training data for hyperspectral reconstruction and camera-pipeline methods. Real HSIs, however, are slow and expensive to capture, and the largest datasets hold only about 1,000 images. High-level vision commonly replaces scarce real data with images rendered from 3D scenes. Low-level tasks, however, need physically correct spectra, which requires spectral rendering with a measured spectrum for every material in a scene, and existing spectral renderings cover only a handful of scenes, mostly with a simplified image formation model. We present Spectrify, a framework that converts 3D scene datasets into HSIs, together with a library of reflectance spectra labeled by material and compiled from close-range hyperspectral datasets and spectrophotometer measurements.
