In Spectrify, spectra follow the material: each object receives a physically based optical model and measured reflectance spectra or optical constants from its material category, each lamp an emission spectrum of its type and the sky a modeled daylight spectrum, and Mitsuba 3 path-traces the full light transport of each scene per wavelength. We show that a hyperspectral reconstruction network trained only on our synthetic HSIs generalizes to unseen real datasets better than networks trained on the largest real HSI datasets on most test sets, and that assigning spectra by material category instead of by color alone improves this transfer on every test set. RAW images projected from our HSIs are also useful training data for color constancy, performing on par with existing synthetic RAW generators. We release the 4,500 rendered HSIs, the code of Spectrify and its material-labeled reflectance library.

</details>


### [259] [SUPRA: Synthesizing Amyloid PET from MRI and Plasma Biomarkers with an Explicit Regional SUVR Prior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33061)
*Hanwen Li,Fadi Deek,Zhi Wei,Ruixiang Tang,Feng Liu,Bharat Biswal,Michal Schnaider Beeri,Auriel Willette,Chenxi Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SUPRA利用血浆生物标志物提供淀粉样蛋白信息、MRI提供图像质量，合成接近真实的淀粉样蛋白PET，并在多队列上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 淀粉样蛋白PET是量化脑内Aβ的金标准，但成本高、可及性差；结构MRI常规可得但难以推断淀粉样负荷，单靠MRI合成PET是病态问题。

Method: 两部分分工：先用回归将血浆标志物组合（含仅p-tau217）映射为区域SUVR，并绘制到受试者MRI分割图上作为显式先验；再由3D网络在MRI引导下做残差校正，输出绝对SUVR值。

Result: ADNI（111对测试）PSNR 23.4 dB（对比≤20.7 dB），复合皮层/早期累积区/纹状体SUVR秩相关0.56–0.67（对比≤0.24）；第二个认知正常队列（143对）22.8 dB、0.32–0.61（对比≤21.4 dB、0.20）；淀粉样阳性AUC 0.91/0.82（对比≤0.63）。

Conclusion: 消融表明血浆提供淀粉样信息、网络提供图像质量；MRI+血液检测可生成逼真且能跨脑区追踪负荷的合成淀粉样PET。

Abstract: Amyloid positron emission tomography (PET) quantifies brain amyloid-$β$ as a standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR), but is costly and not widely available. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is routine, and plasma biomarkers such as phosphorylated tau 217 (p-tau217) are becoming practical. Synthesizing amyloid PET from MRI alone is ill-posed, because brain anatomy reveals little about amyloid burden. We present SUPRA (SUVR prior-guided amyloid synthesis), which divides this task between MRI and plasma biomarkers. A regression maps the plasma panel to regional SUVR levels, painted onto the subject's MRI segmentation as an explicit prior. A 3D network then adds a residual correction guided by MRI. The output is in absolute SUVR, and the model also runs on p-tau217 alone. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort (111 test pairs), SUPRA reaches a peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) of 23.4 dB, against at most 20.7 dB for four published models, and rank correlations of 0.56 to 0.67 with true SUVR in the composite cortex, an early-accumulation region and the striatum, against at most 0.24. In a second, cognitively unimpaired cohort with other plasma platforms (143 test pairs), it reaches 22.8 dB and 0.32 to 0.61, against at most 21.4 dB and 0.20. Its area under the curve for amyloid positivity is 0.91 and 0.82, against at most 0.63. Ablations show that plasma supplies the amyloid information and the network the image quality. Combining MRI with a blood test yields synthetic amyloid PET that is realistic and tracks burden across regions.

</details>


### [260] [RenGen: Generating Images with as Many Tokens as the Scene Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33109)
*Savya Khosla,Jay Mahajan,Akin Tuna Sakalli,Derek Hoiem,David Forsyth,Alex Schwing*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RenGen 是一种区域式潜扩散模型，用数量可变的区域 token 生成图像：简单场景用少量 token，复杂场景用较多 token，从而在保持画质的前提下按场景复杂度换取计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流潜扩散模型把所有图像都表示为固定网格的 patch token，导致简单图像与复杂图像的生成代价相同；而此前内容自适应 token 化的方法在减少 token 时会损失画质。作者希望用"场景复杂度"而非"图像质量"来换取更少 token。

Method: 在预训练区域编码器的潜空间中进行生成，每个 token 代表图像中的一个区域，由解码器渲染回像素。由于区域形状和位置可变，每个 token 需同时编码"内容"和"位置"：在池化前向编码器特征加入位置嵌入以编码空间范围；生成时把每个 token 锚定到一个随机采样点，由生成器推断该区域的形状、尺寸与内容。采样时锚点数量决定场景复杂度与计算量的权衡。

Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，平均 88 个 token 时 gFID 达 1.34，为可变 token 数方法中最佳；以 2.5× 更低的延迟接近 SOTA patch 方法 RAEv2。gFID 在不同场景复杂度下基本持平，而延迟在最简单与最复杂场景间相差 2.4×；自编码器重建接近 RAEv2（rFID 0.32 vs 0.30），同时 token 数少 2.9×。

Conclusion: RenGen 通过"区域 token + 随机锚点"实现按场景复杂度自适应的计算分配，推进了生成质量与计算量的 Pareto 前沿，优于固定 patch 网格和以往自适应 token 化方法。

Abstract: We present RenGen, a latent diffusion model that generates simple scenes from a few tokens and busy scenes from many, saving time and compute on simple scenes without losing realism. Most latent generators represent every image as a fixed grid of patch tokens, so a simple image costs as much to generate as a complex one. Prior methods that vary the token count through content-adaptive tokenization lose image quality as the count shrinks. RenGen instead trades scene complexity, rather than image quality, for fewer tokens. It does so by generating in the latent space of a pretrained region encoder, where each token represents one region of the image, and a decoder renders these region tokens back into pixels. Unlike patch tokens, region tokens cover areas of varying shape and position, so each token must capture both what its region contains and where it lies on the image canvas. We encode this spatial extent by adding positional embeddings to the encoder features before pooling, and we generate it by anchoring each token to a single randomly sampled point, from which the generator infers the region's shape, size, and content. At sampling time, the number of anchor points sets the trade-off between scene complexity and compute. On ImageNet $256{\times}256$, RenGen reaches a gFID of 1.34 with 88 tokens per image on average, the best among methods that vary their token count. It approaches the quality of RAEv2, a state-of-the-art patch-based model, at $2.5{\times}$ lower latency, advancing the Pareto frontier of generation quality versus compute. RenGen's gFID stays flat across scene complexity while latency varies by $2.4{\times}$ between simplest and busiest scenes, and its autoencoder reconstructs nearly as well as RAEv2 (rFID 0.32 vs. 0.30) with $2.9{\times}$ fewer tokens.

</details>


### [261] [Physicl Scenes: An Artist-created 3D Dataset for Learning Perception and Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33137)
*Yueh-Cheng Liu,Snehal Jauhri,Matthias Nießner,Angela Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Physicl Scenes：6,499 个艺术家创建/精选的 3D 场景数据集，含几何、物理材质、对象与部件级语义标注，支持逆渲染、3D 重建、场景理解与移动操作等任务，并配套移动操作基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成数据集在几何真实感、材质、语义标注粒度（尤其部件级）与具身任务支持上不足，缺少同时服务于视觉与具身学习的联合监督数据。

Method: 构建覆盖家庭房间、公共室内与室外空间的 6,499 个高质量艺术家创建场景，提供精细几何、基于物理的材质、精心构图，以及对象级和部件级语义标注；用多任务的 SOTA 方法训练验证，并设计基于部件标注评估抓取位置的移动操作 VLA 基准。

Result: 在逆渲染、3D 重建、场景理解、移动操作四类任务上，使用该场景训练优于其他合成数据集；新基准可评估 VLA 模型在真实布局下的物理抓取放置，并对抓取位置打分。

Conclusion: 该数据集将公开释放，为视觉与具身 AI 研究提供高质量联合监督基准，推动相关领域发展。

Abstract: We present Physicl Scenes, a high-quality artist-created and curated dataset of 6,499 3D scenes spanning household rooms, public interiors, and outdoor spaces. The dataset combines detailed geometry, physically based materials, and carefully composed environments with object- and part-level semantic annotations, providing rich, joint supervision for visual and embodied learning. We demonstrate its value as training data across inverse rendering, 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and mobile manipulation. Across these tasks, training state-of-the-art methods with our scenes improves performance over alternative synthetic datasets. In addition, we introduce a mobile manipulation benchmark, evaluating vision-language-action models performing physical pick and place in diverse 3D scenes with realistic layouts, and using our part annotations to also score where each object is grasped. Our dataset will be released publicly to facilitate research in visual and embodied AI.

</details>


### [262] [Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33145)
*Zehan Zheng,Yanyuan Chen,Deming Li,Yutao Tang,Jianwen Xie,Alan Yuille,Jieneng Chen,Cheng Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Lost on Campus 基准，基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建大规模真实户外校园 3D 环境，用统一"推理-行动"框架评测视觉语言模型的具身空间推理（ESR），并诊断六项能力短板。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多在静态图像或合成室内场景中评测空间推理，语义捷径即可过关，无法忠实反映真实世界中的具身空间推理能力，因此需要大规模、真实、连续的户外 3D 环境评测。

Method: 用 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建真实户外校园 3D 环境；设计统一的推理-行动评测框架，将孤立推理的诊断式问答与多模态指令下的闭环交互式导航结合；按六个能力维度（动作落地、空间前瞻、度量感知、目标导向规划、自我-他我定位、时空一致性）进行细粒度诊断。

Result: 实验表明：(i) 真实户外环境比室内场景对空间推理要求更高，现有模型表现明显较差；(ii) VLM 在细粒度视觉对齐上仍有困难，空间前瞻与自我-他我定位是主要瓶颈；(iii) 提升多模态交互与长程空间推理对具身智能至关重要。

Conclusion: 忠实地评测 ESR 需要将感知、推理与行动紧密耦合于真实、连续环境中的基准；Lost on Campus 提供了这一评测范式并揭示模型的关键短板。

Abstract: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.

</details>


### [263] [One Take, Many Cameras: Audio-Grounded Shot Synthesis for Dialogue Re-Cinematography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33147)
*Anthony Chen,Naomi Ken Korem,Matan Ben-Yosef,Tavi Halperin,Urska Jelercic,Ofir Bibi,Daniel Cohen-Or,Or Patashnik,Maneesh Agrawala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"对话再摄影"任务：从单段广角对话视频合成新的机位镜头（近景、中景、过肩镜头等），利用语音音频的视角不变性驱动任意目标视角下的唇部运动，并用免训练的说话人感知音频门控消除多人场景的语音泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话场景需要多视角、多景别的剪辑覆盖，但真实拍摄成本高、很多场景难以实现。现有视频生成器只依赖视觉线索，当源视频中人物嘴部几乎不可见时，生成的唇动与语音不匹配；且多人场景下预训练音视频模型会让所有可见人脸（包括沉默的听者）同步口型，产生语音泄漏。

Method: 基于预训练音视频扩散模型进行适配，输入三要素：指定视角的目标帧、包含表演的源视频、驱动唇动的语音音频，生成新的目标镜头。并引入说话人感知音频门控（speaker-aware audio gating）——一个免训练模块，使音频只作用于目标镜头中真正说话的人脸。

Result: 在覆盖多视角与多景别的电影配对视角基准上，相较最强基线 Wan 3.0，感知误差降低 59%、关键点误差降低 56%、语音泄漏降低 97%；在真实野外场景中同样保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 音频的视角不变性是实现跨视角对话再摄影的关键信号；方法在基准与真实场景均有效，显示出面向电影后期制作的潜力。

Abstract: Creating a dialogue scene typically requires cutting between multiple views (e.g., close-ups, medium shots, and over-the-shoulder shots) of the actors. Yet capturing such coverage is costly and in many settings unavailable. We study dialogue re-cinematography: synthesizing additional shots from a single wide-angle dialogue video. Existing video generators can synthesize new shots, but rely on visual cues alone, so when the source video barely shows the lips, the generated lip motion fails to match the speech. Our key observation is that the speech audio is view-invariant: it constrains lip motion in any target view. Building on this insight, we adapt a pretrained audio-visual diffusion model to generate the new shot from a target frame that specifies the view, a source video that contains the performance, and the speech audio that drives lip motion. In multi-person scenes, however, pretrained audio-visual models drive every visible face with the same speech, causing speech leakage, where silent listeners mouth the speaker's words. We therefore introduce speaker-aware audio gating, a training-free module that lets the audio drive only the faces that speak in the target shot. On a cinematic paired-view benchmark spanning diverse viewpoints and framings, our method lowers perceptual error by 59%, landmark error by 56%, and speech leakage by 97% relative to the strongest baseline, Wan 3.0. Our method also remains robust on in-the-wild scenes, highlighting its potential for film post-production.

</details>


### [264] [PointX: Multi-View Consistent Intrinsics by Querying Surface Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33157)
*Miguel Farinha,Sam Sartor,Iliyan Georgiev,Giuseppe Vecchio,Ronald Clark,Michael Fischer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PointX提出一种前馈模型，直接在3D表面点上预测内禀属性（albedo、roughness、metallicity、normal、irradiance），从根本上保证多视图一致性，并支持重光照与编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从图像恢复内禀分解本身是病态问题，而逐像素预测的方法会让同一表面点在不同视角得到不一致的分解结果，导致跨视图不一致。

Method: 用多视图Transformer编码一组无位姿图像；对任意查询的3D表面点，将该点在所有可见视图中的token池化，只解码一次得到该点的内禀属性。对点云/网格的每个点给出单一预测。也可通过查询每个像素所对应的点来生成逐视图映射。

Result: 一致性显著优于现有方法；单图精度仍具竞争力，且随视图增加而提升；逐视图映射在几何与对应关系精度范围内保持一致。

Conclusion: 将预测目标从像素改为3D表面点，是获得天然视图一致内禀分解的有效途径，可用于视图一致的重光照与编辑。

Abstract: The appearance of a scene is determined by the albedo, roughness, metallicity and normal of every point on its surface, and by the light that reaches it, its irradiance. Recovering these intrinsics from images is ambiguous, and methods that predict them per pixel give the same surface point a different decomposition in every view. We introduce PointX, a simple feed-forward model that predicts intrinsics per 3D surface point instead. A multi-view transformer encodes a set of unposed images, and for any queried surface point, PointX pools the point's tokens across the views in which it appears and decodes the point's intrinsics once. Each point of a 3D reconstruction of the scene, such as a point cloud or a mesh, thus receives a single prediction, which is exactly consistent across views by construction and enables view-consistent relighting and editing. The same model also predicts per-view maps, from one image or many, by querying the point seen at every pixel. These maps agree across views up to the precision of the estimated geometry and correspondences. PointX is significantly more consistent than existing methods, while remaining competitive in accuracy from a single image and improving as views are added. Project page: https://pointx-paper.github.io/

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [265] [Validation Bias in Large Language Model Responses to Cancer Treatment Queries: A Factorial Cross-Sectional Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31251)
*Ramez Kouzy,Saketh Vinjamuri,Sarah Ghalayini,Jack Gallifant,Shan Chen,Marielle Fis Loperana,Roxanna Attar-Olyaee,Danielle S. Bitterman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过2x2x2因子设计分析14个LLM的1,272段癌症治疗对话，发现LLM存在"确认偏误"：当用户持有与证据不符的信念时，不安全回答率近乎翻三倍（14.4% vs 5.1%，OR 3.14）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 患者越来越多使用LLM聊天机器人获取癌症信息，但当用户表达与循证医学不符的治疗信念时，LLM的安全性尚未被系统刻画。作者假设LLM存在确认偏误（validation bias），即倾向于肯定而非纠正此类信念。

Method: 采用2x2x2因子设计，交叉对话形式（单轮vs多轮）、治疗类型（循证vs替代疗法）、查询效价（正/负）。框架分为证据对齐与证据错位两类。分析了6家厂商14个LLM共1,272段对话（6,360次交互），使用GPT-5-mini作为LLM评判者，基于经人工标注验证的6维安全评分标准评分；主要结局为不安全回答率（Weak分类或任何关键失败）。

Result: 证据错位框架显著提高不安全回答率（14.4% vs 5.1%；OR 3.14，95% CI 2.07-4.78；P<.001），控制模型聚类后仍稳健。证据对齐下评为Strong的429段对话中，22.6%在配对的证据错位版本中降级。多轮对话不安全率低于单轮（5.2% vs 14.7%，P<.001）。不同厂商不安全率从1.8%至36.8%不等。

Conclusion: LLM在肿瘤学领域存在显著确认偏误，证据错位框架下不安全回答近乎三倍。仅评估中性、求事实型查询会高估真实世界安全性，医疗AI安全测试应纳入证据错位的用户表述框架。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) chatbots are increasingly used by patients seeking cancer information, but their safety when users present evidence-misaligned beliefs about treatment remains uncharacterized. We hypothesized that LLMs exhibit validation bias, affirming rather than correcting such beliefs, and evaluated this with a 2x2x2 factorial design crossing conversation format (single-turn vs multi-turn), treatment type (evidence-based vs alternative), and query valence (positive vs negative). Framing was evidence-aligned (supporting evidence-based treatments or questioning alternative therapies) or evidence-misaligned (promoting alternative treatments or questioning evidence-based therapies). We analyzed 1,272 conversations (6,360 interactions) across 14 LLMs from 6 vendors, scored by an LLM judge (GPT-5-mini) validated against human annotation on a 6-dimension safety rubric. The primary outcome was the unsafe response rate, defined as a Weak classification or any critical failure. Evidence-misaligned framing increased unsafe response rates compared with evidence-aligned framing (14.4% vs 5.1%; OR 3.14, 95% CI 2.07-4.78; P < .001), and the association persisted after accounting for clustering by LLM. Among 429 conversations classified as Strong under evidence-aligned framing, 22.6% were downgraded in their paired evidence-misaligned counterpart. Multi-turn conversations had lower unsafe response rates than single-turn conversations (5.2% vs 14.7%; P < .001). Unsafe response rates varied by vendor from 1.8% to 36.8%. LLMs exhibited significant validation bias in oncology, with unsafe responses nearly tripling under evidence-misaligned framing. Evaluations limited to neutral, fact-seeking queries may overestimate real-world safety, and safety testing of medical AI systems should include evidence-misaligned user framing.

</details>


### [266] [DAGGER: Deployment-Free Quality Estimation for Generative AI Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31252)
*Dimitrios Liakopoulos,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DAGGER 将生成式 AI 工作流建模为图，把质量分解为节点精度项与边依赖项，用解析公式结合 SVD 矩阵补全，从稀疏观测中估算端到端质量，无需穷举部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多阶段工作流中误差会跨阶段传播，端到端质量同时取决于各模型精度与阶段间影响；穷举所有模型配置的部署评估代价过高，现有方法在估算成本与准确性之间难以兼顾。

Method: 把工作流表示为图（节点=阶段，边=阶段间输出依赖），将工作流质量分解为逐节点精度项和逐边依赖项，提出新的解析式表述，并用基于 SVD 的矩阵补全从稀疏观测中估算质量，避免执行全部候选工作流。

Result: 在 3 类生成式 AI 工作流、3 个数据集上评估：质量估算中位误差 6.8 个百分点，profiling 成本相比 SOTA 基线 BenchPress 降低 10.2×，所选工作流配置与 LLMSelector 等框架相当。

Conclusion: 通过图分解加矩阵补全，可在不穷举部署的前提下较准确地预测工作流端到端质量，显著降低评估成本并选出有竞争力的配置。

Abstract: Estimating the quality of generative AI workflows is challenging because these workflows comprise multiple stages, and errors can propagate across them, making end-to-end performance depend not only on the accuracy of individual models but also on how their outputs affect downstream stages. Each stage can use one of many candidate models. Estimating end-to-end workflow quality by deploying and evaluating every resulting model configuration is therefore prohibitively expensive. As a result, existing approaches face a tradeoff between estimation cost and accuracy: inexpensive methods often produce unreliable quality estimates, while accurate methods require deploying and evaluating many workflow configurations. In this paper, we introduce DAGGER, a framework for estimating the quality of generative AI workflows without exhaustive deployment and profiling. DAGGER represents a workflow as a graph, in which nodes correspond to stages and edges capture how outputs from one stage affect subsequent stages. It then decomposes workflow quality into per-node accuracy terms and per-edge dependency terms. Using a novel analytical formulation and SVD-based matrix completion, DAGGER estimates workflow quality from sparse observations without executing every candidate workflow. We evaluate DAGGER on three generative AI workflows across three datasets. DAGGER estimates workflow quality with a median error of 6.8 percentage points while reducing profiling cost by 10.2$\times$ relative to BenchPress, a state-of-the-art baseline, and selects workflow configurations competitive with state-of-the-art frameworks such as LLMSelector.

</details>


### [267] [Instantiation of Human Values in Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31253)
*Maria-Teresa De Rosa Palmini,Piera Riccio,Noa Garcia,Eva Cetinic*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文基于Schwartz基本价值观理论构建"价值实例化"研究框架，用70个正负价值条目生成28,000张图像，发现T2I模型对价值观的视觉表征远比人类描述更集中，默认呈现超个人主义、成人中心的世界观，并据此提出一种多样化引导方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2I模型日益深入日常视觉文化，但人们对其如何将成功、关怀、自由等抽象人类价值转化为视觉场景几乎一无所知，存在研究空白。

Method: 以Schwartz基本价值观理论为基础，使用70个正负价值条目的人称化提示词，在4个SOTA T2I模型上生成28,000张图像；识别由主体、动作、场景构成的"视觉原型"，量化实例化的收窄程度并与人类描述对比；再将原型映射到涵盖场景、社会性、参与方式与社会语域的"社会配置"分类体系。

Result: T2I模型的价值表征远比人类描述集中；模型默认采用超个人主义、成人中心的视角，复现价值特定联想（如成就=正式机构场景、享乐主义=富裕消费），同时边缘化日常劳动、关系性关怀与非成人视角。

Conclusion: 这些结构性缺口可作为概念验证，指导一种在无需修改原始提示词的情况下实现输出多样化的引导方法。

Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models are increasingly embedded in everyday visual culture, yet little is known about how they translate abstract human values into visual scenes. We address this gap by introducing a framework, grounded in Schwartz's theory of basic human values, for studying value instantiation: the process by which ideals such as success, care, or freedom are visually realized. Using person-centered prompts from 70 positive and negative value items, we generate 28,000 images across four state-of-the-art T2I models. We identify visual prototypes, recurring combinations of subjects, actions, and settings, and use them to quantify how narrowly models instantiate these values and how this breadth compares with human descriptions of the same items. We then map these prototypes onto a taxonomy of social configurations spanning setting, sociality, mode of engagement, and social register, revealing what is systematically foregrounded or omitted. Our results show that T2I models produce far more concentrated representations than humans do when describing the same values. They default to a hyper-individualistic, adult-centric worldview, reproducing value-specific associations, such as achievement tied to formal institutional settings or hedonism rendered as affluent consumption, while marginalizing everyday labor, relational care, and non-adult perspectives. As a proof of concept, we show that these structural gaps can guide a steering method that diversifies outputs without modifying the original prompt.

</details>


### [268] [The Date You Didn't Set: The System-Prompt Date as a Hidden Variable in LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31254)
*Noureldin Zahran,Mohammed E. Fouda,Khaled N. Khasawneh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 指令微调模型的系统提示中常自动填入当前日期，导致同一次评测每日输入不同。作者发现日期可让中位6.6%的题项在正确/错误间翻转，甚至造成Llama-3.x最高36.5分准确率损失，且11个评测框架无一固定日期。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多指令微调模型的系统提示会自动填入"今天"的日期，使原本固定的评测在不知不觉中每天使用不同提示，从而使评测结果不可复现、比较失真。作者想量化这种隐藏输入对评测结果的影响，并检查现有评测框架是否对此加以控制。

Method: 在6个指令微调模型和4个基准上，固定提示、解码与配置，只改变两个"合理"日期（2024–2026）进行对比；比较隔天重跑与改变batch size造成的题项翻转；用语法约束版本的GCG在任意年份中搜索日期以最大化留出集性能下降；并考察日期对LLM评判判定和越狱复现成功率的影响；最后审计11个评测框架的日期处理方式。

Result: 所有模型均受影响：两个合理日期之间，中位6.6%的测试题项在正确与错误间切换；隔日重跑翻转的题项数与改变batch size相当。GCG搜索出的日期可使Llama-3.x在留出集上最多损失36.5分准确率。换日期还会改变LLM评判结论，并使Llama-3.2-3B上15%–32%已复现的越狱成功失效。审计的11个评测框架均未固定日期。固定日期后重跑可逐字节复现。

Conclusion: 系统提示中的日期是一个被忽视的重要评测变量，会显著影响准确率、评判结果与安全性评测的复现性。作者建议评测时固定（pin）、记录并报告所用日期，以确保结果可复现与可比较。

Abstract: The system prompt of many instruction-tuned models carries a date, usually today's, filled in automatically for conversational and agentic requests alike, so an unchanged evaluation can send a different prompt each day. In this paper, we explore how much this hidden input changes evaluation outcomes. Across six instruction-tuned models and four benchmarks, with prompts, decoding, and configuration fixed, every model is affected: two plausible dates (2024--2026) switch a median $6.6\%$ of test items between correct and incorrect. Even rerunning the evaluation one day later flips about as many items as changing the batch size, although nothing in the setup was changed. In addition, using a grammar-constrained variant of Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) to search dates of any year, we find dates that cost the Llama-3.x models up to $36.5$ points of held-out accuracy. Beyond accuracy, switching to another plausible date alters LLM-judge verdicts and undoes $15$--$32\%$ of reproduced jailbreak successes on Llama-3.2-3B. Yet none of the eleven evaluation stacks we audit pins the date. With the date and the rest of the setup fixed, reruns reproduce byte-for-byte; we therefore recommend pinning, logging, and reporting the date.

</details>


### [269] [INCLUDE-2.0: Disentangling Knowledge Gaps in Multilingual LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31255)
*Angelika Romanou,Maria Grandury,Clara Meister,Negar Foroutan,Jabez Magomere,Anna Sotnikova,Hitesh Laxmichand Patel,Akshay Kumar Dubey,Alfonso Amayuelas,Amit Agarwal,Arion Das,Carlos Arriaga,Cheng Yu,Dalia Ali,David Quispe-Castillo,Fenal Ashokbhai Ilasariya,Francisco-Javier Rodrigo-Gines,Gonzalo Martinez,Gouthami Vadithya,Guido Ivetta,Javier Conde,Jorge Vallego,Juan J. Calderon G.,Karan Gupta,Marcos J Gomez,Marvin M. Agüero-Torales,Mithil Bangera,Naira Paola Arnez Jordan,Oscar M. Cumbicus-Pineda,Priyaranjan Pattnayak,Reewos Erwin Talla Chumpitaz,Sahil Aggarwal,Sahil Raj,Shruti Jalan,Srikant Panda,Susana Zhou,Yeshil Bangera,Orestis Papakyriakopoulos,Scott A. Hale,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad,Antoine Bosselut*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 INCLUDE-2.0，一个覆盖 91 种语言、86 个国家（127 个语言-国家组合）、超过 22 万条来自本地来源样本的"区域感知"多语言事实评测基准，区分了四种区域知识类型，并揭示了聚合准确率掩盖的区域/语言差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多语言基准只覆盖预训练语料中的一小部分语言，且常把语言能力与回答特定地区和社群问题的能力混为一谈（把语言当作区域的代理变量）。

Method: 构建 INCLUDE-2.0：从本土区域来源采集数据，按区域知识类型（与语境无关、因国家而异、广泛记录的地方事实、主要依赖本地语言文化来源表达的知识）和领域逐条标注，每项配英文翻译，从而可控地对比语言熟练度与区域知识掌握情况；并在前沿与开源权重模型上评测。

Result: 聚合多语言准确率掩盖了知识类型、语言和区域间的巨大差异；前沿模型在"本地嵌入知识"上比"广泛记录的区域事实"平均低约 14.5 分；开源模型规模提升准确率，但未能可靠地使性能对提问语言（英文 vs. 原语言）保持不变。

Conclusion: 多语言评测需要显式区分区域知识类型；仅靠语言覆盖或模型规模无法解决本地知识获取与语言不变性问题。基准数据已公开于 Hugging Face。

Abstract: Current multilingual benchmarks cover only a fraction of the languages represented in modern pretraining corpora and often conflate language proficiency with the ability to answer questions grounded in specific regions and communities. We introduce INCLUDE-2.0, a large-scale benchmark for region-aware multilingual factual evaluation, which covers 91 languages from 86 countries (127 total language--country pairs), comprising over 220K curated samples drawn from native regional sources. Unlike existing benchmarks that often treat language as a proxy for region, IINCLUDE-2.0 distinguishes between questions whose answers are independent of context, vary by country, concern widely documented facts about a place, or depend on knowledge primarily expressed through local linguistic and cultural sources. Each item is annotated with its regional knowledge type and domain, and paired with an English translation, enabling controlled analysis of the relationship between language proficiency and possession of regional knowledge.
  Evaluating frontier and open-weight models on IINCLUDE-2.0, we find that aggregate multilingual accuracy masks substantial variation across regional knowledge types, languages, and regions. We find that frontier models perform worse on locally embedded knowledge than on widely documented facts about regions, with an average drop of ~14.5 points. We also show that for open-weight models, scale improves accuracy but does not reliably make performance invariant to whether a question is asked in English or its original language. INCLUDE-2.0 is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/epfl-nlp/include-2.0

</details>


### [270] [Directly Maximizing On-policy Expected Accepted Length for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31256)
*Ziying Zhang,Yaqing Wang,Yong Liu,Quanming Yao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FreDraft：一种直接最大化期望接受长度的on-policy草稿模型训练方法，通过前缀感知的信用分配与分布级梯度重分配，提升推测解码的接受长度与加速比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码中草稿训练通常优化token级分布对齐，但这并不直接优化"被接受前缀的长度"——一旦某个草稿token被拒绝，后续草稿token全部作废，导致优化目标与实际收益（接受长度）不一致。

Method: 提出on-policy训练方法，直接最大化从当前草稿模型采样的期望接受长度；该目标显式考虑首次拒绝截断，产生前缀感知的信用分配，按每个token对当前及后续token被接受的贡献加权。为高效优化，对token级接受率进行解析边缘化，利用目标模型词表分布降低梯度方差；并进一步将部分分布级梯度重分配为对"被草稿模型高估概率的采样token"的显式惩罚，同时保持期望梯度不变。

Result: 在多个基准和目标模型上，FreDraft相比强基线提升了接受长度与解码加速比，并实现了更快的on-policy训练收敛。

Conclusion: 直接优化接受长度并设计前缀感知、低方差且带高估惩罚的训练目标，是提升推测解码草稿质量与推理加速的有效途径。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose tokens for verification by a target model. Draft training commonly optimizes token-level distribution alignment, but this does not directly optimize the length of the accepted prefix: once a draft token is rejected, all subsequent draft tokens are discarded. We propose FreDraft, an on-policy training method that directly maximizes the expected accepted length of drafts sampled from the current draft model. This objective accounts for first-rejection truncation and induces prefix-aware credit assignment, weighting each token by its contribution to the acceptance of the current and subsequent tokens. To optimize the objective efficiently, we analytically marginalize token-level acceptance rate, using the target model's vocabulary distribution to reduce gradient variance. We further redistribute part of this distribution-level gradient into an explicit penalty for sampled tokens whose probabilities are overestimated by the draft model, while preserving the expected gradient. Experiments across multiple benchmarks and target models show that FreDraft improves accepted length and decoding speedup over strong baselines, achieving faster on-policy training convergence.

</details>


### [271] [Reliability of Language-Model Judges for Quantitative Scientific Question Answering: Evidence from Perovskite Photovoltaics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31269)
*Qiwei Han,Chi Zhou,Gaoxiang Yuan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在钙钛矿光伏定量基准上评测自动评判模型：提供计算好的参考答案时，Claude Opus 几乎完美复现真值并保持架构排序；但撤去参考答案后评判保真度大幅下降，本地开源评判接近随机并颠倒排行榜，说明物理科学中的模型评判不能只靠非结构化文本，必须依赖结构化记录预计算的参考答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强语言模型的评估日益依赖自动化模型评判，但其在定量科学综合任务上的可靠性几乎未被测量；本研究旨在量化这种自动评分的可靠性。

Method: 构建钙钛矿光伏定量基准，755 个标准答案均由 45,441 条实验器件记录确定性计算得出；对 6 种检索架构产生的 4,530 条自由文本答案，在三种条件下（带参考答案、带检索证据与查询日志、无辅助）评测前沿评判模型 Claude Opus 5.5 与本地开源评判 Qwen3-14B、Qwen3-8B，用 Cohen's κ 和 Kendall τ 衡量与真值的一致性和排序保真度。

Result: 有参考答案时 Claude Opus 近乎完美复现真值（κ=0.982±0.003）并保持精确架构排序（τ=1.00）；撤去参考答案后一致性跌至 κ=0.557±0.022，补充检索文献段落几乎无改善（κ=0.576±0.024）；无参考答案时本地评判接近随机（κ=0.087 与 0.112），排行榜反转，把幻觉的闭卷基线排到第一（τ≤0.20）；SQL 增强答案还导致严重评判盲区，前沿评判在无参考答案时接受 46.6% 的错误 SQL 答案，将架构准确率高估为 66.4%（真实 52.6%）。

Conclusion: 物理科学中的模型评判不能依赖非结构化文本检查；严谨的基准评测需要由结构化测量记录预先计算出的参考答案真值。

Abstract: Evaluating retrieval-augmented language models increasingly relies on automated model judges, yet their reliability on quantitative scientific synthesis remains largely unmeasured. Here, we evaluate automated grading on a quantitative benchmark for perovskite photovoltaics, where all 755 ground-truth answers are deterministically computed from 45,441 experimental device records. We evaluate a frontier judge (Claude Opus 5.5) alongside two local open-weight judges (Qwen3-14B and Qwen3-8B) across 4,530 free-text answers from six retrieval architectures under three regimes: reference-augmented (with the computed key), evidence-augmented (with retrieved passages and query logs), and unassisted (question and answer alone). Equipped with the reference key, Claude Opus reproduces ground truth near-perfectly (Cohen's $κ= 0.982 \pm 0.003$) and preserves exact architectural rankings ($τ= 1.00$). Withholding the reference causes evaluation fidelity to collapse: frontier agreement drops to $κ= 0.557 \pm 0.022$, and providing retrieved literature passages yields virtually no improvement ($κ= 0.576 \pm 0.024$). Without reference keys, local judges degrade to near-random agreement ($κ= 0.087$ and $0.112$), inverting the leaderboard to rank a hallucinating closed-book baseline first ($τ\le 0.20$). Furthermore, SQL-augmented generations induce severe evaluative blind spots: absent a reference, the frontier judge accepts 46.6% of erroneous SQL answers, overestimating architecture accuracy as 66.4% against its true 52.6%. These findings demonstrate that model-based evaluation in the physical sciences cannot rely on unstructured text inspection; rigorous benchmarking requires reference ground truth precomputed from structured measurement records.

</details>


### [272] [scOPD: Routed On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM-Based Single-Cell Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31257)
*Zhiyin Yu,Yuchen Mou,Songtao Huang,Shuaiyu Zhang,Xing Wei,Chunchun Chen,Wei Ye,Xiao Luo,Zhonghai Wu,Xiangchao Yan,Lei Bai,Shiyang Feng,Bo Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: scOPD：面向LLM单细胞注释的在线策略自蒸馏框架，训练时对错误轨迹提供token级特权监督，推理时用rollout分歧触发的约束感知成对精化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM单细胞注释依赖标量结果奖励，对中间生物推理监督不足；批量注释需同时满足局部细胞身份与全局一对一匹配，局部错误影响整体；单次推理无法定位不确定预测。

Method: 先做推理微调；随后在线策略自蒸馏中自适应路由：合格rollout走奖励优化，错误rollout从成功的兄弟轨迹获得token级特权监督；推理阶段用rollout分歧触发针对不确定分配的约束感知成对精化。

Result: 在CellPuzzles及四个域外疾病数据集上，对多种LLM骨干均稳定提升；Qwen3-8B达细胞级81.71%、批次级44.49%平均准确率。

Conclusion: 细粒度token级推理监督加推理期不确定性精化，可有效缓解批量单细胞注释中的信用分配与匹配约束难题。

Abstract: Motivation: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for single-cell annotation, but existing training methods mainly rely on scalar outcome rewards that provide limited supervision for intermediate biological reasoning. Batch-level annotation is particularly challenging because it requires jointly resolving local cell identities and a global one-to-one matching constraint, such that one local error can affect the entire assignment. Moreover, a single inference pass provides insufficient evidence for locating uncertain predictions. These limitations call for fine-grained reasoning supervision during training and uncertainty-aware refinement during inference.
  Results: To address these challenges, we propose scOPD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM-based single-cell annotation. After reasoning fine-tuning, scOPD adaptively routes qualified rollouts to reward-based optimization, while erroneous rollouts receive privileged token-level supervision from successful sibling trajectories. During inference, rollout disagreement triggers constraint-aware pairwise refinement of uncertain assignments. Across CellPuzzles and four out-of-domain disease datasets, scOPD consistently improves the performance of diverse LLM backbones, achieving average cell-level and batch-level accuracies of 81.71% and 44.49% with Qwen3-8B.
  Availability and Implementation: Code and data are available at https://github.com/YuZhiyin/scOPD.

</details>


### [273] [RECAP: Training Long-horizon LLM Agents with Context Compaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31258)
*Yulun Jiang,Maria Brbic,Michael Moor*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 RECAP，一个基于"压缩摘要应保持原交互历史所诱导的行为"这一原则的强化学习框架，用来联合学习 LLM agent 的上下文压缩与策略，在 BrowseComp-plus 和 SWE-bench Verified 上分别取得 4.6% 和 4.3% 的绝对提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程任务需要在有限上下文预算内处理，需用压缩摘要替换交互历史；但压缩与策略联合学习困难，因为摘要的影响会跨越后续多次交互才能体现，难以直接归因。

Method: 提出行为失真目标，度量压缩上下文与原始上下文下 agent 后续行为分布的差异；证明该目标的梯度可分解为两个互补的学习信号：面向摘要生成的失真奖励，以及面向后续动作的自蒸馏。RECAP 以此为 RL 框架进行联合训练。

Result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上，RECAP 在两个环境中均稳定优于仅用任务奖励的 RL 基线，BrowseComp-plus 绝对提升 4.6%，SWE-bench Verified 绝对提升 4.3%。消融实验表明联合监督摘要生成与压缩后行为具有重要价值。

Conclusion: 以行为保真度（行为失真最小化）作为压缩学习目标，可将长程效应分解为可优化的信号，是一种有效的 agent 上下文压缩学习范式。

Abstract: Context compaction enables large language model agents to tackle long-horizon tasks within limited context budgets by replacing interaction histories with compressed summaries. However, learning effective compaction jointly with the agent policy remains challenging, as summaries affect task success over many subsequent interactions. We introduce RECAP, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework based on the principle that a summary should preserve the behavior induced by the original interaction history. We formalize this principle with a behavior distortion objective that measures the divergence between the agent's subsequent behavior under compressed and original contexts. We show that the gradient of the distortion objective decomposes into two complementary learning signals: distortion-based reward for summary generation and self-distillation for subsequent actions. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that RECAP consistently outperforms the task-reward-only RL baselines on both environments, leading to an absolute improvement of 4.6% and 4.3% on BrowseComp-plus and SWE-bench Verified, respectively. Ablations further highlight the value of jointly supervising summary generation and post-compaction behavior for RECAP.

</details>


### [274] [RecipeADQA: A User-aware Question-Answering Dataset for Multi-Constraint Recipe Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31259)
*Haotian Li,Shuai Jiang,Sayaka Kamei,Yasuhiko Morimoto*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出基于真实用户行为的自然语言菜谱推荐QA数据集构建方法RecipeADQA，包含128,465条样本，并设计噪声增强的检索重排模型，在数据质量与推荐性能上均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有菜谱推荐QA任务缺乏带真值标注的数据集，已有方法通过简单组合食材或标签约束生成数据，导致表达不自然、约束不合理，难以反映用户真实偏好。

Method: 以真实用户行为驱动，融合外部用户查询与评论数据，用LLM抽取细粒度偏好信号并映射到知识图谱标签体系，构建含偏好与食材约束的QA数据；采用贪心策略控制答案规模，并用基于标签的重排序提升质量；另设计噪声增强的检索-重排模型（轻量解析器检索候选，小语言模型在噪声候选池中选择排序）。

Result: 数据集含128,465条实例，包含自然语言问题、结构化约束与答案集。实验从数据质量和检索推荐性能两方面对比基线：在覆盖度、问题自然度、约束合理性和可查询性上均更优；在其上训练的模型性能超过用基线数据集训练的同一模型。

Conclusion: RecipeADQA证明结合真实用户行为与知识图谱标签体系可生成高质量、可查询的菜谱推荐QA数据，并有效提升检索-重排模型性能，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Question-answering recipe recommendation tasks lack datasets with ground-truth labels. Existing methods often generate datasets from simple combinations of ingredient or tag constraints, leading to unnatural expressions and unreasonable constraints that are hard to reflect users' real preferences. This paper proposes a construction method for a benchmark-style QA dataset for natural-language recipe recommendation. Driven by real user behavior, our method integrates external user query and review data to extract fine-grained preference signals by LLMs and maps them onto a knowledge-graph-based tag schema, thereby constructing QA data consisting of preference and ingredient constraints. Besides, a greedy strategy for constraint selection is also used to control the answer size, while tag-based re-ranking is applied to improve data quality. The generated dataset RecipeADQA contains natural-language questions, structured constraints, and answer sets, resulting in 128,465 instances. Experiments compare RecipeADQA with baseline datasets from two perspectives: data quality and retrieval-recommendation performance. The results show that ours outperforms existing methods on the same recipe knowledge graph in coverage, higher question quality in naturalness and constraint rationality, and better queryability. Moreover, we design a noise-augmented retrieve-and-rerank model, in which a lightweight parser first retrieves candidate recipes, and a small language model then selects and ranks relevant recipes from a noisy candidate pool. The model trained on RecipeADQA outperforms the same model trained on the baseline datasets. The relevant construction code and data have been open-sourced at a GitHub repository https://github.com/MorimoLab/RecipeADQA.

</details>


### [275] [ModernELECTRA: Replaced-Token Detection with Boundary-Window Reconstruction for Compact Encoders that Classify and Embed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31495)
*Mykhailo Shtopko,Ihor Stepanov,Dmytro Vodianytskyi,Oleksandr Lukashov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ModernELECTRA：在RTD主目标上增加轻量辅助任务「边界窗口重建」，使判别器最终层隐状态携带邻域信息，从而兼顾分类与嵌入任务；训练出EdgeCoder-31M与EdgeCoder-Multilingual-61M，GLUE达86.0/85.1，并开源FlashDeBERTa高效注意力实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ELECTRA式替换词检测（RTD）样本效率高，DeBERTaV3等模型在分类任务上表现好，但作为检索、语义相似度等嵌入任务的骨干较差：二分类「原词/替换词」信号并不要求最终层保留稠密表示所需的词身份与上下文内容。

Method: 保留RTD为主目标，为每个token采样严格包含它的3–12 token窗口，仅用判别器在两个窗口边界处的隐状态重建该token原始身份；该辅助任务训练时仅需一个小FFN，训练后可丢弃。配合冻结的独立预训练生成器、难负样本温度课程，以及512→8192长度课程。训练两个紧凑编码器：8层英语EdgeCoder-31M与16层覆盖46种语言的EdgeCoder-Multilingual-61M，各约1T token。另实现开源FlashDeBERTa融合式解耦注意力，不存储n×n打分矩阵。

Result: GLUE：EdgeCoder-31M 86.0、EdgeCoder-Multilingual-61M 85.1。英语模型GLUE超过Ettin-Enc-32m(83.5)与MiniLM-L12(84.6)，MTEB English v2与之持平(51.1)；多语言模型在GLUE上超过2.3倍大的mmBERT-small，并在所覆盖语言上于XTREME超过Multilingual MiniLM与mDistilBERT。FlashDeBERTa在4096 token时比参考实现快10倍、显存降低93%，且可直接加载现有DeBERTa检查点。

Conclusion: 轻量边界窗口重建可有效弥补RTD对稠密表示不利的缺陷，在小规模模型上同时取得较强的分类与嵌入性能；配套的高效注意力实现使长序列DeBERTa类模型实用化。

Abstract: ELECTRA-style replaced-token detection (RTD) is a sample-efficient objective for pre-training text encoders, and RTD-trained models such as DeBERTaV3 are strong on classification benchmarks. The same models, however, are known to be poor backbones for embedding tasks such as retrieval and semantic similarity: the binary "original vs. replaced" signal does not ask the final layer to retain the token identity and contextual content that dense representations rely on. We introduce ModernELECTRA, a pre-training recipe that keeps RTD as the main objective and adds a lightweight auxiliary task, boundary-window reconstruction. For every token, we sample a window of 3-12 tokens that strictly contains it and reconstruct the token's original identity only from the discriminator's hidden states at the two window boundaries. The task costs one small FFN at training time and is discarded afterwards, yet it forces every final-layer state to carry information about its neighbourhood. Combined with a frozen, separately pre-trained generator, a temperature curriculum for hard negatives and a 512-to-8192 length curriculum, we train two compact encoders: EdgeCoder-31M, an 8-layer English model, and EdgeCoder-Multilingual-61M, a 16-layer model covering 46 languages, each on about 1T tokens. They reach 86.0 and 85.1 on GLUE. The English model outperforms Ettin-Enc-32m (83.5) and MiniLM-L12 (84.6) on GLUE while matching them on MTEB English v2 (51.1), and the multilingual model outperforms the 2.3x larger mmBERT-small on GLUE and Multilingual MiniLM and mDistilBERT on XTREME over the languages it covers. We also describe FlashDeBERTa, our open-source fused implementation of DeBERTa's disentangled attention that stores no $n \times n$ score matrix: at 4096 tokens it is 10x faster and uses 93% less memory than the reference implementation, and it loads existing DeBERTa checkpoints unchanged.

</details>


### [276] [Capability and Interpretability of Transformers on Multi-task Recurrence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31260)
*Xiamin Chen,Linyu Liu,Jiachen Hu,Pinyan Lu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过有限循环群上的受控线性递推任务族，研究Transformer执行、识别与切换规则的能力及可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer广泛用于语言任务，但其内部机制理解有限；许多语言规则具有递推结构，因此用受控递推任务作为探针来研究其能力与可解释性。

Method: 在有限循环群上设计一族线性递推任务：从执行单一固定规则，到从上下文中识别潜在规则、在显式指定规则间切换，并区分有/无输入掩码；跨多种配置进行大量实验，结合深度、宽度和代数结构分析，并使用线性探测与输入修补等机制可解释性工具，同时考察课程训练的作用。

Result: 总体上，Transformer切换显式指定规则比识别潜在规则更容易；深度、宽度和线性递推的代数结构显著影响泛化能力；规则数量较大时课程训练非常有效；揭示了模型如何表示、识别与执行多条规则。

Conclusion: 受控递推任务族为理解Transformer规则处理机制提供了有效框架，明确了任务难度差异与关键影响泛化的因素，并借助可解释性工具刻画了多规则的内部表征与执行方式。

Abstract: Transformers are widely used in various language tasks, with limited understanding of their internal mechanisms. Motivated by the recurrent structure of many linguistic rules, we study the capability and interpretability of Transformers through a controlled family of linear recurrence tasks over finite cyclic groups. These tasks range from executing a single fixed rule to identifying a latent rule from context and switching between explicitly specified rules, with and without input masking. Through extensive experiments across different configurations, we find that switching specified rules is simpler than identifying latent rules for Transformers in general. We also identify how several key factors affect the generalization capability of Transformers, including the depth, width, and the algebraic structure of the linear recurrence. Curriculum training is extremely useful when the number of rules is large. With standard tools in mechanistic interpretability like linear probing and input patching, our study reveals how Transformers represent, identify, and execute multiple rules.

</details>


### [277] [Does Item Response Theory Generalize Across Languages? Evidence from Cross-Lingual LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31261)
*Ruchira Dhar,Qiwei Peng,Anders Søgaard*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究IRT参数在跨语言翻译后的基准上的泛化性，发现题目难度最稳定，猜测次之，区分度最差，并指出稳定性缺失可归因于特定题目在翻译中发生偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于IRT的基准数据选择研究多局限于单语场景，尚不清楚同一基准被翻译成多语言后，IRT参数与筛选效果能否跨语言一致。

Method: 在Multilingual GSM与Global MMLU上，覆盖100多个语言模型和11种语言；按语言分别拟合1PL、2PL、3PL IRT模型，评估参数跨语言一致性，并检验IRT筛选出的子集能否在跨语言间保持模型排序；另做差异题目分析（DIF）定位问题题目。

Result: 题目难度是最稳定的参数，其次是猜测参数，区分度最不稳定；IRT筛选子集跨语言保持排序的能力受限，且稳定性缺失可追踪到在翻译中发生偏移的具体题目。

Conclusion: 多语言场景下的IRT数据选择必须同时做到参数感知与题目感知，即先验证模型选择、再逐题筛查，才能假设其跨语言可泛化。

Abstract: The application of Item Response Theory (IRT) for data selection in benchmarks has mostly been limited to monolingual settings. In this work, we ask: how does IRT generalize when the same benchmark is translated across languages? We conduct experiments on Multilingual GSM and Global MMLU, covering over 100 language models and 11 languages. Fitting 1PL, 2PL, and 3PL IRT models per language, we assess cross-lingual consistency of parameters and whether IRT-filtered subsets preserve model rankings across languages: item difficulty emerges as the most stable parameter followed by guessing and then discrimination. A differential item analysis also shows that lack of stability can be tracked to specific items shifting under translation across languages. Our findings suggest IRT-based selection in multilingual settings must be both parameter-aware and item-aware, validating model choice and screening individual items before assuming cross-lingual generalization.

</details>


### [278] [Provenance Loss and Repair in Multilingual Compaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31668)
*Ian Miao,Fangrui Zhu,Bowen Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 多语言对话助手压缩旧消息时，英语中开放而目标语言需区分的属性（如西语形容词性别）在笔记中丢失信息，原始消息被驱逐后无法分辨用户是否陈述该属性；作者提出免训练修复方案，在写作、驱逐前验证、阅读三阶段处理，显著提升F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话助手把旧消息压缩成简短笔记并删除原文。当笔记语言要求区分英语中模糊的语法属性（如西班牙语形容词性别agotado/agotada）时，用户未陈述或明确陈述该属性的消息会产生相同笔记。原文被驱逐后，后续轮次无法区分两者：字面采信屈折形式会断言用户从未给出的属性，而将其视为常规语法忽略又会丢弃用户确实给出的属性。

Method: 提出免训练的三阶段修复：(1) 写作阶段，写入者用成对形式（如agotado/a）标记未陈述的属性；(2) 驱逐前验证，通过似然检查将无依据的单一形式改写为成对形式；(3) 阅读阶段，读者将剩余单一形式视为已陈述事实。无需额外训练。

Result: 在五个Qwen3.5和Gemma-4模型上，驱逐使已陈述属性的召回率从90%降至34%（QA场景）；修复方案在每个模型上都提升了F1（同时惩罚两类错误），QA提升9-53个点，agent交接场景提升12-40个点。

Conclusion: 语法性别等语言差异会在消息压缩与驱逐中造成信息歧义与丢失；通过写入标记、驱逐前似然校验与阅读端信任契约的免训练修复，可在多模型上大幅恢复已陈述属性的保真度。

Abstract: Conversational assistants compact older messages into short notes and evict the originals. When the note's language requires a distinction that English leaves open, such as Spanish adjective gender (agotado vs. agotada), messages that omit or explicitly state that attribute can yield the same note. After eviction, later turns cannot tell them apart: taking the inflected form literally asserts an attribute the user never gave, whereas discounting it as routine grammar discards one the user did give. We propose a training-free repair across writing, pre-eviction verification and reading. The writer marks unstated attributes with paired forms (e.g., agotado/a), a likelihood check before eviction rewrites unsupported single forms into paired ones, and the reader trusts remaining single forms as stated facts. On five Qwen3.5 and Gemma-4 models, eviction cuts recall of stated attributes from 90% to 34% in question answering (QA); our repair raises F1 (which penalizes both errors) on every model, by 9-53 points in QA and 12-40 points in agent handovers.

</details>


### [279] [RegioZH: Unveiling Comprehension Disparities across Regional Chinese Varieties in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31262)
*Weihua Zheng,Wu Kui,Thong T. Doan,Lin Jingxia,AiTi Aw,Nancy F. Chen,Roy Ka-Wei Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RegioZH 基准（2,607 道多选题），评测 11 个 LLM 在中国大陆、台湾、香港、新加坡、马来西亚五种中文变体上的区域性词汇推理能力，发现区域间准确率差距达 29.4 分，说明整体"中文能力"会掩盖区域理解的不均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评测把"中文"当作单一整体，掩盖了模型对区域用户（不同地区中文变体）的失败，缺少细粒度的区域内语言鲁棒性评估。

Method: 构建 RegioZH：由各地区标注者编写、专家校验的 2,607 道多选题，覆盖本地习语、俚语、语码混用、礼貌规范与社会文化表达。对 11 个 LLM 做零样本测试；对 5 个模型测试 persona 与结构化思维链提示；并做表征、注意力、校准与表面特征分析及定性分析。

Result: 零样本下模型区域差异显著，台湾与新加坡平均准确率相差 29.4 分；persona 与 CoT 提示仅带来选择性提升，说明部分错误源于检索或表述框架而非知识缺失；分析发现标记注意力与语义接地脱钩、强制选择下过度自信、本地词汇密度是稳定的难度预测因子；定性上存在术语误解、社会文化推理缺口与跨区域语义分歧。

Conclusion: 表面上的中文流利会掩盖对各区域变体的不均衡理解，因此应在多语言泛化评估之外，同步开展"语言内"（intra-language）鲁棒性评测。

Abstract: Current evaluations often treat Chinese varieties as monolithic, obscuring failures for regional users. We introduce RegioZH, a 2,607-item multiple-choice benchmark for regional lexical reasoning across Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Malaysia. Built by region-specific annotators and expert-validated, it targets localized idioms, slang, code-mixing, politeness conventions, and sociocultural expressions. Zero-shot results on eleven LLMs show large disparities, including a 29.4-point average accuracy gap between Taiwan and Singapore. Persona and structured chain-of-thought prompts for five models yield selective gains, suggesting that some errors stem from retrieval or framing rather than only missing knowledge. Representation, attention, calibration, and surface-feature analyses show a dissociation between marker attention and semantic grounding, overconfident forced-choice errors, and localized lexical density as a consistent difficulty predictor. Qualitative analysis finds terminology misunderstandings, sociocultural inference gaps, and cross-regional semantic divergence. RegioZH demonstrates that apparent Chinese proficiency can mask uneven understanding across regional varieties, motivating intra-language robustness evaluation alongside multilingual generalization.

</details>


### [280] [Evaluating Large Language Models on Iranian Doctoral Entrance Exams in Electrical and Computer Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31263)
*Sima Akbari Neisiyani,Hossein Taghizad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究在2024/2025伊朗EE与CE博士入学考试433题（波斯语+英语翻译，共3464次作答）上评测GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5与Grok 4，发现准确率呈两档分层，语言影响小，含图题显著更难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估前沿LLM在伊朗博士入学考试（电气与计算机工程）上的表现，考察模型差异、波斯语/英语语言效应、含图题难度，以及学科（EE/CE）差异的来源。

Method: 从四本官方题册440题中剔除7道有歧义题，保留433题（EE 186、CE 247，其中171题即39.5%依赖图），每题以原始波斯语和英译呈现，共3464次评分作答。四模型零样本、开启推理，通过Perplexity网页界面用自动脚本于2025年10月查询。所有推断使用配对检验或按题聚类的模型。

Result: GPT-5（79.9%，95%CI 76.6–83.1）与Gemini 2.5 Pro（78.4%，74.8–81.9）无显著差异，但均比Grok 4（71.7%）和Claude Sonnet 4.5（71.3%）高6.7–8.7个百分点（Holm校正p<0.001）。英波差异很小（−0.2至+2.5分；精确McNemar p≥0.28），三模型90%CI在±5分内。含图题明显更难（校正学科后OR=0.30，95%CI 0.21–0.43）。两模型的EE劣势在控制含图题比例后消失。

Conclusion: LLM在该考试上已具较高但分层的能力，语言（波斯语vs英语）影响可忽略，图形推理是主要瓶颈，学科差异实为题型构成差异；研究公开题目级作答与分析代码，并说明界面检索与解码设置不可控等局限。

Abstract: We evaluate four large language models (LLMs) on multiple-choice questions from the 2024 and 2025 Iranian national Ph.D. entrance examinations in Electrical Engineering (EE) and Computer Engineering (CE). Of the 440 questions in the four official booklets, 7 were excluded because the question statement or its figure was ambiguous, leaving 433 questions (186 EE, 247 CE), of which 171 (39.5\%) depend on a figure. Each question was presented in the original Persian and in an English translation, giving 3,464 scored responses. GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 were queried zero-shot, with reasoning enabled, through a single commercial web interface (Perplexity) in October 2025, using an automated script. Because every model answers the same items, all inferences use paired tests or question-clustered models. Accuracy separates into two tiers: GPT-5 (79.9\%, 95\% CI 76.6--83.1) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (78.4\%, 74.8--81.9) are statistically indistinguishable, and both outperform Grok 4 (71.7\%) and Claude Sonnet 4.5 (71.3\%) by 6.7--8.7 percentage points (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$). The English--Persian accuracy difference is small for every model ($-0.2$ to $+2.5$ points; exact McNemar $p \ge 0.28$). For three models the 90\% confidence interval lies within $\pm 5$ points, so differences larger than this can be excluded. Questions with figures are much harder: the odds ratio is 0.30 (95\% CI 0.21--0.43) after adjusting for discipline. The apparent EE deficit of two models disappears once the larger share of figure-based EE items is accounted for. We describe the dataset, the protocol and its limitations, including the uncontrolled web-retrieval and decoding settings of the interface, and release item-level responses and analysis code.

</details>


### [281] [Unjamming Deferrals: Supporting Students Through JAMN Bot, a Mobile RAG-Grounded Policy Assistant](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32266)
*Mark Farinas,Alesandra Garcia,Maria Reyes,Jethro Nueva,Nawaf Qureshi,Mahmoud Elsaadany,Shokry Shamseldin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Schedulater 是一款管理大学考试延期流程的移动应用，内置基于 RAG（Ollama + Llama 3.2 3B 自托管推理）的 JAMN Bot 聊天机器人，提供隐私友好的政策依据型问答；作者用 43 题基准与人工评分、检索命中率及 GPT-5.4 等 LLM-as-a-judge 进行评测，揭示开源与前沿模型的权衡及人机评分一致性随答案质量提升的现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高校考试延期等行政流程缓慢、不便且不一致，需要新型数字系统；同时希望在引入 LLM 助手时保证隐私，并能给出有政策依据的回答。

Method: 开发移动应用 Schedulater 及集成其中的 LLM 聊天机器人 JAMN Bot；采用 Retrieval-Augmented Generation 流水线，基于 Ollama 本地部署 Llama 3.2 3B 实现自托管推理以保护隐私；构建覆盖考试延期、隐私、排课、跨政策、对抗与超范围问题的 43 题基准，报告人工评分者间一致性与检索命中率，并用 GPT-5.4 做 LLM-as-a-judge，另用 Gemini 3.5 Flash、Qwen3.5 397B 组成评审团校验排序。

Result: LLM 评判与人工评分的对齐仅为轻微至中等，且随答案质量提高而改善；检索命中率指标被报告；评审团对比显示开源权重模型与前沿模型之间存在权衡；并观察到 LLM 与人类评价一致性受答案质量影响。

Conclusion: 将轻量级 LLM 与结构化检索结合，集成进大学行政工作流是可行的，Schedulater 验证了这一路径。

Abstract: In some educational institutions, workflows such as the exam deferral process can be slow, inconvenient, and inconsistent, which creates the need to implement novel digital systems. This paper presents Schedulater, a mobile app for managing university exam deferrals. JAMN Bot is a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered chatbot integrated into Schedulater that provides context-aware support to help users understand the deferral process. The system features a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using Ollama (Llama 3.2 3B) for self-hosted inference which enables policy-grounded responses without sacrificing privacy. We evaluate the system using a 43-item benchmark spanning Exam Deferral, Privacy, Scheduling, Cross-Policy, and Adversarial & Out-of-Scope questions, and report inter-rater agreement among our human evaluators alongside retrieval hit-rate metrics. Subsequently, we utilize an LLM-as-a-judge approach with GPT-5.4, revealing slight-to-moderate alignment with our raters that improves with answer quality, and check the ranking against a panel including Gemini 3.5 Flash and Qwen3.5 397B. The results of our study display trade-offs between open-weight and frontier models, as well as LLM-human evaluation alignment with answer quality. Schedulater demonstrates the feasibility of integrating lightweight LLMs into university administrative workflows with structured retrieval.

</details>


### [282] [How Persona Conditioning Changes Open-Ended Task Execution: A Paired Evaluation of Behavioral Gains and Reliability Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31264)
*Yugyeong Ji,Changho Lee,Yerin Hwang,Taegwan Kang,Jinsik Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 角色/人设提示并非通用性能提升手段，而是一种选择性的任务执行策略转变：它提升内容深度与程序保真度，但以显著牺牲严格指令遵循和增加无依据细节为代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对人设条件化的评估主要停留在角色保真度或聚合基准准确率上，未将其视为改变模型如何理解、组织和维持回答的任务执行引导信号，因而缺乏受控对比证据。

Method: 使用源自真实用户角色扮演日志的配对实例，并扩展为模拟多轮续写；固定任务内容、约束、用户模拟与评估标准，仅对比"有人设"与"无人设"两种条件，在八个模型上进行测试，并对长度做控制。

Result: 人设条件化提升了专家内容深度与流程保真度，且在控制长度后依然成立；但在所有被评估模型中，严格指令遵循准确率下降17至30个百分点，并因人设引发的过度展开而产生更多无现实依据的具体细节。

Conclusion: 人设提示带来行为收益与可靠性风险并存，应按任务选择性使用而非默认作为性能增强手段。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often prompted with role- or persona-based instructions, yet persona conditioning has mainly been evaluated through character fidelity or aggregate benchmark accuracy. We study persona conditioning as a task-execution steering signal that changes how models interpret, structure, and sustain responses. Using paired instances derived from real user role-play logs and expanded into simulated multi-turn continuations, we compare with-persona and no-persona conditions while fixing task content, constraints, user simulation, and evaluation criteria. Across eight models, persona conditioning improves expert content depth and procedural fidelity, and these gains survive length control. At the same time, it lowers strict instruction-following accuracy by 17 to 30 points in every model evaluated, and increases unsupported real-world specificity through persona-induced elaboration. These results suggest that persona prompting is not a general-purpose performance improvement technique, but a selective task-execution policy shift with both behavioral gains and reliability risks.

</details>


### [283] [SD-Cache: Learnable Memory Consolidation with State-Guided Dynamic Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31265)
*Yuanhong Chen,Yiping Ji,Cameron Gordon,Emily Hackett-Jones,Hemanth Saratchandran,Anton van den Hengel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 SD-Cache，一种与查询无关的 KV 缓存整合框架，将逐层 KV 状态压缩为固定大小的工作记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 作为持久服务需在大量外部知识上推理，RAG 检索内容写入 KV 缓存后随内容累积线性增长，推高显存与推理成本；已有方法（保留子集或学习压缩器）在严格内存预算下难以兼顾信息整合与未来查询可用性。

Method: 在不访问未来查询的前提下，配合冻结的生成器 LLM，学习将逐层 KV 状态通过基于锚点的选择性池化（anchor-based pooling）与状态引导细化（state-guided refinement）整合为固定大小记忆；新上下文单次前向即可处理，无需针对具体上下文优化。

Result: 在检索增强问答与合成长上下文基准上，受限内存预算下保持有竞争力的下游性能。

Conclusion: 原生 KV 状态可被选择性地整合为固定大小工作记忆，实现查询无关、低开销的记忆压缩。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as persistent services that must reason over large volumes of external knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds model responses in relevant documents, but the retrieved content must still be encoded and stored in the key-value (KV) cache. As this content accumulates, the cache grows linearly, increasing memory consumption and inference cost. Existing memory-compression methods address this problem either by retaining a subset of cached states or by learning context compressors that map documents to compact latent representations. Despite these advances, consolidating information under tight memory budgets while preserving its usefulness for future queries remains challenging. We investigate how the model's native KV states can be selectively consolidated into a fixed-size working memory without access to future queries. To this end, we introduce SD-Cache (State-guided and Dynamically updated Cache), a query-agnostic KV-memory consolidation framework that operates alongside a frozen generator LLM. SD-Cache learns to consolidate layer-wise KV states into fixed-size memory through selective anchor-based pooling and state-guided refinement, processing new contexts in a single forward pass without context-specific optimisation. Experiments on retrieval-augmented question answering and synthetic long-context benchmarks show that SD-Cache maintains competitive downstream performance under constrained memory budgets.

</details>


### [284] [Agentic Systems Need Multi-Run Evaluation: A Study of Retrieval and Response Variability in a Deployed Enterprise RAG System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31266)
*Karan Gupta,Sumit Bhatia,Yunyao Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文研究agentic RAG系统的多次运行不稳定性：对739个产品文档问题各运行10次，揭示单次评估掩盖的可靠性问题，发现检索阶段是最大分歧来源，需采用多次评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统（包括agentic RAG）多采用单次运行评估，但agentic RAG中多个组件具有非确定性决策，导致同一问题在不同运行间产生差异（如并行检索数量不同），单次评估可能掩盖系统的可靠性问题。

Method: 在一个已部署的agentic RAG产品文档问答系统上，对739个问题各运行10次，分析执行轨迹，定位不同运行首次出现分歧的位置，并统计检索命中率、回答相似度（BERTScore、BLEU）及各环节分歧占比。

Result: 任一运行成功与全部运行成功的检索命中率差距明显（69.4% vs 50.9%）；回答语义相近但措辞多变（BERTScore 0.90，BLEU 0.49）；轨迹分析显示检索是最大分歧来源（43.9%），仅首次检索步骤的并行搜索数量就占分歧对数的20.1%。

Conclusion: 单次运行评估会隐藏agentic RAG系统的可靠性与一致性问题，多次运行评估是必要的。

Abstract: Previous RAG systems have mostly been evaluated in a single-run setting, and with the advent of agentic RAG, systems are still often evaluated the same way. However, agentic RAG systems introduce a source of run-to-run variability, since several of their components make decisions non-deterministically. Such systems typically comprise a retrieval stage followed by a generation stage, and the retrieval stage in particular can behave differently across runs. For example, the agent might issue a different number of parallel searches from one run to the next, which alters the retrieved documents and therefore the final answer. In this paper we study this behavior in a deployed agentic RAG system for product-documentation questions, running each of 739 questions ten times and analyzing the execution traces to find where different runs first diverge. We find a substantial gap between success in any run and success in every run: the retrieval hit rate is 69.4% when the correct page is found in at least one run, but 50.9% when it must be found in all ten. Responses also stay similar in meaning while varying in wording, with an average BERTScore of 0.90 and a BLEU of 0.49. Trace-level analysis shows that retrieval is the largest source of divergence (43.9%), and the number of parallel searches at the first retrieval step alone accounts for 20.1% of divergent pairs. Taken together, these results show that single-run evaluation can hide reliability and consistency issues in agentic RAG systems, and that multi-run evaluation is necessary to reveal them.

</details>


### [285] [ToneMamaba: Learning Contextualized Tonal Contours with Boundary-Reset State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31267)
*Po-Yu Chiu,Yi-Fen Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ToneMamba，用音节/词/IPU三级边界处的双向状态重置替代静态边界嵌入，结合动态音节池化与节奏条件门控，在朗读和对话语音的普通话声调识别上均超过ToneNet基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续语音中上下文与时长变化会重塑F0轮廓，使普通话声调识别困难；现有方法采用静态边界嵌入，难以充分建模这种层级与动态变化。

Method: 基于状态空间模型构建ToneMamba：在音节、词、IPU三级边界处进行双向状态重置以感知边界；固定权重融合多级表示；共享权重的双向扫描配合通道级方向融合减少参数；动态音节池化形成声调轮廓；节奏条件门控引入时长信息。

Result: FCU-VOICE-360朗读语音准确率97.9%，MCDC-8对话语音74.8%，分别比ToneNet高0.9和15.9个百分点。消融显示词级重置效果显著，节奏条件在对话语音中增益更大。

Conclusion: 边界感知的状态重置与节奏条件建模有效提升声调识别，尤其对自发对话语音中的时长变化鲁棒，凸显时长信息的重要性。

Abstract: Mandarin tone recognition in connected speech is challenging because contextual and durational variation reshapes F0 contours. We propose ToneMamba, a boundary-aware state space model that replaces static boundary embeddings with bidirectional state resets at syllable, word, and IPU levels. Fixed weights fuse multi-level representations, while shared-weight bidirectional scans use channel-wise directional fusion to reduce parameters. Dynamic syllable pooling forms tonal contours, and rhythm-conditioned gating incorporates durational information. ToneMamba achieves 97.9% and 74.8% accuracy on FCU-VOICE-360 read and MCDC-8 conversational speech, outperforming the baseline (ToneNet) by 0.9 and 15.9 percentage points, respectively. Ablations show that word-level resets are particularly effective, while rhythm conditioning provides greater gains in conversational speech, underscoring the role of durational variation in spontaneous speech.

</details>


### [286] [SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33124)
*Yuchao Wu,XingCheng Liang,Xuanze Wang,Yini Huang,Yue Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SAG-Mem：保留完整对话消息并分块，用无模型推理的词法索引构建记忆，查询时通过BM25初检 + 证据评估 + 词法线索引导的二轮检索发现互补证据，并对相对时间做日历标注；在LoCoMo与LongMemEval上分别取得83.08与80.20的最高总分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时对话记忆需要检索跨会话、分散且与问题相似度低的互补事实与中间证据；现有方法依赖派生记忆表示或持久关系结构，带来构建成本且可能丢失源细节。

Method: 将完整对话消息存入不重叠分块；构建阶段无需模型推理，仅用词法索引（无LLM抽取、摘要或语义关系构建）；查询时BM25初检，证据评估器筛出有用分块，再由选中证据的词法线索引导第二轮检索；对检索到的对话中受支持的相对时间表达附加日历解释，同时保留原始措辞与时间粒度。另提供SAG-Mem-Lite，用基于嵌入的候选打分替代证据评分以降低开销。

Result: LoCoMo与LongMemEval上SAG-Mem总分分别为83.08与80.20，均为所评估方法中最高；LongMemEval上领先最强基线7.20分。SAG-Mem-Lite分别为77.09与77.20，并在两个基准上运营成本低于Full Context及所有记忆类基线，查询延迟低。

Conclusion: 保留原始对话并做证据引导的检索扩展，是长时对话记忆的有效设计。

Abstract: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.

</details>


### [287] [AhaPro: A Process-level Rebus benchmark for probing Aha moments in LLM reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31268)
*Wei Guo,Lang Qin,Yundi Gai,Qinghua Xu,Zhi Wu,Wenjian Ding,Huijia Li,Zhenglu Yang,Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AhaPro：用画谜（rebus puzzles）构建过程级基准，将CoT表示为候选答案、证据与验证状态的序列，分层评估模型在Aha时刻的冲突检测、状态改进与后续采纳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对LLM"Aha时刻"的研究多聚焦反思性表述或最终修订结果，缺乏对其在可见推理过程中作用的刻画。画谜通过字形、空间排布与谐音编码答案，重新解读关键细节可触发Aha时刻并改变推理与候选答案，适合作为探针。

Method: 提出过程级基准AhaPro：将CoT显式建模为候选答案、证据和验证状态的序列；设计分层指标分别衡量冲突检测、状态改进与改进状态的采纳；对11个模型评测，并进行成对干预实验（考察前文推理上下文的影响）与多分支搜索分析。

Result: 11个模型普遍未能采纳Aha时刻中发现更优状态；已采纳的修订中亦有不少未提升甚至降低状态质量；模型能检测冲突却无法完成有效修订。干预实验表明先前推理上下文可能阻碍冲突检测后的有效修订；多分支搜索显示答案选择是"发现正确答案"到"成功纠正"之间的瓶颈。

Conclusion: 模型的Aha时刻更多停留在冲突察觉层面，缺乏转化为稳健修订的能力；瓶颈在于状态采纳与答案选择而非答案发现。过程级建模与分层指标为诊断LLM推理自我纠正提供了新视角。

Abstract: Existing research on Aha moments in large language models has largely focused on reflective expressions or final revision outcomes, leaving their role in the visible reasoning process insufficiently characterized. Rebus puzzles encode answers through character forms, spatial arrangements, and homophony. Reinterpreting key details may trigger Aha moments and shifts in the reasoning process and candidate answers. We introduce AhaPro, a process-level benchmark that uses rebus puzzles to examine how models reorganize evidence and revise answers through Aha moments. The framework represents CoT as sequences of candidate answers, evidence, and verification states, using hierarchical metrics to assess conflict detection, state improvement, and subsequent adoption. Across eleven models, we observe frequent failures to adopt better states discovered during Aha moments, alongside adopted revisions that leave state quality unchanged or reduce it. Models also detect conflicts without subsequently achieving an effective revision. Further paired interventions suggest that prior reasoning context may hinder effective revision after conflict detection, while multi-branch search highlights answer selection as a bottleneck between correct-answer discovery and successful correction.

</details>


### [288] [Lexical Tone and Word Order Matter in Translation: Prosodic Correspondence Across Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31276)
*Haopeng Xie,Ismail Rasim Ulgen,Shengying Zhao,Berrak Sisman,Philipp Koehn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 首个系统性词级研究，分析英语与汉语、泰语、越南语（声调语言）及日语、韩语之间翻译语音的韵律对应，发现其对应性低于欧洲语言，并揭示声调与词序的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韵律承载强调、情感与意图，但跨翻译的韵律对应研究不足，尤其缺乏对声调语言与词序差异语言的研究。作者希望填补这一空白。

Method: 对英语与五种亚洲语言（普通话、泰语、越南语、日语、韩语）翻译语音进行词级音高与能量对应分析，并与欧洲语言结果比较；对声调进行校正，并分析词序重排的影响。

Result: 对应性总体低于欧洲语言估计；校正声调后英-汉、英-泰、英-越的音高对应提升，但英-日、英-韩同样偏低，说明声调状态不能单独解释；词序重排越大，局部对应越弱，即使语义对齐亦然。

Conclusion: 这些发现刻画了跨翻译细粒度声学对应的局限，并推动考虑词汇音高约束与译入内容结构语境���韵律建模。

Abstract: Prosody conveys emphasis, emotion, and intent, yet its correspondence across translation remains underexplored, especially when languages differ in lexical tone and word order. To our knowledge, we present the first systematic word-level analysis of prosodic correspondence in translated speech spanning tonal and non-tonal Asian languages, with comparisons to European-language findings and explicit analyses of lexical tone and word reordering. Building on prior evidence of fine-grained prosody correspondence in European-language pairs, we investigate how these linguistic factors relate to word-level pitch and energy correspondence between English and five languages: Mandarin Chinese, Thai, and Vietnamese, which have lexical tone, and Japanese and Korean as additional comparisons. Correspondence is generally lower than previously reported European-language estimates. Adjusting for lexical tone increases pitch correspondence for English-Mandarin Chinese, English-Thai, and English-Vietnamese. However, English-Japanese and English-Korean also exhibit lower correspondence than the European-language estimates, indicating that tonal status alone does not explain the observed pattern. Greater word reordering is associated with weaker local correspondence even under semantic alignment, suggesting that semantic alignment does not fully account for differences in prosodic organization. These findings characterize the limits of fine-grained acoustic correspondence across translation and motivate prosody modeling that accounts for lexical pitch constraints and the structural context of translated content.

</details>


### [289] [Reading Between the Layers: Where Representation Quality Lives, and What Geometry Reveals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31496)
*Arnesh Batra,Aniket Khandelwal,Arush Gumber,Krish Thukral,Kushagra Agrawal,Dev Sharma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对25个预训练模型进行大规模实证研究，发现最佳探测层依赖预训练策略与架构；并提出无标签的Stable Geometry Index (SGI) 来选层，Hit@3从0.39提升到0.52。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表示质量并不集中在最后一层，但无标签选层问题一直未解决，实践中却常默认用最后一层探测，因此需要系统性理解层质量分布并给出无监督选层方法。

Method: 覆盖4大架构族、4种预训练策略共25个模型，在13个数据集上评价分类、句对分类、语义相似度、多选题任务；据此提出闭式、无拟合系数、完全无标签的SGI，结合幂律拟合优度、有效秩容量、谱稳定性和弱深度先验。

Result: 在383个评估组中，SGI优于最后一层基线，Hit@3由0.39升至0.52，挽回约40%与oracle的差距；在匹配子集上超过有监督的ELMo式层混合。消融还发现幂律拟合优度比指数接近1更能预测层质量。

Conclusion: 层质量分布规律可由预训练策略与架构预测，SGI提供了有效且无需标签的选层方案，并修正了谱衰减文献中的常见假设。

Abstract: Representation quality in pretrained text foundation models is not concentrated at the final layer, yet practitioners routinely probe it there because layer selection without labels has remained an open problem. We present a large-scale empirical study of where layer quality lives across 25 models spanning four architectural families and four pretraining strategies, evaluated on 13 datasets across classification, pair classification, semantic textual similarity, and multiple-choice question answering. Peak probing layers depend systematically on pretraining strategy and architecture: masked encoders peak in late-middle layers, sequence-to-sequence models shift their peak with task type, contrastive sentence encoders concentrate signal at the final layer under CLS and last-token readouts but peak early under mean pooling, and decoder-only models exhibit distinct phase structure tied to depth. We distill these findings into the Stable Geometry Index (SGI), a closed-form, fully label-free selector with no fitted coefficients combining power-law fit quality, effective-rank capacity, spectral stability, and a weak depth prior. Across 383 evaluation groups SGI improves over the last-layer baseline and lifts Hit@3 from 0.39 to 0.52, recovering 40% of the gap to the oracle without using any labels, and exceeds a supervised ELMo-style layer mix on the matched subset despite using strictly less information. Our ablations also reverse a common assumption in the spectral-decay literature: power-law fit quality is a stronger predictor of layer quality than the exponent's proximity to one.

</details>


### [290] [Can LLM-Simulated Respondents Pre-Test Survey Questions? Evidence From Preregistered Prospective Validation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31532)
*Sristi Bafna,Mac MacComas,Michael Bader,Kristina Gligorić*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种预注册、前瞻性的评估框架，验证LLM模拟受访者能否在实地调查前对候选问卷题目进行有效排序，发现其能较准确地预测题目的均值、方差及群体差异排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可模拟问卷回答，但尚不清楚这种模拟能否真正支持下调研任务，尤其是"预测试"新问卷题目（如识别天花板/地板效应、筛选有区分度的题目）此前缺乏不受记忆污染的可信评估方法。

Method: 基于2025年本地调查（N=1,271）参与者的数据构建模拟受访者，对2026年调查新增的22道题目（实际N=1,161）预先注册GPT-4.1的预测，在目标人类回答尚不存在前锁定预测，从设计上排除记忆污染；按均值、方差及子群体差异（城市/县、黑人/白人、就业/失业）排序候选题目并与真实结果比较。

Result: 模拟在按均值排序题目上Spearman ρ=0.71；在识别能区分城市与县居民、黑人与白人居民、就业与失业居民的题目上，ρ分别为0.88、0.68、0.57，表明模拟可助力调查前的题目优先级筛选。

Conclusion: LLM模拟受访者可辅助预测试调查题目；更重要的是，这种前瞻性、预注册的设计为在无记忆污染条件下评估AI模拟提供了通用框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can be conditioned to simulate behavioral responses, including survey responses, but it remains unclear whether and how these simulations can support downstream research tasks. Here, we evaluate whether simulated respondents can support pre-testing new candidate survey questions before fielding them, operationalized as prioritizing candidate survey items. Specifically, we rank candidate questions by their mean responses, which can reveal ceiling or floor effects; their variance, which indicates whether responses contain meaningful variation; and differences between subpopulations, which indicate whether questions capture distinctions between relevant groups within a population. We introduce a preregistered, prospective evaluation that commits model predictions before target human responses exist, ruling out memorization of those responses by design. Using two waves of a local survey (2025: N = 1,271; 2026: N = 1,161), we built simulated respondents from 2025 participants and preregistered GPT-4.1 predictions for 22 questions introduced in 2026. Simulations accurately ranked questions by mean responses (Spearman \r{ho} = 0.71) and anticipated which questions distinguished city from county residents (\r{ho} = 0.88), Black from White residents (\r{ho} = 0.68), and employed from unemployed residents (\r{ho} = 0.57), suggesting simulations can help prioritize questions before fielding. More broadly, our prospective, preregistered design provides a general framework for evaluating AI simulations without contamination from memorized target outcomes.

</details>


### [291] [CLAIMGATE: Cautious On-Device Checking of Spoken Legal and Clinical Claims](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31569)
*Peter Forcha,Harshitha Kaje Kusumadhara,Audrey Moguem Souop,Shalom Iboh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CLAIMGATE 是一个端侧实时助手，监听对话、检测可核查的主张、检索官方规则原文，并用引用给出"支持/矛盾/未涵盖"三分类判定；通过 4-bit 7B 模型的检索约束引用与代码化判定实现"宁默勿错"，在交通执法与医疗场景上取得约 80–88% 准确率并显著减少严重错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在执法与医疗对话中，被错误陈述的规则可能在无人核查前就影响决策。实时核查必须同时满足三个条件：跟上对话节奏、敏感音频不出设备、不确定时保持沉默而非误导。

Method: 构建端侧助手：自动检测可核查主张→检索相关官方法规/指南原文（5,742 条佛州与德州法条小节；CDC、FDA、MedlinePlus 指南）→由 4-bit 7B 参数语言模型仅允许引用所检索到的规则，判定结果由代码依据模型引用的主张与规则推导得出，而非由模型直接给结论；以真实转录、实时语音与人工标注金标准主张在交通拦截与过敏就诊场景评估。

Result: 141 条留出交通拦截主张：80.1% 准确率，严重错误（真判假或假判真）从无检索的 20 降至 5；仅将判定改为代码推导可再从 13 降至 5 且不损准确率。主张门控通过 95.7% 留出主张、拒绝全部 30 条日常语句；8 GB 消费级 GPU 上，语音窗结束后中位 1.86 秒给出反馈。148 条过敏主张：仅重建主张门控即达 87.8% 准确率、5 个严重错误（无检索为 20）。

Conclusion: 端侧、检索受限、面向沉默失效的管道设计可在低算力消费硬件上实现实时、可引用的规则核查，并大幅降低误导性判断；系统具备一定跨领域可迁移性，但规模仍有限。

Abstract: In law and medicine, a misstated rule can shape a decision before anyone has time to check it. Checking such claims in real time helps only if the checker keeps pace with conversation, keeps sensitive audio on the device, and stays silent rather than mislead. We present CLAIMGATE, an on- device assistant that listens to a conversation, detects checkable claims, retrieves the relevant official rule, and labels each claim as supported, contradicted or not covered, with a citation. CLAIMGATE is designed to fail towards silence: its 4-bit 7B- parameter language model may cite only retrieved rules, and the verdict is derived in code from the claim and rule the model quotes. We evaluate it on traffic stops and medical visits using real official rule text (5,742 Florida and Texas statute subsections; CDC, FDA and MedlinePlus guidance), real transcripts, live speech and author-written gold-labelled claims. On 141 held-out traffic-stop claims, CLAIMGATE reaches 80.1% accuracy and cuts serious errors (a true claim called false, or the reverse) from 20 to 5 compared with the same model without retrieval; deriving the verdict in code alone reduces them from 13 to 5 at no cost to accuracy. The claim gate passes 95.7% of held-out claims and rejects all 30 everyday sentences, and feedback arrives a median 1.86 s after a speech window closes on an 8 GB consumer GPU. On 148 allergy claims, with only the claim gate to rebuild, CLAIMGATE reaches 87.8% accuracy with 5 serious errors, against 20 without retrieval.

</details>


### [292] [PazaBench: Large-Scale ASR Benchmark for Low-Resource Languages in Africa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31578)
*Mercy Muchai,Nick Mumero Mwangi,Kevin Chege,Samuel Chege Maina*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个面向非洲低资源语言的ASR大规模基准，统合6个公开语料，评估52个模型在39种语言上的WER/CER/RTFx，并提供架构感知比较与部署权衡分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低资源语言在ASR基准中长期缺乏代表性，难以可靠评估和比较模型性能。

Method: 将六个公开语料统一为可复现评估框架，覆盖三类架构范式的52个SOTA ASR模型，在39种非洲语言上以WER、CER、RTFx指标评估，并做架构感知比较、语系方差量化及精度-效率权衡分析。

Result: 在39种非洲语言上给出52个模型的准确率与效率结果，系统比较单个模型及模型族，量化语系语言差异对性能的影响，并呈现精度-效率权衡关系。

Conclusion: 该基准、评估流程与结果为低资源语言ASR提供透明、可复现且面向部署的评估能力。

Abstract: Low-resource languages remain underrepresented in ASR benchmarks, limiting the ability to reliably assess and compare model performance. We present a large-scale benchmark for automatic speech recognition (ASR) on low-resource languages in Africa. The benchmark harmonizes six public corpora into a unified, reproducible evaluation framework and evaluates 52 state-of-the-art ASR models spanning three model architectural paradigms across 39 African languages on diverse datasets. Models are evaluated using standard accuracy and efficiency metrics, word error rate (WER), character error rate (CER), and inverse real-time factor (RTFx). This benchmark introduces architecture-aware comparison that systematically analyzes both individual models and broader model families. In addition, we quantify linguistic variance across language families, revealing how these factors shape ASR performance across diverse African languages. We also provide a comprehensive accuracy and efficiency trade-off analysis directly relevant to deployment in low-resource settings. Together, the benchmark, evaluation pipeline, and results support transparent, reproducible, and deployment-aware evaluation of ASR models for low-resource languages.

</details>
