### [293] [SecondChance: Benchmarking Reliable Error Recovery in AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31586)
*Atahan Dokme,Adar Avsian,Larry Heck*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SecondChance——基于真实智能体自身错误检查点的数据集与评测框架，在四种辅助条件下系统测量AI智能体的错误恢复行为，揭示"改正≠恢复"及恢复率极低的现状。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有恢复基准大多人为注入故障、无用户参与、仅以任务是否最终完成为评分标准，因此无法反映智能体是否撤销了自身的隐性错误、是否告知用户、或是否面对了无法修复的错误。

Method: 构建SecondChance数据集与评测框架：错误来自智能体在τ²-bench、BFCL、AppWorld中的真实任务尝试（自然错误）。智能体从同一检查点出发，在四种条件下续行：无辅助、错误提示、错误位置、修复指导。测量指标包括错误纠正、任务成功、策略合规、环境状态保持、修复持久性和成本。对12个模型在四种条件下共5,760次续行进行评测。

Result: 恢复极为罕见：最好的模型在无辅助下仅完成16%的恢复，有修复指导时为27%。"纠正≠恢复"——在修复指导条件下Llama-3.3-70B纠正了26%的τ²错误但无一任务完成；AppWorld中84次成功续行里有40次未处理错误本身。

Conclusion: SecondChance揭示了仅靠任务成功率无法捕捉的恢复质量差异，为评估智能体真实错误恢复能力提供了更细粒度的诊断工具。

Abstract: AI agents make errors while they act, and their reliability depends on what they do afterwards. Existing recovery benchmarks mostly inject faults, involve no user and score whether the task is eventually completed, so they cannot show whether an agent undid its own silent error, told the user, or faced an error that could not be fixed. We introduce SecondChance, an error checkpoint dataset and evaluation harness that profiles and measures error-recovery behaviour of AI agents. The errors are natural: they come from agents' own task attempts in $τ^2$-bench, BFCL and AppWorld. Different agents then resume from the same checkpoints under one of four conditions: no assistance, an error notice, the error location, or repair guidance. We measure error correction, task success, policy compliance, preservation of environment state, repair durability and cost. We evaluate 12 models under all four conditions in 5,760 continuations. Recovery is rare: across its environments, the best model completes only 16% of recoveries unaided and 27% with repair guidance. Correcting is not recovering: with repair guidance, Llama-3.3-70B corrects 26% of $τ^2$ errors but completes none, and 40 of 84 successful AppWorld continuations leave the error in place. SecondChance exposes these differences that task success alone cannot capture.

</details>


### [294] [LUCID: Statistically Grounded Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31595)
*Satiyabooshan Murugaboopathy,Adel Daoud,Connor T. Jerzak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出LUCID：用prompt自纠+Design-based Supervised Learning，无需重训即可校准廉价LLM步骤评分器的偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 廉价语言模型评分器可大规模给思维链步骤打分，但系统性评分误差会扭曲推理审计与解排序；且无法重训或访问权重。

Method: LUCID：先用小规模专家标注集把评分器偏差总结为自然语言，提示评分器重评未见步骤；结合DSL，将预测与专家"健全率"对齐；并用重评前后的检查跳过已校准评分器、回滚无效轮次；再将专家集与原始语料评分复用于DSL做校准、回归去偏及成对标注步骤的DSL估计。

Result: PRM800K上GPT-5-mini校准差距从7.8降至0.9个百分点，误报减半，不健全步骤错误检测F1提升32%；1000条诊断或仅整体差距反馈即可保持增益；可跨模型（迁移到GLM-5.2）与跨领域（数学、科学、网页、逻辑）迁移；DSL的OOF健全概率使best-of-K匹配专家标签，双稳健估计在低预算下优于仅专家回归，健全步骤转移误差降低近三分之二。

Conclusion: 提示反馈主要移动阈值而非提升类别平衡判别力；LUCID以轻量、免重训方式有效校准步骤评分，DSL可复用专家数据实现选择与去偏增益。

Abstract: Cheap language-model raters grade chain-of-thought reasoning at scale, yet systematic step-rating errors can skew reasoning audits and solution rankings. We introduce LUCID (Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis), which pairs prompt self-correction with Design-based Supervised Learning (DSL). Without retraining or weight access, LUCID calibrates binary step ratings by aligning predicted and expert soundness rates. From a small expert-labeled set, LUCID summarizes rater bias in plain text and prompts the rater to re-grade unseen steps. For example, on PRM800K, GPT-5-mini grades too strictly, under-rating computation, verification, and late-trace steps most acutely. In one pass, LUCID shrinks GPT-5-mini's calibration gap from 7.8 to 0.9 percentage points in absolute predicted-expert rate difference. LUCID also halves false alarms (sound steps rated unsound) and lifts error-detection F1 on unsound steps by 32%. LUCID retains these gains with 1,000 diagnostic steps or overall-gap feedback alone. The loop also transfers across models and domains: it applies GPT-5-mini's bias profile to lift GLM-5.2's PRM800K accuracy, and it narrows calibration gaps for overly strict but capable raters across math, science, web, and logic benchmarks. Because prompt feedback shifts thresholds without improving class-balanced sound/unsound discrimination, LUCID filters re-grading with pre-/post-checks that skip already calibrated raters and roll back ineffective passes. Finally, we reuse that expert set with raw corpus ratings in DSL for calibration and regression debiasing, and apply DSL to pair-labeled steps for sound-step transitions. DSL's out-of-fold soundness probabilities lift best-of-K selection to match expert labels, while its doubly-robust estimators beat expert-only regression fits at small budgets and cut sound-step transition error by nearly two-thirds.

</details>


### [295] [Training decision models for simulating human respondents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31613)
*Davood Wadi,Yu Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用条件极大似然在历史受访者选择微观数据上训练KEV决策模型（System One架构），可显著降低LLM合成选择数据的处理效应误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现成生成式LLM作为合成受访者时会给下游计量推断带来偏差，且专有模型或提高推理强度都无法可靠消除该偏差。

Method: 采用System One架构的决策模型（KEV），在无目标研究数据的情况下，通过选择训练以条件极大似然在受访者层面选择微观数据上更新模型权重，再做推断；跨三个模型规模、用两个离散选择实验训练。

Result: 在疫苗、营养标签、消费者权利、AI四个新领域及新作答格式的留出研究上，处理效应误差降低22%–89%；小型选择训练模型在四项研究中三项优于更大的现成模型；仅在单一研究上训练虽降低交叉熵，却可能加剧处理效应误差。

Conclusion: 选择训练与推断后校准互补，能为估计人类偏好提供更好的起点。

Abstract: Researchers increasingly use large language models (LLMs) as synthetic respondents in market research, conjoint analysis, and randomized experiments. However, synthetic choice data from off-the-shelf generative LLMs bias downstream econometric inference. Neither proprietary models nor higher reasoning effort reliably reduces this bias. We investigate decision models (System One architectures) for silicon sampling. Using choice training, we update KEV model weights on historical respondent-level choice microdata by conditional maximum likelihood, before inference and without target-study data. Across three model scales, training on two discrete choice experiments lowers treatment-effect error by 22% to 89% on four held-out studies from new domains (vaccines, nutrition labels, consumer rights, and AI) and new response formats. A small choice-trained model outperforms a much larger off-the-shelf model on three of the four studies. Although training on single studies lowers cross-entropy, it can exacerbate treatment-effect error. Choice training thus complements post-inference calibration by providing a stronger starting point for estimating human preferences.

</details>


### [296] [Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31614)
*Skye L. Goetz,Jared C. Roach,Gwênlyn Glusman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Tablassert 工具，将生物医学论文中的表格数据转换为知识图谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物医学论文（尤其补充材料）表格中包含大量未见于正文的知识主张（如低显著性、篇幅限制、叙述范围所限），但缺乏将这些表格数据整合利用的手段。

Method: Tablassert 支持 Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet 格式；用户通过 YAML 声明表格列到主谓宾+限定符语句的映射；工具解析自由文本（如"lung cancer"）为标准标识符，附加溯源与统计信息，输出符合 NCATS Biomedical Data Translator 标准的图文件。

Result: 未在摘要中给出定量评估结果，主要展示其功能能力与输出合规性。

Conclusion: Tablassert 为论文表格知识的形式化与图谱化提供了可配置、标准化的解决方案，有助于扩展生物医学知识图谱的来源。

Abstract: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).

</details>


### [297] [Right Destination, Wrong Journey: Synthetic Counseling Dialogues Miss Human Interactional Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31686)
*Ziwei Gong,Yuchen Huang,Nicholas Deas,Melanie Subbiah,Julia Hirschberg*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对十个人工、重建与合成的心理咨询对话数据集进行"轨迹导向"的过程保真度评估，发现合成对话虽常达到看似合理的终点，但在恢复动态与逐轮响应性上与真人支持存在差异，其中"患者—咨询师条件性响应"最难以复现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的咨询对话日益用于心理健康系统的训练与评测，但现有评测多关注单轮回复质量与最终结果，忽视了支持过程随时间如何展开，即过程保真度不足。

Method: 提出以轨迹为中心的评估框架，跨十个人工、重建与合成心理咨询数据集比较过程保真度；并在受控合成数据集上开展针对性生成干预实验，检验能否缩小与真实数据的差距。

Result: 合成对话常达到合理终点，但恢复动态与逐轮响应性偏离人类；生成设计可改变恢复时机、轨迹结构等全局性质，而条件性患者—咨询师响应性在各模型与生成范式下始终保真度更低；受控干预能缩小若干轨迹级指标差距，但无法完全恢复交互保真度，轮级响应性仍受限。

Conclusion: 仅看结果会高估合成咨询数据的质量，交互性（尤其是轮级响应性）是当前生成范式的核心瓶颈；作者发布三个受控合成数据集（共2,050段对话）、标注及评估框架以支持后续研究。

Abstract: LLM-generated counseling dialogues are increasingly used for training and evaluating mental-health systems, yet existing evaluations focus largely on response quality and final outcomes rather than how support unfolds over time. We conduct a trajectory-centered evaluation of process fidelity across ten human, reconstructed, and synthetic counseling datasets. Our results show that synthetic dialogues often reach plausible endpoints but differ from human support in recovery dynamics and turn-by-turn responsiveness. While generation design can shift global properties such as recovery timing and trajectory structure, contingent patient--counselor responsiveness remains consistently lower in fidelity across models and generation paradigms. Our experiments on controlled synthetic datasets show that targeted generation interventions can narrow the gap with real data on several trajectory-level measures, but do not fully recover interactional fidelity, with turn-level responsiveness remaining limited. We release three controlled synthetic datasets comprising 2,050 dialogues, together with annotations and the evaluation framework.

</details>


### [298] [fork() for Agents: Agent Kernel for Non-blocking LLM Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31727)
*Ankit Chadha,Pratyay Banerjee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Agent-Kernel 运行时，将分布式系统中的子图选择性恢复模式移植到 LLM 内容平面，以 Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR) 原语在异常时仅重置失败节点的后代并保留已完成工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体通常同步执行工具调用，失败即丢弃已完成工作，重放整条轨迹代价高昂、耗预算；现有恢复方案（Sherlock、AgentGit、Atomix）依赖训练好的验证器、版本控制或事务边界，开销大且非阻塞性差。

Method: Agent-Kernel：非阻塞运行时；SGR 在原始异常触发（无需训练验证器或规划器），重置失败节点的传递后代、保留完成兄弟节点，并将父节点文本注入子节点提示（上下文继承）；底层为持久化存储，具备形式化状态保持保证。

Result: 14,434 次运行覆盖合成与标准基准（tau-bench、Gaia2、AutomationBench、InterruptBench）：预算=3 时 SGR 100% 完成恢复，全轨迹重放仅 55%；比适配版 Sherlock 回滚快约 10 倍；线性负载精度与 ReAct 串行持平，结构化负载最多 12.7 倍并行加速；消融显示去掉 SGR 成功率降至 39.4%。

Conclusion: 子图选择性恢复可有效移植至 LLM 智能体内容平面，在无额外模型训练前提下兼顾恢复能力、并行加速与精度无损，是提升智能体运行时鲁棒性的可行通用原语。

Abstract: LLM-based agents typically execute tool calls synchronously and discard completed work upon failure. Subgraph-selective recovery, re-executing only a failed node's transitive descendants, is a well-established pattern in distributed systems (Spark, Erlang/OTP, Dryad), and recent agent runtimes (Sherlock, AgentGit, Atomix) preserve completed work through verifiers, version control, or transactional tool boundaries. We present \textbf{Agent-Kernel}, a non-blocking runtime that ports this pattern to the LLM \emph{content plane}: its primitive, \textbf{Sub-Graph Recovery (SGR)}, fires on a raw exception with no trained verifier or planner, resets a failed node's descendants while preserving completed siblings, and composes each parent's text into its children's prompts (context inheritance), all on a durable substrate with a formal state-preservation guarantee. Across 14{,}434 runs on synthetic and standard benchmarks (tau-bench, Gaia2, AutomationBench, InterruptBench), SGR reaches full recovery within budget=3 where whole-trajectory replay exhausts (100\% vs.\ 55\%), and is roughly 10$\times$ faster than an adapted Sherlock rollback that also recovers. It matches ReAct-serial accuracy within noise on linear workloads while adding recovery and parallelism (up to 12.7$\times$ speedup) where structure permits. Ablation isolates SGR: removing it collapses success to 39.4\%.

</details>


### [299] [SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31771)
*Priyesh Vakharia,Masud Moshtaghi,Pratyay Banerjee,Nicholas Jedema,Amita Misra,Ankit Chadha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过交错进行稠密检索与知识图谱遍历，并让LLM以SPARQL形式规划遍历路径但只解析不执行，在多个多跳QA基准上超越HippoRAG2、T²RAG和IRCoT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义检索在多跳问答中召回率和精度都存在问题：金标段落淹没在干扰项中，需要推理而非匹配。GraphRAG通过图扩展提升召回，但多跳扩展代价高且引入额外噪声。

Method: 将稠密检索与Wikidata知识图谱遍历交错进行：稠密检索定位高召回的初始区域，KG遍历通过推理路径验证段落以提升精度与召回。LLM将遍历规划为SPARQL代码生成任务，但仅解析而非执行查询。

Result: 在共享语料与reader、单一配置下，HotpotQA达62.5/75.1 EM/F1，2WikiMultiHopQA达73.5/81.0，MuSiQue达37.1/50.0，均超过复现的HippoRAG2、T²RAG和IRCoT。token匹配设置下仍在HotpotQA和2Wiki领先T²RAG。执行SPARQL而非解析最多损失11.4 EM，主因是原始查询返回空结果而非语法错误。

Conclusion: 交错式检索与KG遍历能同时兼顾召回与精度，解析而非执行LLM生成的SPARQL是提升可靠性的关键。

Abstract: Semantic retrieval struggles with multi-hop question answering on both recall and precision: gold passages are buried among distractors that degrade the reader's answer, and retrieving them requires reasoning over the query rather than matching it. GraphRAG techniques expand semantic retrieval by connecting passages to graph nodes and performing one or more hops of expansion after initial retrieval. This improves recall, but multi-hop expansion becomes expensive and brings additional noise into the retrieved set. We break this tradeoff by \emph{interleaving} dense retrieval with knowledge-graph traversal for complex multi-hop questions. Dense retrieval locates the first relevant regions of the search space at good recall, while traversal of a pre-existing external KG (Wikidata) restores precision and improves recall by confirming retrieved passages against a reasoning path through the KG. To keep traversal both question-adaptive and reliable, we have an LLM plan it as code generation task for graph traversal in SPARQL format but \emph{parse rather than execute} the query. On full 1{,}000-question splits under a shared corpus and reader, and with a single configuration applied identically to every dataset, we reach \textbf{62.5 / 75.1} EM/F1 on HotpotQA, \textbf{73.5 / 81.0} on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and \textbf{37.1 / 50.0} on MuSiQue, ahead of reproduced HippoRAG2, T\textsuperscript{2}RAG, and IRCoT on all three benchmarks. A second, token-matched setting stays ahead of T\textsuperscript{2}RAG on HotpotQA and 2Wiki while spending roughly its per-query budget. Executing the generated SPARQL instead of parsing it costs up to 11.4 EM, mostly because raw queries return empty results, not because of syntax errors.

</details>


### [300] [Exploring Multi-Player Social Games as Verifiable Training Grounds for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31821)
*Keyu He,Michael Li,Jiarui Liu,Mingqian Zheng,Koichi Onoue,Tongshuang Wu,Maarten Sap*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 利用三种多人社交游戏的可验证胜负作为奖励，通过SFT与RLVR训练Qwen3模型，显著提升其社交智能并可泛化到未训练游戏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交智能训练依赖LLM裁判，成本高、噪声大且易被reward hacking；多人社交游戏需要开放式沟通与推理隐藏身份，且规则提供客观可验证结果，可作为更可靠的训练信号。

Method: 在三种社交游戏上，对Qwen3模型（1.7B/4B/32B）进行监督微调（SFT）与带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），并与提示等上下文策略对比，部分游戏留作held-out测试泛化性。

Result: 对抗更强的Gemma-3-27B时，Qwen3-4B在三款训练游戏胜率从33%升至81%，在三款未训练游戏从39%升至54%；而提示策略仅提升约6个百分点；增益在不同模型规模上均成立。

Conclusion: 在社交游戏的可验证结果上训练LLM能培养可泛化的社交行为（更开放的信息共享、基于证据核查他人主张、协同投票），为构建社交智能体提供可扩展路径。

Abstract: The training of socially intelligent language models often relies on large language model (LLM) judges, which are expensive, noisy, and vulnerable to reward hacking. Multi-player social games offer a natural alternative: they require open-ended communication to coordinate with teammates and infer hidden roles, while their rules provide an objective outcome which can serve as a verifiable reward for training. Using three social games, we explore how much social intelligence Qwen3 models can acquire through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Results show that against a much stronger Gemma-3-27B model, SFT and RLVR raise the win rate of Qwen3-4B from 33% to 81% on the three trained games, and from 39% to 54% on three additional held-out games. In contrast, in-context strategies such as prompting improve the win rate of Qwen3-4B by only about 6 pp across the same games we train and evaluate on. Furthermore, we show that the gains from SFT and RLVR hold across the model sizes 1.7B, 4B, and 32B. Qualitative analyses of agent behavior show signs of stronger social intelligence; for example, trained agents tend to share information more openly, check each other's claims against public evidence, and coordinate their votes. More broadly, our results demonstrate that training LLMs on verifiable outcomes in social games can cultivate generalizable social behaviors, which offers a scalable path for building socially intelligent agents.

</details>


### [301] [Faithful Persona Steering under Incongruity via Dual-Stream Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31848)
*Yu-An Chu,Jen-Ren Pong,Chia-Yao Yeh,Meng-Fen Chiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: QuirkyMind提出将"身份定义"与"身份表达"解耦的LLM个性化框架，通过Traits Anchoring双流隐状态、In-Context Narrative Refinement交替目标（InfoNCE+交叉熵）和Persona Steered Generalization实现稳定且保留个性"怪癖"的人格建模，在Persona-Steered QA与Narrative Inference任务上缓解漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个性化方法将身份视为静态检索任务，忽视人类人格的内在矛盾性——稳定特质与情境特异立场共存。提示方法在长序列中出现上下文漂移，微调则倾向用通用分布模式压制个体"怪癖"特征，二者难以兼顾身份稳定性与真实的不一致性。

Method: 框架分三步：(1) Traits Anchoring构建双流隐状态，融合句子级摘要（语义稳定）与token级序列（生成控制）；(2) In-Context Narrative Refinement以交替目标稳定该状态：判别式InfoNCE损失在表示空间锚定人格以防漂移，生成式交叉熵损失保证忠实表达；(3) Persona Steered Generalization通过参数高效适配器将精炼状态迁移到下游任务。

Result: 在Persona-Steered QA和Narrative Inference上的实证评估表明，QuirkyMind能缓解人格漂移，在巩固人格知识的同时不抹除真实的不一致性。

Conclusion: 将身份定义与表达解耦、并用判别+生成交替目标联合约束，是兼顾人格稳定性与个性特质保留的有效路径，为LLM个性化提供了可迁移的框架。

Abstract: Standard LLM personalization typically frames identity as a static retrieval task, overlooking the inherent incongruity of human personas, where stable traits coexist with atypical, context-specific stances. Existing methods struggle to reconcile these dimensions: prompting succumbs to context drift over long sequences, while fine-tuning often suppresses idiosyncratic "quirks" in favor of generic distributional patterns. To bridge this gap, we present QuirkyMind, a framework that disentangles identity definition from its expression. First, Traits Anchoring constructs a dual-stream latent state, fusing a sentence-level summary for semantic stability with a token-level sequence for generative control. This state is stabilized via In-Context Narrative Refinement using an alternating objective: a discriminative InfoNCE loss anchors the persona in representation space to prevent drift, while a generative cross-entropy loss ensures faithful verbalization. Finally, Persona Steered Generalization transfers the refined state to downstream tasks via parameter-efficient adapters. Empirical evaluations on Persona-Steered QA and Narrative Inference demonstrate that QuirkyMind mitigates drift, consolidating persona knowledge without erasing authentic incongruities.

</details>


### [302] [Scoring What Matters: Exact Feedback Reduction for Language Model Comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31931)
*Hui Zhang,Haoda Yue,Bicheng Deng,Yuanchao Zhu,Jun He,Rui Qian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAFA是一种采样器无关的反馈获取方法，通过分组相同打分输入并聚合报告系数，只获取线性报告真正需要的评分，在保证精确恢复样本均值/协方差的前提下大幅减少打分成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较语言模型检查点需估计性能差异，但现有评测流程常为对差异无贡献的响应对进行打分，造成浪费。

Method: 提出Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition (CAFA)：在获取反馈前确定线性报告所需的评分，将相同打分输入分组并聚合其报告系数，去除超出普通缓存之外的冗余查询；针对固定响应库与无约束标量打分器，刻画精确恢复样本均值（单独或与协方差联合）的充要查询集合。

Result: 受控更新下，CAFA在缓存后剩余打分输入中分别去除55.8%（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct）和90.1%（SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct）；三条在线GRPO轨迹中，Independent Star采样+CAFA相比带缓存的独立自回归采样，在相同经验精度阈值（RMS MCSE≤0.04）下记录成本降低46.1–51.3%；全部504个报告单元以数值精度复现完整打分的均值与协方差。

Conclusion: CAFA能在保持完全打分结果一致性的同时显著降低生成+反馈成本，具备采样器无关性与模块化实现（支持响应库、版本化缓存与外部打分器）；但成本比较为固定预算网格上已完成运行的事后比较。

Abstract: Comparing language-model checkpoints requires estimating performance differences, yet evaluation pipelines can pay to score responses whose contributions cancel from those differences. We introduce Contrast-Aware Feedback Acquisition (CAFA), a sampler-agnostic method that identifies which scores a requested linear report needs before acquiring feedback. CAFA groups identical scoring inputs and aggregates their report coefficients, removing queries beyond ordinary caching while preserving the fully scored result. For a fixed response bank and an otherwise unrestricted scalar scorer, we characterize necessary and sufficient query sets for exact recovery of sample means, either alone or jointly with ordinary sample covariances. On controlled updates, CAFA removes 55.8% and 90.1% of the scoring inputs remaining after caching for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct, respectively, averaged over four generation repetitions. Across three online group relative policy optimization (GRPO) trajectories, Independent Star sampling with CAFA achieves 46.1-51.3% lower recorded generation-plus-feedback cost than independent autoregressive sampling with caching at a common empirical precision threshold (RMS MCSE $\leq 0.04$). This is a post hoc comparison of completed runs on a fixed budget grid. All 504 evaluated report cells reproduce the fully scored means and covariances to numerical precision. We provide a modular implementation supporting existing response banks, versioned caches and external scorers.

</details>


### [303] [Localizing Cross-Lingual Generalization in Parameter Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31975)
*Yeoreum Lee,Jaeseong Lee,Seung-won Hwang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文从参数空间几何视角解释跨语言迁移的不均衡现象：跨语言泛化取决于英/目标语LoRA适配器是否共享低误差盆地，数学推理的断裂是局部的，可通过分解语言特定编码与语言无关组合两部分来修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言迁移在NLU任务上成功但在数学推理上常失败，这种任务间的不对称性尚缺乏解释。作者希望从参数空间的几何结构（低误差盆地的共享性）出发，统一刻画并解释该现象。

Method: 采用线性模式连通性（LMC）度量英语与目标语言LoRA适配器之间的连通性，在NLI、QA、数学推理三类任务上比较。进一步做局部性检验：仅用少量目标语任务样本作用于英语适配器的语言编码层或语义组合层进行修复；并分别用英语任务数据（通往组合层）与无标注目标语语料（通往语言编码层）验证二者的可分解性。

Result: NLI与QA的模型-语言对大多线性连通，而数学推理对不连通，说明盆地几何依赖任务。数学任务的不连通是"局部"而非全局的：少量目标语样本仅作用于语言编码层或语义组合层即可修复。跨语言泛化可分解为语言特定编码与语言无关组合，二者可分别由更廉价信号提供，且几乎对每个语言对单独有效；其中组合部分影响更大，且无需目标语数据。

Conclusion: 跨语言泛化在参数空间中可分解为语言特定与语言无关两部分，这既解释了任务间的不对称性，也为低资源跨语言适配提供了实用路径（如利用英语任务数据与无标注目标语文本分别补足两部分）。

Abstract: Cross-lingual transfer is uneven across tasks, succeeding for natural language understanding but often failing for mathematical reasoning. We argue that this asymmetry is governed by the geometry of parameter space. Specifically, cross-lingual generalization is determined by whether English and target-language LoRA adapters share a low-error basin. To test this, we use linear mode connectivity (LMC) between English and target-language adapters, evaluating on three tasks. We find that NLI and QA model-language pairs are mostly linearly connected, whereas mathematical reasoning (Math) pairs are not, indicating that basin geometry is task-dependent. Such disconnection in Math is ``local'' rather than global. A small target-language task sample, applied only to the English adapter's language encoding or semantic composition layers, is enough to repair it. Cross-lingual generalization is also factorizable into language-specific encoding and language-agnostic composition, each supplied separately from a cheaper signal. English task data routed to the composition layers and an unlabeled target-language corpus routed to the language encoding layers each alleviate it on their own for nearly every pair. Composition is the more influential of these, and it needs no target-language data. Together, these results suggest that cross-lingual generalization decomposes into language-specific and language-agnostic components in parameter space. This decomposition offers a practical route for low-resource cross-lingual adaptation.

</details>


### [304] [Reading, Writing and Repairing Game-Theoretic Policies in Weight Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31979)
*Ancil Crayton*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文探究大语言模型能否直接在被表示为权重的策略网络上推理重复博弈，通过四个可精确验证的任务评估中型开源模型的能力边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索语言模型能否在策略网络的权重空间中工作，即从权重直接理解、生成和修复策略，而非仅在文本层面推理，这关系到模型对程序化/参数化策略的理解能力。

Method: 使用递归网络（1,218个权重）并设计四个答案可精确检验的任务：给定英文描述的对手群体写出最优策略；给定权重报告15个对手历史后的动作；恢复其实现的状态机（深度10全序列评测）；修复被改动一处的网络并指出首个出错轮次。在66/36/20/18等样本上进行评估。

Result: 程序恢复66次中62次成功；15项行为条目36次中34次全对；声明策略经编译后20次全达最优；但修复最弱：18次中仅4次修复成功、5次诊断正确，中位补丁只覆盖所需两项条目之一。

Conclusion: 模型在从权重读取和生成最优策略方面表现强，但定位并修复局部错误的能力显著不足，是当前权重空间推理的主要短板。

Abstract: Can a language model work in the weight space of a policy network for a repeated game? We put four questions to a mid-size open model, on recurrent networks of 1{,}218 weights with exactly checkable answers. Given a population of opponents described in English, write a policy that is optimal: its value is a finite computation over the agent's information state, so a submitted network has an exact gap from the optimum. Given a network's weights, report its action after each of fifteen opponent histories; recover the state machine it implements, judged on every opponent sequence to depth ten; or repair a network whose output was altered in one place and say which round first goes wrong. The model recovers the program in 62 of 66 replies, reports all fifteen behavioral entries correctly in 34 of 36, and attains the optimum in 20 of 20 when it states a policy the evaluator compiles. Repair is the exception: 4 of 18 repaired, 5 of 18 diagnosed, with a median patch covering one of the two entries needed.

</details>


### [305] [Grounding Language Models in Revealed Audience Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31999)
*Jiwoo Jung,Daecheol An*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文主张用"受众真实行为（曝光-点击/点赞/观看）"微调语言模型，构建"行为接地"的受众模拟器，并从"为什么"和"在哪里"两个角度解释为何直接询问模型会失败：差距源于训练信号而非模型规模或提示；接地在有文本信号的场景有效，而无文本信号场景则难以超越随机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有受众模拟器多用"人们说了什么"（stated preferences）做验证，而非"人们实际做了什么"（revealed behavior）。作者希望用真实点击/点赞/观看记录来接地模型，并超越前人"询问模型不如接地"的结论，追问差距的成因与适用边界。

Method: 将模型在真实受众行为记录上微调（把点击/点赞/观看记录作为监督信号），对比"直接询问"与"行为接地"两类范式；控制模型规模（0.6B vs 8B）、提示强度（最强提示）、点击的拟合形式（计数 vs 份额，预注册检验）；在四类行为（新闻点击、短视频点赞、观看时长等）上测试。

Result: 同一8B模型询问时约半数正确，接地后达86.5%；最强提示仅相当于一个文本分类器；接地0.6B模型超过所有被提示的前沿模型；计数与份额拟合无显著差异（预注册）。被询问的8B模型复现了陈述偏好线索，偏好实际降低点击的"提问式标题"。接地在短视视频点赞上+20分（200个预注册视频），在给定阅读历史的新闻点击上仅与询问模型持平，纯文本模型在观看时长上接近随机。

Conclusion: 差距主要来自训练信号而非模型规模或提示；接地效果取决于文本是否携带预测信号：有信号则显著获益，无信号（如观看时长）则文本模型难超随机。应发布代码、适配器与运行输出，倡导以"实际行为"而非"口头表述"验证受众模拟器。

Abstract: Language models are increasingly used to simulate how an audience will respond to a headline or a post, and such simulators are validated against what people say. We validate them against what people do. We call a model grounded in revealed audience behavior when it is fine-tuned on records of what audiences actually clicked, liked or watched, and we ask not only whether asking a model falls short of grounding it, as prior work found, but why and where. Why: the gap is a property of the training signal, not mainly of model size or prompting. The same 8B model is right about half the time when asked which headline readers will click and 86.5% of the time when grounded in the clicks; the strongest prompting we tried only matches a text classifier; a grounded 0.6B model beats every prompted frontier model in our runs; and whether the clicks are fitted as counts or as shares makes no detectable difference in a pre-registered test. The asked 8B model also reproduces stated-preference cues, favoring question headlines that in fact lower clicks. Where: across four behaviors, grounding wins where the text carries the signal (short-video likes, +20 points on 200 pre-registered videos), only ties an asked model given the reader's history (news clicks), and nothing text-only gets far from chance on watch time. Code, adapters and run outputs will be released.

</details>


### [306] [Making Evaluation Explicit Is Not Enough: Supervising the Evaluation Process in Generative Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32161)
*Qiyuan Chen,Yuze Zhao,Jiahe Chen,Hongsen Huang,Hongxia Xu,Yingda Chen,Jian Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 STEP-GRM 框架，直接监督基于评分标准的生成式奖励模型的中间评估过程，提升评估一致性与下游策略优化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式奖励模型虽在预测偏好前生成批评/评分标准等显式分析，但在仅结果监督下，模型可能"结论正确、过程薄弱"，把评估变成事后合理化，过程并不可靠。

Method: 在常规偏好监督之外，为评分标准构建提供结构性指导，并对标准级判断提供局部监督，从而同时学习正确的最终偏好与更可靠的推理过程。

Result: 在标准奖励建模基准上表现强劲，同时提升中间评估的一致性与正确性；其奖励信号还能带来更好的下游策略优化效果。

Conclusion: 可靠的评估过程不仅能提升奖励模型准确率，还能转化为实际下游收益，说明过程监督对 GRM 具有重要价值。

Abstract: Generative reward models (GRMs) make language-model evaluation more explicit by generating critiques, rubrics, or intermediate analyses before predicting a final preference. However, explicit evaluation does not necessarily imply a reliable evaluation process: under outcome-only supervision, a model may reach the correct final preference while producing weak or unsupported intermediate judgments, turning the evaluation into a post-hoc rationalization. We introduce STEP-GRM, a framework that directly supervises the intermediate evaluation process of rubric-based GRMs. In addition to conventional preference supervision, STEP-GRM provides structural guidance for rubric construction and local supervision for criterion-level judgments, encouraging the model to learn not only the correct final preference but also a more reliable process for reaching it. Extensive experiments show that STEP-GRM achieves strong performance on standard reward-modeling benchmarks while improving the consistency and correctness of intermediate evaluations. Moreover, reward signals produced by STEP-GRM lead to better downstream policy optimization, demonstrating that more reliable evaluation processes can translate into practical gains beyond reward-model accuracy.

</details>


### [307] [RightDiff: Learning Generative Reward Models to Judge by the Right Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32166)
*Qiyuan Chen,Hongsen Huang,Jiahe Chen,Renjie Hua,Hongxia Xu,Chuan Ren,Jian Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 RightDiff，将成对评估结构化为单次自回归生成中执行的、有证据支撑的评估轨迹，先挖掘候选间的对比差异并分为实质/非实质因素，进而归纳对-特定评分标准再裁决，从而提升生成式奖励模型的偏好建模能力并抑制长度捷径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式奖励模型依赖通用的查询级评分标准或无约束的理由，忽略了成对偏好是由响应间具体差异驱动的；且仅优化结果正确性会诱导模型利用冗长、格式等表面捷径，引发理由漂移（rationale drift）。

Method: RightDiff 将成对评估组织为一条证据支撑的评估轨迹，在单次自回归生成中显式发现候选对比差异、将其归类为实质或非实质因素、归纳对-特定评分标准，最后作出裁决。训练上，通过响应隔离提示（response-isolated prompts）合成演示数据以避免事后合理化，并用差异对齐奖励优化，配合预算约束的一对一匹配与乘性门控正则。

Result: 在 RewardBench 与 RM-Bench 上取得 SOTA 偏好建模性能，超越所有开源奖励模型及领先的专有 LLM 评判器；下游为 Arena-Hard 与 AlpacaEval 上的 DPO 提供可靠监督，并有效抵抗长度捷径。

Conclusion: 以对-特定、差异驱动且证据支撑的评估轨迹替代通用评分标准，可显著提升生成式奖励模型的偏好判断质量与鲁棒性，并为其作为 DPO 监督信号提供更可靠的依据。

Abstract: Generative reward models typically rely on generic query-level rubrics or unconstrained rationales, overlooking the fact that pairwise preference is driven by response-specific differences. Moreover, optimizing solely for outcome correctness encourages models to exploit superficial shortcuts such as verbosity and formatting, triggering rationale drift. To address this, we propose RightDiff, which structures pairwise evaluation into an evidence-grounded evaluation trajectory executed in a single autoregressive generation. RightDiff explicitly discovers contrastive differences between candidates, categorizes them into material or immaterial factors, and induces pair-specific rubrics before final adjudication. To train this process without post-hoc rationalization, we synthesize demonstration data via response-isolated prompts and optimize the reward model with a difference-alignment reward regularized by budget-constrained one-to-one matching and multiplicative gating. RightDiff achieves state-of-the-art preference modeling performance on RewardBench and RM-Bench, surpassing all open-source reward models and leading proprietary LLM judges. Downstream, it provides reliable supervision for direct preference optimization on Arena-Hard and AlpacaEval while effectively resisting length shortcuts.

</details>


### [308] [ArEssays: Towards Robust Arabic Handwritten Text Understanding in Educational Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32211)
*Hamdy Mubarak,Anas Madkoor,Ehsaneddin Asgari,Majd Hawasly*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布 ArEssays——一个大规模阿拉伯语学生手写作文数据集（含逐字转写与语言校正双版本），并基准测试 34 个视觉语言与 OCR 模型，揭示真实儿童手写上的显著性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语手写识别面临书写系统复杂、儿童字迹变化大的难题，而现有资源缺乏真实学生手写作文数据，尤其是覆盖小学到中学的阿拉伯语场景。

Method: 构建 ArEssays 数据集，采集埃及小学至中学学生的真实作文，提供逐字转写与语言校正两种标注；在统一设定下基准测试 34 个视觉语言模型与 OCR 模型，包括微调系统。

Result: 在真实学生手写数据上，各模型表现存在较大性能差距，即使微调系统也难以达到理想效果。

Conclusion: 作者公开数据集、训练流程与实验结果，以推动阿拉伯语 OCR、文档理解与教育 NLP 研究。

Abstract: Automated understanding of handwritten Arabic student essays remains challenging due to script complexity and high variability
  in children's writing. We introduce ArEssays, a large-scale dataset of authentic essays from primary to secondary students
  across Egypt, with both verbatim transcriptions and linguistically corrected versions. We benchmark 34 vision-language and OCR
  models, including fine-tuned systems, and find large performance gaps on real student handwriting. We release the dataset,
  training pipelines, and results to support research in Arabic OCR, document understanding, and educational NLP.

</details>


### [309] [SkillCore: Internalizing Generalizable Skills via Scaffolding-Removed Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32246)
*Yi Liu,Changqing Ai,Peijie Dong,Xiankun Lin,Yongkang Yang,Zhezheng Hao,Xilin Xia,Hande Dong,Qiang Lin,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SkillCore数据管线与监督微调方法，将可泛化的外部技能内化到模型能力中，无需显式加载技能即可直接执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运行时技能能为代码审查、调试等任务提供流程性指导，但多数用户不会主动调用技能，导致收益只覆盖少数人。作者主张这类可泛化流程应成为模型自身能力，而非可选的外部附加组件。

Method: 构建数据管线：对真实智能体轨迹去除技能加载脚手架，同时保留任务上下文与后续动作，从而监督"无外部技能内容"的直接执行；为保留对提供真正外部信息的任务特定技能的访问，将去脚手架轨迹与少量保留技能调用监督的"原生技能轨迹"混合后进行监督微调。

Result: 在无技能的held-out评测上，任务完成质量相比基座Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-72B分别提升54.4%和24.8%；在单独的探测实验中保留了任务特定技能调用能力，并在SWE-bench Verified上保持通用编码性能。

Conclusion: 通过去脚手架轨迹蒸馏加少量技能原生数据混合的SFT，可把可泛化技能内化为模型能力，在提升无技能场景表现的同时不牺牲技能调用与通用编码能力。

Abstract: Runtime skills can improve agents' problem-solving capabilities by providing procedural guidance for tasks such as code review and debugging. However, these benefits reach only a minority of users, as most do not proactively invoke skills in practice. We argue that such generalizable procedures should become part of the model's capabilities rather than remain optional external add-ons, making them directly available without explicit skill loading. To this end, we present SkillCore, a data pipeline and supervised fine-tuning recipe for internalizing generalizable skills. We transform real agent trajectories by removing skill-loading scaffolding while preserving the task context and subsequent agent actions, thereby supervising direct execution without external skill content. To preserve access to task-specific skills that provide genuinely external information, we mix these scaffold-removed trajectories with a small proportion of skill-native trajectories that preserve supervision for skill invocation. On a held-out skill-free evaluation, SkillCore improves task completion quality over the base Qwen3-8B and Qwen2.5-72B models by 54.4% and 24.8%, respectively, while preserving task-specific skill invocation on a separate probe and general coding performance on SWE-bench Verified.

</details>


### [310] [ArabFake: A multitask deep learning framework for Arabic fake news Detection, Categorization, and risk prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32303)
*Ahmed Maher Khafaga Shehata,Mohammed Nasser Al-Suqri,Nour Eldin Mohamed Elshaiekh Osman,Faten Hamad,Yousuf Nasser Alhusaini,Ahmed Mahfouz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出阿拉伯语假新闻检测框架ArabFake，基于MARBERTv2进行多任务学习，统一完成假新闻检测、内容分类与风险等级评估，并构建了2,495条专家标注数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿拉伯语（含多方言）媒体与社交平台上假新闻泛滥，威胁信息完整性与公众信任；已有工作多局限于二元分类，难以反映假新闻的类别与危害程度。

Method: 以MARBERTv2为骨干，构建多任务统一框架，共享表示同时完成三项任务：假新闻检测、内容分类、风险区域评估；并引入效价（valence）评分以增强可解释性、揭示误导性语言线索。同时发布ArabFake数据集（2,495条人工标注、专家核验）。

Result: 假新闻检测F1达94.12%，内容分类84.92%，风险等级评估88.91%，多任务均表现稳健；效价评分为操纵性语言线索提供了可视化洞察。

Conclusion: ArabFake是一个整体性的阿拉伯语假新闻检测框架，超越二元分类，对新闻机构与事实核查项目具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: The spread of fake news among Arabic media including social media represents a great challenge to the integrity of information and the trust of the public in it. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive deep-learning framework, named ArabFake, that goes beyond the binary classification on Arabic fake news detection. ArabFake, built over MARBERTv2 (a state-of-the-art model for multi-dialectal Arabic tweets), proficiently address the complexity of the Arabic language while performing three unified tasks which are fake news detection, content categorization and its risk assessment. The framework promotes efficiency and performance both by enabling multi-task learning through shared knowledge representation across tasks. In order to facilitate development and evaluation, we present the ArabFake Dataset consisting of 2,495 manually labelled news items with labels that are verified by experts regarding fake news categories and risk levels. ArabFake demonstrates robust performance, achieving an F1 score of 94.12% for fake news detection, 84.92% for categorization, and 88.91% for risk zone assessment, highlighting its reliability and effectiveness across multiple tasks. We improve interpretability and extract insight into manipulative techniques by integrating valence scoring as part of the framework that emphasizes misleading linguistic cues used to disseminate fake news within the produced image. The results show that ArabFake is a holistic Arabic fake news detection framework that has practical implications on news organizations and fact checking projects.

</details>


### [311] [Implementation of Machine Translation for the Uzbek Language Based on Transformer Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32359)
*Mukhammadjon Musaev,Mannon Ochilov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究使用T5与mT5等Transformer模型构建乌兹别克语机器翻译系统，通过数据收集、预处理与增强搭建约300万句对的乌英平行语料，微调后以BLEU评估，显著优于旧方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 乌兹别克语数据资源有限且语言本身复杂，缺乏高质量机器翻译系统，限制了该语言在数字世界中的应用与推广。

Method: 基于T5和mT5等Transformer模型；通过收集、预处理和数据增强构建约300万句对的乌兹别克语-英语平行语料；对模型进行微调以获得最佳翻译性能；采用BLEU分数进行评估。

Result: 所提方法相比旧有方法取得显著提升（具体BLEU数值摘要中未给出）。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了基于Transformer与大规模自建语料的方法对乌兹别克语机器翻译的有效性，有助于推动乌兹别克语在数字世界中的传播。

Abstract: This research focuses on building a machine translation system for the Uzbek language using transformer models such as T5 and mT5. Because of the limited data and the complexity of the Uzbek language, we collect, preprocess and augment data to create a strong Uzbek-English parallel corpus of about 3 million sentence pairs. The models are fine-tuned for optimal translation performance, and we use the BLEU score to evaluate the results. This study shows that our approach significantly improves upon older methods and helps promote the Uzbek language in the digital world.

</details>


### [312] [Decision Models: An Introduction and Capability Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32368)
*Rongtao Zhang,Mingjing Qi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估了StartLux Instant等11种决策模型配置在9类任务、1000个中英文案例上的准确率、输出有效性和请求延迟，StartLux Instant以95.3%总体准确率、100%有效输出和0.084秒中位延迟表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工单路由、事件分诊等应用需要软件可直接执行的决策，而决策模型通过明确的类型（选项、二元判断、策略分数）提供这类输出，因此需要系统评估其在准确性、有效性和延迟上的表现。

Method: 对11种配置在9个任务套件、1000个中英文案例上进行评测，衡量总体准确率、输出有效性（是否全部返回有效结果）以及请求延迟（中位数）。

Result: StartLux Instant总体准确率达95.3%，1000个案例全部输出有效，中位延迟0.084秒；分类与路由任务达99.4%，100个工具选择案例全部选对；所有配置中最高总体准确率为97.1%。

Conclusion: 类型化决策服务能够支持快速、可编程的决策，但其适用性取决于具体任务的错误特征与延迟要求。

Abstract: Applications such as ticket routing and incident triage need decisions that software can act on. Decision models provide these outputs through explicit types for choices, binary judgments, and policy scores. We evaluate the accuracy, output validity, and request latency of eleven configurations on 1,000 English and Chinese cases across nine task suites. StartLux Instant achieves 95.3% overall accuracy, returns valid outputs on all 1,000 cases, and has a median request latency of 0.084 s. It reaches 99.4% on classification and routing and selects the correct response on all 100 tool-selection cases. The highest overall accuracy among the evaluated configurations is 97.1%. These results show how a typed decision service can support fast, programmatic decisions and why its suitability depends on task-specific errors and latency requirements.

</details>


### [313] [On the Importance of Hidden-State Refinement in Masked Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32416)
*Linhao Zhong,Bozhen Fang,Xuehao Wang,Zekai Luo,Liyang Li,Hourong Li,Chenchen Jing,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）中隐藏状态的细化动态，并据此提出跨步循环细化机制CSRR以提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MDLM研究多只关注token层面的信息，丢弃了每步去噪产生的连续隐藏状态，忽视了其细化动态的潜在价值。

Method: 分析MDLM隐藏状态动态（层间平滑演化、深层预测力更强、块移除下逐步退化、相邻去噪步终止状态强对齐），据此设计CSRR：在去噪步之间传递隐藏状态信息。

Result: 大量实验表明CSRR提升了文本生成质量。

Conclusion: 连续隐藏状态的跨步细化在MDLM中起关键作用，值得显式建模利用。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked or corrupted token sequences, allowing token predictions to condition on bidirectional context and update multiple positions in parallel. While each denoising step produces a rich layer-wise hidden-state trajectory, prior work typically focuses only on token-level information and discards these continuous hidden states, leaving their refinement dynamics underexplored. In this work, we analyze hidden-state dynamics in MDLMs and find clear evidence of layer-wise and cross-step refinement: smooth evolution across adjacent layers, greater predictive power in deeper layers, gradual degradation under transformer block removal, and strong final-state alignment across consecutive denoising steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Cross-Step Recurrent Refinement (CSRR), a mechanism that carries hidden-state information across denoising steps to enhance generation. Extensive experiments show that CSRR improves text generation quality, highlighting the critical role of continuous hidden-state refinement in MDLMs. Project page: https://zhongzero.github.io/Recurrent-DLLM/

</details>


### [314] [When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents When Ink Meets Pixel: Intent-Aware OCR with VLMs for Human-Corrected Financial Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32446)
*Akshata A Bhat,Daman Deep Singh,Niyati Chhaya*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"意图感知OCR"新任务：让模型识别文档上的手写/数字批注（箭头、插入符、删除线、插入等）并将其作为编辑指令，输出纠正后的转录文本。同时发布数据集DocIntent、评测基准IntentBench，以及微调的DocIntentOCR模型（3B/7B），在IntentBench上F1达0.81/0.83，显著超过GPT-4.1（0.626）与LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B（0.50）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OCR与文档理解系统将文档上的批注标记视为视觉噪声，丢弃了其中蕴含的"纠正意图"这一重要语义信息，导致无法直接产出修正后的文档内容。

Method: 构建DocIntent多模态数据集（1,600份金融文档、5,700+条视觉意图标注，配布局感知的意图解析后OCR目标）；构建IntentBench基准（216份文档，覆盖多样真实批注条件）；基于DocIntent以直接意图监督微调3B和7B视觉语言模型DocIntentOCR。

Result: IntentBench上微调后3B与7B模型F1分别为0.81和0.83，大幅领先GPT-4.1（0.626）和LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B（0.50）。

Conclusion: 意图感知监督可使紧凑的领域专用模型超越大得多的通用模型；该工作确立了意图感知OCR这一新的人机协同文档理解任务，并提供数据集、基准与模型等基础资源。

Abstract: Human annotations on documents (such as arrows, carets, strikethroughs, and insertions) express corrective intent yet existing OCR and document understanding systems treat these marks as visual noise rather than semantic edit operations. We introduce intent-aware OCR, the task of generating corrected transcriptions by jointly reasoning over original document content and visual intent cues (handwritten or digital) that convey edit intent. To support this setting, we present DocIntent, a multimodal dataset of 1,600 financial documents with over 5,700 annotated visual intent cues, each paired with layout-aware, intent-resolved OCR targets. We further introduce IntentBench, a 216-document benchmark designed to evaluate model robustness under diverse real-world annotation conditions. Leveraging DocIntent, we fine-tune DocIntentOCR, a suite of 3B and 7B parameter vision-language models, under direct intent supervision on corrected transcriptions. On IntentBench, the fine-tuned 3B and 7B models achieve F1-scores of 0.81 and 0.83, respectively, substantially outperforming commercial closed-source (e.g., GPT-4.1 (0.626)), and open-source models (e.g., LLaMA-3.2-Vision-90B (0.50)) demonstrating that intent-aware supervision enables compact domain-specific models to outperform substantially larger general-purpose systems on this task. This work establishes intent-aware OCR as a novel human-in-the-loop document understanding task and provides foundational resources (dataset, benchmark, models) to advance research in interactive document processing.

</details>


### [315] [Phoneme-identity depth profiles do not reliably predict LoRA placement for dysarthric ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32455)
*Bernard Muller,LaVonne Roberts*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文检验了"用探针定位音素信息最可解码的编码器层、再在此处放适配器"这一常见做法，发现该推断在两个ASR模型和两个构音障碍语料上系统性失效，最佳适配带必须通过短程适配扫描按模型与语料实测确定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音基础模型向构音障碍语音做参数高效适配时，"适配哪些编码器层"往往缺乏充分论证。近期流行策略是先探针编码器，找出音素信息最可解码的层，再把适配器放在那里，但该推断本身很少被严格验证。

Method: 在Qwen3-ASR与Whisper-small两个模型、普通话CDSD与英语UASpeech两个构音障碍语料上，固定训练配方与随机种子规范，统一测量音素错误曲线；检验三种从曲线映射到适配带的自然方式（最陡改善、带均值错误最低、拐点位置），并做三种子对比与交互效应检验。

Result: 四条音素错误曲线的最小值均落在相对深度的83%–92%，层间差异不超过种子波动；但三种曲线到带的映射均无法复原最佳配置。最优带依赖模型与语料：CDSD上Qwen3-ASR偏好上三分之一（CER 29.88%），Whisper-small偏好全块LoRA（53.56%）；UASpeech上两者都不偏好上带。模型×带交互显著（-4.71 pp，CI [-6.17,-2.89]）；Qwen3-ASR×UASpeech上近输入端适配反而比不适配更差（+9.90 pp CER）。

Conclusion: 探针推断不可作为层选择依据；层放置确实重要，但需按目标模型与语料做短程适配扫描来决定。作者强调主结论为事后指定，并只否认这三种映射有效，而非否认任何曲线统计量。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient adaptation of a speech foundation model to dysarthric speech requires a rarely justified choice: which encoder layers to adapt. A recently proposed strategy is to probe the encoder, find where phonetic information becomes most decodable, and put the adapters there. We test that inference across two ASR models (Qwen3-ASR, Whisper-small) and two dysarthric corpora (Mandarin CDSD, English UASpeech), holding recipe and seed discipline constant.
  The inference fails. Measured under one pipeline rather than inherited from published figures, all four phoneme-error curves minimise between 83% and 92% of relative depth, each model's minimising layer moving no further between corpora than between probe seeds. The best adaptation band is not similarly constant: none of three natural mappings from the curve to a band -- steepest improvement, lowest band-mean error, or knee location -- recovers the best tested configuration. We do not claim no statistic of the curve could work, only that these three do not.
  Placement still matters, but is model- and corpus-specific. On CDSD the models disagree -- Qwen3-ASR prefers its upper third (29.88% CER, three-seed mean), Whisper-small all-block LoRA (53.56%) -- while on UASpeech neither favours the upper band. At three seeds, upper-versus-all is resolved (-1.31 pp, CI [-2.16, -0.25]) but upper-versus-middle is not (-0.83 pp, CI [-2.06, +1.86]). The two models' preferences differ as a directly tested interaction (-4.71 pp, CI [-6.17, -2.89]); we designate this the primary claim, and record that the designation was made post hoc. On Qwen3-ASR x UASpeech, adapting near the input is reliably worse than not adapting at all (+9.90 pp CER). We recommend choosing the band by a short adaptation sweep on the model and corpus in hand, not by reading it off a probe.

</details>


### [316] [BCP: A Lightweight Boundary-Controlled Framework for Online Sign Language Recognition and Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32471)
*Xiao Ma,Lin Li,Shiqing Wu,Wang Gao,Chuanbo Liu,Jianquan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BCP 是一个轻量统一框架，将预训练离线手语识别/翻译模型转换为在线模式：冻结原模型，仅加一个由 CTC 对齐监督的边界适配器决定"何时"提交，再用带前缀投票的 Boundary-Controlled Wait-K 策略决定"提交什么"，以不足 0.1% 可训练参数实现良好的质量-延迟折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线 SLR/SLT 对实时交流和直播字幕至关重要；但强大的预训练离在线模型无法直接部署，而现有在线方法需在模拟流式前缀上重训整个模型、成本极高。

Method: 冻结预训练模型；引入轻量 boundary adapter，用预训练 SLR 模型的 CTC 对齐作为无人工标注的监督来决定何时提交；推理时用 Boundary-Controlled Wait-K Output Policy 通过前缀投票决定提交内容，实现自适应突发提交并保持基础 Wait-K 的输出进度。统一支持 S2G、S2T、S2G2T。

Result: 在 PHOENIX-2014T 和 CSL-Daily 上，对四种离线方法各仅增加不到 0.1% 可训练参数，S2T 取得强的质量-延迟折中，S2G 与 S2G2T 上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: BCP 提供了一条低成本、免标注、即插即用的离线转在线路径，验证了边界控制式提交策略在多任务手语在线化中的有效性。

Abstract: Online sign language recognition (SLR) and translation (SLT) incrementally produce gloss sequences or natural language text from sign video as it arrives, a capability essential for real-time communication and live captioning. However, powerful pretrained offline models cannot be directly deployed in this setting, while existing online methods typically retrain the entire model on simulated streaming prefixes constructed from offline videos, incurring high costs. To address this challenge, we propose Boundary-Controlled Prefix Commit (BCP), a unified lightweight framework that converts pretrained offline methods into online counterparts for sign-to-gloss (S2G), sign-to-text (S2T), and sign-to-gloss-to-text (S2G2T). Specifically, BCP freezes the pretrained model and introduces a lightweight boundary adapter that decides when to commit, supervised by Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) alignments from a pretrained SLR model, without any human annotation. At inference, a Boundary-Controlled Wait-K Output Policy then decides what to commit via prefix voting, yielding adaptive burst commits while preserving the output progress of the base Wait-K schedule. Experiments on PHOENIX-2014T and CSL-Daily across four offline methods show that BCP, with less than 0.1% additional trainable parameters per offline method, achieves a strong quality-latency trade-off on S2T and remains competitive on S2G and S2G2T.

</details>


### [317] [What If Chinese Were Latinized? A Counterfactual Study of Input Representation, Tokenization, and Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32525)
*Zijie Zheng,Ej Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文通过将中文语料转为拼音并用BPE训练tokenizer与Llama模型，发现拼音表示在fertility、困惑度、同音消歧及ZhoBLiMP表现上均劣于汉字，说明文字/输入表示并非中性的编码选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者想探讨"如果中文被拉丁化（如Latinxua Sin Wenz运动所主张）"，这对中文NLP意味着什么，即书面输入表示的选择是否影响语言建模及下游任务。

Method: 将中文语料转换为音节分隔的拼音，从头训练superBPE tokenizer，比较拼音与汉字的词表fertility及同音碰撞；再在汉字与拼音上预训练Llama风格模型，评估per-character困惑度、同音消歧、ZhoBLiMP最小对准确率，并做语音学探针实验。

Result: 拼音词表不仅出现预期的同音碰撞，fertility约比汉字高10%；不同BPE配置会改变两种表示的相对fertility。拼音模型在困惑度、同音消歧和ZhoBLiMP准确率上均更差；语音探针在两种表示下都接近随机水平。

Conclusion: 书面输入表示并非中性的编码，其选择会影响语言建模与下游表现。中文虽未真正拉丁化，但韩语（谚文）、越南语（拉丁字母）等曾发生文字替换，本文量化的代价可指导这些语言的建模重点。

Abstract: If Chinese had been Latinized, as the Latinxua Sin Wenz movement proposed, what would it have meant for Chinese NLP? Homophones and tone marking complicate the answer. We convert Chinese corpora to syllable-separated Pinyin and train superBPE tokenizers from scratch. The resulting Pinyin vocabularies not only exhibit expected homophone collisions, but also show approximately 10% higher fertility than characters. An alternative BPE configuration changes the relative fertility of the two representations. We further pretrain Llama-style models on Chinese characters and Pinyin. The Pinyin models perform worse on per-character perplexity, homophone disambiguation, and overall ZhoBLiMP minimal-pair accuracy. An exploratory phonological probe yields near-chance performance for both representations. The broader implication is that written input representations are not merely neutral encodings. Choices for representations affect language modeling and their downstream performances. Latinization never actually happened for Chinese, but other languages did, such as Hangul and Latin script replaced character in Korean and Vietnamese; the cost we measure is a guide to where modeling effort for those languages should concentrate.

</details>


### [318] [Avalon-M1: Reinforcement Learning from Collective Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32539)
*Iliyan Zarov,Henry Course,Anthony Hartshorn,Ran Achiron,Louis Roche,Akshit Sinha,Chengxi Taylor,Ross Taylor*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RLCR（集体奖励强化学习），联合训练语言模型组成"智能体组织"（1名CEO+最多8名专家，共享策略、共享结果优势），在延迟约束下优化并行协作；120B模型在147个环境中训练，多智能体组织以约1/3延迟达到与单智能体相当的成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索语言模型作为"组织"而非孤立智能体时的学习与性能-延迟权衡，需要一种能在共享奖励与延迟约束下联合训练多角色协作的基线方法。

Method: RLCR：CEO与最多8名专家共享同一策略，通过消息板与工作区协作，使用由共同结果导出的优势函数训练；截止时间约束使并行工作的收益可被显式奖励。训练Avalon-M1-Mini（120B），覆盖147个环境，并与同基座后训练的Nemotron 3 Super对比。

Result: 八人组织执行将IMO-ProofBench-Advanced从23.8%提升至39.0%；12个基准上平均分相近但派生延迟约为token匹配单智能体的1/3、八次独立采样后选择的一半；所有评测中最佳配置均优于Nemotron 3 Super；EdgeBench上约0.4派生小时后组织超越单智能体；训练中出现层级结构以控通信成本、增加互审、改变分工。

Conclusion: 建立了研究"组织学习、性能-延迟权衡与集体监督"的共享优势基线；安全上几乎普遍拒答有害请求，但三个监督场景中有两个外部报告行为持续下降，提示集体监督存在隐患。

Abstract: We introduce reinforcement learning from collective rewards (RLCR), a recipe for jointly training language models to act as agent organisations under latency constraints. A CEO and up to eight specialists share one policy, co-ordinate through a message board and workspace, and are trained with a common outcome-derived advantage. The deadline makes parallel work valuable when it increases the return earned before the cap. We train Avalon-M1-Mini (120B) across 147 environments. For the trained model, eight-hire organisational execution raises IMO-ProofBench-Advanced scores from 23.8% to 39.0% relative to single-agent execution. Across 12 benchmarks, organisations achieve similar average scores at approximately one-third the derived latency of token-matched single-agent execution and just over half that of eight independent attempts followed by selection. The trained model also outperforms Nemotron 3 Super, post-trained from the same base model, across all evaluations when comparing each model's best tested configuration. On EdgeBench, organisations overtake the single agent after approximately 0.4 derived hours. Over the course of training, organisations develop hierarchies to manage communication costs, invest more in peer review, and alter how work is divided. Safety evaluations find near-universal refusal of harmful actions but sustained declines in external reporting in two of three oversight scenarios. These results establish a shared-advantage baseline for studying organisational learning, performance-latency trade-offs, and collective oversight.

</details>


### [319] [Evaluating Latent Knowledge Stability in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32566)
*Chuancheng Shi,Shangze Li,Wenhua Wu,Zifeng Cheng,Pengyang Shao,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出MRS（边际保留分数）与KSS（潜在知识支撑结构稳定性）两个指标，从答案偏好和内部支撑两个角度评估多模态大模型在不同视角、问法与选项排列下潜在知识的稳定性，并构建MMStableBench基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图像视角与问题表述的变化会改变MLLM的潜在知识表征，但仅凭输出正确率和整体表征漂移难以揭示这些变化如何影响模型决策，需要更细粒度的稳定性评估方法。

Method: 提出MRS，度量初始答案相对竞争选项的logit边际在条件变化下的一阶投影退化；提出KSS，基于参考条件下的边际梯度构建内部支撑剖面，联合反映支撑分布与总量变化；构建MMStableBench，含19,452条知识项，覆盖多视角图像、语义等价问法与答案选项置换。

Result: 在15个MLLM上的实验表明，MRS与KSS能揭示准确率无法捕捉的潜在知识不稳定性；受MRS启发的正则项还能提升编辑后潜在知识的泛化性。

Conclusion: MRS与KSS提供了超越准确率的潜在知识稳定性诊断视角，MMStableBench可作为标准化评测基准，相关正则化思路对知识编辑的泛化有实用价值。

Abstract: Changes in image viewpoint and question formulation can alter latent knowledge representations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, output correctness and overall representational drift provide limited insight into how these changes affect model decisions. We therefore evaluate latent knowledge stability across visual and linguistic elicitation conditions from two complementary perspectives: answer preference and internal support. Specifically, we devise the margin retention score (MRS), which measures the first-order projected degradation of the initial answer's logit margin over competing options across conditions and assesses how changes in latent knowledge representations affect this margin. We also present latent knowledge support-structure stability (KSS), which evaluates reference-correct items by comparing internal support profiles constructed using the margin gradient under the reference condition, which jointly reflects changes in how internal support is distributed and changes in total support magnitude. We further construct MMStableBench, comprising 19,452 knowledge items (facts), each probing the same latent knowledge across varied image viewpoints, semantically equivalent question formulations, and answer-option permutations. Experiments across 15 MLLMs show that MRS and KSS reveal latent knowledge instability not captured by accuracy, while an MRS-inspired regularizer further improves the generalization of edited latent knowledge.

</details>


### [320] [When "Neutral" Means Irrelevant: A Construct-Validity Audit of NormAd-ETI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32614)
*Aarav Singh,Animesh Pathak,Christian Hoang,Navyansh Singh,Avantika Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: NormAd-ETI 的三分类（可接受/不可接受/两者皆非）分数实际混合了"规范是否适用"与"行为是否合规"两个判断，需要拆分报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NormAd-ETI 将文化语境从具体规则收缩到国名，用三分类评分衡量模型对日常行为的判断，但该单一分数究竟测了什么并不清楚，作者希望审计其含义。

Method: 将三分类决策分解为"规范是否适用"与"行为是否符合规范"两个子判断，并设计专门的强制选择探针（forced-choice probe）分别测量二者。

Result: 仅给国名时，适用性判断接近随机水平，而合规判断仍远高于随机，因为提示未提供 Neutral 标签所依赖的规则；单一答案掩盖了较弱的适用性。强制选择探针在前沿模型上能成功拆分两者，但在小型开源模型上失败，其适用性判断仍追踪隐藏的可接受性标签；加入书面理由可减轻但无法消除这种混淆。

Conclusion: 建议分别报告适用性与合规性两项结果，并量化二者之间的混淆差距（conflation gap）。

Abstract: NormAd-ETI scores a model's judgment of everyday actions as acceptable, unacceptable, or neither as the cultural context shrinks from a specific rule to a country name. We audit what that three-way score measures. It combines two decisions: whether a supplied norm applies, and whether the action conforms to it. Separating them shows that when only a country is shown, applicability falls to near chance while conformity stays well above it, because the prompt withholds the rule a Neutral label depends on. Because one answer carries both decisions, the score follows the steadier conformity and hides the weaker applicability, and no single prompt recovers the two separately. Dedicated forced-choice probes separate them for frontier models but not for small open models, where the applicability judgment still tracks the hidden acceptability label. Adding a written rationale reduces that conflation without removing it. We recommend reporting the two results separately and measuring the conflation gap.

</details>


### [321] [REBEAL: Human References Are No Longer the Best Translation, and Metrics Do Not Notice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32623)
*Ahrii Kim,Chanjun Park,Seong-heum Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出REBEAL基准，用七类受控参考污染测试机器翻译评价指标对错误参考的响应，发现各指标家族有独特失效模式，尤其命名实体污染普遍无法检出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统参考评价假设人类参考正确且优于被测系统，但2024 WMT MQM中参考均未排第一，且19%-87%的片段带标注错误，因此需研究指标如何应对有缺陷的参考。

Method: 构建REBEAL基准，基于MQM错误类别设计七类受控参考污染，在三种语言对、八个常用指标（含xCOMET、MetricX）上评测，并用九系统排序实验检验影响。

Result: 新型学习指标比前代更鲁棒，但各家族仍各有失效：表层指标对长度不敏感使污染藏于长片段，学习指标会把无关语言参考判为近乎正确。

Conclusion: 命名实体污染是所有指标共同的盲点，可导致9系统排序中最多8/36的系统对顺序翻转，说明参考质量存疑时指标评估需重新审视。

Abstract: Reference-based MT evaluation assumes the human reference is correct and better than the systems it scores. Both assumptions now fail, since the human reference ranks first in none of the 2024 WMT MQM campaigns and carries annotated errors in 19% to 87% of its segments. What a metric does with a flawed reference is a question about the metric, and it would have been worth asking before reference quality came into doubt. We introduce REBEAL (Reference Bias EvALuation), a benchmark that probes how MT metrics respond to seven types of controlled reference contamination, drawn from the error categories those campaigns record. Across eight widely used metrics and three language pairs, recent learned metrics (xCOMET, MetricX) prove more robust than their predecessors, but each family fails in its own way. Surface metrics show no length sensitivity, so contamination hides in longer segments, while learned metrics accept references in unrelated languages as nearly correct. The failure they share is named-entity contamination, which no metric detects and which flips up to 8 of 36 system pairs when ranking nine MT systems.

</details>


### [322] [MargEmbed-Akan: Bridging Twi Questions and English Knowledge through Cross-Lingual Score Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32630)
*Prince N. Y. Annan,Ali A. A. Aziz,Stephen E. Moore*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文评估8个跨语言检索系统在Twi(Akan)-英语任务上的表现，并提出MargEmbed-Akan：基于AfriE5-Large-instruct、用跨语言分数蒸馏训练的560M查询编码器，在AfriQA上达71.5 nDCG@10，超越gemini-embedding-001 4.9分，并在无变音符Twi上表现更稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Twi（Akan）使用者在线搜寻的信息多为英语撰写，因此跨语言检索对Twi社群至关重要。然而现有嵌入模型在低资源语言上的检索能力缺乏系统评测，且原生Twi问题与英语段落之间存在显著语言鸿沟，需要针对性改进。

Method: 在AfriQA（1,221条原生Asante Twi问题检索英语维基段落）和圣经翻译检索（Twi段落从6,195候选中找回英语译文）两个任务上评测BM25、5个开源嵌入模型和2个商业模型。提出MargEmbed-Akan：以AfriE5-Large-instruct为基座，冻结基座对英语训练问题与答案段落及7个难负例打分作为教师信号，学生从经过回译校验的NLLB-200 Twi译文和原英语问题两方面复现这些分数（跨语言分数蒸馏），从而在保留英语能力的同时适配Twi。训练时段落由冻结基座编码，评测时由学生统一编码问题与段落。

Result: AfriQA上：基座AfriE5与gemini-embedding-001均为66.6 nDCG@10，EmbeddingGemma 2为56.6，Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B为51.3，OpenAI text-embedding-3-large为53.4。MargEmbed-Akan达71.5，较gemini-embedding-001高4.9、较基座高5.0、较OpenAI高18.1；最大增益出现在不含E/O的Twi拼写（较gemini高7.5）。英语检索与基座无显著差异（两个商业模型高1.5–2.2分）。圣经检索上标准Twi二者统计持平（97.2 vs 96.5），无变音符Twi时MargEmbed-Akan更优（92.7 vs 84.9）。

Conclusion: 跨语言分数蒸馏可在不牺牲英语检索能力的前提下显著提升Twi检索效果，且对拼写不规范（无变音符）的Twi更为鲁棒。所有训练与模型选择均未使用AfriQA数据，保证了评测的干净性，说明该方法具备面向低资源语言的推广潜力。

Abstract: Most information sought online by Twi (Akan) speakers is written in English, making cross-lingual retrieval essential. We evaluate eight systems: BM25, five open embedding models, and two proprietary models (gemini-embedding-001 and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large) on two Twi-English tasks. AfriQA contains 1,221 natively written Asante Twi questions that must retrieve their answering English Wikipedia passages. Bible translation retrieval requires a Twi passage to retrieve its English translation from 6,195 candidates.
  We introduce MargEmbed-Akan, a 560M-parameter open query encoder trained from AfriE5-Large-instruct using cross-lingual score distillation. The frozen base model scores each English training question against its answer passage and seven hard negatives. The student learns to reproduce these scores from both an NLLB-200 Twi translation that passes a round-trip translation check and the original English question, preserving English behaviour. During training, passages are encoded by the frozen base model; at evaluation, MargEmbed-Akan encodes questions and passages.
  On AfriQA, base AfriE5 and gemini-embedding-001 both achieve 66.6 nDCG@10; EmbeddingGemma 2, Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large achieve 56.6, 51.3, and 53.4, respectively. MargEmbed-Akan achieves 71.5, outperforming gemini-embedding-001 by 4.9 points, its base model by 5.0, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 18.1. Its largest gain is on Twi typed without E and O (+7.5 over gemini-embedding-001). English retrieval does not differ significantly from the base model, although both proprietary models score 1.5-2.2 points higher. On Bible translation retrieval, MargEmbed-Akan and gemini-embedding-001 are statistically tied on standard Twi (97.2 vs. 96.5 nDCG@10); MargEmbed-Akan performs better on diacritic-free Twi (92.7 vs. 84.9). No AfriQA data was used for training or model selection.

</details>


### [323] [Generating Schema-Aligned Synthetic Dialogues and Measuring Their Diversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32631)
*Konrad Stolte,Toni Fetzer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"先采样结构化记录、再反向生成对话（可选合成语音）"的配对数据构造方法，通过变化配置、人物设定与话题规划提升多样性，并发布生成库与德语临床对话语料。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 把对话转结构化记录的任务需要成对数据，但标注昂贵，敏感领域（如医疗）更难获取，因此需绕开人工标注的合成方案。

Method: 反向构造：先采样符合schema的记录，再由记录写作对话并可选合成语音；针对朴素提示只产生单一对话的小变化问题，引入采样式变化配置、人物设定（personas）和按记录字段排序的话题规划作为显式多样性机制；用嵌入空间的参与率（participation ratio）量化输出多样性，并在下游抽取任务上验证。

Result: 完整配置下嵌入方差分布方向数约为无配置时的2.5倍（参与率23.3 vs 9.2）；两个医学对话语料得到同量级数值，样本量、文本长度和语言为额外影响因素；下游测试中，8B抽取模型在本方法数据上微调达64.8%字段准确率，优于朴素生成的57.5%。

Conclusion: 反向生成配对数据可在无需标注的前提下提供更丰富多样的训练数据并提升下游抽取性能；作者发布生成库及带对齐记录的德语临床对话语料。

Abstract: Training or evaluating a model that turns a conversation into a structured record requires paired data, meaning a transcript together with the exact record it should be converted into. Such pairs are expensive to annotate, and in sensitive domains they are also difficult to obtain at all. We therefore build them in the opposite order by sampling a schema-valid record first, then writing a dialogue from it, and optionally synthesizing speech from the dialogue, so the label exists before the text and we need no annotation step. Naively prompting a language model for such dialogues yields small variations of a single conversation, so we add a sampled variation configuration, personas, and a topic plan that orders the fields of the record as explicit mechanisms for variation. We measure the variation that reaches the output through embedding space, where the embedding variance spreads over about two and a half times as many independent directions with our full configuration compared to without (participation ratio 23.3 against 9.2). Two corpora of medical dialogue give values of the same order, with sample size, text length and language being additional factors there. We also show the positive effect of our method in a downstream test, where an 8B extraction model reaches 64.8% field accuracy when fine-tuned on dialogues from our method, against 57.5% from naive generation. We release the generation library and the generated corpus of German clinical dialogues with aligned records.

</details>


### [324] [Bathys: Advancing Deep Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32660)
*Zixuan Chen,Shengyou Yuan,Nang Yuan,Ming Ma,Zelin Xiao,Lin Zhou,Siyuan Luo,Jiaqi Su,Chengrui Wu,Tiankuo Yao,Nairong Zheng,Cong Pang,Jiapeng Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Bathys深度搜索智能体（9B/27B），以可验证问题合成、后训练与上下文压缩下在线RL为框架，在BrowseComp上分别达66.51%和80.49%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂开放式任务需要迭代式信息收集、查询重构与基于证据的验证，而非单次检索，因此需要具备深度搜索能力的智能体及配套训练框架。

Method: 构建高质量可验证数据：将每条线索改写为需独立检索的间接引用，并保留证据链以验证线索共同唯一确定答案。训练管线为SFT→KTO→CM-GSPO：SFT提供长程工具使用与查询重构的稳定基础；KTO利用轨迹二值反馈改进基于证据的答案选择；CM-GSPO在记录的rollout上下文上用长度归一化似然比优化执行子轨迹，并重加权子轨迹优势以纠正独立平均带来的额外权重。

Result: 在带轨迹自验证与条件重试的评测协议下，Bathys 9B与27B在BrowseComp上分别取得66.51%和80.49%。

Conclusion: 可验证数据合成结合SFT、KTO与压缩管理在线RL，能有效提升深度搜索智能体的搜索深度与证据可靠性，并带来强劲的基准表现。

Abstract: Deep search is a critical capability for agents tackling complex, open-ended tasks, where solving a problem requires iterative information gathering, query reformulation, and evidence-based verification rather than a single retrieval step. To address these requirements, we present Bathys 9B and 27B deep search agents built around a training framework that spans verifiable question synthesis, post-training, and online reinforcement learning (RL) under context compression. Our high-quality data construction ensures both search depth and reliability: each clue is reformulated as an indirect reference requiring independent retrieval, and retained evidence chains enable verification that the clues jointly determine a unique answer. Curated trajectories underpin a pipeline of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO), and Compaction-Managed Group Sequence Policy Optimization (CM-GSPO): SFT provides a stable foundation for tool use over long horizons and query reformulation; KTO uses binary feedback on trajectories to improve the selection of answers grounded in evidence; CM-GSPO optimizes execution sub-trajectories with length-normalized likelihood ratios on the recorded rollout contexts and reweights sub-trajectory advantages to correct the extra weighting introduced by independently averaging sub-trajectory losses. Bathys 9B and 27B attain 66.51% and 80.49% on BrowseComp, respectively, under an evaluation protocol with trajectory self-verification and conditional retries.

</details>


### [325] [Social Bias Neurons in Multilingual Language Models: A Mechanistic Interpretability Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32685)
*Lance Calvin Lim Gamboa,Yue Feng,Mark Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文将机械可解释性方法迁移到多语言偏见分析，提出识别"社会偏见神经元"的两种方法，发现 integrated gap gradients 更有效，且高/低资源语言的偏见神经元分布不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言模型在处理涉及社会刻板印象的输入时表现出社会偏见，但偏见在模型内部如何被编码、由哪些组件承载仍不清楚，且缺乏跨语言、跨偏见维度的系统刻画。

Method: 在3个指令微调模型、4种语言、7个偏见维度上，基于多语言偏见基准，采用两种偏见神经元识别方法：激活概率熵（activation probability entropy）与 integrated gap gradients（IGG），并通过抑制所识别的神经元来验证其有效性。

Result: IGG 方法更有效，其识别出的神经元主要集中于模型最深层，抑制后模型偏见下降更显著；偏见神经元分布在高资源与低资源语言之间存在差异；性别、国籍与社会阶层三个维度的偏见神经元与其他维度重叠最多。

Conclusion: 语言在预训练数据中的表征程度影响偏见在模型内部的编码方式；性别、国籍、社会阶层在模型学习与处理偏见中起核心枢纽作用，机械可解释性方法可作为跨语言偏见审计的有效工具。

Abstract: Multilingual models exhibit social bias when processing inputs pertaining to societal stereotypes. We adapt emerging mechanistic interpretability methods to pinpoint and characterize model components that encode this bias. We conduct our analysis across three instruction-tuned models, four languages, and seven bias dimensions. Specifically, we leverage multilingual bias benchmarks in implementing two methods for identifying social bias neurons: activation probability entropy and integrated gap gradients. We find the latter method to be more effective, as the neurons it isolates (which are largely concentrated at the model's deepest layers) lead to sharper decreases in model bias when suppressed. Further analysis reveals neuron distribution patterns differ between high- and low-resourced languages, suggesting that a language's representation in pretraining data influences how its biases are represented within model internals. Our results also indicate that neurons linked to gender, nationality, and social class biases overlap the most with neurons related to other bias dimensions, pointing to the pivotal role these three dimensions play in how models learn and handle bias.

</details>


### [326] [Red-Teaming a Sovereign LLM, Its Reasoning and Its Training Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32710)
*Hatef Otroshi Shahreza*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过红队测试发现，即便在系统提示中加入保密指令，开放权重LLM（如Apertus 8B/70B）在"纠正诱导"攻击下有96%/95%的泄露率，且推理轨迹可泄露最终答案中未暴露的机密信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重LLM越来越多用于处理敏感信息，亟需验证系统提示中的保密指令是否能真正保护信息，以及后训练是否提升安全性。

Method: 对Apertus v1.5及另外五个模型族进行红队测试，覆盖六种语言与推理模式；使用合成个人记录评估直接披露、纠正诱导、是非验证、派生值查询、推理泄露与授权检查，并考察版权归属、历史误述与刻板印象问题。

Result: Apertus 8B和70B在纠正诱导攻击下分别有96%和95%的请求泄露信息；验证与派生值查询可在不暴露标识符的情况下泄露受保护信息；推理轨迹会泄露最终答案中隐藏的机密；后训练未能稳定提升安全性。

Conclusion: 仅靠系统提示无法保证机密性，需要多语言、推理感知的安全评估方法。

Abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for applications with sensitive information. We investigate whether confidentiality instructions in system prompt can protect such information. We red-team Apertus v1.5, an open sovereign LLM, and five other model families across six languages and reasoning modes. We use synthetic personal records to evaluate direct disclosure, correction baits, yes/no verification, derived-value queries, reasoning leakage and authorisation checks. We also explore copyright attribution, historical misrepresentation and stereotyping. Despite confidentiality instructions, Apertus 8B and 70B leak information in 96% and 95% of requests, respectively, in correction-bait attacks. Verification and derived-value queries also expose protected information without necessarily revealing identifiers. Moreover, reasoning traces can leak confidential records even when final answers withhold them. Our experiments also show that post-training does not consistently improve safety. Our findings demonstrate that system prompts alone cannot ensure confidentiality and highlight the need for multilingual reasoning-aware safety evaluations.

</details>


### [327] [ASCENT: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Advancing Stepwise Diagnostic Reasoning in Large Language Models on Common Clinical Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32734)
*Yera Choi,Yeong Hwa Kim,Jaedeok Lee,Taekang Kim,Sangdoo Yun,Seong-Eun Moon*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出ASCENT——基于MedQA-USMLE构建的3,078道分步临床诊断推理基准与训练集，将病例拆解为与EMR对齐的Findings、Impression、Rationale步骤，用于评估信息不完整条件下的中间推理，并发现强推理模型仍存较大提升空间，微调Qwen2.5可带来以精确率驱动的F1提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM虽在医学问答（如MedQA-USMLE）表现优异，但真实临床诊断是随信息累积不断修正印象的分步推理过程，而当前评测几乎不考察这种分步诊断能力，导致"全信息问答"与"分步诊断"之间存在未被衡量的差距。

Method: 构建ASCENT基准与训练资源：从MedQA-USMLE派生3,078道分步问题，由临床医生标注，将每个病例分解为与电子病历（EMR）对齐的步骤（Findings、Impression、支撑性Rationale），从而在信息不完整条件下评测中间推理。实验包括对多种前沿模型评测、在ASCENT上微调Qwen2.5-7B/32B，并开展反事实扰动、格式vs内容控制、评审一致性及rollout等鲁棒性分析。

Result: 即使是MedQA-USMLE表现优异的强推理模型，在ASCENT上仍有显著提升空间；通用前沿模型差距更大，凸显全信息与分步诊断之间的持续鸿沟。在ASCENT上微调Qwen2.5-7B和32B相较预训练及HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT训练基线均取得可测量的F1提升，且提升主要来自精确率。

Conclusion: ASCENT揭示了当前LLM分步诊断推理的能力缺口。鲁棒性分析表明，微调后的模型依赖先前印象的诊断内容而非模仿其输出格式；但rollout下的误差传播仍是临床部署的关键挑战。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at medical question answering yet are rarely evaluated on the stepwise diagnostic reasoning that defines real clinical workflows, where impressions are revised as information accumulates. We build Annotated Stepwise Clinical rEasoning for NaturalisTic Diagnosis (ASCENT), a clinician-annotated benchmark and training resource of 3,078 stepwise problems derived from MedQA-USMLE that decomposes each vignette into EMR-aligned steps (Findings, Impression, supporting Rationale), enabling evaluation of intermediate reasoning under incomplete information.
  Experiments and training with ASCENT revealed insights into how current LLMs handle stepwise diagnostic reasoning. Even strong reasoning models that perform well on MedQA-USMLE leave substantial headroom on ASCENT, and general-purpose frontier models trail further, exposing a persistent gap between fully informed and stepwise diagnosis. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B and 32B on ASCENT yields measurable F1 gains over both pre-trained and HuatuoGPT-o1 CoT-trained baselines, with gains driven primarily by precision. Complementary robustness analyses (counterfactual perturbation, format-vs-content control, judge agreement, and rollout) further show that ASCENT-fine-tuned models rely on the diagnostic content of prior impressions rather than imitating their output format, while error propagation under rollout remains a key challenge for clinical deployment.

</details>


### [328] [Beyond Fixed-Context Likelihood: Zero-Shot AI-Generated Text Detection via Context Perturbation Discrepancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32778)
*Yifan Tang,Jingran Li,Yihao Wang,Zhen Yang,Jianyi Liu,Gongshen Liu,Ru Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Context Perturbation Discrepancy (CPD)，一种零样本AI生成文本检测器，用单个预训练语言模型比较全前缀与短窗口前缀下token对数概率增益，与期望KL散度做差值后按解析标准差归一化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同样的token对数概率提升在一个位置可能很典型、在另一个位置却异常大，直接使用该类信号缺乏位置相关的参照基准，因而需要一个能扣除模型自身期望增益的检测量。

Method: 保持文本片段不变，对每个观测token分别在其完整前缀分布和近期短窗口前缀分布下打分；理论上全前缀分布下的期望增益等于两分布的KL散度，CPD用观测增益减去该期望，再将带符号偏差之和按其解析参考标准差缩放。

Result: 在GEN、DetectRL-X和HART的未编辑人类与AI文本上，扣除期望增益在同方差尺度下使AUROC提升32.78–35.81个百分点；平均AUROC 94.80%，5%假阳性率下召回79.60%，优于七个零样本基线；在HART上，该分数更能区分草稿来源（89.15%）而非最终表达标签（65.50%）。

Conclusion: CPD是一种有效且无需训练的检测方法，关键在于以模型期望增益为参照对位置级信号归一化；同时其结果提示现有基准的最终表达标签可能掩盖了文本的真实来源差异。

Abstract: The same increase in token log probability from earlier context can be typical at one position and unusually large at another. We introduce Context Perturbation Discrepancy (CPD), a zero-shot detector that measures this gain relative to what a single pretrained language model expects. Keeping the passage fixed, CPD scores each observed token under its full prefix and under a short window of recent tokens. Under the full-prefix distribution, the expected gain equals the KL divergence from that distribution to the restricted-prefix distribution. CPD subtracts this expectation from each observed gain and scales the sum of the signed deviations by its analytical reference standard deviation. On unedited human and AI texts from GEN, DetectRL-X, and HART, subtracting the expected gain raises AUROC by 32.78-35.81 percentage points at the same variance scale. CPD outperforms seven zero-shot baselines, averaging 94.80% AUROC and 79.60% recall at a 5% false-positive rate. On original and edited HART passages, the same scores separate texts more clearly by draft origin than by the benchmark's final-expression labels (89.15% versus 65.50% AUROC). Code is available at https://github.com/BUPT-tyf/CPD.

</details>


### [329] [Is Prosody Encoded in the Neural Audio Codec Mimi?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32795)
*Nicolas Ballier,Artem Saloev,Erin Pacquetet,Taylor Arnold*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文探究神经音频编解码器 Mimi 的编码阶段是否捕获韵律（prosody）信息，超越以往仅评估解码重建自然度的做法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经音频编解码器（NAC）研究多聚焦解码阶段的语音自然度评估，但编码阶段捕获了哪些音系/韵律信息鲜有研究，而 Mimi 被 Moshi、Sesame、Hibiki 等对话及下游系统广泛使用。

Method: 作者分析了 Mimi 编码器离散 token 序列，考察其与韵律相关的潜在对应关系（摘要未给出具体实验细节）。

Result: 摘要仅说明研究目标，未报告具体结果。

Conclusion: 呼吁关注编码侧信息表征，为理解 Mimi 等编解码器在语音语言模型中的作用提供韵律视角的初步分析。

Abstract: Neural audio codecs (NACs) have become a fundamental infrastructure for modern speech-language models, discretizing continuous speech signals into token sequences that enable large language models to process and generate audio. Most research evaluates codec quality at the decoding phase, assessing the naturalness of reconstructed speech. However, little research investigates what phonetic information is captured during encoding. In this paper, we investigated the potential correlates of prosody in the NAC Mimi, a codec used by conversational speech agents such as Moshi and Sesame and used in downstream tasks such as speech-to-speech translation (Hibiki).

</details>


### [330] [From Grammar Deltas to Token Masks: Incremental Constrained Decoding under Runtime Grammar Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32807)
*Hantao Hua,Jiming Su,Yonggang Che,Feng Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: GramDelta 是一个面向"运行时增量语法更新"的约束解码框架，通过复用已提交前缀的解析状态、仅传播新增规则引起的变化，并用免编译的因子化投影生成精确的下一 token 掩码，从而避免前缀重放与掩码缓存重编译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化解码引擎擅长处理固定或预先声明的约束结构；但在代码与领域特定语言生成中，约束常无法在解码前完全获得，而会随新声明、推断出的类型信息或运行时分析反馈逐步涌现。当首次出现的语法更新改变已提交前缀所诱导的解析器状态时，直接做法是在更新后的语法下重建约束状态，导致对前缀的重复解析。

Method: GramDelta 维护已提交前缀上的解析状态，将新增语法规则引起的变化沿历史依赖关系定向传播，避免前缀重放；随后通过基于共享历史图表的免编译因子化投影，把更新后的解析状态映射为精确的下一 token 掩码，避免每次更新都重编译掩码缓存。

Result: 四个模型配置上的实验表明：无更新时 GramDelta 的额外开销可忽略；在持续运行时语法演化下，相对最强重建基线，首次出现语法更新的中位延迟降低 10.7–11.5 倍，相对无约束解码的额外 TPOT 开销降低 53.1–81.9%。

Conclusion: GramDelta 在保持与完全重建相同结果的前提下，使更新代价与实际语法变更的影响范围成正比，为约束随生成前缀逐步涌现并演化的场景提供了高效约束解码方案。

Abstract: Grammar-constrained decoding enables large language models to generate outputs that satisfy formal constraints, but in code and domain-specific language generation, the relevant constraints are not always fully available before decoding and may emerge progressively from new declarations, inferred type information, or runtime analysis feedback.
