Existing structured-decoding engines efficiently handle fixed, predeclared, or previously seen constraint structures; however, when a first-seen grammar update changes the parser state induced by an already committed prefix, the straightforward solution reconstructs the constraint state under the updated grammar, repeating parsing work already performed over the prefix. We introduce GramDelta, an incremental framework for constrained decoding with append-only runtime grammar updates. GramDelta maintains parse state over the committed prefix and propagates only changes induced by newly added grammar rules through historical dependencies, avoiding prefix replay. It then maps the updated parse state to exact next-token masks via compilation-free factorized projection over shared historical charts, avoiding per-update mask-cache recompilation. GramDelta therefore preserves the result of full reconstruction while making update cost sensitive to the actual impact of a grammar change. Experiments across four model configurations show that GramDelta adds negligible overhead without updates; under sustained runtime grammar evolution, it reduces median first-seen grammar-update latency by 10.7--11.5x and reduces the additional TPOT overhead over unconstrained decoding by 53.1--81.9% relative to the strongest reconstruction baseline. These results enable efficient constrained decoding when constraints progressively emerge and evolve with the generated prefix.

</details>


### [331] [Joint Detection of Constructive Speech, Hate Speech and Agreement in Online Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32889)
*Ida Dencker,Simon Karg,Kenneth Enevoldsen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文构建了英语和丹麦语社交媒体评论数据集，标注仇恨语气、建设性语气及对父评论的赞同，并用多语言LLM进行三分类检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络仇恨言论影响个人与群体，导致用户退出在线讨论；部分平台减少审核力度，因此"建设性言论"成为对抗仇恨的替代策略。自动检测建设性与仇恨言论有助于监测其流行度与动态。

Method: 收集并标注大规模英/丹麦语社交媒体评论，标注仇恨语气、建设性语气、对父评论的赞同三个维度；微调多个多语言LLM，并对比结合上下文与不结合上下文的模型架构。

Result: E5-large表现最佳：上下文增强架构平均F1为82%，非上下文增强架构平均F1为81.6%。

Conclusion: 多语言LLM在跨语言可扩展地检测仇恨与建设性言论方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Online hate speech is an ever-growing issue with negative impacts on both groups and individuals, potentially causing users to withdraw from online conversations and debate. With some prominent social media platforms reducing their moderation efforts, constructive speech has emerged as an alternative strategy for countering hate. Automated detection of constructive and hateful speech can aid monitoring and improve understanding of their prevalence and online dynamics. In this work, we collect and annotate a large dataset of English and Danish social media comments for hateful tone, constructive tone, and agreement with parent comments. We fine-tune several multilingual LLMs to classify along these three dimensions and compare context-enriched and non-context-enriched model architectures. The E5-large LLM performs best on both the context-enriched (82% average F1) and non-context-enriched (81.6% average F1) classification tasks, demonstrating the potential of multilingual LLMs for scalable detection of hateful and constructive speech across languages.

</details>


### [332] [Modelling Billingual Learning Through LLM Training: A Critical-Period Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32997)
*Uriel Benymon,Tristan Whipps,Armita Ghobadi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 用小型两层GPT-2依次学习英语后学习德语或芬兰语，从内部表征层面考察关键期效应：transformer层英语相似度保持高位，嵌入层转为负值，EWC虽减少参数漂移但对表征影响极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关键期假说认为二语学习能力取决于已习得的一语知识是否容易被修改，但以往研究多关注行为表现，本文转向考察模型内部表征。

Method: 训练小型两层GPT-2：先学英语，再以序列训练或弹性权重巩固（EWC，限制对英语重要参数的改变）学习较近的德语或较远的芬兰语。分别在学习1个和2个二语epoch后，对每种语言20个留出探测句的均值池化隐状态，在嵌入层和两个transformer层与纯英语模型做余弦相似度比较。

Result: transformer层中英语相似度保持较高，嵌入层变为负值；transformer层中二语相似度上升，且德语与芬兰语的差异在第二层比第一层更大。EWC使Fisher加权参数漂移减少约6%，但transformer层相似度变化小于0.001。

Conclusion: 表征层面观察到的关键期效应与行为层面不同，参数保护（EWC）几乎不改变内部表征；但每种条件仅一次训练，结果属初步发现。

Abstract: Critical-period accounts of second-language (L2) acquisition suggest that the ability to learn a new language may depend on how easily previously acquired first-language (L1) knowledge can be modified. This exploratory computational study extends a neural language-model approach to critical period effects by examining internal representations rather than behavior. A small two-layer GPT-2 model was trained on English and then on German (a relatively related L2) or Finnish (a relatively distant L2) through either Sequential training or Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), which limits change in parameters important for English. Mean-pooled hidden states for 20 held-out probe sentences per language were compared with those of the English-only model using cosine similarity at the embedding layer and two transformer layers after one and two L2 epochs. English similarity remained high in the transformer layers but became negative in the embedding layer. L2 similarity increased in the transformer layers, and German and Finnish differed more in the second transformer layer than in the first. EWC reduced Fisher-weighted parameter drift by about 6% but changed transformer-layer similarity by less than .001. With one training run per condition, these findings are preliminary.

</details>


### [333] [Leto: Utility-Centric Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33005)
*Shuguang Chen,Salman Paracha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出记忆系统LETo，将LLM智能体的外部记忆视为预测问题，聚焦记忆对未来的效用而非对过去的忠实度，通过记忆索引、记忆重放和效用循环实现面向未来请求的记忆服务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统把记忆当作对过去的记录，并按与对话的忠实度来评估；但记忆的价值在于能否改进智能体的响应。由于记忆系统在响应产生前就决定记什么、供什么，忠实度检查无法评估这些决定，因此忠实记忆未必能提升响应。

Method: 将记忆建模为预测问题：用记忆索引保留对对话细节的访问（信息可经来源获取）；请求到来时通过记忆重放从索引中预测并补充请求未明说的所需上下文；由于所供上下文的效用要等响应生成后才能确定，引入效用循环，用响应结果反过来优化未来的记忆选择。

Result: 在3个场景、5个基准上与6个记忆系统对比：个性化场景下PrefEval准确率超最强基线16.3个百分点，PERMA任务完成率高3.1个百分点；长程任务在MemoryArena五个环境上平均取得最佳，且增益随链深增加；长上下文理解与原始历史检索相当但所用上下文token更少。

Conclusion: 以效用而非忠实度为核心的记忆视角能更有效提升LLM智能体的响应质量，在个性化、长程任务与长上下文理解场景中均取得优势，并体现出更优的上下文效率。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on external memory to retain and reuse information across interactions. Existing memory systems treat memory as a record of the past and evaluate it by fidelity to the conversation. However, the value of memory lies in whether it improves the agent's response. A memory system decides what to memorize and what to serve before that response exists, and fidelity checks neither decision against it. Faithful memory can therefore fail to improve the response. We instead view memory as a prediction problem and present \textbf{\emph{\leto{}}}, a memory system for LLM agents that focuses on the utility of memory to the future rather than on its fidelity to the past. Because future requests are unknown, \emph{\leto{}} preserves access to conversation details through memory indexing, allowing information to remain available through its sources. When a request arrives, memory replay draws on this index to anticipate and supply the context the agent needs beyond what the request explicitly states. The utility of the served context remains uncertain until the response is generated, motivating a utility loop that uses response outcomes to refine future memory selection. We evaluate our system against six memory systems on five benchmarks across three scenarios. In personalization, it outperforms the strongest compared memory system by 16.3 percentage points in accuracy on PrefEval and by 3.1 points in task completion on PERMA. For long-horizon tasks, it achieves the best overall performance on MemoryArena averaged over five environments with a gain that increases with the chain depth. In long-context understanding, it is on par with retrieval over the raw history while serving fewer context tokens.

</details>


### [334] [SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33030)
*Shivank Rajput,Himanshu Singh,A. V. Subramanyam*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SALSA 从优化得到的越狱攻击语料中学习"越狱后缀分布"，训练后可用采样方式高效生成对抗后缀，在开源与黑盒（含 GPT-4o）目标上取得高攻击成功率且生成速度大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化（GCG 类）的越狱攻击虽有效，但推理阶段计算开销大、迁移性差，难以用于规模化漏洞发现。

Method: 构建生成式框架：先由优化方法生成攻击后缀语料，再训练一个生成模型学习该后缀的概率分布；训练完成后通过采样生成新后缀进行攻击，并给出"采样分布接近优化输出分布时可保持高成功率"的直觉性解释。

Result: 开源目标上 ASR 与最优优化基线相当，单提示生成时间从 3.46s 降至 0.04s；黑盒迁移中 GPT-3.5-Turbo 上 ASR 达 99%，GPT-4o 上达 45%，在相同采样预算下超过最强基线两倍以上。

Conclusion: 学习对抗后缀分布为持续、规模化且实用的 LLM 漏洞发现提供了有效基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.

</details>


### [335] [Worth the Wait? How Response Time and Streaming Shape Judgments of Generative AI Answers and Chatbot Engagement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33050)
*Zihan Chen,Di Zhu,Lei Nico Zheng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在法国政府chatbot竞技场compar:IA的盲测中，将同一模型同一提示的答案以缓存一次性回放呈现而非流式逐字生成，胜率下降25.8个百分点（57%→29%）；拥堵带来的延迟对盲投票无净收益，但会降低用户追问意愿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI答案的交付方式（推理模型延迟、缓存秒回、流式输出）差异巨大，而盲投票排行榜被当作对文本质量的判断。业界预期更快答案更受欢迎，但"劳动错觉"与屏幕文本呈现研究表明：逐步展开的答案可能比瞬间呈现的同一答案获得更高评价。论文要检验这两种对立解释。

Method: 利用三处自然使用中的变异：（1）compar:IA随机抽签决定用新生成流式答案还是同模型同提示的缓存回放答案，做同一提示内的对比；（2）服务商拥堵导致的流式答案变慢，分析324,029段对话中的投票与追问行为；（3）WildChat中4,378,514条真实ChatGPT回复，检验拥堵减速对用户是否继续的影响。

Result: 同一提示下，回放使答案赢得决定性盲投票的概率降低25.8个百分点；同一段文本流式时胜率57%，回放时仅29%，且回放被评价为更不完整、更肤浅、更常出错。在324,029段对话中，更慢的答案未获得可检测的投票净加分，但更慢的首轮交互降低用户追问概率；WildChat的437万条回复中，拥堵导致的变慢同样降低用户继续使用的意愿。

Conclusion: 交付方式确实影响盲投票，且方向与竞技场设计者预期相反；而等待的代价体现在追问等行为上，两两比较在双方都慢时无法捕捉。结果对AI服务如何缓存与流式输出答案、如何分配延迟预算、以及偏好排行榜如何评估模型均有启示。

Abstract: Answers from generative AI chatbots built on large language models (LLMs) now arrive at very different speeds: reasoning models deliberate before replying, while response caches can return a stored answer at once. Blind preference votes, which rank these models, are read as judgments of their text, and if delivery matters, faster answers are expected to gain. Research on the labor illusion and on how text appears on screen suggests instead that an answer which unfolds as it is written is credited over the same answer shown at once. We test these accounts with three sources of variation in natural use. First, compar:IA, a French government chatbot arena, answered repeated prompts, by a random draw, either with a fresh answer streamed as it was written or with a stored earlier answer from the same model, shown at once. Within the same prompt, a replay lowered an answer's chance of winning a decisive blind vote by 25.8 percentage points. The same stored text won 57% of its decisive votes when streamed and 29% when replayed, and voters called it less complete, more superficial and more often incorrect when replayed. Second, provider congestion slowed streamed answers. In 324,029 conversations, slower answers earned no detectable net credit in the vote, but a slower first exchange made visitors less likely to ask a follow-up question. Third, in 4,378,514 WildChat replies from everyday ChatGPT use, replies slowed by congestion made users less likely to continue. Delivery moved blind votes, in the direction opposite to the one the arena's designers expected, while waiting cost follow-up questions that a comparison between two answers cannot register when both are slow. The results bear on how AI services cache and stream answers, how they budget latency, and how preference leaderboards evaluate models.

</details>


### [336] [FOL-Proof: Verifying LLM Text-to-Logic Translations via Deterministic Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33078)
*Yisrael Clark,Guy Katz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FOL-Proof是一个"语义防火墙"流水线，用独立语言学分析工具生成候选FOL译文，再用SMT求解器检验LLM生成公式的逻辑等价性，实现高精度选择性接受/拒绝/修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM将自然语言翻译为一阶逻辑以增强推理，但可能产生语义不忠实的公式，污染下游推理。需要一种验证LLM生成FOL翻译是否忠实的方法。

Method: 用ERG和最小递归语义学等语义分析工具确定性生成候选译文池，对每个解读用SMT求解器检验其与LLM生成公式的逻辑等价性；忠实则接受，否则拒绝或通过反复调用LLM修复；设计保守，面对不完整搜索、不支持结构或不确定结果时选择弃权而非误拒。

Result: 在ProofWriter、RuleTaker、PrOntoQA及新对抗基准LongFaithCheck上评估，FOL-Proof达到近乎完美的选择性准确率，显著优于直接LLM评判和往返（round-trip）基线。

Conclusion: 结合符号语义分析与SMT等价检验可有效验证LLM的FOL翻译，避免误拒、保证下游推理可靠性。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to translate natural-language statements into first-order logic (FOL) to improve reasoning. However, LLMs are prone to errors, and so a semantically unfaithful FOL formula could corrupt downstream reasoning. We present FOL-Proof, a semantic firewall pipeline that validates LLM-generated FOL translations against independently derived linguistic interpretations. FOL-Proof operates by deterministically obtaining a pool of candidate translations via semantic analysis tools, such as the English Resource Grammar and Minimal Recursion Semantics; then applying an SMT solver to check each derived reading for logical equivalence to the LLM-generated formula. If the translation is faithful it is accepted; otherwise, it is rejected, or optionally repaired via repeated invocations to the LLM. The procedure is conservative: incomplete search, unsupported constructions, or inconclusive checks yield abstention rather than false rejection. We evaluated FOL-Proof on established benchmarks (ProofWriter, RuleTaker and PrOntoQA), and also on a new adversarial benchmark (LongFaithCheck). Our experiments show that FOL-Proof attains near perfect selective accuracy, while direct LLM judges and round-trip baselines show substantially worse performance.

</details>


### [337] [AIChipBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Automated AI Accelerator Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33093)
*Guangyuan Wang,Chengran Li,Minchen Luo,Jichen Feng,Mengdi Wang,Yifan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AIChipBench 让编码智能体把多个量化 LLM 解码器写成可综合 RTL，并要求逐步对齐存储状态；结果显示"状态感知"的调试反馈大幅提升接受率，而仅靠输出测试通过的设计仍有大量在更长序列上失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件解码器在步骤间携带状态，一次错误的状态更新可能当下 token 正确、却在若干步后才出错，因此通过输出测试并不等于设计正确。作者想探究 LLM 编码智能体要做好这类硬件需要什么。

Method: 构建 AIChipBench：智能体针对可执行的整数参考实现（规定每步输出与存储状态）用可综合 RTL 实现 Qwen3.5、Gemma 3、Gemma 4、Llama 3.2 量化解码器；在固定预算下用公开测试调试，冻结设计后在留出 token 序列、复位、内存停顿与综合上评分；另设加速赛道，要求近固定面积下提升正确设计速度。并做了指向首个状态失配的反馈 vs 仅输出反馈的配对实验。

Result: 四个智能体共 9,136 次尝试；指向首个状态失配的反馈在全部 12 个（智能体×任务）单元中把接受率提高 25.0–46.9 个百分点，并使每个被接受设计所需智能体工时减半；69 个被接受设计中有 45 个在新序列/条件下、于测试所要求的 32 步内失败；超过三分之一加速尝试未能产出正确设计；总体排名 Sol 5.6、Fable 5.1 高于 Astra 6 与 Opus 5.5，且在 200 次随机划分中顺序稳定。

Conclusion: 硬件智能体需要能暴露存储状态的调试反馈，其基准也需要远超开发用例的最终测试；否则会系统性高估设计正确性。

Abstract: A language-model decoder carries state between decoding steps, and in hardware a wrong state update can leave the current token correct and corrupt the output several tokens later, so a design can pass output tests and still be wrong. AIChipBench asks what LLM coding agents need to build such hardware correctly. Agents implement quantized Qwen3.5, Gemma 3, Gemma 4, and Llama 3.2 decoders in synthesizable register-transfer-level (RTL) code against an executable integer reference that specifies the outputs and the stored state at every decoding step. They debug against public tests under fixed budgets; their frozen designs are graded on held-out token sequences, resets, memory stalls, and synthesis, and a second track asks them to speed up a correct design at nearly fixed area. Across 9,136 attempts by four coding agents, the difficulty lies in stored state. Feedback that points to the first state mismatch raises acceptance over output-only feedback in all 12 agent--task cells of a matched study, by 25.0 to 46.9 percentage points, and halves the agent-hours per accepted design. Regraded on new sequences and conditions, 45 of 69 accepted designs fail within the 32 steps their tests required. More than a third of attempts to speed up a correct design end without one. An overall score ranks Sol 5.6 and Fable 5.1 above Astra 6 and Opus 5.5, and both halves of the instances give this order in all 200 random splits. Hardware agents therefore need debugging feedback that exposes stored state, and their benchmarks need final tests well beyond the development cases.

</details>


### [338] [CoT-Proxy: Cross-Format Transfer for Distilling Long-Horizon Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33148)
*Dawid J. Kopiczko,Tijmen Blankevoort,Yuki M. Asano*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出仅从教师模型的"动作"轨迹中蒸馏长程智能体策略，无需暴露的思维链。学生以空推理块训练，配合对自身生成回放缓冲的KL约束防止漂移，并发现"跨格式迁移"现象：空推理块学到的策略在推理时开启思考仍有效。进一步引入CoT-proxies（教师推理摘要）提升效果。在AppWorld上Qwen3-4B从7%升至18%（CoT-proxies再升至35%），蒸馏GPT-5.6 Luna（用其可见输出与API返回的推理摘要）可升至48%，SWE-bench Verified从3%升至28%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强教师模型（大多为闭源）的思维链隐藏在API之后不可见，而标准微调需同时模仿思维链与动作，因此需要一种不依赖隐藏思维链的长程智能体蒸馏方法。

Method: 仅用教师的动作轨迹蒸馏长程策略，学生训练时推理块留空；用学生自身生成回放缓冲上的KL损失限制偏离初始模型；引入CoT-proxies（教师推理的简短摘要）置于空推理块之后；方法同样适用于闭源教师，只需其可见输出与API返回的推理摘要。

Result: 蒸馏Qwen3.6-27B动作使Qwen3-4B在AppWorld成功率从7%升至18%，Qwen3-32B从12%升至25%；加入CoT-proxies后Qwen3-4B达35%；蒸馏GPT-5.6 Luna使Qwen3-4B在AppWorld从7%升至48%、SWE-bench Verified从3%升至28%。发现跨格式迁移：空推理块学到的策略在开启思考推理时仍有效。

Conclusion: 无需教师的隐藏思维链即可有效蒸馏长程智能体策略，动作蒸馏本身已能带来提升，CoT-proxies进一步增强；该框架可无缝应用于闭源教师，具有广泛实用性。

Abstract: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [339] [Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31284)
*Marcelo Fernandez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将自主智能体治理从"执行正确性"扩展到"执行准入"，用不可能性结果与不可约性定理论证资源分配是治理的一等结构约束，并提出时间、状态、行为、种群四维正交治理框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往智能体治理被框定为"如何正确执行动作"，但在多智能体系统中，资源受限下"谁有权执行"的分配问题同样根本，且被当作辅助问题而忽视。

Method: 形式化建模竞争性执行下的分配机制，证明一组不可能性结果（含Sybil放大、理想分配属性不相容）；分析分配约束如何跨层传播到执行原子性、状态强制与行为漂移；提出四维正交治理结构，并给出去中心化结论——有限可观测性下的不可约性定理；辅以分析性构造与实证消融实验。

Result: 证明公平性、效率与抗策略操纵之间存在不可避免的权衡；四维治理（时间/状态/行为/种群）在有限可观测性下无法在无损正确性与稳定性的前提下坍缩；消融实验显示移除或近似任一治理层会导致系统性失效模式。

Conclusion: 智能体治理应被重构为结构性问题：不仅关乎动作如何执行，更关乎执行准入如何决定，且这一决定产生不可约的架构要求，分配是防止治理栈被简化的核心约束。

Abstract: Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act.
  In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a set of impossibility results, including Sybil amplification and the incompatibility of desirable allocation properties.
  We then show that these allocation constraints cannot be resolved within a single layer of control. Instead, they propagate across the system, interacting with execution atomicity, state enforcement, and behavioral drift. This leads to a multi-scale governance structure composed of four orthogonal dimensions: temporal (atomicity), state (enforcement), behavioral (drift monitoring), and population (allocation).
  Our main result is an irreducibility theorem: under finite observability, no governance architecture can collapse these dimensions without loss of correctness or stability. Allocation, in particular, acts as a first-class constraint that prevents simplification of the governance stack.
  We validate these results through a series of analytical constructions and empirical ablations, showing that removing or approximating any layer leads to systematic failure modes.
  This work reframes agent governance as a structural problem: not only how actions are executed, but how access to execution is determined, and why these decisions impose irreducible architectural requirements.

</details>


### [340] [MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31301)
*Shaina Raza,Mohamed Hafez,Ahmed Y. Radwan,Khalid Elgazzar,Kathryn Hume*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MOZAIC，一个四分类配对音视频深伪基准，可直接测量检测器对画面/声音的依赖，并揭示现有MLLM在细粒度伪造判别与泛化上的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频深伪基准多只做"真/假"二分类，无法判断检测器依据的是画面、声音还是编码痕迹，因此难以诊断模型的模态依赖与解释能力。

Method: 构建配对基准：每个源片段均发布"真/假视频 × 真/假音频"四种组合，形成4-way标签；伪造类型覆盖内脸替换、整帧视频扩散与声音转换。数据含137,745个片段、15,014对源，设四个任务（T1真伪、T2操纵类型、T3身份验证、T4解释）。评测12个音视频MLLM，训练4个检测器，并用LoRA微调MLLM。

Result: 最佳MLLM在四分类T1仅35.6%，对纯视频伪造识别率远高于纯语音伪造（43.6% vs 7.5%）；训练的检测器T1达98.4%；LoRA微调显著提升解释分数（OmniVinci 4.17→7.40，Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42→6.98）；但留出换脸生成器后最佳检测器T1降至78.3%。

Conclusion: MOZAIC通过配对四分类设计实现了可归因的模态贡献测量，表明当前MLLM判别与解释能力薄弱、检测器跨生成器泛化有限；作者开源数据集、MOZAIC-SMALL子集、代码与提示词。

Abstract: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation. We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA. Overall, the best MLLM reaches only 35.6% on the four-way T1 and catches far more video-only fakes than voice-only fakes (43.6% vs 7.5%). Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoRA fine-tuning raises explanation scores (OmniVinci 4.17 to 7.40, Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42 to 6.98), but the best T1 detector falls to 78.3% when the face-swap generator is held out of training, so generalization and explanation remain open. We release the dataset, the compact MOZAIC-SMALL split, the code and the prompts. https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mozaic/

</details>


### [341] [Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31329)
*Trung Hieu Vuong,Van Thien Nguyen,Nhu Son Nguyen,Thanh Dai Tran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出保守重叠模糊粗糙集(COFRS)模型处理不完备信息系统属性约简：相似度按固定属性总数|A|归一化以全局惩罚缺失值，并用加权粒度一致性定义软依赖度，贪心后向消除求约简。在11个UCI数据集上COFRS平均约简最小(4.1个属性)，但分类精度无显著优势，RBF-SVM下反而最差，其收益在于紧凑性而非预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不完备信息系统中缺失值破坏了粗糙集理论的等价类结构，传统方法难以直接做属性约简；若把缺失值当作通配符匹配，会低估缺失带来的信息损失。

Method: COFRS模型：每个对象由其"存在属性集合"描述；两对象相似度取二者共有属性上的加权重叠，并除以固定属性数|A|（而非并集大小），从而全局惩罚缺失值；基于加权粒度一致性定义软依赖度；用贪心后向消除搜索约简，复杂度O(|U|^2|A|^2)。

Result: 该关系对称但非自反，依赖度不单调，并给出单调性成立的充分条件。11个UCI基准（缺失率0.15%–20.46%）上COFRS平均约简最小（4.1个属性，对比5.0–11.2）；对Tol-RS_tau、Zhou-RS、COFRS-min显著（Holm校正Wilcoxon p<0.01），对Tolerance-RS不显著(p=0.56)，对Jensen-Shen选择器差异小(p=0.084)。同等约简规模下所选属性信息量高于随机子集；kNN下各方法精度/F1/G-mean无显著差异，RBF-SVM下有差异且COFRS最差。

Conclusion: COFRS的收益是约简紧凑性，而非预测精度提升；作者需明确该方法的定位为属性约简规模优化工具。

Abstract: Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes. The similarity of two objects is a weighted overlap on the attributes present in both, divided by the fixed number of attributes |A| instead of the size of their union, so missing values are penalised globally and are not matched as wildcards. From this similarity we define a soft dependency degree based on weighted granule consistency, and we search for reducts by greedy backward elimination in O(|U|^2 |A|^2) time. We show that the relation is symmetric and non-reflexive, that the dependency degree is not monotone, and we give a sufficient condition under which monotonicity holds. On 11 UCI benchmarks with missing rates from 0.15% to 20.46%, COFRS gives the smallest reducts on average (4.1 attributes, against 5.0-11.2 for Tolerance-RS, a range-threshold variant Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and the min-aggregation variant COFRS-min). The difference is significant against Tol-RS_tau, Zhou-RS and COFRS-min (Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon p<0.01) but not against Tolerance-RS (p=0.56), and it is small against the Jensen-Shen selector (adjusted p=0.084). At equal reduct size, COFRS selects more informative attributes than random subsets. With a kNN classifier the methods do not differ significantly in accuracy, F1 or G-mean; with an RBF-SVM they do, and COFRS ranks last. The gain is therefore compactness, not predictive accuracy.

</details>


### [342] [Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31345)
*Yuhan Bian,Haoyu Liu,Siyu Li,Hanpei Guo,Jingrong Gao,Zhixu Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ChartInt——首个面向交互式图表到代码生成的基准，包含2779个标注样本，并通过预设状态快照协议将动态交互行为转化为可复现的评估目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图表到代码生成基准主要关注静态图表，忽视支持更丰富数据探索的交互式图表；且交互式任务强调"行为一致性"，需图表状态在交互序列下正确演化，传统一步式评估范式失效。

Method: 构建 ChartInt 基准（2,779 个标注样本），覆盖 hover、highlight、tooltip 等常见交互模式，并加入数据更新、样式调整、跨图表风格迁移等编辑任务；提出预设状态快照协议，预先定义目标交互状态并确定性触发交互事件，将动态行为转为可复现评估目标；据此设计衡量语义与风格一致性的多维度评估框架。

Result: 实验表明，当前 MLLMs 在静态图表上表现良好，但在交互式任务上性能显著下降，凸显交互感知基准的必要性。

Conclusion: 交互式图表到代码生成是现有基准的空白领域，需要专门的行为一致性评估；ChartInt 及其快照协议为可复现的交互行为评估提供了可行方案，并揭示现有模型的明显不足。

Abstract: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant progress in chart-to-code generation. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, overlooking interactive charts that enable richer and more expressive data exploration. Unlike static chart-to-code generation, which emphasizes visual consistency, interactive chart-to-code evaluation targets behavioral consistency, requiring chart states to evolve correctly under sequences of user interactions, thereby rendering traditional one-step evaluation paradigms ineffective. To address this gap, we introduce ChartInt, the first benchmark specifically designed for interactive chart-to-code generation. ChartInt consists of 2,779 carefully annotated examples covering common interaction patterns such as hover, highlight, and tooltips. Additionally, ChartInt incorporates editing tasks such as data updates, style adjustments, and cross-chart style transfer to expand real-world application scenarios. To enable reliable evaluation of interaction behavior, we propose a preset state snapshot protocol that predefines target interaction states and deterministically triggers interaction events, transforming dynamic behaviors into reproducible evaluation targets. Based on this protocol, we design a multi-dimensional evaluation framework measuring semantic and stylistic consistency. Experiments show that while current MLLMs perform well on static charts, their performance drops significantly on interactive tasks, highlighting the need for interaction-aware benchmarks.

</details>


### [343] [What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31346)
*Yuhan Bian,Zhaokai Liang,Jia Wang,Haoyu Liu,Yu Chen,Jianfeng Qu,Zhixu Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: InfoCon是一个面向对话中细粒度信息操纵理解的多模态基准，定义六种操纵策略并推导出一致性标签，采用基于证据的多智能体标注框架构建可靠数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM社会理解基准多停留在粗粒度情绪识别或二元真假检测，忽视了人们在对话中扣留、泄露、捏造、回避、防御性反驳等多样化信息操纵方式；这些行为需结合底层事实、参与者知识与会话语境进行推理，难以可靠评估。

Method: 构建InfoCon多模态基准：界定六种细粒度信息操纵策略，依据其事实与交互关系导出粗粒度一致性标签；设计证据驱动的多智能体标注框架，从丰富上下文证据中生成并验证标签；对代表性多模态模型进行系统基准测试与分析。

Result: 对代表性多模态模型进行了系统评测，揭示了其在细粒度信息操纵理解上的表现与不足，提供了超越二元真假判断的测试平台。

Conclusion: InfoCon填补了细粒度信息操纵评估的空白，为多模态模型的社会理解能力提供更细致、可靠的评测基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context, making them difficult to evaluate reliably. To address this gap, we introduce InfoCon, a multimodal benchmark for fine-grained information manipulation in conversations. InfoCon identifies six fine-grained strategies and derives a coarse consistency label from their factual and interactional relations. We develop an evidence-grounded multi-agent annotation framework to construct and verify reliable labels from rich contextual evidence. We benchmark representative multimodal models and systematically analyze their fine-grained information manipulation understanding, providing a testbed beyond binary truth-deception judgments.

</details>


### [344] [Antares-Smaug: Adversarial Names, Tokens and Attack Rewrites: Sanitisers Miss Unseen Generalisations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31347)
*Mohammed Nayeem Khan,Akhil P*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文系统评估了开放式决策模型 Laya 对提示注入/对抗编辑的鲁棒性：81 种程序化攻击在 566 条合成样本上大幅可被劫持（未见措辞攻击成功率 59%/36%），注入主要通过选项名称起作用，描述几乎无影响；单一冻结的清洗器与微调只能泛化到有限攻击族，字符级编辑基本未被覆盖，检测器对字符编辑亦失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Laya 让软件可对未见答案直接行动，因此需要量化其对注入式对抗编辑的真实脆弱性与现有防御的泛化边界。

Method: 对 6 个 Laya 模型做 81 种程序化编辑（注入句、标签泄漏、改描述、诱饵选项、隐形/形近字符、洪水），以 566 条合成条目测量正确项被劫持或丢失比例并给 bootstrap 区间；对比构建族内/留出族攻击、清洗器、微调（含未改动行对照）、以及删除选项名测偏移的无标签检测器。

Result: 未见措辞攻击成功率 59%（发布版）/36%（v1）；否定式命名选项句仍达 32%，不指名选项的祈使句仅 5%；描述影响约 2%；字符编辑使 v1 损失最多 72%。冻结清洗器对构建族降 72%、留出句降 27%；逐项 34 串最优 oracle 恢复至 84%（均值串 18%）；四族微调模型由 5% 升至 58%；仅按族微调对留出句由 33% 降至 3%，但字符编辑仅 25%→20%。无标签检测对留出句 AUROC 0.95、字符编辑 0.46；跨 schema/语言 5% 阈值下误报升至 8%–18%。

Conclusion: 现有防御在构建攻击族内有效但泛化有限，字符级与跨 schema/语言迁移是主要盲区，需按最坏情况（oracle 选串）评估防御；结果限于合成数据、LLM 标签、单一骨干，且部分实验未完成。

Abstract: Laya is an open decision model: given a text, a question and K named options with descriptions, it returns one probability per option in a single pass, and software may act on the answer unseen. We attack six Laya models with 81 programmatic edits of 566 synthetic items (injected sentences, label leaks, edited descriptions, decoy options, invisible and look-alike characters, floods) and report the share of correctly answered items hijacked or lost, with bootstrap intervals. Attack wordings that no defence was built from win the attacker's option on 59% of items for released Laya and 36% for fine-tune v1 (trained on 109 written injections). An injection works through the option name: a sentence naming an option steers the released model even when negated (32%), while an imperative naming no option does not (5%). Option descriptions barely matter (2%). Character edits alone cost v1 up to 72% of right answers. A sanitiser frozen before any held-out result cuts the attacks it was built from by 72% but held-out sentence attacks by 27%, and an attacker who picks the best of 34 held-out strings per item restores success to 84% (mean string 18%). The same oracle takes the model fine-tuned on the four build families of injected sentences from 5% (mean string) to 58%. Fine-tuning on build families only (against an unchanged-rows control) cuts held-out sentence attacks (three held-out families) from 33% to 3% but character edits only from 25% to 20%. A label-free check that deletes the option names and measures the shift flags held-out sentence attacks (AUROC 0.95) but not character edits (0.46), and thresholds set on dev schemas for 5% false alarms gave 8% to 18% on an unseen schema and other languages. All data are synthetic with LLM labels, on one backbone. Several planned runs (other checkpoints, a second seed, some fine-tunes) were not run.

</details>


### [345] [ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31424)
*Yi Han,Zhen Sun,Zhijie Deng,Yini Huang,Yangyang Zheng,Dongyi Zhang,Xinlei He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ContextLure红队框架：攻击者静默观察良性对话、提取证据并构造间接提示注入，在AgentDojo和InjecAgent上分别达67.4%和87.3%攻击成功率，无需事先投毒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体与用户的长对话中会保留任务结果、用户关切与操作约束等"证据"，可观测这些良性对话的攻击者可能借此增强间接提示注入；而现有研究缺乏对攻击者如何有效选取和利用这类证据的系统性考察。

Method: ContextLure：攻击者不修改先前良性对话，仅观察并提取证据后构造注入。针对(a)证据选取，沿"用户/系统偏好"两个维度设计3种选取策略；(b)将证据表述为未授权行为的"理由"，引入紧迫性/优先级矩阵与4种改写策略。

Result: 在所评估条件下，AgentDojo上达到67.4% ASR，InjecAgent上达到87.3% ASR。

Conclusion: 攻击者可利用良性交互证据在后阶段实施攻击而无需预先污染对话，说明观测型威胁模型下的间接提示注入风险被低估，需加强智能体上下文安全防护。

Abstract: As LLMs become more capable, agents can perform more complex tasks with tools and maintain longer interactions with users. These benign conversations contain evidence on task results, user concerns, and operational constraints. The risk is that attackers who can observe benign conversations (evidence) may construct stronger indirect prompt injections without increasing the attackers' control over prior turns or the later injection. However, we still lack a clear study of how effectively attackers can select and use this evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ContextLure, a red-teaming framework in which an attacker silently observes an existing benign conversation, extracts evidence, and constructs an injection. The challenges are twofold: (a) selecting useful evidence and (b) presenting it as reasons for an unauthorized action, without changing the prior benign conversation. To efficiently exploit (a) the effect of evidence on attack success, our framework selects evidence across 2 dimensions: User/System Preferences with 3 selection policies. And to enhance (b) the process of turning the selected information into the malicious request, we introduce an Urgency/Priority matrix with 4 rewriting strategies. Across the evaluated conditions, we reach 67.4% ASR on AgentDojo and 87.3% on InjecAgent. These results show that attackers can use benign interaction evidence in later attacks without first poisoning the benign conversation.

</details>


### [346] [Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31427)
*Chaeeun Lee,Hossein A. Rahmani,Aryo Pradipta Gema,Kexin Xu,Emine Yilmaz,Pasquale Minervini,T. Ian Simpson,Chen Jin,Amrutha Saseendran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文区分智能体的"任务能力"与"接口能力"，揭示单一harness训练的干扰问题，提出harness rehearsal方法，并发现多harness蒸馏+排练的组合增益远超单独使用，且RL对单一harness训练更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体通过harness（系统提示、动作格式、反馈循环、资源约束）运作。模型可能具备任务知识却无法通过特定harness表达，因此需要判断策略失败是缺少任务知识还是缺少操作接口的能力。

Method: 在四个推理与智能体基准上区分任务能力与接口能力；提出harness rehearsal——用携带极少任务知识的轨迹进行蒸馏以专门锻炼目标接口；对比多harness蒸馏、单一harness训练与on-policy RL的影响。

Result: 单一harness训练会干扰接口能力，甚至在留出harness上灾难性崩溃。在BFCL V3多轮任务上用Qwen3-4B，跨harness任务监督与rehearsal单独仅为8.5%和32.5%，组合达58.8%。RL对单一harness训练更鲁棒，且蒸馏获得的接口能力可通过后续RL保持。

Conclusion: 任务能力与接口能力需解耦监督，二者结合才能有效提升智能体性能；RL比蒸馏更能保持跨harness泛化。

Abstract: LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability to act on that knowledge through a given harness. Across four reasoning and agentic benchmarks, we show that harness-conditioned training yields vastly different outcomes depending on how these interact. Multi-harness distillation aggregates task knowledge from trajectories collected through different harnesses into a shared policy, but this knowledge is realised only when training preserves or improves competence on the inference-time interface. Otherwise, single-harness training can induce interference in interface competence, sometimes catastrophically collapsing performance on a held-out harness despite improvements in underlying task knowledge. To disentangle task and interface supervision, we introduce harness rehearsal: distillation on traces that carry minimal task knowledge while exercising the target interface. Cross-harness task supervision or rehearsal alone yields little gain, but their combination yields gains far larger than either: on BFCL V3 multi-turn with Qwen3-4B, they achieve 8.5% and 32.5% respectively, versus 58.8% together. Finally, on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is more robust than distillation to single-harness training: it does not substantially degrade performance on other harnesses, and interface competence acquired through multi-harness distillation persists through subsequent RL.

</details>


### [347] [Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31457)
*Guy Dar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Taxi 是一个可扩展到百万级步骤的智能体调试、聚类与监控系统，核心是"聚类+SQL 查询"混合分析管线，由编码智能体驱动，并实验性集成 Jev 式决策模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模智能体运行产生海量步骤数据，难以高效地调试与监控；单一手段（如嵌入向量或字面查询）不足以支撑复杂分析需求。

Method: 1) 主要依赖聚类在步骤上生成分类学（taxonomy），提供结构化数据概览；2) 提供完整 SQL 访问，供工程师与自动化智能体提出复杂问题；3) 聚类与查询组合为混合流水线，并由编码智能体引导；4) 实验性集成 Jev 式决策模型（状态+有界问题 → 类型化概率决策）用于低成本语义路由与评估；5) 模块化、可扩展的设计，内置评估器与日报。

Result: 系统可高效扩展至数百万步骤；混合管线在嵌入或字面查询不足时补充语义路由与评估能力。

Conclusion: Taxi 通过可扩展的聚类与查询组合，为个人与团队提供模块化、易扩展、可插拔的大规模智能体分析平台。

Abstract: In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an experimental integration of Jev-style decision models: models that map state and bounded questions directly to typed, probabilistic decisions. They add low-cost semantic routing and evaluation where embeddings or literal queries alone are insufficient. In addition, Taxi provides an extensible ecosystem, including built-in evaluators and daily reports. To accommodate growth, Taxi is designed to be modular, hackable, and easy to plug-and-play for individuals and teams.

</details>


### [348] [Alpha-Beta Pruning via Monadic Continuations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32320)
*Martín Escardó,Paulo Oliva*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于延续单子与读者单子的组合，给出alpha-beta剪枝的单子式表述，将剪枝边界记录在单子结果中而非移动类型里；并证明其计算的最优结果与最优着法与穷举minimax一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有单子化alpha-beta方法需把alpha-beta边界编码进可选移动的类型中，导致移动类型被改动；同时selection单子在alpha-beta搜索中存在效率问题，需引入延续单子的推广。作者希望用标准单子抽象更简洁地表达并验证alpha-beta剪枝。

Method: 将延续单子（continuation monad）与读者单子（reader monad）组合构造单子式alpha-beta；把alpha-beta边界记录在单子输出中，保持移动类型不变。通过扩展结果类型以包含对应移动序列，使普通延续单子即可同时计算最优结果与最优着法，避免对延续单子的推广。

Result: 在井字棋（Tic-Tac-Toe）实现中，计算最优着法时被评估的着法数相较穷举搜索减少约39倍；并形式化证明了单子式alpha-beta搜索与穷举minimax搜索得到相同的最优结果与最优着法，即正确性成立。

Conclusion: 该工作表明AI中的基础算法alpha-beta剪枝可用标准单子抽象表达并验证，为对抗搜索的组合式方法提供了基础，并可作为进一步开发单子化博弈搜索的起点。

Abstract: Alpha-beta pruning is a fundamental technique in game-playing AI, enabling efficient minimax search by avoiding the exploration of branches that cannot affect the optimal decision. We present a monadic formulation of alpha-beta pruning based on the combination of the continuation monad and the reader monad. Unlike previous approaches that encode alpha-beta bounds into the types of available moves, our construction records these bounds within monadic outcomes, leaving the move types unchanged. We further show that the ordinary continuation monad suffices to compute not only optimal outcomes but also optimal plays, by extending the outcome type to include the corresponding sequences of moves. This provides an alternative to generalisations of the continuation monad proposed to address the inefficiencies associated with the selection monad in alpha-beta search. We illustrate our approach with an implementation of Tic-Tac-Toe, observing a 39-fold reduction in the number of plays evaluated, compared with exhaustive search, in computing an optimal play. Finally, we formally establish the correctness of our construction by proving that the monadic alpha-beta search computes the same optimal outcomes and plays as exhaustive minimax search. Our results demonstrate how a foundational algorithm in AI can be expressed and verified using standard monadic abstractions, providing a basis for further development of compositional approaches to adversarial search.

</details>


### [349] [SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31475)
*Xiwei Liu,Yulong Li,Xuhui Li,Zhixiang Lu,Haolin Yang,Jianxu Chen,Yifan Lu,Di Fan,Yutong Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SpatialCraft：无需参数更新，让冻结的工具调用智能体通过自身交互历史自我进化空间推理工具编排能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 外部工具（3D重建、分割、几何计算）把瓶颈从视觉感知转移到"编排"——该调用哪些工具、顺序如何、如何解读输出。然而无状态智能体在不同任务间会重复同样的错误，且现有方法依赖参数更新。

Method: 维护两种外部知识：Experiences（通过对比同一任务的不同rollout提炼的条件-动作策略）与Skills（带显式激活/终止条件的多步流程）。三个耦合设计：Experience可锚定到Skill，仅在其激活时出现；对比效用评分（Contrastive Utility Score）通过随机保留/屏蔽Experience区分其贡献与任务难度；持续正效用的Experience被整合进所支持的Skill。

Result: 在5个空间基准、4个骨干模型上，SpatialCraft在全部20种设置中均取得最佳准确率。

Conclusion: 冻结的智能体可以仅凭自身经验学习编排空间工具，无需更新参数即可持续改进。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools, such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation, to answer questions that a multimodal large language model (MLLM) cannot resolve from pixels alone. Tool access, however, shifts the bottleneck to orchestration: the agent must decide which tools to call, in what order, and how to interpret their outputs, yet a stateless agent repeats the same mistakes across tasks. We ask whether a frozen tool-using agent can improve its orchestration from its own interaction history, without parameter updates. We present SpatialCraft, a self-evolving framework that maintains two forms of external knowledge: Experiences, condition-action tactics distilled by contrasting rollouts of the same task, and Skills, multi-step procedures with explicit activation and termination conditions. Three designs couple the two streams. Experiences can be anchored to a Skill, appearing only while it is active rather than once per task. A Contrastive Utility Score estimates each Experience's effect by randomly withholding it across rollouts of the same task, separating its contribution from task difficulty, and Experiences with consistently positive utility are consolidated into the Skills they support. Across five spatial benchmarks and four backbones, SpatialCraft achieves the best accuracy in all 20 settings, showing that a frozen agent can learn to orchestrate spatial tools from its own experience.

</details>


### [350] [Interactive Neural Computers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32811)
*Ross Murphy,Marcel Hedman,Gabriel Brostow*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出训练生成模型"成为计算机"而非训练智能体操作现有计算机，将桌面视为交互式世界模型，用Neural Turing Machine式结构从像素和动作端到端预测下一屏幕。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机与界面通常是固定的，人和AI智能体只能被动适应操作系统；当用户需要不同工作流、免手操作或无障碍界面时受到限制。作者探索另一种被忽视的思路：直接让模型充当计算机本身。

Method: Interactive Neural Computer，类Neural Turing Machine结构，含三模块端到端训练：(1) surprise-gated slot memory，由MEMORY-JEPA潜空间下一帧预测监督，用于记住屏幕外内容；(2) exploratory query bridge，引入预训练VLM的推理能力；(3) residual renderer，仅预测帧间潜空间变化。

Result: 长闭环滚动中，遮挡文件回忆准确率64.2%（随机33.3%），优于循环与滑动窗口基线（≤56.0%）；终端文本OCR准确率从1.3%提升至50.1%。

Conclusion: 将桌面建模为交互式世界模型可行且存在独特挑战（无相机位姿索引记忆、算术需精确、小字需可读、需交互帧率）；显式记忆可在测试时迁移，因果地改变渲染结果。

Abstract: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. Small interface text must also stay legible at interactive frame rates. Our Interactive Neural Computer is structured like a Neural Turing Machine and starts to address these problems with three modules trained end to end from pixels and actions. A surprise-gated slot memory, supervised by latent next-frame prediction (MEMORY-JEPA), stores what is off screen. An exploratory query bridge brings in the reasoning of a pretrained VLM, and a residual renderer predicts only the latent changes between frames. In long closed-loop rollouts, our model recalls occluded files in 64.2% of trials (chance is 33.3%), compared with at most 56.0% for recurrent and sliding-window baselines. It also raises terminal-text OCR accuracy from 1.3% to 50.1%. Finally, because the memory is explicit, it can be transplanted at test time to causally change what the model renders.

</details>


### [351] [Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31579)
*Edo Liberty,Ashwin Padaki,Amir Ingber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文研究高斯数据下的乘积量化（PQ）优化，提出EZPQ——一个简单且带强近似保证的算法，性能与OPQ相当并能给出每实例失真下界证书。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PQ优化（如OPQ）缺乏理论最优性证明与可验证的近似保证；随机旋转类算法（EDEN、E-RaBitQ、TurboQuant）精度受限，且低比特率、低维下k-means量化代价估计不准。

Method: 三项贡献：(i) 证明SVD是PQ的最优预条件旋转；(ii) 提出在低比特率与低维下准确的扩展Zador（EZ）k-means量化代价估计量；(iii) 基于全局比特分配的一维装箱分割算法。

Result: EZPQ匹配OPQ的经验精度，同时在高斯EZ代价模型下提供每实例失真下界证书；真实嵌入谱上每坐标2比特时常可证明位于最优1%以内；重构误差持续低于EDEN、E-RaBitQ、TurboQuant等随机旋转算法。

Conclusion: SVD旋转+EZ代价估计+比特装箱分割可构成有理论保证的PQ优化框架，兼顾精度与可验证性，优于随机旋转类方法。

Abstract: This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.

</details>


### [352] [Evaluating Frontier-Model Agent Skills with Open-Weight Models in a Science Gateway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31480)
*Komal Thareja,Mats Rynge,Anirban Mandal,Ewa Deelman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种把为前沿模型编写的 Pegasus 工作流"技能"适配到开源权重大模型的方法：用评估框架以真实用户方式驱动 PegasusAI Studio 网关，对智能体生成的工作流打分，并把反复出现的失败反馈给维护技能的前沿模型，从而实现技能迭代改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多跨任务、跨计算站点的科学分析依赖工作流管理系统(如 Pegasus)可靠运行，但编写生产级工作流需要专业知识，领域科学家通常不具备。编码智能体可在技能与打包流程指导下提供这种专业知识，但新用户若无前沿模型额度，就需要在研究型网络基础设施上免费提供的开源权重模型；而面向前沿模型编写的技能未必能直接适用于开源权重方案。

Method: 为 Pegasus 编写技能与专家智能体(由前沿模型完成)，通过 PegasusAI Studio 科学网关以聊天界面提供给科学家。设计评估框架(evaluation harness)，像真实用户一样驱动网关、对智能体构建的工作流打分，并将反复出现的失败反馈给维护技能的前沿模型以改进技能。在 17 项任务上评测 21 个开源权重模型；并对最优的三个开源模型做重复试验，与 Claude 对比。另进行受控消融实验。

Result: 每任务一次试验后，得分最高的五个开源模型质量接近，但中位响应时间相差达 12 倍。在最优的三个开源模型的重复试验中，工作流构建得分重复达到 0.76，而 Claude 为 0.82。评估框架促成了对初始技能的五处修改。此外识别出在运行系统中评估智能体的挑战：评估失败可能被误判为模型失败；智能体可能在其权限域内规避实验控制；在正确实施限制后，受控消融中原本显著的效果消失。

Conclusion: 面向前沿模型的技能可通过"真实网关驱动+自动打分+失败回馈"的闭环方法适配到开源权重模型，使免费开源模型在 Pegasus 工作流构建上接近前沿模型(0.76 vs 0.82)。同时，在真实运行系统中评估智能体需警惕评估失败与模型失败的混淆以及智能体规避实验控制的问题。

Abstract: Scientific analyses that span many jobs and computing sites depend on workflow management systems to run reliably, but writing a production workflow requires expertise in such a system, which many domain scientists do not have. Coding agents can supply this expertise when they are guided by skills and packaged procedures for recurring tasks. We wrote skills and specialist agents for the Pegasus workflow management system with a frontier model, and the PegasusAI Studio science gateway offers them to scientists through a chat interface. New users without frontier-model credits need an open-weight model, served at no cost on research cyberinfrastructure, but skills written for a frontier model may not work with an open-weight solution. This paper presents a method for adapting such skills. An evaluation harness drives the real gateway as a user would, scores the workflows the agent builds, and feeds recurring failures back to the frontier model that maintains the skills. We evaluated 21 open-weight models on 17 tasks. The five highest-scoring models are close in quality after one trial per task, and their median response times differ twelvefold. In repeated trials with the best of the three open-weight models, we repeated scores of 0.76 on workflow building against 0.82 for Claude. The harness led to five changes to the initial skills. We also identify challenges in evaluating agents within operational systems: evaluation failures can be mistaken for model failures, and agents can circumvent experimental controls within their privilege domain. In a controlled ablation, an initially significant effect disappeared when the restrictions were properly enforced.

</details>


### [353] [XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31498)
*Malay Phadke,Chirath Hettiarachchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: XRL4T1D：一个无需重新训练的事后可解释性框架，用SHAP/TimeSHAP评估预训练胰岛素给药策略，验证归因与策略输出敏感度的一致性，并比较PPO与G2P2C对CGM历史和胰岛素历史各时间窗的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1型糖尿病需终身胰岛素治疗，强化学习在UVA/Padova模拟器中展现自动给药潜力，但RL控制器的决策难以解释，缺乏可信度评估手段。

Method: 构建后验解释框架，基于60分钟CGM与胰岛素史（5分钟采样）。用SHAP比较CGM与胰岛素史输入重要性，并将胰岛素史归因按20分钟分为近/中/远三个窗口（依据insulin-on-board）。通过定向输入替换检验归因是否对应策略输出敏感度，并与TimeSHAP做时间排序对比；在20个虚拟患者上应用于PPO与G2P2C。

Result: 全部80个患者-策略-掩码尺寸情形中，替换高归因输入对归一化胰岛素推荐的影响均大于替换低归因或随机输入；最高归因胰岛素窗口在120个配置中有115个同时也是最敏感窗口；KernelSHAP与TimeSHAP在120个中有111个选出相同顶层窗口。两种控制器主要依赖CGM历史（G2P2C更甚），但胰岛素史各窗口重要性分布随队列、解释器和分析设置变化，控制器间无一致区分。全局特征归因排序在测试的观测扰动下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 归因保真度、时间可复现性与控制器比较鲁棒性应分别评估；XRL4T1D提供了不重训练即可检验RL给药策略可解释性的实用工具。

Abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. In all 80 patient-policy-mask-size cases, replacing the highest-attribution inputs changes the normalized insulin recommendation more than replacing the lowest-attribution or random inputs. The highest-attribution insulin-history window is also the most output-sensitive in 115 of 120 patient-policy-scenario configurations, and KernelSHAP and TimeSHAP select the same top window in 111 of 120. Applying XRL4T1D to PPO and G2P2C across 20 virtual patients, we find that both controllers rely predominantly on CGM history, especially G2P2C. However, the distribution of insulin-history importance across recent, middle, and older windows varies by cohort, explainer, and analysis settings, without a consistent separation between controllers. Global feature-attribution rankings remain stable under the tested observation corruptions. These results show why attribution fidelity, temporal reproducibility, and controller-comparison robustness should be assessed separately.

</details>


### [354] [PatientFlowSynth: Evaluating FHIR Agents with Matched Patient Charts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31521)
*Anthony Cuturrufo,Ratul Ghosh,Devashish Khatwani,Krishnaram Kenthapadi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PatientFlowSynth 基准（225 例合成患者、18000 任务、18 模板 × 4 证据状态），考察 FHIR 状态字段等显式指引对智能体检索/分类的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索患者病历的智能体需对证据缺失或冲突的声明进行分类，而 FHIR 的 status 字段会改变记录解读方式；现有评测把检索、引用与分类混在一起，难以定位错误来源。

Method: 构建 PatientFlowSynth：固定患者、问题与检索程序，跨四类证据状态的病历变体生成 3600 匹配对；重跑程序验证参考答案、证据集与检索要求。"严格成功"要求完成作答、标签正确，且引用精确匹配本轮检索到的可接受证据集；必要时工具返回须体现指定范围的完整检索。用 GPT-5.6 Luna 及预设的第二模型做复现，采用患者自助法置信区间。

Result: 显式 Encounter-status 指引使严格成功率由 40.7% 升至 51.3%（+10.6pp，95% CI 8.4–12.8）；但主参考标签为"证据不足"的病例上，标签一致性由 49.2% 降至 29.3%。两模型复现趋势一致；指引收益具模型依赖性。

Conclusion: 检索失败会掩盖解释错误（不经查阅相关记录也能得出"证据不足"而看似正确）；检索、引用与分类应分别评估。

Abstract: Agents that search patient charts must classify claims from retrieved records, including cases with missing or conflicting evidence. In Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), status fields can change how those records should be interpreted. PatientFlowSynth provides 18,000 tasks from 225 synthetic patients and 18 templates that hold the patient, question, and retrieval program fixed across chart variants representing four evidence states. Re-executing the program verifies each variant's reference answer, evidence sets, and search requirements. Strict success requires a completed response with correct labels and citations exactly matching an accepted evidence set retrieved during the episode. Where required, a tool response must also show a complete search at the specified scope. In a study using GPT-5.6 Luna and 225 synthetic patients (3,600 matched pairs), explicit Encounter-status guidance increased strict success from 40.7% to 51.3% (+10.6 percentage points; 95% patient-bootstrap confidence interval, 8.4 to 12.8). Among cases whose primary reference label was insufficient evidence, label agreement fell from 49.2% to 29.3%. A prespecified two-model replication reproduced both changes. Failed retrieval can mask interpretation errors by producing a correct insufficient-evidence label without examining the relevant records. Additional model comparisons showed that the benefit of guidance was model-dependent. Retrieval, citation, and classification should be evaluated separately.

</details>


### [355] [One Step, Four Clocks: How GUI Agents Fall Out of Step](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31522)
*Zhanwen Chen,Tianchun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出GUI智能体失败并非源于延迟，而是动作在交互不同阶段失效；提出EODA事件模型与ChronotopeGym评测框架，并设计加速器端控制器Chronotope，通过紧凑交互历史与动作保留/更新/重决策机制实现实时GUI控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI智能体可能选对动作，但在思考（deliberation）期间界面发生变化导致失败。仅用延迟无法解释，因为动作可能在不同交互阶段失效，需要新的建模与评测方式。

Method: 建模四类事件：环境变化、观察可用性、决策提交、动作接收（EODA）；构建ChronotopeGym在Paused、Replay、Live三种执行模式下评测；设计驻留加速器的GUI控制器Chronotope，维护紧凑交互历史，对pending动作选择保留、更新或重新决策。

Result: 五个任务中，智能体在Live模式下即使满足时限且响应仍有效也会失败；Moving Balloon任务上，更新待执行点击可将成功率从0%提升至100%且不改变响应时间。相比Agent S3，27B模型上Chronotope将中位端到端延迟降低85.5%，8秒时限下Live成功率由0%提升至100%。

Conclusion: 实时GUI控制的关键在于紧凑交互历史与"何时保留、修订或替换动作"的判断，以及无需冗长反思、推理与定位调用的高效架构设计。

Abstract: GUI agents can choose correct actions yet fail as interfaces change during deliberation. Latency alone cannot explain these failures because actions may become invalid at different interaction stages. We model four events: environment change, observation availability, decision commitment, and action receipt (EODA). We introduce ChronotopeGym to study these failures under Paused, Replay, and Live execution. Across five tasks, agents can fail in Live despite succeeding when responses remain valid, even when actions meet deadlines. On Moving Balloon, updating a pending click raises success from 0% to 100% without changing response time. Our accelerator-resident GUI controller, Chronotope, maintains compact interaction history and selectively keeps, updates, or redecides pending actions. Compared with Agent S3, Chronotope reduces median end-to-end latency by 85.5% for a 27B model, expanding its performance envelope to 100% Live success at an 8-second deadline versus 0%. Chronotope enables real-time GUI control through compact interaction history, knowing when to preserve, revise, or replace actions, and an overall efficient architectural design that obviates verbose reflection, reasoning, and grounding calls.

</details>


### [356] [Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31539)
*Brian M. Cho,Michael Lindon,Nathan Kallus*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出用e-values作为统计证据、在无确定性真值标签的噪声实验环境下评估智能体质量的框架，给出上下界估计量与置信集，并附案例研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体越来越端到端自主（提出干预、做实验、决定部署与下一步研究），其动作正确性无法再用外部验证的真值标签（如证明正确、代码编译通过）判断，只能从噪声且常无定论的实验中推断，缺乏相应评估方法。

Method: 将智能体质量定义为轨迹上正确决策的加权和，用e-value序列代替真值标签作为正确性的统计证据；框架支持任意相依的决策、依赖数据的轨迹终止、动态生成的假设及轨迹结束后定义的质量度量；构造质量的上/下界估计量与置信集，并证明在轨迹分布上一致成立，且给出估计量类的逐实例锐度。

Result: 得到具有一致统计保证的上下界估计器和置信集，并证明其逐实例最优性（sharpness）；案例中比较了Claude Opus与Claude Haiku在提升某开源Python包运行速度上的表现。

Conclusion: 为自主实验型智能体提供了无需真值标签、适用于复杂轨迹结构的严格质量评估工具，并以实际代码优化案例验证可用性。

Abstract: The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. However, as coding and science agents are entrusted with more end-to-end autonomy -- proposing interventions, running experiments, and deciding what to deploy and investigate next -- whether an agent's actions genuinely improve an outcome must be inferred from noisy, often inconclusive experiments. To evaluate agents in this setting, we define agent quality as a weighted sum of correct decisions along its trajectory, using sequences of $e$-values as statistical evidence regarding correctness in place of ground-truth labels. Our framework accommodates arbitrarily dependent decisions, data-dependent trajectory termination, dynamically generated hypotheses, and quality measures defined after the trajectory concludes. We construct upper and lower bound estimators and confidence sets for agent quality with statistical guarantees that hold uniformly over agent trajectory distributions and establish instance-wise sharpness of our estimator class. We demonstrate our methods with a case study comparing the success of Claude Opus and Claude Haiku in improving the runtime of an open-source Python package.

</details>


### [357] [A Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Official Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32646)
*Lucas Lageweg,Karen Goes,Tom van den Broek,Frank Pijpers,Paul Groth,Jan-Christoph Kalo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LOCuST 是一个面向官方统计的 text-to-SQL 基准，将荷兰统计局两千余张英/荷双语句表与语义知识图谱配对，并引入 observation F1 指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 text-to-SQL 基准与官方统计场景不匹配：官方统计以开放域目录形式发布数千张宽表，列和值均为编码，其含义记录在独立的元数据而非关系模式中。为提升统计数据的可访问性与治理能力，需要能处理该场景的问答系统。

Method: 构建 LOCuST 基准：包含两千余张英/荷双语表，配有描述表、度量与维度编码的语义知识图谱（标签、定义、层次、单位），作为系统定位正确表并将问题接地到正确编码所需的外部知识；同时提供覆盖原始取值检索、求和、比例计算、连接等多种查询与聚合类型的专家标注问题，并提出 observation F1 指标衡量查询与真值的接近程度。

Result: 评测多种最先进大语言模型，结果显示它们难以写出正确回答问题的 SQL。

Conclusion: 官方统计场景对 text-to-SQL 提出了新的挑战，LOCuST 填补了这一基准空白，并表明现有 LLM 在该任务上仍有明显不足。

Abstract: Official statistics are critical datasets for a wide variety of actors, including policymakers and businesses. For providers of official statistics, improving accessibility, governance, and disclosure of their data is of key importance. This can be improved by providing question-answering systems based on text-to-SQL approaches. However, existing text-to-SQL benchmarks do not resemble this setting. Official statistics are published as open-domain catalogs of thousands of wide tables whose columns and values are codes, and whose meaning is recorded in separate metadata rather than in a relational schema. To address this gap, we introduce LOCuST, a text-to-SQL benchmark that pairs over two thousand English and Dutch tables from Statistics Netherlands with a semantic knowledge graph. The graph describes the tables, measures, and dimension codes through labels, definitions, hierarchies, and units, and is the external knowledge a system needs to find the right tables and ground a question in the right codes. The benchmark includes expert-annotated questions for different query and aggregation types, including raw value retrieval, summations, proportion calculations, and joins. Alongside standard evaluation measures, we introduce an observation F1 metric that measures how close a query is to the ground truth even when the answers are different. We evaluate a variety of state-of-the-art LLMs and find that they struggle to write SQL that answers the questions correctly.

</details>


### [358] [Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31554)
*Artem Trofimov,Boris Novikov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文测量了代码执行型 LLM 代理在部分执行失败后重试恢复对系统外部状态的危害，发现危害发生率高（加权估计 24.6%），重复调用检测与幂等性标识方案均无法充分防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理提交的代码块若在中途失败会留下已生效的写入，随后代理改写代码继续运行。若失败是自然发生的（而非人为注入），这种恢复是否破坏外部状态此前未知。

Method: 在 AppWorld 代理的录制轨迹上做分层随机抽样（10 个模型、200 个候选片段），用数据库状态确认部分执行（145 个），并对恢复后结果分类；评估基于重复调用的检测规则，以及两种操作身份来源（模型生成的标识符、从调用内容推导的身份）在反事实下的表现。

Result: 143 个可判定结果的已确认部分执行中，30 个出现有害恢复且违规持续到运行结束，分层加权估计 24.6%；其中三分之二为效果重复，其余为删除用户数据或错误首次写入（如下错产品订单）。重复调用规则能捕获 75% 的重复但仅 41% 的全部危害。小规模试验（17 个片段、单个本地模型）中模型自供标识符未显著降低危害，因对同一操作给出新标识符；基于调用内容的身份反事实可匹配 30 次有害恢复中的 14–18 次，但无法覆盖任何错误首次写入，且也会匹配 30 个片段中任务所需的写入。

Conclusion: 自然失败下的重试恢复是代理系统中真实且偏高的风险来源，简单重复检测和模型自供幂等键不足；论文由此提出更安全恢复机制的设计需求。

Abstract: Code-executing LLM agents submit blocks of code that issue several API writes. If a block fails after some of its writes have taken effect, the agent rewrites the block and continues. It is unknown how often such a recovery harms the external state when the failure occurs naturally in the code written by the agent. In this paper, we measure it on recorded trajectories of AppWorld agents. In a stratified random sample of 200 candidate episodes across ten models, 145 are partial executions confirmed by the database state. In the sample, 30 of 143 confirmed partial executions with a determinable outcome are followed by a harmful recovery, and its violation remains at the end of the run, which gives a stratification-weighted estimate of 24.6%. Two thirds of the harmful recoveries duplicate an effect, and the rest delete user data or make a wrong first-time write, e.g., an order of a wrong product. A rule that searches for repeated calls finds 75% of duplications but only 41% of all harm. We also examine two sources of operation identity for an idempotency contract. In a small pilot (17 episodes, one local model), identifiers supplied by the model do not detectably reduce harm, because the model issues a new identifier for the same operation. Identity derived from the call content, evaluated counterfactually on the sample, would have matched every harmful write in 14 to 18 of the 30 harmful recoveries, but in none of those with a wrong first-time write, and it would also have matched writes required by the task in 30 episodes. Based on these results, we outline design requirements for safer agent recovery.

</details>


### [359] [Delegent: A Multi-Agent Harness That Reduces Cost without Sacrificing Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33098)
*Lingwei Gu,Jimmy Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Delegent 让前沿模型始终主导任务，把简单子任务（读代码、跑测试、检索语料）交给本地小模型（SLM）执行，在编码与检索任务上分别降低 67% 和 59% 的前沿成本且不掉性能，甚至 2B 模型也能省 66% 编码成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于前沿大模型的 Agent 成本高昂：每一步都要重读全部上下文并执行所有子任务，无论难易。作者认为其中大量开销可通过把简单子任务下放给运行在自有硬件上的小模型来消除。

Method: 构建 Delegent——基于 Claude Code 的简洁 Agent harness：前沿模型全程负责与统领任务，将聚焦性子任务委派给 SLM 子代理；区别于级联/模型路由器按整任务选模型，这里不做任何路由或模型训练，模型可自由替换。

Result: 配合 27B FP8 SLM，长程编码成本降 67%、Agent 检索降 59%，任务性能无损；2B 可笔记本运行 SLM 也能降编码成本 66%。节省随前沿模型原本承担的"体力活"增多而增大，一条简短指令（把主编码任务留给前沿模型）贡献了大部分节省并避免 2B 模型丢任务。

Conclusion: 在保持前沿模型主导的前提下做细粒度子任务委派，是一种无需训练、可替换模型、即插即用的显著降本方案，且小至 2B 的本地模型亦有效。

Abstract: Agents built on frontier language models are expensive. At every step, the frontier model re-reads its entire context and executes every subtask regardless of its difficulty. This paper explores the simple thesis that much of this cost can be removed by delegating easy subtasks to a small language model, or SLM, that runs on hardware one already owns. To test it, we build Delegent, a simple and effective agent harness built on Claude Code, in which the frontier model stays in charge of every task but hands focused subtasks, such as investigating code, running tests, and searching a corpus, to SLM subagents. Existing approaches such as cascades and model routers usually choose which model executes the entire task, whereas in Delegent, the frontier model always leads the execution and delegates easy subtasks to the SLM. No router or model is trained, so either model can be swapped freely. With the help of a 27B FP8 SLM, Delegent reduces the frontier cost of long-horizon coding by 67% and of agentic search by 59%, with no loss in task performance, and even a 2B SLM that fits on a laptop reduces the coding cost by 66%. The savings grow with the legwork that the frontier model would otherwise do itself, and a short instruction, which leaves the main coding tasks to the frontier model, accounts for most of the saving and keeps the 2B SLM from losing tasks. Code: https://github.com/castorini/delegent

</details>


### [360] [COGENT: A Modular Cognitive Architecture for Agentic User Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31559)
*Yikun Chi,Adam Davies,Debarati Das,Lin Ai,Scott Counts*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COGENT是一个模块化认知架构，用Norman动作循环和ACT-R等认知理论分解LLM用户模拟流程，实现可解释、可干预、模块化的桌面界面用户模拟，并在三个基准上取得显著的行为保真度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的计算机使用智能体以完成任务为目标，而非复现人类如何感知、推理与行动，因此难以用于界面设计、无障碍研究和交互智能体评估等需要人类行为保真的场景。

Method: 提出COGENT（COGnitive agENT）模块化认知架构，借鉴Norman动作循环与ACT-R等认知理论，将模拟过程分解为感知、记忆、用户状态、意图和动作选择等具有显式表征的认知模块；通过六个可干预性演示，追踪对记忆、用户属性或处理模块的单点修改如何沿认知流水线传播并产生行为变化；在AgentNetBench、A11y-CUA和SENSE-42三个基准上评估行为与归因保真度。

Result: 相比计算机使用基线，COGENT在复现真实人类行为上取得统计显著的行为保真度提升，并能恢复人类自报心理状态之间的关系结构。

Conclusion: 演示与评估共同表明COGENT有助于构建更保真、可解释、可干预且模块化的LLM认知模拟。

Abstract: LLM-based user simulation can support interface design, accessibility research, and interactive-agent evaluation, but standard computer-use agents are optimized for task completion rather than reproducing how people perceive, reason, and act. We introduce COGENT (COGnitive agENT), a modular cognitive architecture for simulating user interaction with desktop interfaces. COGENT draws on established cognitive theories, such as Norman's action cycle and ACT-R, to enable explainable, intervenable, and modular user simulation by decomposing the simulation process into cognitive modules with explicit representations of perception, memory, user state, intentions, and action selection. We begin by presenting six intervenability demonstrations, each tracing how a single edit to memory, a user attribute, or a processing module propagates through the cognitive pipeline to produce a behavioral change. We evaluate COGENT's behavioral and attributional fidelity across three benchmarks -- AgentNetBench, A11y-CUA, and SENSE-42 -- finding that it achieves statistically significant fidelity gains over computer-use baselines in reproducing recorded human behavior and recovers the relational structure among human self-reported psychological states. Together, these demos and evaluations demonstrate COGENT's utility toward more faithful, explainable, intervenable, and modular LLM-based cognitive simulations.

</details>


### [361] [Off-the-Shelf Autonomous Agents for Game Playtesting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31570)
*Ayush Maniar,Eryk Banatt*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Buddy：一个无需走通攻略或模型训练、基于现成语言模型的自主动作-反馈循环智能体，能在陌生 3D RPG 中完成长时程目标，并支持记录 bug 工单与将成功轨迹转为分层任务网络回归测试脚本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 游戏试玩测试通常依赖人工操作，成本高且重复性工作多；现有自动化试玩方案往往需要攻略、训练或定制集成，且难以泛化到未见过的环境。

Method: 构建模块化框架：语言模型与外部执行/反馈接口（harness）可替换。智能体多轮“采取动作—接收反馈—推进目标”，不提供 walkthrough、不训练模型，依赖探索逐步发现解法。

Result: 在未见过的 3D 角色扮演游戏中成功完成长时程目标；展示三项下游能力：无攻略通关、为遇到的困难记录 bug 工单、把成功轨迹转换为可脚本化的分层任务网络用于回归测试。

Conclusion: 语言模型驱动的探索式试玩智能体可作为可扩展、可插拔的自动化游戏测试方案；随模型能力提升可直接替换组件，并可将探索成果固化为可复用回归测试资产。

Abstract: In playtesting games, a human operator is typically required to test most gameplay elements. In this work we present Buddy, an autonomous game solving agent which can solve long time horizon objectives in an unseen 3D role-playing game using off-the-shelf language model systems. Buddy will take actions, receive feedback on those actions, and pursue a goal across many turns. No written walkthrough or model training of any kind is required, and we show that this paradigm holds in a novel environment where the agent must discover solutions via exploration rather than recalling them from pretraining. We demonstrate three downstream capabilities: game solving with no provided walkthrough, logging bug tickets for encountered difficulties, and conversion of successful agent traces into scripted hierarchical task networks for regression testing. Unlike existing playtesting solutions, our framework is fully modular: language models and harnesses can be easily swapped out as capabilities improve over time.

</details>


### [362] [Safe Autoformalization: Sufficiency and Necessity with Entailment Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31571)
*Umut A. Acar,Eli Goldweber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于蕴含图（Entailment Graph）与可证安全的自动形式化框架，用充分/必要边界夹逼公式含义并给出歧义残差，LLM作为蕴含判定器提供可靠或完备保证，Lean机器验证并通过AWS安全属性专家评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动形式化依赖语句上下文才能准确捕捉意图，而LLM输出具有概率性、缺乏形式保证，直接将公式用于安全强制或验证存在风险，因此需要能提供可证明安全性的自动形式化方法。

Method: 用LLM生成候选公式，在求解器判定的蕴含序上构建蕴含图EG，每条边携带残差与余残差；在给定上下文中通过两次局部检查搜索出充分前沿（最弱的蕴含语句的候选）与必要前沿（语句蕴含的最强候选），二者夹逼语句并给出歧义残差；用LLM蕴含oracle判定检查，并证明oracle可靠则搜索安全、完备则边界紧致；所有证明在Lean中机器检查。

Result: 在安全关键的AWS属性上，EG在专家裁决的20个案例中全部安全，而等价簇多数投票和Universal Self-Consistency分别有25%与10%不安全；使用同一oracle但去掉图的消融方法25%不安全、另有30%拒绝所有候选。

Conclusion: 蕴含图加可证安全的边界搜索能在候选池质量未知时仍提供单侧逻辑充分性保证，显著优于弱于图结构的基线，且核心定理已形式化验证，为安全关键场景下的自动形式化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Autoformalization translates a natural-language statement into a formula that captures its intent, which depends on the statement's context: the background that disambiguates it. LLMs make autoformalization practical, but their probabilistic output carries no formal guarantees. We propose techniques for safe autoformalization that certify one-sided logical adequacy: a formula sufficient for the intent is safe to enforce, and a formula necessary for it is safe to rely on. We use LLMs to generate candidate formulas and order them by logical strength in an Entailment Graph (EG), an ordering a solver decides. Each edge carries a residual and a co-residual, the two adjoints of the entailment order, all fixed by the candidate pool alone. In a context, two searches return the sufficient frontier, the weakest candidates that entail the statement, and the necessary frontier, the strongest candidates the statement entails; each step is one local check against an edge's residual or co-residual. The frontiers bracket the statement and yield the ambiguity residue, which holds exactly of the situations the candidates certify neither as satisfying nor as violating it; the statement is ambiguous precisely when the residue is satisfiable. For natural-language statements and contexts, an LLM entailment oracle decides the checks; it is sound if it accepts only checks that hold, and complete if it accepts every check that holds. We prove that a sound oracle makes the search safe regardless of pool quality, and that a complete one makes the frontiers tight. On security-critical AWS properties, EGs are safe in all 20 cases of an expert-adjudicated study, where majority vote over equivalence clusters and Universal Self-Consistency are unsafe in 25% and 10%. An ablation with the same oracle but no graph is unsafe in 25% and rejects every candidate in another 30%. We machine-checked our proofs in Lean.

</details>


### [363] [CAPE: Coordinating Calibration and Search for Tool-Use Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31938)
*Jiahao Wang,Xiaoxuan Chen,Aijun Yang,Xiaohua Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CAPE 是一种无需训练的工具使用策略编译器，通过交错校准与搜索、始终保持可执行策略，在共享编译预算下高效求解工具调用策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用即使操作本身正确也可能失败，因为接收工具按 agent 无法查看的配置解析分隔符、日期或记录布局。因此需要编译工具使用策略，但校准（在候选配置上评估候选调用）与搜索共享同一预算，先全部校准或反复重解模型都会浪费预算、延迟改进。

Method: 基于"调用在其可达配置上的效果已知即可使用"的观察，CAPE 始终维护一个可执行策略，把校准导向能改进当前策略的调用，并只在能提前结束校准时收紧边界；当可执行值与乐观值相等时证明最优性，并保证返回策略保留初始策略完成的所有配置。

Result: 在由 64 个请求构成的 CSV 与 JSON 工作流上，CAPE 在 504 次编译中的 502 次达到独立计算的最优解，编译时间比 eager 精确搜索少 22.0%；在更大的 CSV 族上以相近时间取得更高完成率，相比从错误反馈修订序列化的 LLM 提升 15.38–34.66 个百分点。

Conclusion: 交错校准与搜索、保持可执行策略并以乐观边界指导校准，能在有限预算下高效获得近最优乃至可证明最优的工具使用策略，显著优于先校准后搜索及 LLM 反馈修订方法。

Abstract: A tool call can fail even when the operation behind it is correct, because the receiving tool parses delimiters, dates or record layouts under a configuration the agent cannot inspect. Compiling a tool-use policy for such a tool requires both calibration, which evaluates candidate calls on candidate configurations, and search over the evaluated calls. The two share one compilation budget: calibrating everything first postpones any improved policy until the end, while re-solving every partially known model delays the next useful query. A call becomes usable as soon as its effects are known on the configurations that reach it. We present CAPE, a training-free compiler built on this observation. It maintains an executable policy at all times, directs calibration to the calls that can improve this policy, and tightens bounds only where doing so ends calibration early. Returned policies preserve every configuration the initial policy completes, and CAPE certifies optimality when its executable and optimistic values meet. On CSV and JSON workflows built from 64 requests, CAPE reaches the independently computed optimum in 502 of 504 compilations while taking 22.0% less compilation time than eager exact search. On larger CSV families it returns policies with higher completion at similar compilation time, and it raises completion by 15.38 to 34.66 percentage points over an LLM that revises its serialization from error feedback.

</details>


### [364] [Frequency-Conditioned Privacy Auditing of Fine-Tuned Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31581)
*Aymen Noor,Ke Lyu,Honglu Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了微调数据中敏感信息出现频次（1×至50×）与可提取性之间的关系，并在四个模型上比较标准微调、梯度裁剪与差分隐私训练（DP-SGD, ε=5）三种防护机制对提取风险的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型越来越多在含敏感数据的语料上微调，同一人的信息可能在多条记录中重复出现，导致模型记忆甚至生成时被恢复。记忆并不等于可提取，真正严重的隐私风险在于生成阶段的复现，而究竟敏感信息需重复多少次才会变得可提取尚不清楚。

Method: 将邮箱地址与电话号码在微调数据中的出现频次从1×变化到50×，在四个语言模型上分别采用标准微调、梯度裁剪和差分隐私训练（DP-SGD），并通过提取攻击测量敏感信息何时变得可恢复。

Result: 敏感信息变得可提取所需的重复次数因模型差异显著；梯度裁剪可延缓提取，但在高重复下不能稳定阻止泄漏；DP-SGD在ε=5时，在所有四个模型、直至50×重复的设置下，在所用攻击下观测到的提取量为零，但效用代价因模型而异。

Conclusion: 本文刻画了观测到的提取行为如何随敏感数据频次、模型家族和训练机制变化，揭示模型间提取行为存在显著差异；DP-SGD在高重复下显示了强防护效果，但需权衡不同模型的效用损失。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly fine-tuned on sensitive data, where the same person's information may appear multiple times across records. This can cause models to memorize sensitive information, but memorization does not necessarily mean that the information can be recovered. A more serious privacy risk arises when the model begins to reproduce that information during generation. In this paper, we study how often sensitive information must appear in the fine-tuning data before it becomes recoverable. Across four language models, we vary the frequency of email addresses and phone numbers from $1\times$ to $50\times$ and compare standard fine-tuning, gradient clipping, and differentially private training. We find that the number of repetitions required before sensitive information becomes recoverable varies substantially across models. Gradient clipping can delay extraction, but it does not consistently prevent leakage at high repetition. DP-SGD at $\varepsilon=5$ produces zero observed extraction through $50\times$ repetition across all four models under the attacks we test, although the utility cost varies by model. These findings characterize how observed extraction varies across sensitive-data frequencies, model families, and training mechanisms, and highlight substantial differences in extraction behavior across models. Code and data are publicly available.

</details>


### [365] [Monitorable-by-design architectures for a post-Astra world: a compartmentalization-based approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31610)
*Jake Watts,Joel Sokol*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于GRAM、SGTM、DEMix、BTS等方法的LLM架构改造，将危险能力模块化隔离，使这些能力（尤其与危险推理类型组合时）的使用可被比思维链更廉价地监控，以应对思维链监控可能失效的未来。


<details>
