With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.

</details>


### [435] [RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33022)
*Yifan Duan,Lihuan Li,Chao Xue,Siyuan Zheng,Du Yin,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RecordRoute，将"比较式定位"与"局部诊断"耦合：用词+字符特征在轨迹内做记录级排序以定位责任记录（actor 与最早决定性步骤），再用该记录文本与元数据预测错误模式，在 Who&When Pro 等基准上优于 StepFinder、ASCon。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计失败的 agent 执行需同时给出责任方、最早决定性步骤和错误模式。现有监督方法要么只做步骤定位，要么用共享的轨迹表示同时预测多个归因目标，导致定位结果未被用于筛选模式诊断所需的文本，定位与诊断割裂、诊断信息冗余。

Method: 以词级与字符级特征表示每条记录，在单条轨迹内部通过成对比较学习记录排序，选出责任记录；该记录的 actor 与步骤即定位输出，其文本与元数据作为输入驱动错误模式预测。

Result: 在受控注入的 Who&When Pro 上，四项官方指标全部超过 StepFinder 与 ASCon；固定 actor 与步骤预测后，局部诊断的合并联合准确率达 77.47%，而全轨迹诊断为 69.28%。在 TraceElephant 与 CatchBench POST 的自然失败上，定位能力优于上述基线及三个开源 LLM。

Conclusion: 将定位结果作为诊断的文本选择器可显著提升错误模式识别，比较式排序定位在合成与自然失败场景中均有效；但方法仍依赖记录级监督数据，对无标注场景的泛化有待验证。

Abstract: Auditing failed agent executions requires identifying the responsible actor, the earliest decisive step, and the error mode. Representative supervised methods either focus on step localization or predict multiple attribution targets from shared trajectory representations. These methods do not use the localization result to select the text for mode diagnosis. To address this limitation, we propose RecordRoute, which couples comparative localization with local diagnosis. Specifically, it represents each record with word and character features and learns to rank records through comparisons within each trajectory. The selected record supplies the actor and step, while its text and metadata drive mode prediction. On controlled-injection Who&When Pro, RecordRoute outperforms StepFinder and ASCon on all four official metrics. With actor and step predictions fixed, local diagnosis reaches 77.47% pooled joint accuracy versus 69.28% for full-trace diagnosis. On natural failures from TraceElephant and CatchBench POST, it outperforms these baselines and three open LLMs in localization.

</details>


### [436] [Hybrid AI for AI-Native RAN Control: A Functional Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33035)
*Sabrine Aroua,Osama Arouk,Pegah Alizadeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该综述提出一个与技术无关的RAN决策能力分类框架（表征与推理、预测与仿真、自适应控制、决策综合），据此对比AI与模型方法在慢/中/快/跨时间尺度RAN控制中的作用，梳理数据集、基准、仿真器与实验平台，并指出闭环评估资源与任务/指标标准化之间的差距及未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI原生RAN控制涉及跨网元、跨协议层、跨时间尺度的相互依赖决策，而AI方法与传统方法的功能角色缺乏统一比较基准，难以理解二者如何协同支撑这些决策。

Method: 构建以控制过程角色而非具体技术为依据的四类能力分类法；用该框架审视代表性AI与模型方法（基础模型、世界模型、强化学习、优化）；将分类法应用于慢、中、快及跨时间尺度的典型RAN控制方案以识别其能力组合；并按对决策过程和可复现评估的支撑程度梳理数据、基准、仿真器、数字孪生与实验平台。

Result: 揭示了混合AI系统如何组合各项能力，并发现闭环实验资源较丰富，但任务定义、指标与评估协议的标准化不足，制约了有意义的横向比较。

Conclusion: 提出AI原生RAN中混合AI的研究方向：能力集成、多智能体与跨时间尺度协同、约束处理、可复现闭环评估；并提供已调研工作与评估资源的公开清单。

Abstract: AI-native radio access network (RAN) control involves interdependent decisions across network entities, protocol layers, and timescales. Understanding how AI and conventional methods can jointly support these decisions requires a common basis for comparing their functional roles. This survey introduces a technique-agnostic taxonomy of RAN decision-making organized around four complementary capabilities: Representation and Reasoning, Prediction and Simulation, Adaptive Control, and Decision Synthesis. These capabilities are defined by their roles in the control process, independently of the techniques used to implement them. Through this perspective, we examine representative AI and model-based approaches, including foundation models, world models, reinforcement learning, and optimization. We then apply the taxonomy to representative RAN control solutions across slow, medium, fast, and cross-timescale applications to identify which capabilities they implement and how these capabilities are combined in hybrid AI systems. We also review datasets, benchmarks, simulators, digital twins, and experimental platforms according to their support for the decision-making process and reproducible evaluation. The review highlights a gap between the availability of resources for closed-loop experimentation and the standardization of tasks, metrics, and evaluation protocols needed for meaningful comparisons.Finally, we identify research directions for hybrid AI in AI-native RAN, including capability integration, multi-agent and cross-timescale coordination, constraint handling, and reproducible closed-loop evaluation. A curated list of surveyed works and evaluation resources is available at https://github.com/pegahani/Hybrid-AI-RAN-Survey.

</details>


### [437] [Auditing the Judge: Human-Derived Bias Discovery, Quantification, and Mitigation in LLM Judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33065)
*Hamin Koo,Chanjoo Jung,Fangzhao Wu,Jaehyung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HUB-J 是一个基于人类偏好衍生偏差因子的框架，可自动发现、量化并缓解 LLM-as-a-Judge 中的系统性偏差，采用免训练回归校正，显著减少偏差导致判定翻转并具跨模型泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 作为自动评估者时判断常受系统性偏差影响与人类偏好冲突；已有工作偏重预定义偏差清单、忽视偏差强度、依赖高成本干预，且较少利用人类偏好来指导偏差识别与缓解。

Method: 利用人类与 LLM 判断不一致样本自动发现可解释的偏差因子；利用判断一致样本，通过受控输入修改及模型决策变化量化偏差强度；再基于量化结果提出轻量、免训练的回归式缓解策略，估计各偏差因子影响并从判定中扣除其效应。

Result: 实验显示 HUB-J 能发现已知与新颖偏差因子，揭示模型间敏感度差异，并持续减少偏差驱动的决策翻转，同时跨模型泛化。

Conclusion: HUB-J 将人类偏好纳入偏差识别与缓解闭环，提供可解释、可量化且低成本的 LLM 评审去偏方案。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as automated evaluators in evaluation and training pipelines, their judgements are often affected by systematic biases that conflict with human preferences. Although prior work has identified various biases and proposed methods for detecting and mitigating them, less attention has been paid to using human preferences to inform bias identification and mitigation. Moreover, these approaches rely heavily on pre-discovered bias lists, overlook bias strength, and depend on costly interventions. In this work, we propose HUB-J, an integrated framework based on human-derived bias factors that detects, quantifies, and mitigates biases in LLM-as-a-Judge systems. Our approach leverages human-LLM judgement disagreement cases to automatically discover interpretable bias factors, and utilizes agreement cases to quantify bias strength through controlled input modifications and resulting shifts in model decisions. Finally, building on these quantified biases, we introduce a lightweight, training-free regression-based mitigation strategy that estimates the influence of each bias factor on model judgments and corrects bias-influenced decisions by removing its estimated effect. Empirical results show that HUB-J uncovers both known and novel bias factors, reveals meaningful differences in model susceptibility, and consistently reduces bias-driven decision flips while generalizing across models.

</details>


### [438] [Uncertainty-Aware Candidate Generation for Entity Linking in Cyber Threat Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33086)
*Nasser Alkhulaifi,Direnc Pekaslan,Christian Wagner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出不确定性感知的实体解析(ER)概念验证：在NER阶段用MC dropout捕捉提及级不确定性信号，并传入实体链接(EL)阶段自适应调整候选生成的模糊阈值，在AnnoCTR数据集上Recall@10从0.6186提升至0.7966。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ER流水线把歧义过早固化为硬决策：上游NER只选单一span和类型，下游EL视其为真值，丢弃了边界分歧、类型混淆等不确定性信息，导致系统脆弱、遇不确定输入时不可预测地失败。

Method: 构建基于BERT并加两个辅助span边界预测头的NER模型，推理时用MC dropout得到三类提及级代理信号：MC平均起始边界概率、MC平均结束边界概率、BIO预测分布上的De Luca-Termini模糊熵；用这些信号自适应调整EL候选生成(CG)中的模糊截断阈值，并将CG视为blocking步骤，以检索召回为评价指标。

Result: 在链接到MITRE ATT&CK知识库的AnnoCTR数据集上，边界感知与双信号模糊链接方法将Recall@10从0.6186提高到0.7966。

Conclusion: 贡献不在于端到端优化的ER流水线，而在于确立"不确定性保留"作为ER流水线中可行且有益的组成部分，使下游EL能在不确定性下做出更有依据的决策。

Abstract: Entity Resolution (ER) pipelines often collapse ambiguity into early hard decisions: upstream Named Entity Recognition (NER) selects a single span and type, and downstream Entity Linking (EL) treats that choice as ground truth. This discards valuable information about the ambiguity of the underlying data (e.g., span boundary disagreement and type confusion), leading to brittle systems that fail unpredictably when faced with uncertainty in inputs. Therefore, this work presents a proof-of-concept for uncertainty-aware ER that treats uncertainty as native data that should be preserved and exploited throughout ER pipelines. We (i) capture uncertainty signals in the NER stage and (ii) leverage these signals into the EL stage to improve candidate retrieval under ambiguity. Using a BERT-based NER model augmented with two auxiliary span-boundary prediction heads, we apply Monte Carlo (MC) dropout at inference time to derive three mention-level proxy signals: the MC-averaged start-boundary probability, the MC-averaged end-boundary probability, and De Luca-Termini fuzzy entropy computed over the Begin-Inside-Outside (BIO) predictive distribution. These signals are used to adapt the fuzzy cutoff in candidate generation (CG) for EL. Because CG is treated as a blocking step, we evaluate retrieval recall. On the AnnoCTR dataset linked to the MITRE ATTCK knowledge base, the boundary-aware and dual-signal fuzzy linking approaches improve Recall@10 from 0.6186 to 0.7966. The contribution lies not in an end-to-end optimised ER pipeline but in establishing uncertainty preservation as a viable and beneficial component of ER pipelines, enabling downstream EL to make better-informed decisions under uncertainty.

</details>


### [439] [Temporal Conditioning for Human Behavioral Cloning in Chess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33106)
*Victor Dziwniel,Tianxiang Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出时间感知Transformer（在Chessformer基础上加入时钟状态、时间控制、近期节奏等时间条件token及思考时间/认输预测头），使行为克隆模型更好拟合人类在时间压力下的决策质量退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有国际象棋行为克隆模型仅从棋盘状态预测人类走子，忽略剩余时间等时间输入；而时间压力是影响人类决策质量的关键因素，时间状态是行为建模中被忽略的维度。

Method: 扩展Chessformer式架构，引入可学习的时间条件token编码玩家时钟状态、时间控制与近期节奏，并附加思考时间和认输两个行为预测头；在大规模在线棋局数据上训练，与无时间基线及SOTA对比。

Result: 整体准确率仅小幅提升，但在时间压力下增益显著；思考时间与认输预测更准确；能更好复现人类在关键时间区间的走子质量下降，减少无时间模型系统性"过强"的问题。

Conclusion: 时间状态是国际象棋人类行为克隆中被低估但重要的信号，纳入时间条件可提升模型的拟人性与保真度。

Abstract: Behavioral cloning models in chess typically predict human moves from board states while ignoring temporal inputs such as the remaining clock. However, time pressure is a major determinant of human decision-making quality, and temporal state is a missing dimension of human behavioral modeling. This paper introduces a time-aware transformer that extends a Chessformer-style architecture with learned temporal conditioning tokens encoding player clock state, time control, and recent tempo, together with behavioral heads for thinking time and resignation. The model is trained on large-scale online chess data and evaluated against time-agnostic baselines and the state of the art. Results show that temporal conditioning yields modest overall accuracy improvements but substantially stronger gains under time pressure. Beyond move choice, it also produces more accurate thinking-time and resignation predictions. More importantly, the model better matches human move-quality degradation in critical time regimes, reducing the systematic over-strength observed in time-agnostic behavioral cloning models. These results suggest that temporal state is a previously underutilized but important signal for human behavioral cloning in chess.

</details>


### [440] [MetaFORGE: A Meta-Learning Framework for Harness Optimization in Automated Code Generation for Parallel Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33119)
*Scott Piersall,Yang Gao,Shenyang Liu,Liqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MetaFORGE：一个以执行为基础的元学习框架，迭代优化可复用的自然语言"技能规范"，用于指导LLM生成MPI C并行程序，融合正确性、编译器诊断、静态分析、运行时和负载均衡信号来改进生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM能生成并行程序，但其正确性与性能高度依赖提示指令的质量，如何自动构造并持续改进这类指导性指令尚缺乏系统方法。

Method: 构建标量奖励，综合正确性测试、编译器诊断、静态分析结果、运行时测量与rank级负载不均衡剖面，驱动"文本梯度"式的技能规范迭代精炼；并用外部记忆跨运行蒸馏与检索有奖励支撑的优化知识。

Result: 在6个MPI任务×3种负载规模上，相比零样本生成提升了静态分析质量、运行时与负载均衡，并总体优于TextGrad迭代基线；将精炼模型降级为gpt-4o后优势仍保持；18个任务-负载配置的检索消融显示运行时稳定获益、静态分析与负载均衡广泛获益；受控泄漏的留出与零更新实验表明优化知识可在技能与外部记忆中持续。

Conclusion: 以执行反馈驱动的元学习来优化自然语言技能规范，是提升LLM并行代码生成正确性与性能的有效途径，且收益不依赖强精炼模型并可通过外部记忆迁移复用。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate parallel programs, but their correctness and performance depend strongly on the instructions that guide generation. We present \textsc{MetaFORGE}, an execution-grounded meta-learning framework that iteratively optimizes persistent natural-language skill specifications for MPI C code generation. \textsc{MetaFORGE} combines correctness testing, compiler diagnostics, static-analysis findings, runtime measurements, and rank-level load-imbalance profiles into a scalar reward that drives textual-gradient refinement, while an external memory distills and retrieves reward-supported optimization knowledge across runs.
  Across six MPI tasks and three workload sizes, \textsc{MetaFORGE} improves static-analysis quality, runtime, and load balance relative to zero-shot generation and generally exceeds the evaluated \textsc{TextGrad} iterative baseline. A model-matched refinement ablation shows that the MetaFORGE advantage persists when its refinement model is reduced to \texttt{gpt-4o}. An expanded retrieval ablation across all 18 task--workload configurations shows consistent runtime benefit and broad static-analysis and load-balance benefit from retrieved context. Leakage-controlled held-out and zero-update experiments further provide evidence that optimization knowledge persists in both the transferred skill and external memory under the evaluated protocol.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [441] [Query Obfuscation with Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON): A Representational Blindspot in Agentic Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31344)
*Ankit Gupta,Christoph Adami,Emily Dolson*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 

Method: 

Result: 

Conclusion: 

Abstract: In modern agentic and semantic retrieval systems, dense embedding models increasingly determine which intent, tool, document, memory, or image to retrieve for a query. We identify a representational failure mode in this pipeline: a meaningful query can be replaced by visibly nonsemantic content while preserving much of its retrieval outcome, even when the candidate bank is hidden from the optimizer. We introduce Embedding-Optimized Noise (EON), constructed using only the natural query representation, without access to candidate embeddings, relevance labels, rankings, retrieval feedback, or guardrail decisions. Despite this corpus-blind objective, EONs frequently preserve intent and tool routing, benchmark document search, episodic agent-memory retrieval, and cross-modal search across multiple dense embedding families. Crucially, this disconnect carries serious security implications: for malicious queries, an EON can reliably evade input guardrails that block the natural query, executing the intended safety-sensitive retrieval undetected. Through the geometry of the embedding space, we then characterize how query-level representation matching can reliably maintain subsequent retrieval outcomes over candidates unseen during optimization. Together, these findings expose a fundamental phenomenon across dual encoders that we call BLINDSPOT, where systems remain operationally blind to nonsemantic artifacts while reliably retrieving real, consequential content.

</details>


### [442] [MELODI: Similarity-Identity Decoupling for Lightweight Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31940)
*Quoc Phong Nguyen,Vuong Le,Volodymyr Vaskovych,Julien Monteil*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文提出相似性-身份解耦框架用于延迟受限的候选排序，将目标-历史兼容性与仅目标信息分离，并实例化为MELODI模型，在公开与工业数据集上精度相当或更优，且大候选数下延迟更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延迟受限的候选排序场景中，需高效计算目标与用户历史的兼容性；现有目标感知方法计算开销大，需兼顾性能与低延迟。

Method: 提出相似性-身份解耦框架，研究similarity-then-pool与pool-then-similarity两种顺序，证明相似度算子对历史参数线性时可等价，从而采用更廉价的pool-then-similarity。实例化MELODI：相似分支用目标条件多头历史池化加单个无残差交叉层（对池化历史输入线性），身份分支依问题而定。

Result: 公开基准上MELODI匹配或超过目标感知与目标无关基线；两个大规模工业数据集上AUPRC、NDCG、recall达到或高于所评估目标感知基线；处理器测量显示大候选数下延迟低于候选条件基线，并可通过请求内历史复用进一步降低。

Conclusion: 通过相似性-身份解耦和pool-then-similarity形式，MELODI在保持或提升排序质量的同时显著降低延迟，适用于延迟受限的大规模候选排序。

Abstract: For latency-constrained candidate ranking, we propose a similarity-identity decoupling framework that separates target-history compatibility from target-only information. We study two orders for computing pooled similarity, similarity-then-pool and pool-then-similarity, and identify linearity of the similarity operator in its history argument, for each fixed target, as sufficient for their equivalence, justifying the cheaper pool-then-similarity form. We instantiate the framework as multi-head efficient lightweight operator for decoupling identity and similarity (MELODI), whose similarity branch combines target-conditioned multi-head history pooling with a single residual-free cross layer that is linear in its pooled-history input and whose identity branch is problem-dependent. On public benchmark datasets, MELODI matches or surpasses the evaluated target-aware and target-agnostic baselines. On two large-scale industrial datasets, its area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC), normalised discounted cumulative gain (NDCG), and recall values are equal to or higher than those of the evaluated target-aware baselines. Processor measurements show lower latency than the evaluated candidate-conditioned baselines at large candidate counts, further reduced by request-local history reuse.

</details>


### [443] [User-Adaptive Fusion of Multiple Foundation Models for Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31951)
*Sunwoo Kim,Hyunjin Hwang,Geon Lee,Kyungho Kim,Kijung Shin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出用户自适应的多基础模型融合方法UF2O，在分数层面按用户自适应加权融合，优于现有融合方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同基础模型可捕获物品元数据的不同方面，但朴素地融合其表示相比单一基础模型仅有边际提升。作者发现关键现象：受益于不同基础模型的用户群体不同，因此融合应当按用户自适应进行。

Method: UF2O为每个基础模型维护独立的推荐视图，将各模型的贡献建模为用户特定权重，并在分数层面为每个用户自适应组合各视图的预测分数；由于在分数层面融合，无需对齐各基础模型的表示空间，从而可融合异构模型。

Result: 在四个数据集上联合四种基础模型的实验中，UF2O在静态与序列推荐设置下均优于现有融合方法，相较最强融合基线最高提升7%。

Conclusion: 多基础模型融合的关键在于用户自适应而非统一表示对齐；分数层面的用户级融合是有效且通用的方案。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Can recommender systems benefit from combining a collection of foundation models within and across modalities? While different foundation models may capture complementary aspects of item metadata, we find that naively combining their representations yields only marginal gains over using a single foundation model. We make a key observation: the users who benefit vary across foundation models. Motivated by this observation, we introduce UF2O, a user-adaptive approach for fusing multiple foundation models for recommendation. In a nutshell, UF2O models the contribution of each foundation model as user-specific by maintaining separate recommendation views and adaptively combining their scores for each user. By performing fusion at the score level, UF2O can also fuse heterogeneous foundation models without directly aligning their representation spaces. Extensive experiments that jointly combine four foundation models on four datasets show that UF2O outperforms existing fusion approaches in both static and sequential recommendation settings, with improvements of up to 7% over the strongest fusion baseline. The code, datasets, and supplementary materials for our work are available at https://github.com/kswoo97/UFFO.

</details>


### [444] [LARF: Learning-aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32125)
*Tian Tang,Guo Chen,Reed Li,Hao Wang,Yu Lu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: LARF：三阶段框架（多智能体CoT冷启动SFT + 判别式GRPO（属性/列表/规则一致性奖励+边界margin损失）+ 双头学生蒸馏），在30万训练的网页搜索相关性基准上准确率+5.78pp、NDCG+5.05，纯分类推理延迟降82.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 查询-文档相关性估计是AI原生搜索的核心，但直接用LLM面临三个问题：1) 常规SFT对领域特定判断理由的监督不足；2) 标准轨迹级RL目标未显式约束相邻序数相关性标签间的边界间隔（margin separation），模糊决策边界难分辨；3) CoT推理虽利于训练但对延迟敏感的在线排序不可行。

Method: 三阶段框架LARF。阶段一：在策略性筛选的样本上用多智能体生成的CoT理由做冷启动SFT。阶段二：判别式GRPO，结合属性级（attribute-wise）、列表级（list-wise）和规则一致性（rule-consistency）奖励，并在终端相关性token上加入margin损失。阶段三：将教师蒸馏为双头学生模型，保留分类头以支持非自回归推理。

Result: 在约30万训练、1.6万测试实例的人工标注网页搜索相关性基准上：LARF-8B六分类准确率提升5.78个百分点，NDCG提升5.05点；仅分类的serving路径推理延迟降低82.9%。

Conclusion: 将结构化推理对齐、终端决策优化与分类头蒸馏相结合，可为工业搜索相关性建模提供有效的精度-效率权衡方案。

Abstract: Query-document relevance estimation is a core component of AI-native search systems, where a model must assess whether retrieved documents satisfy users' information needs under complex, multi-dimensional criteria. However, directly applying large language models (LLMs) to this task remains challenging because conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) provides limited supervision for domain-specific judgment rationales, while standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning (RL) objectives do not explicitly enforce margin separation among adjacent ordinal relevance labels. Moreover, although such reasoning can be useful during training, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is impractical for latency-sensitive online ranking. These challenges make it difficult to resolve ambiguous decision boundaries. We propose a three-stage framework LARF (Learning-Aligned Reasoning Framework for Search Relevance): it first performs cold-start SFT on strategically selected samples with multi-agent guided CoT rationales, then applies discriminative GRPO with attribute-wise, list-wise, and rule-consistency rewards together with a margin loss on the terminal relevance token, and finally distills the teacher into a dual-head student whose classification heads are retained for non-autoregressive inference. On a human-annotated web search relevance benchmark with approximately 300K training and 16K test instances, LARF-8B improves six-class classification accuracy by 5.78 percentage points and NDCG by 5.05 points, while the classification-only serving path reduces inference latency by 82.9\%. These results indicate that aligning structured reasoning, terminal decision optimization, and classification-head distillation can provide an effective accuracy--efficiency trade-off for industrial search relevance modeling.

</details>


### [445] [OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32203)
*Zifei Wang,Wei Wen,Qiang Ji,Qian-Wen Zhang,Ruizhi Qiao,He Liu,Xing Sun,Qiang Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: OmniEVIE：4.5B 多向量嵌入模型，用压缩单索引覆盖文本/图像/文档/视频/工具，并通过三阶段检索实现高精度低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态检索需匹配稠密页面、细粒度实体、有序视频与智能体工具/记忆；单向量嵌入丢失局部证据，cross-encoder 在线重读全部候选代价高，未压缩 late interaction 索引体积过大难以服务。

Method: 每条记录最多存 128 个 d=64 的 int8 向量（9,472 字节，每百万条 8.82 GiB），含均值向量、1-bit 符号与 int8 多向量，支撑粗/中/终三阶段检索并可定位到页面区域或视频区间。训练-合并-索引-检索协同设计：统一检索格式、三级证据校验剔除假负例、按 baseline-teacher 差距动态采样、训练中用 ST-HAC 压缩候选以对齐索引、按参数块合并阶段模型与专家模型、显著性门控加噪声下限精化查询打分。

Result: MMEB-V3（190 任务）60.68（完整 d=2048 序列）/60.06（K128×d64 int8 索引），MMEB-V2（78 任务）77.96，ViDoRe V3（48 任务）62.96。1M/5M 记录下单线程查询 54.2 ms / 120.2 ms，比精确 4096-d 单向量检索快 11.1x/25.3x，比完整 int8 MaxSim 快 236x/532x。视频直接由帧编码无需解析模型：QVHighlights（1,083 查询）峰值落在标注区间内占 78.0%，返回片段（视频长度 18%）与标注区间相交 94.3%，随机为 44.9%。

Conclusion: 通过压缩多向量索引与协同设计的检索流程，OmniEVIE 在保持接近完整序列精度的同时大幅降低存储与延迟，并统一支持多模态与视频片段定位；权重与代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal retrieval must match dense pages, fine-grained entities, ordered video, and agent tools and memory. Single-vector embeddings lose local evidence, cross-encoders reread every recalled item online, and uncompressed late interaction is too large to serve. We present OmniEVIE, a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model covering text, images, visual documents, video, and tools with one compressed index and a three-stage retriever. Each record stores at most 128 int8 vectors of dimension 64 (9,472 bytes, or 8.82 GiB per million records), providing a mean vector, 1-bit signs, and int8 multi-vectors for coarse, middle, and final search while localizing each hit to a page region or video interval. Training, merging, indexing, and retrieval are co-designed: all tasks share one retrieval format, a three-grade evidence check removes false negatives, dynamic sampling follows the baseline-teacher gap, candidates are compressed with ST-HAC during training to match the index, stage-wise and specialist models are merged by parameter block, and a saliency gate with a noise floor refines query scoring. Trained on public datasets, OmniEVIE scores 60.68 (full d=2048 sequence) and 60.06 (K128 x d64 int8 index) on MMEB-V3 (190 tasks), 77.96 on MMEB-V2 (78 tasks), and 62.96 on ViDoRe V3 (48 tasks). On 1M and 5M records, a single-thread query takes 54.2 ms and 120.2 ms (11.1x and 25.3x faster than exact 4096-d single-vector search; 236x and 532x faster than full int8 MaxSim). Video is encoded directly from frames without a parsing model: on QVHighlights (1,083 queries), the peak falls inside the labeled segment for 78.0% of queries and the returned span (18% of video length) intersects it for 94.3% vs. 44.9% random. Weights and code: https://huggingface.co/tencent/OmniEVIE-4B and https://github.com/Tencent/OmniEVIE.

</details>


### [446] [LazUnirec: Unifying Retrieval and Ranking in Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32590)
*Xiaodong Li,Junfeng Zhang,Shichao Nie,Ziyue Guo,Yiming Liu,Xinxin Xu,Xurong Li,Jinyuan Dang,Zhanming Ou,Jianan Yan,Tao Luo,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出LazUnirec统一检索与排序框架，通过任务共享/私有参数、LoRA调制注意力、任务自适应稀疏MoE及不确定性估计缓解梯度冲突，并已上线工业多场景推荐系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统工业推荐将检索与排序分为两阶段，导致优化目标不一致、用户序列重复编码、算力浪费；已有Transformer统一方案仍受梯度冲突及冲突时更新方向不可靠两大问题困扰。

Method: 在Transformer主干上构建任务共享与任务私有参数：注意力部分提出LoRA调制注意力（共享注意力参数同时保留任务私有参数）；FFN部分提出任务自适应稀疏MoE（共享专家+私有专家）；并提出不确定性估计评估两任务梯度可靠性，指导冲突时更可靠的更新方向；辅以排序到检索的知识蒸馏实现跨任务知识迁移。

Result: 大量离线实验与线上A/B测试验证了LazUnirec的有效性与优越性，已部署于线上多场景工业推荐系统并为平台带来显著收益。

Conclusion: LazUnirec有效缓解了统一检索排序中的梯度冲突，实现更可靠的梯度更新与跨任务知识迁移，具备良好的工业落地价值。

Abstract: Modern industrial recommendation systems typically divide retrieval and ranking into two separate cascaded stages, leading to inconsistent optimization objectives, redundant encoding of user sequences, and a waste of computational resources. Previous efforts have investigated using Transformers to model both retrieval and ranking simultaneously. However, these studies still face two major limitations: (1) Since retrieval and ranking share a single Transformer backbone, the gradient conflict arises when the gradient directions of the two tasks are inconsistent. (2) When gradient conflict occurs, the model cannot determine a reliable direction for gradient updates. To this end, we propose a Unified Retrieval and Ranking approach for Multi-scenario Industrial Recommendation, termed as LazUnirec. Specifically, we construct task-shared and task-private parameters on the Transformer backbone to mitigate the gradient conflict. Wherein, for the attention components, we propose LoRA-modulated attention, enabling retrieval and ranking to share attention parameters while preserving task-private parameters. For the feed-forward networks (FFN), we present task-adaptive sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to mitigate gradient conflict by constructing task-shared and task-private experts. Moreover, we propose an uncertainty estimation that evaluates the gradient reliability of the retrieval and ranking, thereby guiding the model toward a more reliable gradient update direction when gradient conflict occurs. In addition, knowledge distillation from ranking to retrieval further enables cross-task knowledge transfer. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B testing demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of LazUnirec. LazUnirec has been deployed in online multi-scenario industrial recommendation system and currently delivers significant gains for the platform.

</details>


### [447] [Speculative Decoding for Semantic-ID-Based Generative Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32855)
*Harshal A. Chaudhari*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SIDECAR 用近似草稿候选加一次树注意力打分，并对未探索前缀做概率上界认证，从而在少于 beam search 的调用/内存下给出精确 top-K 或带可证明 1+δ 保证的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义 ID 生成式推荐的工业检索用受限 beam search，需固定 L 次顺序调用，且随 SID 生成器变钝而精度下降，无法给出与精确 top-K 的接近程度，导致生产系统无法按请求检测检索退化。

Method: SIDECAR 先产生近似草稿候选，用树注意力在一次模型调用内给整个草稿打分，并对每个未探索 SID 前缀的概率给出上界；若草稿含精确 top-K 即认证。否则用分支定界回退，仅扩展可能改变输出的 trie 部分，任何草稿最多 L 次调用内完成认证；在每次 M token、Y 次调用预算下给出逐排名精确的 1+δ 因子。

Result: 依模型锐度不同，SIDECAR 以 beam search 的部分调用或内存返回精确 top-K；预算过小时虽不能恢复精确 top-K，但仍报告 1+δ 因子，而 beam search 无法做到。

Conclusion: SIDECAR 为生成式推荐检索提供可认证的精确性与可解释的质量-延迟权衡，使服务系统可在达到质量目标或延迟上限时提前停止。

Abstract: Generative recommender systems with Semantic IDs (SIDs) represent each item as a short sequence of $L$ discrete tokens and use a sequence model to predict the next item's tokens from a user's history. Industry-scale deployments typically use these models to retrieve multiple candidates per request with constrained beam search. However, this incurs a fixed cost of $L$ sequential model calls per request, and accuracy degrades as the SID generator becomes less sharp, without a guarantee on how close the output is to the exact top-$K$. Production systems therefore cannot detect degraded retrieval for individual requests.
  We propose SIDECAR, which uses approximate draft candidates and a tree-attention pass to score the entire draft in a single model call, memory permitting. This pass bounds the probability of every unexplored SID prefix and certifies the exact top-$K$ if the draft contains them. Otherwise, a branch-and-bound fallback expands only the parts of the trie that can still change the output, reaching certification within at most $L$ calls for any draft. Moreover, under a budget of $M$ tokens per call and $Y$ calls, which for $Y = L$ matches the resources of a beam search of width $M$, SIDECAR announces a factor $1 + δ$ within which its list will be exact at every rank. Depending on model sharpness, SIDECAR returns the exact top-$K$ using a fraction of beam search's calls or memory. Even when the budget is too small to recover the exact top-$K$, SIDECAR, unlike beam search, reports the announced factor, allowing the serving system to stop early once a quality target or latency limit is reached.

</details>


### [448] [SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32917)
*Amin Bigdeli,Liye Fu,Fattane Zarrinkalam,Joel Stremmel,Elizabeth Lingg*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: SOARS：一个无需训练的系统一（快速）重排序框架，在每步搜索中单次调用完成长文档段落选择与候选重排，同时降低延迟成本并提升深度搜索效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度搜索智能体需迭代检索与推理，检索证据相关性影响下游表现；但现有重排序器若在搜索轨迹中反复调用，会带来显著延迟与成本。

Method: 提出训练无关框架SOARS，用系统一（System One）模型做快速且校准的相关性估计；每步单次调用完成：从长文档中选query相关段落并对候选重排，同时考虑原始问题与智能体生成的子查询。

Result: 在BrowseComp-Plus与WebShaper上，六个LLM骨干上均稳定提升答案准确率与证据召回，同时减少搜索调用、端到端延迟与推理成本。BrowseComp-Plus上GPT-5.4 Mini准确率73.9%→84.7%，搜索调用23→14。

Conclusion: 系统一重排序可让深度搜索更有效、更高效，兼具性能与成本优势。

Abstract: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. On BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7% while reducing search calls from 23 to 14, demonstrating the potential of System One reranking for more effective and efficient deep search.

</details>


### [449] [Towards Realistic Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-Based Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33036)
*Hao Wu,Sipeng Chen,Weikai Li,Tianyi Chen,Qiancheng Yang,Hang Zhou,Yizhou Sun,Wei Wang,Xiao Luo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出固定排序基准，在统一输出契约下评估8种异构不确定性量化(UQ)信号对LLM排序推荐的实例级监测能力，发现方法优劣随骨干模型变化、Top10Mass最适误差检测、标量信号难辨配对控制差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推荐系统发布的排序需要可靠的实例级不确定性监测，但LLM排序器缺乏标准分类头，且现有UQ方法来源与作用阶段各异、有的评估已发布排序有的直接改变排序，导致难以直接比较。

Method: 构建固定排序基准，在共享输出契约与共享固定排序协议下，跨4个推荐数据集和2个LLM骨干，评估8种异构UQ信号作为记录级监测器。

Result: 三点主要发现：(1)同一参考实例上UQ方法排序随骨干变化；(2)排序对齐的Top10Mass在若干条件下scalar Error@10检测最强，但面向长尾目标时优势收窄；(3)标量UQ信号在识别哪个控制有更大clipped NDCG@10差异上较弱，而Perturbation Rank Instability与简单listwise距离等来源特异信号配对一致性更强。

Conclusion: 应将排序失败检测、跨推荐条件鲁棒性、对受控证据变化的响应视为UQ的三个独立属性分别评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for recommendation systems. However, their issued rankings require reliable instance-level uncertainty monitoring. In this scenario, comparing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods becomes challenging because LLM rankers lack a standard item-classification head. Their scores may depend on option labels, prompts, generation procedures, and the available user and item evidence. Existing methods derive uncertainty from different sources and apply it at different stages of the recommendation process. Some methods evaluate an issued ranking, whereas others use uncertainty to change the ranking itself, making direct comparison difficult. Here we introduce a fixed-ranking benchmark which evaluates eight heterogeneous UQ signals as record-level monitors under a shared output contract. We evaluate these signals across four recommendation datasets and two LLM backbones under a shared fixed-ranking protocol. From the results, we draw three main observations. First, UQ method ordering changes across backbones even on the same reference instances. Second, ranking-aligned Top10Mass provides the strongest scalar Error@10 detection in several evaluation conditions, reflecting effective cutoff-aligned monitoring, while its advantage narrows for popularity-tail targets. Third, scalar UQ signals are weak at identifying which control has the larger clipped NDCG@10 difference, whereas source-specific signals, including Perturbation Rank Instability and simple listwise distances, provide stronger paired-control agreement, reflecting their sensitivity to the two controlled evidence sources. These findings motivate us to evaluate ranking-failure detection, robustness across recommendation conditions, and responses to controlled evidence changes as distinct properties of UQ.

</details>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [450] [The Defect Is in the Arithmetic Between the Files: Static Detection of Exactly-Once Violations in Payment Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31298)
*Abhishek Sharma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出一种跨工件关系检查器，从幂等键寿命与重复处理时记录陈旧度的关系中发现流式支付管道的重复扣款缺陷，并将发现合成为可运行故障场景，多数产生两次扣款。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式支付管道重启后是否重复扣款，取决于"提供方记住幂等键多久"与"记录二次处理时能多陈旧"这两个量之间的比较，但前者只在文档中，后者分散在检查点间隔、运行手册、重启延迟、源延迟界等四个文件中，无人做此比较，单看每个文件都合理，缺陷存在于它们的关系中。

Method: 构建检查器收集这些分散事实并陈述其关系，再用合成器把515条发现中的335条转成可运行场景（指定记录、杀死作业的位置、恢复时间、可观测结果）；在630条生成管道语料上测量证据分散程度，并用真实Kafka broker与真实进程杀死执行见证，辅以对照实验和故障注入扫描。

Result: 335条可运行场景中245条产生两次扣款；630条管道里210条无法由少于三个工件推导，单个工件最多贡献305条时长发现中的35条；执行见证修正了自身规则（两条被降级，因场景只产生被幂等吸收的重复调用而非二次扣款）；16个精选实况见证全部复现预测，对照组未复现，将二次扣款归因于键寿命而非重放；故障注入仅在假设足够长中断时才能发现，愿模拟5分钟者仅发现15%，需12小时才发现全部；扫描还发现一处无应用层修复的配置，恢复假设超过14分钟时所需事务超时超过broker上限。

Conclusion: 重复扣款缺陷本质上是跨工件的关系性缺陷，单工件审查难以发现；证据分散程度是核心度量，合成可执行见证能反过来校正规则，并揭示出超越应用层修复能力的配置边界。

Abstract: Whether a streaming payment pipeline charges a customer twice after a restart turns on a comparison nobody performs: how long the provider remembers an idempotency key, against how stale a record can be when the pipeline processes it for the second time. The first number is in the provider's documentation. The second is not written anywhere. It is assembled from a checkpoint interval in one file, a recovery assumption in a runbook, a restart delay in a third and a source's lateness bound in a fourth. Each file is defensible alone; the fault is in the relation between them. We give a checker that gathers those facts and states the relations, and a synthesiser that turns 335 of the 515 findings into a runnable scenario: these records, kill the job here, bring it back after this long, and this is the observable. 245 of them produce two charges. The central measurement is how far apart the evidence lies. Across a corpus of 630 pipelines we generated, 210 of them cannot be derived from fewer than three artifacts, and no single artifact yields more than 35 of the 305 duration findings. Executing the witnesses corrected our own rules: two were demoted after their scenarios produced a repeated call the provider's idempotency absorbed rather than a second charge. All 16 selected live witnesses reproduced their predicted observable against a real Kafka broker with a real process kill, and a matched control in which the provider never forgets the key did not, attributing the second charge to the key lifetime, not the replay. Fault injection finds the same defects only if the tester already assumed a long enough outage: one willing to simulate five minutes finds 15% of them, and 12 hours is needed for all. A sweep also locates a configuration with no application-level fix, where above a 14-minute recovery assumption the transaction timeout required to survive it exceeds the broker's own cap.

</details>


### [451] [Diffs Are Cheap, Show Me the Trajectory: An Empirical Study of Trajectory-Informed Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31316)
*Zijian Luo,Pengfei Gao,Dayi Lin,Zhiyu Fan,Yongqiang Tian,Alejandro Carderera de Diego,Judge Hiciano,Gemma Garriga,Qingwei Lin,Dongmei Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文系统研究了编码智能体的开发轨迹（trajectory）能否帮助独立评审智能体发现最终代码中的问题。基于113个DeepSWE任务、339个实现及其轨迹和882条合成参考评审意见，比较了仅看diff、完整轨迹及四种替代呈现方式的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码评审通常从最终diff开始，但diff无法反映代码是如何开发的；开发轨迹中包含中间决策、失败尝试与验证证据，可能补充评审上下文。论文旨在系统验证这些轨迹是否、以及如何帮助独立评审智能体发现最终代码的问题。

Method: 构建流程：通过比较PR初始版与合并版生成评审意见，并与留出的人类评审意见对照。以held-out参考实现作为智能体产出的比较目标，构建数据集：113个DeepSWE任务、339个实现，配套轨迹与882条合成参考评审意见。在三种编码智能体配置、两种评审框架下，对比仅diff评审、完整轨迹访问以及四种替代的轨迹呈现与使用方式。

Result: 完整轨迹访问将平均参考召回率从23.03%提升至25.87%，但仅在六种配置中的四种有效。四种替代方式均优于仅diff，平均参考召回率提升4.05–7.32个百分点。增益也体现在解释任务验证器失败原因的评审意见上。更高召回可能需要更多token和更长评审时间，较简单的轨迹视图仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: 开发轨迹可作为代码评审的额外上下文来源；但其收益与资源成本取决于轨迹的呈现与使用方式。简单轨迹视图在效果与成本间具有竞争力，完整轨迹并非总是最优。

Abstract: Code review typically starts from the final diff. However, the diff reveals little about how the code was developed. Coding-agent trajectories preserve intermediate decisions, failed attempts, and validation evidence that may assist code review. We systematically investigate whether and how these trajectories can help independent review agents identify problems in the resulting code, beyond inspecting the final diff and repository. We develop a procedure that generates review comments by comparing the initial and merged versions of pull requests, and assess it against withheld human review comments. Using held-out reference implementations as comparison targets for agent-produced code, we construct a dataset linking 339 implementations of 113 DeepSWE tasks with their trajectories and 882 synthetic reference review comments. Across three coding-agent configurations and two review harnesses, we compare diff-only review, full-trajectory access, and four alternative ways of presenting and using trajectories. Full-trajectory access raises mean reference recall from 23.03% to 25.87%, but improves recall in only four of six configurations. All four alternatives improve mean reference recall over diff-only by between 4.05 and 7.32 percentage points. The gains also extend to review comments that explain task-verifier failures. Higher recall can require more tokens and longer review time, while simpler trajectory views remain competitive. These results support development trajectories as an additional source of code-review context and show that their benefits and resource costs depend on how they are presented and used.

</details>


### [452] [Decision Models for Definition-Driven GitHub Actions Workflow Smell Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31421)
*Rohit Gheyi,Anderson Uchôa,Wesley Assunção,Francisco Sousa,Baldoino Fonseca,Márcio Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文研究"定义驱动检测"：让模型依据可复用的自然语言smell定义判断GitHub Actions工作流是否存在smell，重点考察面向决策（返回有界问题分数）的模型，并比较其有效性、评分可靠性、可重复性与鲁棒性。在1710个经人工验证的工作流-smell对（19种smell、903个workflow、559个仓库）上，JEV 1.13在阈值0.5时micro-F1为79.69%，分仓库折选阈值达85.43%；生成模型GPT-6 LUNA分类效果相当但有247个未解析。可重复性≠鲁棒性：决策模型三次相同输入结果一致，但标签保持变换后超3%预测改变。静态分析器在46个重构工作流上以87.8%优于76.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GitHub Actions工作流中的smell是反复出现的配置模式，可能削弱安全性、妨碍维护或浪费资源。传统做法是把构件、适用条件和例外编码进静态分析器的检测规则，扩展到新smell成本高。作者希望探索"定义驱动检测"——用可复用的自然语言smell定义直接让模型评估工作流，从而降低扩展成本，并弄清这类模型能否可靠用于实际部署。

Method: 构建含1710个手工验证的工作流-smell对的数据集（19种smell、903个工作流、559个仓库）。评估3种决策导向配置（对限定问题返回分数）和2种生成式配置，与静态分析器对比。分析：不同决策策略与阈值的有效性（含在独立仓库折上选阈值、在历史比较集上检验全局阈值）、评分可靠性与重复性（三次相同输入重复运行）、对标签保持变换的鲁棒性，以及延迟与API成本。

Result: 有效性高度依赖决策策略：JEV 1.13阈值0.5时micro-F1 79.69%，分仓库折选阈值为85.43%；但用基准上选的全局阈值会在历史比较集上降低micro-F1。生成模型GPT-6 LUNA在其可分类的样本上效果相当，但留下247个未解析样本。重复性不保证鲁棒性：两个决策模型在三次相同输入下结果一致，然而经标签保持变换后预测变化超过3%，而总体F1几乎不变。在46个重构工作流上，静态分析器优于JEV 1.13（87.8% vs 76.4% micro-F1）。JEV 1.13每工作流延迟中位数0.675秒，基准测试API费用约0.22美元。

Conclusion: 定义驱动的决策模型可用于高频、模型辅助的smell检查，运行成本低、延迟小；但部署前必须验证并确定决策策略（阈值选择方式会显著影响效果）。此外，可重复性不足以证明鲁棒性，且相对静态分析器在重构工作流上仍有差距，对新判据的有效性尚待评估。

Abstract: GitHub Actions workflows automate continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), and workflow smells are recurring configuration patterns that may weaken security, hinder maintenance, or waste resources. Extending static analyzers to new smells requires encoding constructs, applicability conditions, and exceptions in detection rules. We investigate definition-driven detection, in which models assess workflows against reusable natural-language smell definitions, focusing on decision-oriented models that return scores for bounded questions. We compare them with generative models and a static analyzer, and examine their score reliability, repeatability, and robustness. We evaluate three decision-oriented and two generative configurations on 1,710 manually validated workflow-smell pairs covering 19 smells, 903 workflows, and 559 repositories. Effectiveness depends strongly on the decision policy: JEV 1.13 achieves 79.69% micro-F1 at threshold 0.5 and 85.43% with thresholds selected on separate repository folds, but global thresholds selected on the benchmark lower micro-F1 on a historical comparison set. Generative GPT-6 LUNA achieves comparable effectiveness on the pairs it classifies but leaves 247 unresolved. Repeatability does not ensure robustness: two decision models agree across three identical-input runs yet change more than 3% of their predictions after label-preserving transformations, despite nearly unchanged aggregate F1. On 46 reconstructed workflows, a static analyzer outperforms JEV 1.13 (87.8% versus 76.4% micro-F1). With a median latency of 0.675 seconds per workflow and about US$0.22 in API charges for the benchmark, JEV 1.13 makes frequent model-assisted checks operationally plausible, but deployment requires validated decision policies, and effectiveness on new criteria remains to be evaluated.

</details>


### [453] [Below the Stopwatch: Checking the Performance Claims of Coding Agents in the Kernel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31460)
*Yuvraj Sehgal,Sneh Patel,Mahsa Panahandeh,Naser Ezzati-Jivan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Below 流水线，用内核级信号（硬件计数器、LTTng 内核追踪）验证 AI 编码代理的性能 PR 中所声称的加速机制是否真的成立。分析 1343 个性能 PR 发现多数缺乏量化证据，82 个实测 PR 中仅 34 个出现其声称机制对应的预期信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理提交了大量声称让软件更快的 PR，并给出"缓存结果""只读一次文件"等理由，但秒表只能证明变快，无法证明是"因该理由"而变快。需要一种能在内核层面核验性能声称机制的方法。

Method: 从 AIDev 数据集的 1343 个运行时性能 PR 中抽取每个 PR 声称的机制，并映射到该机制若成立则必然发生变化的内核与硬件信号。由一个看不到声称内容的构建代理重建 PR 前后代码，再用普通计时、硬件计数器和 LTTng 内核追踪对比测量两版本。

Result: 57.3% 的 PR 仅给推理或无证据，仅 31.4% 陈述效应量。82 个分析 PR 中 32 个变快、28 个无明显变化、22 个变慢；34 个 PR 出现声称机制的预期信号（其中 20 个仅靠内核追踪信号可识别），42 个 PR 输出也发生变化。更快 PR 的声称机制相关内核信号变化频率约为未声称机制的 1.7 倍，而指令计数仅 1.15 倍，区分力很弱。

Conclusion: 秒表式评测不足以验证性能 PR 的因果声称；内核级信号能有效区分"声称机制"与"未声称机制"，而指令计数等粗粒度指标几乎无区分力。现有代理生成的性能 PR 普遍缺乏可核验的证据。

Abstract: Coding agents open many pull requests (PRs) that claim to make software faster. Most such claims also give a reason, such as "cache the result" or "read the file once". A stopwatch can show that code got faster, but not that it got faster for the stated reason. We present Below, a pipeline that checks these reasons at the kernel level. From 1,343 runtime-performance PRs in the AIDev dataset, Below extracts the mechanism each PR claims and maps it to the kernel and hardware signals that must change if the claim is true. A build agent that never sees the claim rebuilds the code before and after each PR. Below then measures both versions with plain timing runs, hardware counters and LTTng kernel traces. Most claims are not measured: 57.3% of the PRs offer only reasoning or no evidence, and only 31.4% state an effect size. Of 82 analyzed PRs, 32 ran faster, 28 showed no clear change and 22 ran slower. The expected signal of the claimed mechanism appeared in 34 PRs (20 in kernel-trace signals alone), and 42 PRs also changed their output. Kernel signals move about 1.7 times as often for a faster PR's claimed mechanism as for mechanisms it did not claim; the instruction count barely separates them (1.15 times).

</details>


### [454] [Spec-Test Coverage Gap: Detecting Overspecified Tests in SWE-Bench-Style Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31839)
*Avi Aggarwal,Yiran Hu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文定义"Spec-Test Coverage Gap (STCG)"，用双LLM裁判量化SWE-bench类基准中测试过度规定的问题，并证明此类测试普遍存在、显著压低智能体得分、并扭曲排行榜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SWE-bench类基准用原始修复补丁中的测试来评判智能体，但这些测试会强制任务中从未声明的实现细节，导致正确的替代方案被判失败；此前这类"过度规定测试"只能靠昂贵的人工审查发现，缺乏可扩展的自动检测手段。

Method: 提出STCG 1-4分量表衡量过度规定程度，由Claude Opus 5.5与GPT-6.1 Sol两个LLM裁判在给定规格和测试补丁下打分，双方均≥3即标记为过度规定。研究分三步：(1)在206个已有人工审计/智能体结果标注的任务上验证裁判；(2)对全部500个Verified与731个公开Pro任务打分，并与前30名Verified提交结果对比；(3)让Claude Opus 5.5放宽被标记任务的过度要求，重新评分2,186个失败补丁。

Result: (1)裁判有效：正确标记89%人工认定的过度规定任务，误报仅4%；(2)问题普遍：Verified中23%、Pro中35%任务被标记；(3)被标记任务明显更难：前30名提交平均仅解决31%，其余任务为88%；(4)排行榜被扭曲：放宽后61%的失败补丁可通过，若计为通过可为每个前30名提交增加33-60个任务，解决率最高提升12个百分点。

Conclusion: 基准测试中的过度规定是可自动检测且普遍存在的问题，会系统性低估智能体能力并改变排行榜排名；STCG提供了低成本、可扩展的诊断工具，呼吁基准构建者在评测中考虑放宽过度规定测试或加以标注。

Abstract: SWE-bench-style benchmarks, such as SWE-bench Verified (Verified) and SWE-bench Pro (Pro), evaluate coding agents with tests taken from the change that originally fixed each issue. However, these tests can enforce details the task never states, causing correct alternative fixes to fail. Such overspecified tests have so far been found mainly through expensive expert review. To address this, we define the Spec-Test Coverage Gap (STCG), a 1-4 scale measuring overspecification, and score it with two LLM judges, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, which are given the specification and the test patch. A task is flagged as overspecified when both judges score it 3 or higher. Our study has three parts. First, we validate the judges on 206 tasks that earlier human audits and agent results label as overspecified or fine. Second, we apply STCG to all 500 Verified and 731 public Pro tasks and compare the flags with the results of the top 30 Verified submissions. Third, we verify the flags by asking Claude Opus 5.5 to loosen the overspecified requirements of flagged tasks, and regrade 2,186 failed patches from those submissions. Our main findings are: (1) Overspecified tests are detectable: on the validation tasks, the judges correctly flag 89% of the tasks that human audits identify as overspecified and wrongly flag only 4% of the tasks known to be fine. (2) Overspecified tests are common: applied to whole benchmarks, the judges flag 23% of Verified and 35% of Pro tasks. (3) Flagged tasks are much harder for agents: the top 30 Verified submissions resolve only 31% of the flagged tasks on average, against 88% of the other tasks. (4) Overspecified tests change the leaderboard: relaxing the tests lets 61% of the 2,186 failed patches on flagged tasks pass. Counting these patches as resolved would add 33 to 60 tasks to each top-30 submission, raising resolve rates by up to 12 percentage points.

</details>


### [455] [(No) Separation of Concerns: Philosophical Concerns about Agent Ethics and Implications for SE Practitioners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31927)
*Marc Cheong,Sebastian Baltes,Joanne Byrne,Haoyu Gao,Raula Gaikovina Kula,Sarita Rosenstock,Christoph Treude,Mansooreh Zahedi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该文通过系统映射PhilPapers上33篇2023年以来的AI智能体伦理论文（8主题、85编码），将其伦理关切转译为软件工程（SE）研究议程与编码智能体团队的实践启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 哲学界已开始研究AI智能体伦理，SE界却多在原则主义（principlism）框架下探讨；作者旨在弥合哲学伦理与SE实践之间的鸿沟。

Method: 对PhilPapers进行系统映射研究，获得33篇同行评审哲学论文；主题编码并结合跨学科评议，形成8个主题、85个编码，据此推导SE研究问题与实践启示。

Result: 提出7个SE研究问题（开发者对智能体的依赖、智能体所写代码的责任归属、智能体配置中的伦理约束、基准设计等），以及5条面向团队的实践启示（界定须转人工的决策、保持智能体PR足够小以便审查、配置文件指令配合检查、警惕测试被改动、记录谁批准了什么）。

Conclusion: 伦理关切无法作为独立模块与SE关切分离：它们产生于代码审查、配置、评估与需求工作之中，解决这些问题需要跨学科协作。

Abstract: The use of AI agents in software engineering (SE) are commonplace, with differing levels of autonomy, a myriad of capabilities, and ability to perform a variety of tasks. Philosophers have begun to examine the ethics of such agents, and SE researchers or practitioners could benefit from them; on the other hand, SE practitioners currently explore most of these concerns through the lens of principlism. We bridge this gap by reviewing the philosophical literature on AI agents indexed in PhilPapers, and translating its ethical concerns into a research agenda for SE researchers and into implications for teams that use coding agents. A systematic mapping study of PhilPapers -- a major philosophy index and open access archive -- yielded 33 peer-reviewed papers by professional philosophers published since 2023. We coded these papers thematically, with cross-disciplinary review of the emerging themes, resulting in eight themes and 85 codes. From these, we derive seven research questions for SE, covering developers' reliance on agents, responsibility for agent-written code, ethical constraints in agent configurations, and benchmark design. For practitioners, we derive five implications: decide which choices an agent must refer to a human, keep agent-written pull requests small enough to review, pair configuration-file instructions with checks, watch for changes to tests, and record who approved what. We argue that ethical concerns cannot be separated from SE concerns into a module of their own: they arise inside code review, configuration, evaluation, and requirements work, and addressing them requires cross-disciplinary work.

</details>


### [456] [Shuttle: Dependency-Attributed Workflow Evolution for Smart Contract Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31929)
*Yue Xue,Yi Rong,Ziqiao Kong,Ronghui Gu,Dan She,Yuannan Yang,Zhiju Yang,Yuqiang Sun*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出受限工作流演化系统 Shuttle 及其演化出的智能合约审计框架 LucidScan，通过溯源图归因定位线索丢失节点，实现稳定可泛化的审计工作流演化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的智能合约审计质量取决于模型能力与工作流设计，但现有编码代理的无约束重写难以带来稳定增益：跨函数漏洞需多步状态跟踪；端到端评分掩盖了失败环节；小样本反复迭代易引入过拟合启发式，膨胀提示并损害泛化。

Method: Shuttle 以溯源图归因（provenance-graph attribution）为核心：将每次运行展开为实例级依赖图，用前向搜索定位线索丢失节点，并反向追踪已有命中形成保护集；评估合并批次后通过节点级溯源账本剔除拖累性编辑，仅当早期编辑在同一节点重叠时回退到复用缓存的局部重跑；对局部瓶颈在任务分解、渐进细化与通用性盲审约束下生成编辑。

Result: 10 个训练项目上将 LucidScan 从 G0（28.7% 平均 C/H/M 召回）演化至 G8（82.1%）；13 个留出验证项目上同模型平均召回从 28.6%（G0）升至 70.3%（G8），优于 Pashov 与 Codex Security。在 2026 年 11 月含 896 名研究者的匿名公开审计竞赛中，High 级召回 6/8（75.0%）并列第 1，计分 H/M 簇 34/72（47.2%）第 2，有效率 92.9%（78/84），综合第 3。

Conclusion: 以溯源图归因为中心的受限演化机制可在不依赖海量案例的前提下稳定提升审计工作流，并在真实公开竞赛中达到顶尖水平，验证了细粒度归因与编辑约束对工作流演化的有效性。

Abstract: In LLM-based smart contract auditing, detection quality depends on both model capability and workflow design. While coding agents can revise workflows from execution feedback, unconstrained rewrites rarely yield stable gains. Cross-function vulnerabilities require multi-step state tracking and boundary reasoning that coarse pipelines miss. End-to-end outcomes hide which step lost a clue, so direct rewrites regress existing hits or discard valid edits under coarse aggregate scoring. Repeatedly iterating on a small project set also adds case-specific heuristics that bloat prompts and hurt generalization. We present Shuttle, a constrained workflow-evolution system, and LucidScan, the auditing framework it evolves. Shuttle centers on provenance-graph attribution: it expands each run into an instance-level dependency graph, locates the node where a clue was lost via forward search, and traces existing hits backward into a protected set. After evaluating a merged batch, Shuttle drops dragging edits via a node-level provenance ledger, falling back to cache-reusing local re-runs only when early-round edits overlap on the same node. For localized bottlenecks, Shuttle generates edits under task decomposition, progressive refinement, and generality blind review. On 10 training projects, Shuttle evolves LucidScan from $G_0$ (28.7% per-project average C/H/M recall) to $G_8$ (82.1%). On 13 held-out validation projects under the same model, average recall rises from 28.6% ($G_0$) to 70.3% ($G_8$), above Pashov and Codex Security. In an anonymized live public audit contest with 896 researchers (Nov. 2026), the evolved scanner tied for #1 in High-severity recall (6/8, 75.0%), ranked #2 in scored H/M clusters (34/72, 47.2%) with 92.9% validity (78/84), and finished #3 overall.

</details>


### [457] [DesignEvo: Recovering and Tracking Repository-Level Implemented Design Systems Across Commits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32020)
*Mingyue Yuan,Jinbo Yang,Jieshan Chen,Aorui Yang,Aaron Quigley,Gelareh Mohammadi,Zhenchang Xing,Boxi Wu,Dehai Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: DesignEvo 结合截图、DOM、几何与样式信息，将以程序生成候选区域约束视觉语言模型，从代码仓库层面自动恢复功能UI分组并推断其跨提交生命周期状态，在10个开源仓库上分组恢复F1达0.85、生命周期状态准确率0.84。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代前端依赖设计系统维持一致性，但文档与组件库无法反映界面模式在实践中如何被实现、复用与改编；现有UI分析偏重视觉缺陷、结构或元素对应，缺乏仓库级别自动恢复与追踪已实现设计系统的手段。

Method: DesignEvo 融合截图、DOM结构、元素几何与样式值来恢复功能UI分组；将视觉语言模型的判断限制在程序生成的候选区域内；把恢复出的分组与样式聚合成仓库级记录；并依据相邻提交推断其生命周期状态。含候选约束、功能类别、样式证据的消融实验。

Result: 在10个开源仓库（317个页面版本实例、3,478个标注功能UI分组、2,435个生命周期状态标签）上，分组恢复F1为0.85，生命周期状态总体准确率0.84，明显优于最强基线0.71；消融验证了候选约束、功能类别与样式证据的贡献。

Conclusion: DesignEvo 产出的结构化、可追溯记录能揭示重复出现的UI模式及其演化，为前端维护与变更审计提供支持。

Abstract: Modern frontend applications rely on design systems to maintain consistency across pages and releases. However, documentation and component libraries do not fully capture how interface patterns are implemented, reused, and adapted in practice. Existing UI analysis techniques focus on visual defects, interface structure, or element correspondences, providing limited support for automatically recovering and tracking implemented design systems at the repository level. To bridge this gap, we present DesignEvo, which combines screenshots, DOM structure, element geometry, and style values to recover functional UI groups. DesignEvo constrains vision-language model judgments to program-generated candidate regions, aggregates recovered groups and styles into repository-level records, and infers lifecycle states across adjacent commits. We evaluate DesignEvo on 10 open-source repositories comprising 317 page-version instances, 3,478 annotated functional UI groups, and 2,435 lifecycle-state labels. DesignEvo achieves an F1 score of 0.85 for group recovery and an overall lifecycle-state accuracy of 0.84, compared with 0.71 for the strongest lifecycle baseline. Ablations demonstrate the contributions of candidate constraints, functional categories, and style evidence. The resulting records provide structured, traceable evidence of recurring UI patterns and their evolution to support frontend maintenance and change auditing.

</details>


### [458] [Automated Smoke Testing for Multi-ending Game Quests via Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32089)
*Jinyu Cai,Mingyue Zhang,Nianyu Li,Jinglue Xu,Tianshui Li,Jialong Li,Hitoshi Iba,Kenji Tei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: EndWeaver：基于LLM多层级规划的自动化游戏任务冒烟测试框架，覆盖所有多结局分支。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代游戏任务趋向高自由度与多结局，设计与测试复杂。现有自动化冒烟测试难以处理分支叙事和多结局任务，导致结局探索不足、动作序列冗余、交互成本过高。

Method: 提出EndWeaver框架：用LLM解析任务描述与游戏环境，生成高层方法指导全局探索，并生成原子任务序列做细粒度规划；结合多层级规划结构与动态构建的状态转移图，保证所有可能结局的覆盖与高效测试。

Result: 在Mini RPG、Overcooked Plus、Minecraft、PySC2四个环境中与基线对比，均实现稳定高可靠的任务完成，显著优于基线；测试成本仅需数千步，而基线需数百万步，且完整覆盖所有任务结局。消融实验验证了各组件的关键作用，证明了有效性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: EndWeaver通过LLM多层级规划与状态转移图，实现了多结局游戏任务的高覆盖、低成本的自动化冒烟测试。

Abstract: Modern game quests are increasingly trending toward high freedom and multiple endings, making their design and testing more complex. Smoke testing in games aims to rapidly validate quest functionality, but existing automated testing approaches face critical limitations when handling quests with branching narratives, and multiple possible endings. These challenges result in insufficient exploration of endings, redundant action sequences, and prohibitively high interaction costs. To address these challenges, we propose EndWeaver, an automated smoke testing framework specifically designed for multi-ending game tasks. EndWeaver leverages LLMs to interpret quest descriptions and game environments, generating high-level methods to guide global exploration, complemented by the generated primitive task sequences for fine-grained planning. By combining this multi-level planning structure with the dynamic construction of state-transition graphs, EndWeaver ensures comprehensive coverage of all possible endings and enables efficient testing. We evaluated EndWeaver on four game environments---Mini RPG, Overcooked Plus, Minecraft, and PySC2 against baseline methods. In all environments, EndWeaver achieved stable quest completion with high reliability, significantly outperforming the baselines. In terms of testing cost, EndWeaver required only a few thousand steps, while baseline methods required millions of steps, all while ensuring comprehensive coverage of all possible quest endings. Ablation studies further demonstrated the critical contributions of each framework component, validating the effectiveness and robustness of our approach.

</details>


### [459] [SCOPE: Evaluating and Enhancing Permission Explanation Transparency in Mobile Apps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32122)
*Liu Wang,Tianshu Zhou,Haoyu Wang,Xiyuan Liu,Yi Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对600款主流移动应用的权限说明文本进行实证研究，发现透明度缺陷普遍存在（15%无说明、语言含糊、未披露第三方SDK数据访问），并提出多智能体框架SCOPE自动评估权限说明合规性并生成优化建议，在抽取、合规分析和用途推断上分别达到98%、93.5%、92%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 权限说明对用户隐私透明与知情同意至关重要，但当前实践常不满足监管要求，主要原因是缺乏系统化的评估机制；现有研究也尚未系统刻画权限说明的实际质量与第三方SDK的数据访问披露问题。

Method: 首先通过600款主流应用的实证研究揭示缺陷；随后提出SCOPE框架，由四个专门智能体协作：基于多模态LLM的说明抽取、基于少样本学习的语言分析、基于动态API的用途推断、自适应报告生成，从而实现合规评估与针对性优化建议生成。

Result: 实证显示15%权限请求无说明、其余存在含糊或术语化表达、且第三方SDK虽实际使用权限却未被披露；SCOPE在说明抽取上达98%准确率，合规分析一致性93.5%，用途推断准确率92%；30人用户研究中84.6%偏好SCOPE优化后的说明。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统分析权限说明实践，揭示其透明度缺陷，并提供可扩展的自动化解决方案SCOPE，以提升移动应用隐私透明度和用户知情同意质量。

Abstract: Permission explanations, explanatory text accompanying mobile app permission requests, are crucial for user privacy transparency and informed consent. Despite their importance, current practices often fall short of regulatory expectations due to the lack of systematic evaluation mechanisms. Through an empirical study of 600 mainstream mobile apps, we reveal widespread deficiencies: 15\% of permission requests provide no explanation, others use vague language or technical jargon, and critically, many fail to disclose third-party SDK data access despite these components actively using granted permissions. To address these transparency gaps, we present SCOPE, an automated multi-agent framework that systematically evaluates permission explanation compliance and generates targeted optimization recommendations. SCOPE employs four specialized agents working collaboratively: multimodal LLM-based explanation extraction, few-shot learning-based linguistic analysis, dynamic API-based purpose inference, and adaptive report generation. Comprehensive evaluation demonstrates SCOPE's effectiveness, achieving 98\% accuracy in explanation extraction, 93.5\% consistency in compliance analysis, and 92\% accuracy in purpose inference. A user study with 30 participants shows 84.6\% preference for SCOPE-optimized explanations, confirming practical utility. Our work provides the first systematic analysis of permission explanation practices and establishes a scalable solution for enhancing mobile app privacy transparency.

</details>


### [460] [Validating Multi-Model AI-Generated Acceptance Criteria in Requirements Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32374)
*Mateen Ahmed Abbasi,Petri Ihantola,Tommi Mikkonen,Niko Mäkitalo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向AI生成验收标准的验证导向方法，结合RAG、多模型生成与显式人在回路工作流，构建可用的原型系统，支持生成、对比、检查检索上下文及人工审阅定稿，并记录全过程以便追溯，强调把验证操作化为可检查、可问责的流程而非宣称生成准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在需求工程中生成需求、用户故事、验收标准等制品的应用日益增多，但正确性、可追溯性与幻觉问题突出——有缺陷的规格会影响后续设计、实现与验证。现有AI辅助软件工程研究多聚焦代码生成与代码级验证，AI生成规格的验证关注不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 提出一种验证导向的AI生成验收标准方法，融合：检索增强生成（RAG）、多模型并行生成、以及显式结构化的人在回路工作流。实现一个可运行原型，用户可准备/输入用户故事，用多个LLM生成验收标准，可选地用检索到的需求相关示例增强生成，并排对比输出、查看检索上下文，随后选择、编辑或重新生成候选标准，最后显式提交经审阅者定稿的版本；系统记录模型输出、用户干预、检索设置与最终标准，形成可追溯的决策日志。

Result: 交付一个可运行原型系统，支持多模型生成与对比、检索上下文检查、人工选择/编辑/再生成和定稿提交，并完整记录模型输出、用户干预、检索设置与最终标准的决策过程。作者明确不宣称生成准确率已提升。

Conclusion: 本文贡献在于将验证操作化为一个显式、可检查且可问责的流程，用于AI生成的需求制品，而非声称已提高生成准确率。该工作为AI辅助需求工程中的规格验证提供了流程性基础与可追溯的实践支撑。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software engineering to generate artifacts such as requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, documentation, and code. Their use in requirements engineering raises important questions about correctness, traceability, and hallucination, especially because flawed specifications can affect later design, implementation, and verification activities. While much recent work on AI-assisted software engineering has focused on code generation and code-level validation, the validation of AI-generated specifications has received less attention. This paper addresses this gap by presenting a validation-oriented approach for AI-generated acceptance criteria. The approach combines retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-model generation, and an explicitly structured human-in-the-loop workflow. We describe a working prototype that allows users to prepare or enter user stories, generate acceptance criteria using several LLMs, optionally augment generation with retrieved requirements-related examples, compare outputs side by side, inspect retrieved context, and select, edit, or regenerate candidate criteria before explicitly submitting a reviewer-finalized version. The system also records model outputs, user interventions, retrieval settings, and final criteria as part of a logged decision process. Rather than claiming that generation accuracy is already improved, the contribution of this work is to operationalize validation as an explicit, inspectable, and accountable process for AI-generated requirements artifacts.

</details>


### [461] [Generating Property-Based Regression Tests from Source Code Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32636)
*Clemens Bauer,Johann Glock,Martin Pinzger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出基于多路径符号执行(SE)直接从源码语义生成属性回归测试：为每条路径记录路径条件、符号返回值与状态变更映射，构成Hoare三元组并编译为可执行属性，辅以基于搜索的常规单元测试补全覆盖。EqBench上82.0%方法保留有效属性，平均变异分数63.8%，优于EvoSuite(55.2%)和Teralizer(60.3%)；TOGBench上仅2.8%方法保留有效属性，变异分数48.6%，低于EvoSuite(50.9%)和Teralizer(51.1%)，主要因测试生成失败导致部分类缺乏有效测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单元测试(CUT)只在固定具体输入上检验方法，若该输入即便存在缺陷仍产生期望输出，就可能漏检回归；属性测试(PBT)能在大量随机输入上检验全称量化规范，但手写属性与输入生成器困难。现有自动化PBT方法通过泛化已有或生成的单元测试套件来构造属性，但要么在重复测试间过度近似具体输入，要么沿具体测试执行做单路径符号分析，均不够精确。

Method: 通过多路径符号执行从源码语义直接导出属性回归测试。对目标方法的每条探索路径记录路径语义，包括路径条件、符号返回值及状态变更映射；每个路径语义诱导一个Hoare三元组，并编译为可执行属性。由于符号执行会留下部分类未规格化，方法再辅以基于搜索的CUT覆盖整个类。实现为Java工具，并在EqBench及TOGBench的11个项目上与EvoSuite和测试泛化工具Teralizer对比评估。

Result: 在EqBench上，方法对82.0%的方法保留了有效属性，平均变异分数63.8%，高于EvoSuite的55.2%和Teralizer的60.3%。在TOGBench上，受目标选择、符号执行局限和属性验证限制，仅2.8%的方法保留有效属性，平均变异分数48.6%，低于EvoSuite的50.9%和Teralizer的51.1%；差距主要源于测试生成过程中的失败导致少数类缺乏有效测试。

Conclusion: 基于多路径符号执产生Hoare三元组属性并结合搜索式单元测试的方法在小规模基准(EqBench)上显著优于现有工具，但在真实项目(TOGBench)上受SE可扩展性与生成失败制约，覆盖面与变异分数不及对比工具，未来需提升符号执行处理与生成鲁棒性。

Abstract: Conventional unit tests (CUTs) check a method under test at fixed concrete inputs. A test can therefore miss a regression if its input produces the expected output despite a fault. Property-based testing (PBT) checks universally quantified specifications across many randomly generated inputs, but writing properties and input generators by hand is difficult. Existing approaches automate PBT creation by generalizing an existing or generated unit test suite. They either over-approximate concrete inputs across repetitive tests or apply single-path symbolic analysis along concrete test runs. This paper presents an approach that derives property-based regression tests directly from source code semantics via multipath symbolic execution (SE). For each explored path through a target method, the approach records a path semantics comprising the path condition, the symbolic return value, and the state change map. Each path semantics induces a Hoare triple that compiles into an executable property. Because SE leaves parts of a class unspecified, the approach complements the generated properties with search-based CUTs for the whole class. We evaluate our Java implementation against EvoSuite and the test generalization tool Teralizer on EqBench and on 11 projects from TOGBench. On EqBench, our approach keeps validated properties for 82.0% of all methods. Its mean mutation score of 63.8% exceeds the 55.2% of EvoSuite and the 60.3% of Teralizer. On TOGBench, target selection, SE limitations, and property validation restrict validated properties to 2.8% of all methods. The resulting mean mutation score of 48.6% falls below the 50.9% of EvoSuite and the 51.1% of Teralizer. Failures during test generation leave a few classes without effective tests and lead to this gap.

</details>


### [462] [The Elephant-Goldfish Model for software design review: what a fresh reviewer can see](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32668)
*Sabry E. Farrag*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 实验表明，将设计文档连同其起草对话一起提供给"新鲜"评审智能体，可大幅提升遗漏决策（62.4%→94.8%）和仅存于对话中的需求违例（98.3%）的检出率，而对文档中可见缺陷的召回率无显著差异（87.5% vs 88.4%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受Google "Elephant-Goldfish Model"启发：让无上下文的"新鲜"智能体评审设计虽有助理解，却会遗漏产生该设计的对话中隐含的决策。作者想检验"是否有上下文"如何影响自动化设计评审对不同类型缺陷（遗漏决策、对话约束违例、文档内可见缺陷）的检出能力，并区分两个评审目标：测试新读者能否重建设计，与检验设计是否保留了支配实现的决策。

Method: 在47份公开软件设计文档中各植入9个缺陷，并为每份配备脚本化的起草对话。对比同一模型在"带对话作为其先前交流"与"仅给文档"两种条件下的检出表现；使用三名模型评审进行打分，并在构造的对照样本上校准；另比较了插件的五阶段评审（几何均值9.03分钟）与单一评审者（1.81分钟）的耗时，以及后续的通用提示词对照实验。

Result: 带对话评审检出94.8%的遗漏决策实例（仅文档为62.4%），检出98.3%的对话专属需求违例；对文档可见缺陷召回为87.5%（带对话）与88.4%（无对话），在预设的15个百分点等效区间内视为等价。仅文档运行时插件更慢（9.03 vs 1.81分钟），估计召回更低，两种评判程序下均偏低、其中一种差异显著异于零；通用提示词对照结果类似。

Conclusion: 设计评审存在两个可分离的目标：检验新读者能否重建设计，与检验设计是否保留治理实现的决策。仅给文档有利于前者，但会系统性遗漏决策相关的缺陷；将起草对话纳入上下文可显著改善后者的检出，而几乎不损害文档可见缺陷的检出。

Abstract: A design can be easy to understand and still specify the wrong system. Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model asks fresh agents to review a design without the conversation that produced it. We examined how this choice affects detection of omissions, agreement violations and internal defects. We seeded nine defects in each of 47 public software design documents and supplied each with a scripted drafting conversation. A fresh reviewer given the conversation as its own earlier exchange detected 94.8% of omitted-decision instances, compared with 62.4% for the same model given the document alone. It detected 98.3% of violations of conversation-only requirements. On document-visible defects, recall was 87.5% with the conversation and 88.4% without it, equivalent within a prespecified 15-percentage-point margin. Three model judges scored detection and were calibrated on constructed controls. In document-only runs, the plugin's five-stage review took a geometric mean of 9.03 minutes against 1.81 for one reviewer. Its estimated recall was lower under both judging procedures, with a difference distinguishable from zero under one. A later generic-prompt comparison gave a similar result. The experiment separates two objectives for automated design review: testing whether a new reader can reconstruct the design and checking whether the design preserves the decisions that govern implementation.

</details>


### [463] [AI-Generated Code Issues: A Taxonomy from Repository Histories, AI Conversations, and Developer Interviews](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32676)
*Rosalia Tufano,Nargiz Humbatova,Daniele Bifolco,Gunel Jahangirova,Fiorella Zampetti,Massimiliano Di Penta,Paolo Tonella,Gabriele Bavota*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文通过混合方法实证研究了AI生成代码中的质量问题，构建了包含87种开发者归因质量问题类型的分类体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于生成源代码，但其代码质量问题尚未被充分理解。理解这些问题有助于开发者调整代码审查和测试等质量保障实践，以更好检测AI生成代码中可能比人写代码更常见的问题。

Method: 混合方法实证研究，基于三个互补证据来源：(1) 挖掘GitHub提交信息中明确将修复归因于AI生成代码问题的commit，人工检查914个匹配commit以剔除误报并分类；(2) 收集开发者与AI工具共享的对话，识别含源代码和模型错误文本信号的对话，人工分析其中299个；(3) 访谈20位使用AI编程工具的从业者和研究者以丰富和验证所得分类。

Result: 从上述分析中得出包含87种开发者归因的AI生成代码质量问题类型的分类体系，涵盖超出功能缺陷的多种问题。

Conclusion: 研究贡献了一个有实证基础的分类体系，以及对AI编程助手和智能体设计与评估的启示。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate source code, yet the quality issues in such code remain only partially understood. Understanding these issues can help developers adapt quality assurance practices, such as code review and testing, to better detect problems that may be more common in AI-generated than in human-written code. We study how quality issues in AI-generated code manifest in real software development activities through a mixed-method empirical study that draws on evidence from three complementary sources. First, we mine GitHub commits whose messages explicitly attribute a fix to a problem in AI-generated code, and we manually inspect the 914 matched commits to remove false positives and classify the quality issue being corrected. Second, we collect developers' shared conversations with AI tools, identify conversations including source code and textual signals of model mistakes, and manually analyze 299 of them to classify the underlying quality issue. Third, we interview 20 practitioners and researchers who use AI coding tools to enrich and validate the obtained catalog of quality issues. From these analyses, we derive a taxonomy of 87 types of developer-attributed quality issues in AI-generated code, going beyond functional bugs. Our findings contribute an empirically grounded taxonomy and implications for the design and evaluation of AI coding assistants and agents.

</details>


### [464] [Energy as a Service-Level Objective: Transaction-Level Energy Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32731)
*Julian Legler*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文（研究提案）探讨如何将能耗目标从单纯的报告指标转化为可操作的工程工具，借鉴SRE在可靠性领域的SLI/SLO/响应策略范式，提出将"有用工作语义、能耗归因、服务级工程决策"三条线索整合为可实验评估的方法论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务工程师评估变更时关注功能需求及可靠性、性能、可用性等质量，但能耗很少被纳入。变更后能耗上升时团队无法判断是否值得调查或接受，且追踪、重试或共享组件的变更可能影响超出被修改组件的能耗。现有工作多在组件层面、与决策脱节。作者希望像SRE为可靠性所做的那样，让能耗目标成为可行动的工程工具。

Method: 以SRE为指导思想，研究能耗与SRE的类比在何处成立、何处失效。将三条线索连成一个经实验评估的方法论：(1) 有用工作语义定义何为成功交易（如"在给定负载条件下每次成功交易的能耗约束"）；(2) 能耗归因把共享与辅助能耗分摊到交易；(3) 服务级工程决策基于由此产生的能耗目标行动。计划在受控的可观测性配置变更与注入故障下，比较聚合、请求归一化和基于有用工作的三类指标。

Result: 尚无最终结果（属研究计划）。已有前期工作表明：服务级能耗建模中辅助服务的能耗常被忽视且难以测量。计划中的实验将回答一个开放问题——这些决策是否需要交易级归因，还是服务级归因加结果计数即可。

Conclusion: 论文主张将能耗目标构建为服务级工程决策工具而非报告指标，提出可实验检验的方法论，并以实验判定交易级归因的必要性，从而弥补现有能耗研究与工程决策脱节的空白。

Abstract: Service engineers assess every change against functional requirements and qualities such as reliability, performance and availability. Energy is rarely part of this assessment. When consumption rises after a change, the team cannot tell whether the increase is worth investigating, worth accepting, or neither. A change to tracing, retries or a shared component can affect consumption far beyond the modified component. This thesis asks how energy objectives can become actionable engineering instruments rather than reporting metrics. Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) answered a similar question for reliability with service-level indicators, objectives and response policies. We take SRE as the guiding research vision and study where the analogy holds for energy and where it breaks. An energy objective could, for example, bound the energy per successful transaction under stated workload conditions. The thesis connects three threads into one experimentally evaluated methodology. Useful-work semantics define what a successful transaction is. Energy attribution assigns shared and auxiliary consumption to transactions. Service-level engineering decisions act on the resulting energy objectives. Existing work covers attribution methods, measurement frameworks and sustainability objectives, mostly at component level and without a link to decisions. Our prior work on service-level energy modeling showed that the energy of auxiliary services is often overlooked and hard to measure. Planned experiments compare aggregate, request-normalized and useful-work-based indicators under controlled changes to observability configuration and injected failures. Whether transaction-level attribution is needed for these decisions, or whether service-level attribution with outcome counts is sufficient, is an open question the experiments are designed to answer.

</details>


### [465] [How Use Case Tables Enable the Elicitation of Explanation Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32809)
*Lucas Burgath,Jovita Vahlhaus,Jakob Droste,Hannah Deters,Kurt Schneider*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探讨了利用用例(use case)描述来引出用户"解释需求"(explanation needs)的新思路，并通过用户研究验证了用例步骤足以触发解释需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着软件系统日益复杂并深度融入日常生活（如驾驶辅助、智能家居），用户对软件"解释"的需求可能随之产生。目前解释需求通常通过原型测试或现有软件测试来获取，成本较高且依赖软件已存在；而用例表等交互文档能在早期提供系统关键交互信息，因此作者设想其可作为引出解释需求的替代资源，但这一可行性此前尚不明确。

Method: 作者开展了一项用户研究，让参与者阅读从现有软件中提取的用例描述部分，要求他们在阅读过程中报告所遇到的任何解释需求。

Result: 研究发现，用例步骤本身就足以在被试阅读步骤时诱发解释需求。

Conclusion: 本文提出了将用例用于解释需求引出的新概念，并通过对利益相关者的研究验证了该概念的适用性，证明用例可作为一种有效的解释需求获取资源。

Abstract: [Context and motivation] While software systems get more integrated into people's daily lives - like driver-assistance systems or smart-home applications - they are also becoming increasingly complex. When complex software is used, needs for explanations may arise. At present, explanation needs are usually elicited through the testing of prototypes or existing software. However, detailed documentation of software interactions, such as use case tables, might be a suitable alternative. Since use cases provide early insights into the key interactions within the system, they are appealing to employ as resources for explanation needs. [Question/problem] As of now, it remains unclear whether use cases allow the elicitation of explanation needs. Or, from a different perspective, whether their utilization for this purpose is desirable. [Principal ideas/results] We conducted a study in which users perused the description sections of use cases extracted from existing software. While reading through these use cases, they reported any explanation needs they encountered. Our findings indicate that use case steps are sufficient to induce explanation needs in the participants as they read the steps. [Contribution] This paper explores the novel idea of utilizing use cases for the elicitation of explanation needs and reports on a study that provides insights into the applicability of this concept with stakeholders.

</details>


### [466] [SpecEngineeringBench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Autonomous Specification Engineers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32973)
*Xingjian Wang,Shijian Wang,Minghao Liu,Ji Zou,Zetao Yang,Xinping Lei,Yiming Liang,Shen Yan,Enduo Zhao,Xiaoyang Shen,Weihao Xuan,Jiaheng Liu,Ge Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 SpecEngineeringBench，用 100 个 Python 仓库实例评估编码智能体从需求到测试、再到缺陷发现的自主能力，发现测试有效性与缺陷曝光能力脱钩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准提供了 issue 描述、指定测试入口或待检查文件等明确线索，绕过了"要测什么、去哪调查"这一核心挑战，未能充分评估智能体将需求映射到实现并主动发现未知缺陷的能力。

Method: 构建 SpecEngineeringBench，包含来自 78 个开源 Python 仓库（16 类应用）的 100 个实例，每个实例含多个已记录缺陷。设置两个独立任务：生成测试套件、通过执行分析发现缺陷。评估指标结合测试有效性、缺陷检测、覆盖率及定位精确率/召回率。

Result: 七个前沿编码智能体达到 91.47% Head Pass Rate 与 80.48% Change-focused Coverage，但 Fail-to-Pass Rate 仅 26.36%；定位召回率从文件级 78.11% 降至函数级 51.29%。自主测试生成相比仅依赖已有测试套件，将文件、函数、hunk 定位召回率分别提升 4.99、2.77、2.69 个百分点。

Conclusion: 测试有效性与覆盖率并不保证缺陷发现能力；自主测试生成可显著提升缺陷定位效果，揭示当前智能体在需求到实现的映射与未知缺陷挖掘方面仍有较大提升空间。

Abstract: Autonomous specification engineering requires coding agents to translate functional requirements into executable tests and use the results to discover and validate defects. However, existing benchmarks evaluate coding agents on explicitly specified test generation tasks, commonly providing an issue description, a designated test entry point, or files to inspect, leaving the ability to determine what to test and where to investigate insufficiently evaluated. Relying on such clues bypasses the challenge of mapping requirements to implementations and proactively uncovering unknown defects. We propose SpecEngineeringBench, comprising 100 instances from 78 open-source Python repositories across 16 application categories, with multiple recorded defects in each instance. Two independent tasks evaluate complementary capabilities: generating test suites and discovering defects through execution analysis. The evaluation combines test validity, defect detection, and coverage with localization precision and recall. Across seven frontier coding agents, results reveal that test validity and coverage decouple from defect exposure: agents achieve a 91.47% Head Pass Rate and 80.48% Change-focused Coverage alongside a 26.36% Fail-to-Pass Rate, while localization recall drops from 78.11% at the file level to 51.29% at the function level. Autonomous test generation improves file, function, and hunk localization recall by 4.99, 2.77, and 2.69 percentage points over relying solely on existing repository test suites.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [467] [Local subspace encoding for spectral prediction: from TabPFN to operator-adaptive calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31245)
*Gregory Beurier,Robin Reiter,Denis Cornet,Lauriane Rouan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估LVSE与GCU两种光谱表示在nirs4all数据集上对TabPFN及经典校准模型（PLS、Ridge）的帮助，发现LVSE显著且稳定提升性能，GCU可靠性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RamanPFN提出的GCU与LVSE表示此前仅在近红外光谱上验证；作者想检验它们在nirs4all生态数据集上是否同样有效，以及其价值能否延伸到经典校准方法。

Method: 重新分析公开光谱数据集目录中已完成的实验：在61个匹配的数值预测任务（排除10个类别码/元数据/语义模糊目标）上比较LVSE与原始光谱TabPFN；在76个分类数据集上评估（含对2.5检查点的15个超类数数据集使用输出编码）；同时测试LVSE对PLS与Ridge的提升，并在AOM基准的35任务面板上检验其加入算子自适应模型的效果。
