Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/Noise-Level-Adjacency-in-Diffusion-Training.

</details>


### [502] [Eliciting sandbagged LLM capability via structural interventions on attention-head functional networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31615)
*Manzi Fabrice Niyigaba,Ishan Verma Prasad,Sansheng Cao,Zheng Huang,Yujun Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从内部功能组织的角度研究AI模型的"蓄意能力隐藏"（sandbagging），发现蓄意隐藏能力时注意力头功能图中社群内部连通性系统性降低，并利用该信号恢复被隐藏的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进AI系统的能力评估可能被sandbagging（模型策略性地压制自身具备的能力）破坏。已有工作多关注检测或诱导隐藏能力，但对能力被压制时模型内部神经计算如何变化知之甚少，缺乏机制层面的理解。

Method: 受网络神经科学启发，从注意力头激活构建功能图（functional graph），在模型架构与权重固定不变的前提下，比较诚实与sandbagging两种条件下的功能图组织，并跨多种模型架构与社群检测方法进行验证；随后消融连通性变化最大的注意力头，并将结构信号融入现有的推理层与权重层诱导方法。

Result: 跨架构与社群检测方法一致发现：sandbagging对应检测到的社群内部功能连通性降低。消融变化最大的注意力头可显著恢复被压制的性能，同时基本保持诚实行为下的性能；引入该结构信号还能进一步提升现有推理层和权重层诱导方法的效果。

Conclusion: sandbagging伴随内部计算的系统性重组；功能网络结构既为理解能力压制提供机制视角，也为恢复隐藏能力提供实用信号。

Abstract: Reliably evaluating the capabilities of advanced AI systems is critical for safe development and deployment, yet such evaluations may be undermined by sandbagging, a situation in which a model strategically suppresses capabilities it possesses. Existing work has developed controlled sandbagging settings and methods for detecting or eliciting hidden capabilities, but comparatively little is known about how a model's internal neural computation changes when its capabilities are suppressed. In this work, we study sandbagging through the lens of internal functional organization. Inspired by network neuroscience, we construct functional graphs from attention-head activations and compare their organization under honest and sandbagging conditions while holding the model architecture and weights fixed. Surprisingly, across model architectures and community detection methods, we find a consistent structural signature in which sandbagging is associated with reduced functional connectivity within detected communities. We further demonstrate that this reorganization can guide capability elicitation. Ablating attention heads that exhibit the largest connectivity changes substantially recovers suppressed performance while largely preserving performance under honest behavior. Moreover, incorporating these structural signals further improves existing inference-level and weight-level elicitation methods. Together, our results show that sandbagging is accompanied by systematic reorganization of internal computation and demonstrate that functional network structure can provide both a mechanistic lens for understanding capability suppression and a practical signal for recovering hidden capabilities.

</details>


### [503] [What a Forecasting Leaderboard Can Establish: Resolution Reporting for Zero-Shot Time-Series Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31619)
*Arya Sikder,Sriram Pillutla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"榜单分辨率"概念与工具Vernier，用榜单已公开的逐数据集得分计算其能区分的最小差距；发现GIFT-Eval、fev-bench、Chronos II、TIME等主流榜单分辨率远粗于相邻排名差距，排名受提交池影响，且榜单未记录历史长度这一关键变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型的证据主要来自少数公开榜单，但无人说明这些榜单能检测到多小的差异；排名差异可能小于榜单的分辨力，甚至取决于同期谁提交了什么。

Method: 定义榜单"分辨率"，开发Vernier工具，从榜单发布的逐数据集得分文件自动计算分辨率、不可区分的条目、提交池变化导致的排名翻转；并在70组配置上做历史长度消融实验。

Result: GIFT-Eval分辨率6.8个名次而相邻仅差0.91，其前十不足两个可分辨步；fev-bench、Chronos Benchmark II、TIME的分辨率是相邻差距的3.6–19倍；BOOM（2,554条序列视作独立来源）是唯一能分辨前十的榜单。四个榜单中，相对池排名规则在一次更新中（七次之一）翻转43对前十组合且无重跑。缩短历史长度使3/4开放模型误差上升，其中两个升15%。

Conclusion: 主流时间序列榜单无法分辨其展示的排名差异，排名不稳健，且缺失输入长度等元数据；呼吁报告分辨率并公开Vernier（一条命令即可运行）。

Abstract: A foundation model for time series is pretrained once and then asked to forecast series it has never seen, so the evidence for it is its score on held-out datasets. Such datasets are scarce, and a few public leaderboards carry most comparisons, yet none of them states how small a difference its datasets can detect. We call that quantity the resolution of a board and introduce Vernier, a tool that computes it from the files a board already publishes. Vernier also reports which entries a board cannot separate from its leader and whether its order changes when unrelated parties submit. GIFT-Eval resolves 6.8 rank places, and its displayed neighbours sit 0.91 apart. The ten places of its top ten hold fewer than two resolvable steps. fev-bench, Chronos Benchmark II and TIME show the same pattern: their resolution is 3.6 to 19 times the gap between neighbours. With each of its 2,554 series as an independent source, BOOM is the one board that resolves its top ten. Below the resolution the order depends on who else submitted: across four boards, rules that rank against the pool reversed 43 top-ten pairs with neither entry rerun, in one update in seven. Boards also do not record how much history a model receives. On 70 configurations, shortening it raised the error of three of four open models, two of them by 15%. We release Vernier, which runs this report with one command on any leaderboard that publishes per-dataset scores: https://github.com/therealram18/vernier

</details>


### [504] [Reward Basis Decomposition for Interpreting Preference Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31640)
*Mohamed I. Eldagla,Ifesi Onubogu,Prerana Rane,Harsh Sharma,Rachel Freedman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Reward Basis Decomposition (RBD)，将奖励模型的每用户权重拆分为群体项与个体项，分别用概念对齐和稀疏自编码器分析，发现群体共享方向足以解释绝大多数偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有奖励模型可解释性方法只处理单一奖励头，无法区分人群中共享的价值与个体间差异的价值，这对AI对齐评估是不足的。

Method: RBD把每用户奖励权重分解为群体项和每用户项，得到共享群体方向与个体用户方向，再分别通过概念对齐与稀疏自编码器分解进行分析；先用合成对照实验验证能恢复人为植入的个体方向，再应用于PRISM和Community Alignment两个真实多偏好数据集。

Result: 在合成对照中RBD能成功恢复植入的个体方向；在两个真实数据集上未发现可靠的个体用户结构，拟合出的个体项相比共享群体方向没有带来可靠的预测增益。

Conclusion: 奖励嵌入空间中单一共享方向即可解释大部分偏好，个体差异结构在现有设置下不明显；代码与合成数据集已开源。

Abstract: Canonical reward models specify the optimization target for AI policies, so understanding the values they encode is important for ensuring AI alignment. Existing interpretability techniques interpret reward models with a single reward head, which cannot distinguish between the values that a population shares and those that vary among individuals. We introduce Reward Basis Decomposition (RBD), which splits per-user weights into a population term and a per-user term. This yields a shared population direction and individual user directions that are analyzed separately via concept alignment and sparse autoencoder decomposition. We verify that RBD can recover artificially planted per-user directions on a synthetic control, then apply it to two real-world multi-preference datasets, PRISM and Community Alignment. In both, we find no individual-user structure, suggesting that a single direction in the reward embedding space accounts for most preferences. We verify that RBD can recover artificially planted per-user directions on a synthetic control, then apply it to two real-world multi-preference datasets, PRISM and Community Alignment. In both, we find no reliable predictive benefit from the fitted per-user terms beyond the shared population direction under our setup. Code and the synthetic dataset are available at https://github.com/RachelFreedman/RBD.

</details>


### [505] [Boundary Representation-Driven Graph Transformer Modeling for Machining Operation Sequencing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31661)
*Fatemeh Elhambakhsh,Gaurav Ameta,Aditi Roy,Hyunwoong Ko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出基于图Transformer的“几何到序列”学习框架，直接从B-Rep设计几何预测加工工序序列，无需中间特征提取或加工状态表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加工工艺规划复杂，零件几何、加工操作与可制造状态相互依赖；传统方法依赖专家知识与规则系统，难以扩展与自动化。现有机器学习方法多使用体素或手工特征等简化几何表示，未充分利用B-Rep中丰富的几何与拓扑信息。

Method: 从B-Rep实体构建拓扑感知图，将面及其邻接关系编码为含几何与关系信息的节点/边特征；用图神经网络编码器学习几何感知嵌入，并以此条件化双解码器Transformer，自回归生成加工工序序列，同时建模工序类型预测与工序级顺序约束。在包含2,991个合成加工零件的数据集上进行实验。

Result: 主工序预测准确率95%，子工序预测准确率64%，序列长度预测准确率93%；进一步分析显示模型有效捕捉了加工过程中的先后关系与几何相关约束。

Conclusion: 结果显示了B-Rep驱动的图学习在可扩展、自动化加工工艺规划方面的潜力。

Abstract: Machining process planning is inherently complex due to the interdependence between part geometry, machining operations, and evolving manufacturable states. Traditional approaches rely heavily on expert knowledge and rule-based systems, limiting scalability and automation. While recent machine learning methods have shown promise, most operate on simplified geometric representations, such as voxels or hand-crafted features, which fail to fully exploit the rich geometric and topological information encoded in Boundary Representation (B-Rep) models. In this work, we propose a graph transformer-based framework for geometry-to-sequence learning that directly predicts machining operation sequences from B-Rep design geometry. The proposed method constructs topology-aware graphs from B-Rep entities, where faces and their adjacencies are encoded as node and edge features capturing both geometric and relational information. A graph neural network encoder learns geometry-aware embeddings, which are then used to condition a dual-decoder transformer that autoregressively generates machining operation sequences. This formulation enables the model to capture both operation-type prediction and process-level ordering constraints directly from design geometry, without requiring intermediate feature extraction or machining-state representations. Experiments on a dataset of 2,991 synthetic machined parts demonstrate strong performance, achieving 95% accuracy for main operation prediction, 64% accuracy for sub-operation prediction, and 93% accuracy for sequence length prediction. Further analysis shows that the model effectively captures precedence relationships and geometry-dependent constraints inherent in machining processes. These results highlight the potential of B-Rep-driven graph learning for scalable and automated machining process planning.

</details>


### [506] [Neural Interoperability Protocols: Specifying Compatibility Before Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31670)
*Alireza Bagheri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Neural Interoperability Protocols (NIPs)，一个"规范优先"的框架，将神经网络间的兼容性定义为公开的接口义务（交换边界、数据包语义与可接受条件、接收方须支持的下游计算），并通过检索、视觉、连续记忆实验区分"已演示的互操作性"与更强的符合性主张。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立训练的神经网络中间表示难以跨模型交换。现有方法虽能对齐表示或促成特征兼容，但"某对模型间迁移成功"并不能界定未来实现需满足何种条件才能互操作，缺乏公开的接口规范。

Method: 提出 NIP 规范框架：规定交换边界、交换数据包的语义与可接受条件、接收方必须支持的下游计算，且独立于具体架构与训练过程。实验包括独立的检索、视觉与连续记忆任务，涉及独立训练模型、不同架构与目标、以及后续训练批次；并设置匹配能力对照、共享语义监督、信息扣留实验、部分契约实验与数据包干预。

Result: 匹配能力对照表明原生任务成功并不保证互操作性；共享语义监督在实验设定下带来显著直接迁移；信息扣留实验显示接收方可继续依赖供体交换时不可得信息的计算；部分契约与数据包干预表明兼容性取决于所评估的语义、数据包群体与接收方续算。

Conclusion: 公开的神经接口规范可作为设计前瞻性组件交换的框架，并能区分已演示的互操作性与更强的符合性主张。

Abstract: Neural networks are increasingly developed as reusable components, yet their intermediate representations remain difficult to exchange across independently trained models. Existing approaches can align representations or encourage compatible features, but successful transfer between particular models does not by itself define what future implementations must satisfy to interoperate. We introduce Neural Interoperability Protocols (NIPs), a specification-first framework that treats neural compatibility as a set of public interface obligations rather than a property inferred solely from model-pair performance. A NIP specifies an exchange boundary, the semantics and admissibility conditions of exchanged packets, and the downstream computations that recipients must support, independently of the architectures and training procedures implementing it. We investigate this distinction through controlled retrieval, vision, and continuous-memory experiments involving independently trained models, differing architectures and objectives, and later training cohorts. Matched-competence controls demonstrate that native task success does not ensure interoperability, while shared semantic supervision enables substantial direct transfer in the evaluated settings. Withheld-information experiments show that recipient models can continue computations requiring information unavailable to donors at exchange time. Partial-contract experiments and packet interventions further establish that observed compatibility is conditional on the semantics, packet populations, and recipient continuations being evaluated. Together, these results support public neural interface specifications as a framework for designing prospective component exchange and distinguishing demonstrated interoperability from stronger conformance claims.

</details>


### [507] [Curvature-Equilibrated Policy Optimization for Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31680)
*Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 EQUIP，一种通过对 actor 损失函数局部正负曲率进行均衡化来调整梯度的方法，并集成到 SAC 中，在 6 个 MuJoCo 任务上取得更高样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规一阶优化器（如 Adam）在优化 neural actor 时未显式利用 actor 损失的局部曲率信息；而二阶方法虽有曲率信息但开销大或稳定性不足，因此需要一种既能利用曲率又保持一阶效率的 actor 优化方案。

Method: EQUIP 构建轨迹引导（trajectory-informed）的搜索子空间，利用投影 Hessian 构造有界的局部度量以均衡正负曲率；通过一阶损失匹配保持近似的 actor 损失一阶下降量，并结合梯度混合（gradient mixing）与基于曲率的梯度选择来调整实际用于 actor 更新的梯度。理论上给出曲率均衡的几何性质、梯度对齐与幅度的界，以及直接梯度更新下 actor 损失改进与收敛至稳定点的条件。实现上不改动 SAC 的 actor 损失、critic 学习和回放机制。

Result: 在 6 个 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上，EQUIP-SAC 的平均样本效率高于 SAC 及两个二阶策略优化基线；消融实验显示曲率均衡与轨迹引导几何均对策略训练有正面贡献。

Conclusion: 在 actor 优化中引入有界局部曲率均衡是一种实用且有效的手段，可在保持一阶优化简洁性的同时提升深度 RL 的样本效率。

Abstract: Gradient-based actor optimization is central to deep reinforcement learning. However, conventional first-order optimizers do not explicitly exploit the local curvature of neural actor losses. We propose EQUIP (Curvature-Equilibrated Gradients for Policy Search), a novel approach that seeks to balance local contraction and expansion of the actor parameter space by equilibrating positive and negative curvature. EQUIP constructs a trajectory-informed search subspace and uses the projected Hessian of actor loss to build a bounded local metric for curvature equilibration. First-order loss matching preserves the approximated first-order decrease in actor loss. Meanwhile, gradient mixing and curvature-based gradient selection adjust the gradient applied for actor optimization. We establish the geometric properties of curvature equilibration, derive bounds on gradient alignment and magnitude, and identify conditions for improved actor loss reduction and convergence toward stationarity under direct gradient updates. We integrate EQUIP into Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) without modifying its actor loss, critic learning, or replay mechanism. Experiments on 6 MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks show that the resulting EQUIP-SAC algorithm achieves higher mean sample efficiency than SAC and two second-order policy optimization baselines. Ablation studies further highlight the benefits of curvature equilibration and trajectory-informed geometry for policy training.

</details>


### [508] [Tokenization and Architecture Jointly Allocate Component Roles in Time Series Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31730)
*Mingyu Kim,Doguk Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出时序探针框架，用15个token级诊断任务测量Transformer子层对时序特征的构建作用，发现特征构建的"主力组件"由tokenization与架构共同决定：patch tokenization下FFN远胜attention，variate tokenization下attention主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序Transformer预测性能强，但尚不清楚究竟是attention还是FFN在构建时序特征，也不清楚patching等tokenization方式如何改变这一分工。作者希望用可量化的表征探针回答"哪个组件在建特征"。

Method: 构建时序探针框架：用15个token级诊断任务，以"线性可解码性从一层到下一层的增益"来量化特征构建（对照MLP探针在embedding处即饱和）。应用于5个有监督模型、8个长期预测基准。并通过激活patching、knockout、去掉attention重训等干预验证组件的依赖性与充分性；还做了P=1/P=2的token化控制实验。

Result: PatchTST（patch tokenization）下FFN的探针增益在全部8个数据集上超过attention，均值达attention的3.2倍；去掉attention后FFN单独几乎达到相同总增益，重训模型预测误差仅差几个百分点。iTransformer（variate tokenization）下attention主导；CATS中cross-attention是唯一输入路径。P=1时FFN构建几乎消失，P=2即恢复。

Conclusion: 特征构建组件并非固定，而由tokenization与架构交互分配。该结果为patching带来增益、无自注意力模型（TSMixer、PatchMLP）具竞争力、以及CATS中cross-attention的特殊作用等既有发现提供了表征层面的解释。

Abstract: Time series transformers have achieved strong forecasting performance, yet it remains unclear which of their components, attention or the feed-forward network (FFN), constructs temporal features, and how tokenization such as patching changes this. We propose a temporal probing framework that uses 15 token-level diagnostic tasks to measure feature construction as the gain in linear decodability of temporal properties from one sub-layer to the next (a matched MLP probe already saturates at the embedding). It targets models whose probed representations are read by a linear forecasting head. Applied to 5 supervised models trained on 8 long-term forecasting benchmarks, it finds that the constructing component is not fixed but allocated by the interaction of tokenization and architecture. Under patch tokenization (PatchTST), the FFN's gain exceeds attention's in probing on all 8 datasets, and its 8-dataset mean is 3.2x attention's. Without attention, the FFN alone reaches nearly the same total gain, both when attention is removed from a trained model and when PatchTST is trained without it, and the retrained model forecasts within a few percent of the full model. In probing, attention dominates under variate tokenization (iTransformer); in CATS, cross-attention is the only input path. In a controlled manipulation of PatchTST, single-scalar tokens (P=1) nearly eliminate the FFN's construction, while one more point per token (P=2) restores it. Our forecasting-side interventions (activation patching, knockout, and training without attention) establish component-level reliance and sufficiency. These results offer a representational reading of prior findings on the gains from patching, the competitiveness of self-attention-free models (TSMixer, PatchMLP), and the distinct role of cross-attention in CATS.

</details>


### [509] [Geo-SMILE: Statistical Model-Agnostic Interpretability with Local Explanations for Geospatial Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31731)
*Shadieh Mohammadi,Koorosh Aslansefat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Geo-SMILE，一个模型无关的事后解释框架，通过互补扰动分支将实质特征解释与地理位置响应分开，并在三个空间预测任务上验证了代理保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统事后解释方法主要面向非空间输入，对地理语境缺乏显式处理，难以区分"特征贡献"与"地理位置响应"。

Method: 基于SMILE的统计距离加权代理原则：Feature分支掩蔽实质预测因子、保留坐标；Geo分支在固定预测因子下重定位地理单元。用输入分布的Wasserstein距离确定联盟局部权重，以加权Ridge代理近似黑箱期望预测，并定义GeoSensitivity指标量化模型对地理参与者重定位的响应。

Result: 在Hull犯罪预测、Seattle房价预测、Chicago网约车需求三个任务上，留出加权代理保真度为：Feature分支R_w²=0.910–0.989，Geo分支R_w²=0.842–0.906。

Conclusion: 框架使地理位置成为事后解释的显式对象，但需分别评估其解释性、稳定性与参考依赖问题。

Abstract: Conventional post-hoc explanation methods were developed largely for non-spatial inputs and often provide limited explicit treatment of geographic context. We introduce Geo-SMILE, a model-agnostic framework that distinguishes substantive Feature explanation from geographic-position response through complementary perturbation branches. The Feature branch masks substantive predictors while retaining observed coordinates; the Geo branch relocates geographic units while holding substantive predictors fixed. Following the statistical-distance-weighted surrogate principle of SMILE, input-distribution Wasserstein distances determine coalition locality weights and weighted Ridge surrogates approximate expected black-box predictions. GeoSensitivity, signed in the keep orientation, quantifies fitted-model responses to geographic-player relocation under the specified design. Across crime prediction in Hull, housing-price prediction in Seattle and ride-hailing demand in Chicago, held-out weighted surrogate fidelity ranges from $R_w^2=0.910$ to $0.989$ in the Feature branch and from $0.842$ to $0.906$ in the Geo branch. The framework makes geographic position an explicit object of post-hoc explanation while requiring separate assessment of interpretation, stability and reference dependence.

</details>


### [510] [Byte Patches versus BPE at Matched Data: A Matched-Twin Comparison at 350M Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31790)
*Asadullah Maliyawala,Andrej Lisal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在相同原始字节、文档顺序与近似相同每步字节量下，对比MEGABYTE式字节patch Transformer（64字节滑动局部解码器）与8k BPE字节级解码器：BPE-8k在匹配span评分下bits-per-byte相对领先约5–9%，下游任务各有胜负（CharBench偏local64，fact200/PIQA/ARC-Easy偏BPE-8k），并指出多项评测陷阱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分词器研究多在固定token预算下变化子词分词器，或做FLOP受控的字节模型缩放对比，未回答"固定patch字节模型能否整体替代分词器"这一问题；本文在固定原始字节、顺序与优化配方条件下直接进行比较。

Method: 350M参数、100亿训练字节的两组"双胞胎"模型：一组为MEGABYTE式字节patch Transformer配64字节滑动局部解码器（local64），另一组为匹配的byte-level 8k BPE解码器；控制原始字节、文档顺序及每优化步约等字节量，采用匹配span的文档滑动（相同评分字节区间），以bits per byte为核心指标并用配对bootstrap检验。

Result: 匹配span下BPE-8k在bits per byte上领先，整体/文本/代码/数学相对差距分别为-5.2%、-4.9%、-9.3%、-6.1%。下游：CharBench等量微调local64更优（53.7% vs 40.0%），fact200 BPE-8k更优（16.5% vs 7.0%），PIQA（原始及长度归一化）与ARC-Easy长度归一化在Holm校正α=0.05下BPE-8k更优，其余任务持平。

Conclusion: 在严格控制字节与优化条件时，8k BPE在压缩指标上总体优于固定patch字节模型，但下游表现因任务而异，说明固定patch字节模型尚不能简单替代分词器。研究还揭示若干会改变结论的评测陷阱：超出BPE训练上下文的长度外推、把bits per token当作bits per byte报告、字节分母不一致。局限包括单一规模、单一种子、预先固定的单一8k词表，以及两模型嵌入初始化存在已知差异。

Abstract: We compare a MEGABYTE-style byte-patch Transformer with a 64-byte sliding local decoder (local64) to a matched byte-level 8k BPE decoder (BPE-8k) under identical raw bytes, document order, and approximately matched bytes per optimizer step: 350M parameters and 10 billion training bytes. Under matched-span document sliding (identical scored byte ranges), BPE-8k leads with relative gaps of -5.2%, -4.9%, -9.3% and -6.1% in bits per byte (overall, text, code, math; paired bootstrap). Downstream, CharBench equal fine-tuning favors local64 (53.7% vs 40.0%), fact200 favors BPE-8k (16.5% vs 7.0%), and PIQA (raw and length-normalized) and ARC-Easy length-normalized favor BPE-8k after Holm correction at alpha = 0.05; remaining tasks are ties. Evaluation pitfalls that changed conclusions include context-length extrapolation past the BPE training context, bits per token reported as bits per byte, and inconsistent byte denominators. Unlike controlled tokenizer studies that vary the subword tokenizer under a fixed token budget, or FLOP-controlled byte-model scaling studies, we hold the raw bytes, their order and the optimizer recipe fixed and ask whether a fixed-patch byte model can replace the tokenizer at all. Limits: one size, one seed, one 8k vocabulary fixed before the runs, and a known difference in embedding initialization between the twins.

</details>


### [511] [Two-Stage Post-Training for Flow-Based Embodied Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31850)
*Jiaming Zhang,Yao Lyu,Haoning Wang,Yongjun Chen,Liping Zhang,Shengbo Eben Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向流式具身模型的两阶段后训练框架：第一阶段用多教师在线策略蒸馏(MOPD)整合专家能力，第二阶段结合RL与按采样噪声加权的教师蒸馏（仅针对失败轨迹），实现超越教师的性能且样本效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模预训练赋予具身模型通用能力，但可靠任务执行仍需后训练。多任务下SFT存在训练-部署分布不匹配；RL受稀疏奖励与任务间学习进度不均限制；MOPD虽能提供密集监督但难以超越教师。

Method: 基于条件流匹配的速度回归形式构建蒸馏目标的两阶段框架：Stage 1通过MOPD高效整合专家能力；Stage 2将RL与教师蒸馏结合，按采样噪声对速度误差加权，且蒸馏仅限制在失败轨迹上，用密集引导补充稀疏奖励而不约束成功行为。

Result: 在多个模型与基准上，框架优于联合SFT，并超过对应教师的聚合成功率；样本效率对比显示，以更少环境交互达到比直接RL更高的成功率。

Conclusion: 将蒸馏与RL在流匹配速度回归框架下两阶段结合，可兼顾专家能力整合与超越教师，且样本高效，为流式具身模型后训练提供有效方案。

Abstract: Large-scale pretraining provides embodied models with general capabilities, but reliable task execution still requires post training. In multitask settings, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) faces distribution mismatch between training and deployment, whereas reinforcement learning (RL) is limited by sparse rewards and uneven learning progress across tasks. Multi-teacher on policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates expert capabilities through dense supervision on the model's own trajectories, but achieving performance beyond the teachers remains challenging. We propose a two-stage post training framework for flow-based embodied models, constructing distillation objectives from the velocity regression formulation of conditional flow matching. Stage 1 efficiently consolidates expert capabilities through MOPD. Stage 2 combines RL with teacher distillation that weights velocity errors according to the sampling noise, where distillation is restricted to failed trajectories to supplement sparse rewards with dense guidance without directly constraining successful behaviors. Experiments across multiple models and benchmarks show that the framework outperforms joint SFT and exceeds the corresponding teachers' aggregate success rates. Sample efficiency comparisons show higher success rates than direct RL with fewer environment interactions.

</details>


### [512] [Start Where the Data Are: Statistical Priors for One-Step Generation on Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31856)
*Yuyao Wang,Haoliang Sun,Xiankai Lu,Xinxin Zhang,Yongshun Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于数据统计先验与后验耦合的一步式流形生成框架，并扩展为隐马尔可夫先验处理长扭转角链，显著降低分布误差与蛋白结构异常率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流形上的一步生成对蛋白设计等科学任务很重要，但现有方法常在数据模态间的低密度空隙产生虚假样本。作者指出根源在于均匀噪声与集中数据之间的失配，因此需要一个能刻画数据粗结构的统计先验。

Method: 通过几何感知的矩匹配在切空间中拟合高斯混合来估计先验；引入后验耦合，按数据点采样隐变量分量并从该分量取配对噪声，避免独立配对跨模态连接；对长扭转角链用共享参数的隐马尔可夫先验建模序列依赖以控制成本。框架可直接嵌入现有一步训练流程，保持生成器结构、训练目标和单次网络推理。

Result: 在球面、环面和 SO(3) 上实验，多种生成器均有显著提升，分布误差最多降低 125 倍；蛋白 Ramachandran 异常率由 12.1% 降至 0.55%。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的流形统计先验结合后验耦合能有效抑制一步生成中的模态间虚假样本，并通过隐马尔可夫先验扩展到高维序列数据，是一种低侵入、可即插即用的改进方案。

Abstract: Fast generation on manifolds is important for scientific applications such as protein design, yet existing one-step generators often produce spurious samples in low-density gaps between data modes. Our analysis highlights the mismatch between uniform noise and concentrated data, motivating a statistical prior that captures the data's coarse structure. We first estimate this prior by fitting mixtures of tangent-space Gaussians through geometry-aware moment matching. However, independent noise-data pairing can still connect different modes and weaken the benefit of the fitted prior. We therefore introduce posterior coupling, which samples a latent component conditioned on each data point and draws its paired noise from that component. To extend this approach to long torsion-angle chains, where full-covariance mixtures become costly, we use a hidden Markov prior to model sequential dependence with shared parameters. The resulting framework plugs into existing one-step training pipelines while retaining the generator architecture, training objective, and single network evaluation at inference. Experiments on spheres, tori, and SO(3) demonstrate substantial improvements across multiple generators, reducing distributional error by up to $125\times$ and the protein Ramachandran outlier rate from 12.1% to 0.55%.

</details>


### [513] [Subliminal Learning Crosses Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31870)
*Saraswathy Amjith,Kimia Hamidieh,Antonio Torralba,Yoon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现文本层面的"潜意识学习"可跨模态迁移：通过数字序列将偏好（如动物主题）蒸馏给视觉-语言模型后，该偏好会改变其图像生成与表征，并揭示了其机制并提出weight lens方法识别潜藏特质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜意识学习现象（用一个看似无意义的数据如数字序列，把某个模型的偏好传给另一个模型）此前主要在文本模态中被观察到。作者希望探究这种迁移是否能跨越模态、影响视觉-语言模型的图像生成，并弄清其机制。

Method: 1) 用学生模型作为扩散模型的文本编码器，比较其与原模型生成的图像差异；2) 分析迁移机制与哪些概念可跨模态迁移（区分需要整体提示的概念如动物 vs 单token编码的颜色/风格）；3) 提出weight lens方法，从单个训练模型的权重中识别潜意识特质。

Result: 学生模型驱动的扩散模型更常生成学生的偏好动物，但颜色和风格不迁移；学生变化中的一个恒定分量解释了图像表征向该特质偏移的大部分原因，均匀加入该分量可改变生成动物但无法改变颜色/风格；weight lens能识别几乎每个学生的特质，包括未在生成图像中显现的特质。

Conclusion: 文本潜意识学习可跨模态迁移并影响图像生成与表征；迁移机制依赖于概念是否需要整体提示编码；weight lens可有效从权重中探测潜藏特质。

Abstract: Subliminal learning refers to a surprising phenomenon in language models wherein a prompt given to one model (e.g., preference for cats) can be subliminally distilled to another model via training on data that is ostensibly meaningless (e.g., number sequences). This paper shows that text-based subliminal learning transfers cross-modally, in particular, a topic/preference (e.g., animals) transferred through number sequences across vision-language models also changes how images are generated and represented. First, we show that a diffusion model using the student as its text encoder generates the student's animal more often than with the original model as its text encoder, but not its color or style. We then investigate the mechanism behind this phenomenon and which concepts transfer across modalities. A constant component of the student's change accounts for much of the shift of image representations toward the trait. Adding this component uniformly can change the generated animal, which depends on the whole prompt, but not concepts such as color or style, which are encoded in a single token. Finally, we introduce weight lens as an approach to identify a subliminal trait from the weights of a single trained model, and show that it identifies the trait of nearly every student, including traits that do not surface in generated images.

</details>


### [514] [EEG-Jev: A Unified Single-Pass Decision Model for EEG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31875)
*Zhifei Zhu,Hongtao Zhang,Yu Ren,Wei Zhou,Zeping Xie,Yi He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EEG-Jev：一个统一的单次前向决策模型，将EEG分析统一为CHOICE、NOUL、SCORE三类带校准概率的读出任务，单一检查点跨35个公开数据源联合训练并统一评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG分析涉及选择方案、判断陈述、评定有序属性等异质任务，均需具有明确含义且可校准的概率输出；现有方法缺乏统一、高效且可校准的框架。

Method: 输入EEG窗口、问题与答案规格，单次前向给出类型化读出：CHOICE输出候选分布，NOUL输出命题概率，SCORE输出有序等级分布及期望。单检查点联合训练，在35个公开来源的held-out划分上一次性评测；采用先验校正与温度缩放校准。

Result: Stieger2021运动想象平衡准确率54.08%，Sleep-EDF-SC睡眠分期70.45%，CHB-MIT癫痫检测阈值0.5下72.11%/窗口、AUROC 0.825，ds005292疼痛0-10评分MAE 1.700。校准使NLL在Sleep-EDF-SC由0.766降至0.606、CHB-MIT由0.166降至0.019；batch-1延迟由122.43ms降至63.11ms（1.94倍加速）。

Conclusion: 统一单次前向决策范式可在多类EEG任务上同时取得可用性能、可校准概率与更低推理延迟，验证了跨任务单一模型的可行性与效率优势。

Abstract: EEG analysis spans choosing alternatives, judging statements, and rating ordered attributes, requiring calibratable probabilities with explicit meaning. We present EEG-Jev, a unified single-pass decision model for EEG. Given an EEG window, a question and an answer specification, one forward pass returns a typed readout: CHOICE gives a candidate distribution, NOUL a proposition probability, and SCORE an ordered-level distribution and expectation. One checkpoint is trained jointly and evaluated once on held-out splits of 35 public sources. Core raw outputs reach 54.08% balanced accuracy on Stieger2021 motor imagery, 70.45% on Sleep-EDF-SC sleep staging, 72.11% per window at threshold 0.5 on CHB-MIT seizure detection with 0.825 AUROC, and 1.700 MAE on 0-10 ds005292 pain ratings. Prior correction and temperature scaling lower negative log-likelihood from 0.766 to 0.606 on Sleep-EDF-SC and 0.166 to 0.019 on CHB-MIT, while direct readout cuts batch-1 latency from 122.43 to 63.11 ms (1.94-fold) against a matched-backbone generative comparator. Interactive demonstration and aggregate results: https://neuroimglab.github.io/EEG-Jev/.

</details>


### [515] [Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning enhanced Federated Learning for Predicting Remaining Useful Lifetime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31880)
*Rajarshi Chattopadhyay,Chen-Khong Tham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用多智能体强化学习(QMARL/QMIX)为联邦学习配置每客户端分层传输与重传上限，以应对无线丢包，并结合GCPATr进行RUL预测，在CMAPSS上优于标准FL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer做RUL预测参数重、需大量数据，而工业数据孤岛且隐私敏感；FL可免共享原始数据，但客户端常经有损无线链路、偏好UDP，导致模型交换易丢包。

Method: 协作式MARL框架：每客户端作为智能体选择传输的层子集并限制重传次数，用QMIX值函数分解保证可扩展性；预测模型为Graph Convolution Position-Aware Transformer (GCPATr)。

Result: CMAPSS数据集上RL-FL稳定优于标准FL的MSE，丢包越高收益越大，如FD003在50%丢包下最高提升约18%。

Conclusion: MARL是缓解FL-based RUL预测中无线链路退化的有效手段。

Abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is central to Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). The growth of industrial IoT has unlocked large multivariate sensor streams and enabled deep models - especially Transformers - for long-horizon sequence learning. However, transformers are parameter-heavy and data-hungry, while operational datasets are often siloed and privacy-sensitive. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this by training across clients without raw data sharing, but in practice many clients connect over lossy wireless links where UDP is preferred for low latency, making model exchange vulnerable to packet drops. We present a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework that adapts FL to lossy channels by selecting per-client layer subsets to transmit and capping retransmissions. This framework is trained with QMIX value-function factorization for scalability. We instantiate the approach with a Graph Convolution Position-Aware Transformer (GCPATr) for RUL forecasting. On the CMAPSS dataset, our MARL-enhanced FL (RL-FL) consistently improves mean square error over standard FL, with the largest gains at high packet loss (e.g., up to 18% improvement on FD003 at 50% loss). These results show that MARL is an effective countermeasure to wireless degradation in FL-based RUL prediction.

</details>


### [516] [MIFLOW: Dynamic Recent-Behavior Priors for Reference-Calibrated Online Flow-Policy Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31902)
*Chenhao Wang,Haonan Ma,Wenjie Zhang,Yifan Wang,Mingbin Gao,Yuan-Ye Zhang,Wenjing Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIFLOW 用近期动作拟合的自适应 flow-matching 先验来校准在线 flow 策略学习，抑制在高 Q 值区域被 critic 误导的低密度动作，在多个 MuJoCo 任务上取得有竞争力的回报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线 actor-critic 中，off-policy 价值估计在覆盖差的动作区域不可靠，而表达力强的 flow 策略容易把概率质量移向 critic 偏爱（但可能被高估）的动作，导致策略被错误引导。

Method: 提出 MIFLOW：对最近执行的动作拟合一个近期自适应 flow-matching 先验，作为移动的密度参考（借用"渠化"canalization 作为路径依赖稳定化的类比）。将近似近期动作对数密度经维度归一化后作为校正项，同时加入 actor 更新与 critic 目标，提高低密度动作的代价但不禁用它们。

Result: 6 个 MuJoCo 连续控制任务、5 个随机种子：平均回报曲线具竞争力，多任务后期平均回报高于基线；Walker2d-v4 案例中，被学得参考判为低密度的动作比例更低（整体及高-Q 动作中均是）；先验族与先验缓冲的对比显示回报和先验诊断存在任务相关差异。

Conclusion: 结果支持在所评估设定中用动态近期行为先验进行参考校准；但诊断仅衡量采样动作与学得参考的对齐程度，真实动作支撑范围与 critic 外推误差未被测量。

Abstract: Flow-based policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. In online actor-critic learning, off-policy value estimates can be unreliable in poorly covered action regions, where expressive policies may shift probability mass toward critic-favored actions. We propose MIFLOW, which calibrates online flow-policy learning with a recency-adaptive flow-matching prior fitted to recently executed actions. Inspired by canalization as a qualitative analogy for path-dependent stabilization, we use the prior as a moving density reference for value-guided policy improvement. MIFLOW uses the approximate recent-action log-density in a dimension-normalized correction to both actor updates and critic targets. This correction increases the cost of low-density actions while keeping them available. Across six MuJoCo continuous-control tasks and five random seeds, MIFLOW achieves competitive mean return curves and higher late-training mean returns than the evaluated baselines on several tasks. In a Walker2d-v4 case study, MIFLOW shows a lower proportion of actions assigned low density by the learned reference, both overall and among high-Q actions. Prior-family and prior-buffer comparisons show task-dependent differences in returns and prior-defined diagnostics. These results support dynamic recent-behavior priors for reference calibration in the evaluated settings. The diagnostics measure how sampled actions align with the learned reference. True action support and critic extrapolation error remain unmeasured in these experiments.

</details>


### [517] [OrangeTree: A Linear and Tree-based Time Series Forecasting Model Supporting Multiple Input and Output Lengths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31905)
*Yiqi Tang,Zhichen Lai,Yuxuan Yang,Dalin Zhang,Jinpeng Chen,Gang Chen,Huan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OrangeTree是一种线性树结构架构，将模型参数与序列长度解耦，用Segment Tree Encoder和Inverse Tree Decoder在统一框架中完成多输入多输出长度（MIOL）预测，六个基准上达SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型刚性较强，单一架构难以处理多输入输出长度（MIOL）；padding和自回归等变通方法存在计算冗余或误差累积问题。

Method: 提出线性且基于树的架构OrangeTree：由Segment Tree Encoder与Inverse Tree Decoder实现多长度历史输入到多长度输出的映射；并以Range Weighter和Feature Fuser动态选择、融合相关区间，形成最优预测上下文。

Result: 在六个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能；在MIOL设置下精度与固定长度模型相当，无显著精度下降，也不像启发式方法那样显著增加推理延迟。

Conclusion: 通过树结构解耦参数与序列长度，OrangeTree在统一框架内高效支持多输入多输出长度预测，兼顾精度与效率，并提供开源代码。

Abstract: Time series forecasting (TSF) models suffer from a critical rigidity: the inability to handle Multiple Input and Output Lengths (MIOL) within a single architecture. Current workarounds, such as padding or autoregression, often incur computational redundancy or suffer from error accumulation. We propose OrangeTree, a linear and tree-based architecture that decouples model parameters from sequence lengths. It employs a Segment Tree Encoder and an Inverse Tree Decoder to translate multi-length input history into multi-length output predictions within a unified framework. Crucially, a Range Weighter and a Feature Fuser bridge these components, dynamically selecting and fusing relevant ranges into optimal contexts for forecasting. Experiments on six benchmarks confirm OrangeTree achieves the SOTA performance. In MIOL settings, it matches the accuracy of length-fixed models without substantial accuracy degradation or a substantial increase in inference latency typical of heuristic methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Tang-Yiqi/OrangeTree.

</details>


### [518] [TQ-HQNet: A Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for Cross-Domain Learning on Heterogeneous Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31908)
*Abdur Rasool,Saba Aslam,Hui Chen,Chayut Bunterngchit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TQ-HQNet：面向异构数据跨域学习的可训练性与量子比特高效混合量子神经网络，通过自适应潜压缩、可训练性感知电路搜索与多浅层量子专家融合实现稳健提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合量子神经网络在NISQ上面临可训练性差、电路设计僵化、跨异构真实任务鲁棒性弱的问题，限制了其实用效果。

Method: 提出TQ-HQNet，包含三机制：1）自适应潜压缩，将域特定特征映射到与量子比特兼容的表示；2）在紧凑变分电路候选中进行可训练性感知搜索；3）融合多个浅层量子专家以提升鲁棒性且不过度增加比特开销。

Result: 在神经筛查、钓鱼检测、金融方向预测、DNA序列分类四个公开数据集上均优于固定混合量子基线，平衡准确率提升分别为+0.280、+0.170、+0.071、+0.060；消融与敏感性分析表明增益来自可训练性感知的紧凑电路选择与专家融合，而非电路扩展；部分任务上经典基线更优，但固定划分下相对固定混合参考均有一致提升。

Conclusion: 紧凑电路选择与融合具有实际作用；重复划分与硬件感知研究留待未来工作。

Abstract: Hybrid quantum neural networks are a promising direction for noisy intermediate-scale quantum computing, but their practical effectiveness is often limited by poor trainability, rigid circuit design, and weak robustness across heterogeneous real-world tasks. This paper proposes TQ-HQNet, a Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for cross-domain learning on heterogeneous data. The proposed framework combines three mechanisms: 1) adaptive latent compression to map domain-specific features into qubit-compatible representations, 2) trainability-aware search over compact variational circuit candidates, and 3) hybrid fusion of multiple shallow quantum experts to improve robustness without increasing qubit cost excessively. TQ-HQNet is evaluated on four public datasets spanning neurological screening, phishing detection, financial direction prediction, and DNA sequence classification. Across all domains, the proposed model consistently improves over a fixed hybrid quantum baseline, with balanced-accuracy gains of +0.280, +0.170, +0.071, and +0.060, respectively. Ablation and sensitivity studies confirm that gains arise from trainability-aware compact circuit selection and expert fusion, not circuit scaling. Although classical baselines outperform on some tasks, fixed-split results show consistent improvements over the fixed hybrid reference. These analyses support the practical role of compact selection and fusion, with repeated-split and hardware-aware studies left for future work.

</details>


### [519] [ReJEPA: Bounded Predictive Regulation for Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31910)
*Fangzhou Lin,Yuping Wang,Shuo Xing,Yang Chen,Yuwen Heng,Xin Li,Wenbin He,Yuhan Yao,Zhengzhong Tu,Liu Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 ReJEPA，用逐元素 log-cosh 损失替代 L2/L1 作为潜空间世界模型的预测损失，以"大误差梯度有界、小误差平滑二次"的特性抑制对噪声帧的过拟合、缓解梯度冲突，在多个世界模型上即插即用提升表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多帧序列训练中并非所有帧与空间区域都同等可用或可预测，强制最小化每个预测误差可能有害：L2损失对大误差梯度无界，导致编码器/预测器过拟合噪声或瞬态帧而牺牲核心物理结构，并放大与表示正则项的梯度冲突；L1虽有界但近零处梯度恒定，破坏规划所需的局部平滑性。

Method: 提出 ReJEPA（有界预测调节）原则：对大误差使用有界梯度、对近零误差保持平滑二次行为，并简单实例化为逐元素 log cosh 损失。作为即插即用的训练替换，应用于 Temporal Straightening、LeWorldModel 和 V-JEPA 2.1，不改变架构与推理流程；并设置曲率匹配的二次损失作对照。

Result: log cosh 一致优于 L2、曲率匹配二次对照、L1 与 Smooth-L1 基线；增益随环境复杂度提升，从简单导航扩展到接触丰富的操作任务及 NAVSIM 真实自动驾驶。探针与几何分析显示，放松对极端误差的惩罚使表示更好地刻画物理状态，并与真实规划代价地形更吻合。

Conclusion: 预测损失形式本身是世界模型训练的关键设计变量；有界且近零平滑的损失（log cosh）能在不改变架构的前提下提升表示质量与规划一致性，且收益随任务复杂度增长。

Abstract: Latent world models learn representations by predicting future states in an abstract embedding space rather than reconstructing raw pixels. When training across multi-frame sequences, however, not all frames and spatial regions are equally informative or predictable. We argue that forcing a world model to minimize every prediction error may be unnecessary and harmful. Under standard $L_2$ loss, unbounded gradients force the encoder and predictor to overfit noisy or transient frames at the expense of core physical structure, while amplifying gradient conflict with representation regularizers. Conversely, $L_1$ loss bounds large gradients, but its constant gradient magnitude near zero disrupts the local smoothness required for planning. We resolve this tension with \textbf{ReJEPA}, a bounded predictive regulation principle that combines bounded gradients for large errors with smooth quadratic behavior near zero, instantiated simply via the element-wise $\log\cosh$ loss.
  As a drop-in training replacement across Temporal Straightening, LeWorldModel, and V-JEPA~2.1, $\log\cosh$ consistently outperforms $L_2$, a curvature-matched quadratic control, $L_1$, and Smooth-$L_1$ baselines without altering architectures or inference procedures. Notably, the gains grow with environmental complexity, scaling from simple navigation to contact-rich manipulation and real-world autonomous driving on NAVSIM. Probing and geometric analyses confirm that relaxing the penalty on extreme errors yields representations that better capture physical states and align with the true planning cost landscape.

</details>


### [520] [Meta-Amortized Cognitive Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31914)
*Jerry M. Huang,Lukas Schumacher,Niek Stevenson,Mischa von Krause,Stefan T. Radev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CogFormerV2，一个元摊销贝叶斯推断框架，用单个在单GPU上约一天训练的神经网络，覆盖超146亿种认知模型配置，实现准确且校准良好的后验估计，并开源为交互式应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知建模高度迭代，研究者需反复修改模型结构、参数化、协变量与实验设计；现有摊销贝叶斯推断虽能快速估计单个模型，但每次修改都要重新模拟与训练，成本高昂。

Method: 构建元摊销（meta-amortized）框架，将摊销能力扩展至整个模型空间；用单一神经网络一次性训练（单GPU约一天），覆盖二选一、多选项与连续决策任务，并包含不同参数集、协变量结构、试次数与污染水平；通过持续学习与表示迁移扩展到新模型。

Result: 在超过14.6亿种模型配置上给出准确、校准良好的后验；可拟合不同行为任务的经验数据；可持续学习拓展至新模型；以开源交互应用形式发布。

Conclusion: CogFormerV2为认知建模提供可复用的元摊销推断基础设施，有望大幅加速计算建模工作流程。

Abstract: Cognitive modeling is highly iterative. Researchers repeatedly revise model structures, parameterizations, covariates, and experimental designs as theories evolve and data accumulates. Amortized Bayesian inference with neural networks provides rapid estimation for individual models, but every revision requires new simulations and training. Here, we introduce CogFormerV2, a meta-amortized framework that enables researchers to specify, revise, and fit cognitive models with a single network, carrying amortization across an entire space of models all at once. Trained once in about a day on a single GPU, it delivers accurate, well-calibrated posteriors across more than 14.6 billion model configurations spanning binary, multi-alternative, and continuous decisions, with varying parameter sets, covariate structures, trial counts, and contamination levels. It can fit empirical data from distinct behavioral tasks and extends to new models through continual learning and representation transfer. Released as an open-source interactive application, CogFormerV2 provides a reusable infrastructure for meta-amortized inference in cognitive modeling, while carrying the potential to accelerate computational modeling workflows at large.

</details>


### [521] [Rethinking Universal Time Series Foundation Models from Unified Representations to Shared Dynamics (UniTFU)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31921)
*Shuxin Li,Yingjie Zhou,Le Zhang,Jingyuan Xia,Shengxi Li,Ce Zhu,Anderson Rocha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出通过刻画跨域共享的局部时序动态共性来提升时序基础模型的跨域泛化能力，构建可复用的时序基础单元TFU并据此提出统一模型UniTFU，在七个公开数据集上取得更优的跨域预测表现且可低成本适配新域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TSFM依赖大规模预训练（受限于预训练数据多样性与域覆盖）和通用建模范式（学习跨异构域的统一表征却未显式识别共享时序规律），导致跨域泛化能力受限。

Method: 从多尺度时序片段中挖掘跨域重复出现的局部动态模式，定义为可复用的时序基础单元TFU；基于TFU构建统一时序基础模型UniTFU，显式复用并组合跨域共享的时序规律进行预测；并通过用少量目标域数据更新可复用组件实现高效域适配。

Result: 在七个公开数据集上，UniTFU跨域预测显著优于现有TSFM，且在少量目标数据下能高效适配目标域动态；与SOTA方法相比也具备强预测性能。

Conclusion: 显式建模跨域局部动态共性是可替代/补充隐式表征学习的有效跨域泛化路径，模块化可复用单元兼顾泛化性与高效适配性。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have attracted increasing attention in cross-domain forecasting. Existing works mainly rely on large-scale pre-training and general modeling paradigms. However, the former heavily relies on the diversity and domain coverage of pre-training data. Meanwhile, the latter learns unified representations across heterogeneous domains without explicitly identifying the temporal regularities shared among them, limiting robust cross-domain generalization. This work explores cross-domain generalization by characterizing commonalities in recurring local dynamics across domains, rather than relying solely on implicitly learned temporal representations. To capture such cross-domain commonalities, we propose Time Series Foundation Units (TFUs) as reusable building blocks discovered from multi-scale temporal segments, each characterizing a recurring local dynamic pattern shared across domains. Building on TFUs, we develop a unified time series foundation model (UniTFU) that explicitly reuses and composes shared temporal regularities across domains for forecasting. Experiments on seven public datasets show that UniTFU substantially outperforms existing TSFMs in cross-domain forecasting and can efficiently adapt to target-domain dynamics by updating its reusable components with limited target data. UniTFU also achieves strong forecasting performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [522] [Beyond the Last Loop: Reinforcement Learning with a Teacher Extrapolated from the Model Itself](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31939)
*Linghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ELGO 将"从首循环到末循环外推的 next-token 分布"作为内在教师，结合 GRPO 做稠密逐 token 蒸馏后训练循环语言模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型每 token 多次复用同一 transformer 栈，可经共享 LM head 读出各循环。但用可验证奖励后训练存在困难：结果奖励每响应仅 1 bit，摊到各循环会让中间循环学到末循环采样的 token；蒸馏方案要么需要忽略奖励的教师，要么依赖外部更大模型。作者观察到模型自身含有比末循环更强的教师。

Method: ELGO 在 GRPO 上增加一个稠密逐 token 蒸馏项，指向由第一循环外推到最后一循环的 next-token 分布。教师由冻结的锚点副本计算；当学生到教师的 KL 低于阈值时用当前模型替换锚点，使教师随学生提升而不追逐自身外推。结果奖励在正确/错误响应间分配概率，教师决定响应内部哪些 token 更受偏好。刷新之间目标为以教师为锚的 KL 正则化 RL，其最优解为奖励对教师的倾斜。

Result: 在 Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 上，ELGO 将五个数学基准的 avg@8 从 GRPO 的 62.32 提至 64.20，且在每项基准上均为最佳对比方法；而把奖励摊到各循环的做法低于基座模型。

Conclusion: 利用循环结构自身的外推分布作为内在教师，可有效实现稠密信用分配，优于仅用稀疏结果奖励或将奖励分摊到循环的方案。

Abstract: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop can be read out through the shared language-model head. Post-training them with verifiable rewards is hard: the outcome reward carries one bit per response, spreading it over loops trains intermediate loops on tokens sampled from the last loop, and distillation needs either a teacher that ignores the reward or an external, larger model. We observe that a looped model already contains a teacher stronger than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELGO (Extrapolated-Loop Group-relative Optimization) adds to GRPO a dense per-token distillation term towards this distribution. The teacher is computed from an anchor copy of the model, which stays frozen and is replaced by the current model once the student's KL to the teacher falls below a threshold, so the teacher improves with the student without chasing its own extrapolation. The outcome reward splits probability between correct and incorrect responses, and the teacher decides which tokens are preferred inside a response. Between refreshes the objective is KL-regularised RL anchored at the teacher, whose optimum tilts the teacher by the reward. On Ouro-1.4B-Thinking, ELGO raises the average avg@8 over five math benchmarks from 62.32 with GRPO to 64.20 and is the best compared method on every benchmark, while spreading the reward over loops falls below the base model.

</details>


### [523] [Sounding the Black Box: Online Training of Embedded Neural Networks in Forward-Only Physical Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31964)
*Ruiqi Shu,Tianrun Gao,Haomin Wen,Xiaomeng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FORGE：一种仅依赖前向仿真器运行的黑盒在线训练框架，通过两阶段解耦网络梯度与求解器动力学，在混合物理-神经PDE仿真器中显著降低多步滚动误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合物理-神经仿真器需要在线（多步滚动）优化来最小化轨迹误差，但许多实际Fortran/C/C++求解器只有不可微、仅前向的接口，无法做BPTT，因此需要一种只用前向运行即可训练嵌入网络的在线方法。

Method: 提出FORGE框架，将精确网络导数与黑箱求解器动态解耦：Stage I用沿输出正交权重方向的低维Gauss-Newton步预热滚动，并用末层修正抵消多层特征漂移；Stage II扰动空间输出场，拟合有增益界的因果线性响应算子，求解正则化目标输出，再通过网络反向传播更新全部权重。

Result: 在涵盖相分离、反应扩散、流体与MHD湍流、海洋环流的5个2D和3D基准上，优于无梯度、强化学习及代理模型基线；2D粗求解器测试MSE降低50%-96%，3D降低70%，比最强前向基线优16%-69%，并恢复Solver BPTT 88%-98%的增益。

Conclusion: FORGE使黑箱、不可微的PDE求解器也能进行有效的多步在线训练，性能接近需完整求解器梯度的BPTT，拓宽了混合物理-机器学习在现实仿真器中的应用。

Abstract: Hybrid physics-neural simulators embed neural networks in partial differential equation (PDE) solvers to model unresolved subgrid dynamics while preserving resolved physics and conservation laws. Because closure outputs feed back across time steps, single-step offline regression does not directly minimize multi-step rollout error, motivating online trajectory optimization. Solver backpropagation through time (BPTT) is the standard online solution when solver derivatives are available, yet many operational Fortran and C/C++ simulators expose only non-differentiable, forward-only interfaces. We introduce FORGE (Forward-Only Response and Gauss-Newton Estimation), an online framework that trains embedded networks from forward runs alone by decoupling exact network derivatives from black-box simulator dynamics. Stage I warms up the rollout via a low-dimensional Gauss-Newton step along output-orthonormal weight directions, canceling multi-layer feature drift via a final-layer correction. Stage II perturbs spatial output fields to fit a gain-bounded causal linear response operator across rollout steps, solves for regularized target outputs, and updates all weights via network backpropagation. Across five 2D and 3D benchmarks spanning phase separation, reaction-diffusion, fluid and MHD turbulence, and ocean circulation, FORGE outperforms gradient-free, reinforcement-learning, and emulator-based baselines, cutting coarse-solver test mean squared error (MSE) by 50%-96% in 2D and 70% in 3D, outperforming the strongest forward-only baseline by 16%-69%, and recovering 88%-98% of Solver BPTT's gains. Code is available at https://github.com/ChiyodaMomo01/FORGE.

</details>


### [524] [On the Information Loss of Multi-Token Prediction: Origin and Solution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31966)
*Tangyu Jiang,Zhanke Zhou,Haodi Wang,Yiu-ming Cheung,Xiaohua Jia,Bo Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Dual-MTP，通过在完整上下文与随机掩码上下文下共同监督共享预测头，缓解块式多 token 预测的跨块误差累积，提升准确率并保持高解码吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多 token 预测（MTP）通过块式预测加速自回归解码，但顺序生成的各块之间存在误差累积，模型使用自身不完美输出作为前缀时预测质量下降。作者希望从信息损失角度理解这一局限并加以改善。

Method: 分析块级与序列级累积信息损失（CIL），指出在无参考答案、以自生成输出为输入时，输入条件差距等于参考目标的跨块依赖；据此提出 Dual-MTP，在完整前缀与随机掩码上下文下监督共享预测头，保留原 MTP 架构；并用归一化 dual loss 界定两种上下文下预测分布的散度。

Result: 在 5 个骨干模型、6 个任务（数学推理与 GLUE）上，Dual-MTP 在 4/5 骨干上取得最高平均分，较 MTP 最高提升 2.46 分；数学推理任务上解码吞吐为 NTP 参考的 1.4–1.9 倍。

Conclusion: 双上下文监督可在保留高效多 token 解码的同时提升预测准确率，是缓解 MTP 误差累积的有效途径。

Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) accelerates autoregressive decoding through block-wise prediction, but remains vulnerable to error accumulation across sequentially generated blocks. To investigate this limitation, we analyze the distinction between block-wise and sequence-level cumulative information loss (CIL). Specifically, when the model generates using its own previous outputs without access to reference answers, the input-conditional gap equals the cross-block dependence of the reference targets. To improve prediction when these generated prefixes are imperfect, we propose Dual-MTP, which supervises shared prediction heads under full and randomly masked contexts. Together, complete-prefix supervision and context perturbations provide complementary training signals while retaining the MTP architecture. To characterize this training objective, we use the normalized dual loss to bound the divergence between the model's predictive distributions under full and masked contexts. Experiments across five backbones and six tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and GLUE understanding show that Dual-MTP achieves the highest average task score on four of five backbones, with gains of up to 2.46 points over MTP. On mathematical reasoning tasks, Dual-MTP also achieves 1.4 to 1.9 times the decoding throughput of the NTP reference. Together, these results show that dual-context supervision can improve prediction accuracy while retaining efficient multi-token decoding.

</details>


### [525] [Predict Backbone, Graft Dynamics: A Decoupled Paradigm for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31970)
*Lin Zhang,Zilin Li,Jingmei Zhao,Jiayang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"预测骨架，嫁接动态"的解耦预测范式GRAFT：基预测器给出可靠主干轨迹，专用嫁接路径通过检索历史证据恢复局部动态，在7基准/2指标/4预测步长/6骨干的网格上87%优于对应骨干，MSE/MAE平均降4.6%/3.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代长期预测模型按逐点精度优化，偏向低频主干，压制了突变、瞬时激增、拐点等高价值局部动态，导致预测"平滑但无用"。通用后处理修正只纠残差，未针对性地恢复动态。

Method: 解耦式两阶段框架：基预测器输出稳定轨迹骨架；第二条嫁接路径从历史检索证据中恢复反复出现的动态，经相位感知释放、通道级控制与置信度约束，把校准后的可迁移动态选择性嫁接到骨架上，并用"恢复协同优化"联合训练。

Result: 在7个基准、2种指标、4个预测步长、6个骨干的完整评估网格中，87%比较优于对应骨干；平均MSE降4.6%、MAE降3.9%。动态窗口分析显示其恢复局部动态的同时保持骨架结构稳定。

Conclusion: 高价值预测的新原则是"先预测骨架，再嫁接动态"；解耦结构可在不牺牲稳定性的前提下提升局部动态还原能力。

Abstract: Modern long-term forecasters are typically optimized for point-wise accuracy, which rewards dominant low-frequency backbones but often suppresses high-utility local dynamics such as abrupt variations, transient surges, and turning points. We propose Predict Backbone, Graft Dynamics, a decoupled forecasting paradigm that separates stable structural prediction from grounded dynamic restoration. We instantiate it as GRAFT, where a base forecaster predicts the reliable trajectory backbone, and a dedicated grafting path restores historically recurrent dynamics through retrieval-based evidence, phase-aware release, channel-wise control, and restoration-cooperative optimization. Unlike generic post-hoc revision methods that correct residual errors, GRAFT formulates the second stage as grounded dynamic grafting, where historical response evidence is calibrated into transferable dynamics and selectively grafted onto the backbone under phase-, channel-, and confidence-aware constraints. Across the full evaluation grid of seven benchmarks, two metrics, four horizons, and six backbones, GRAFT improves over the corresponding backbone in 87% of all comparisons, with average MSE/MAE reductions of 4.6%/3.9%. Dynamic-window analyses show that GRAFT restores local dynamics while preserving the stable backbone structure. These results suggest a new principle for high-utility forecasting: predict the backbone, then graft the dynamics.

</details>


### [526] [Metric-Dependent Scaling Laws for Sketched Multiclass Softmax Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31995)
*Ziyan Chen,Linhe Zheng,Peilin Liu,Zhongzhu Zhou,Ding-Xuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究在随机特征草图下的多类softmax回归中，全批量梯度下降（一般稳定确定性学习率）的缩放律，揭示交叉熵超额风险与零一超额风险共享同一谱尺度，并据此给出最优草图规模与优化时长的选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 草图会使学生模型产生模型错配（misspecification），因此分析需同时考虑近似误差、非线性有限时间学习动态，以及有限样本重复使用带来的固定经验扰动，这三者耦合难以分离。

Method: 采用幂律特征谱与教师谱的高斯师生模型，学生学习一个随机特征草图，并在优化全过程复用同一个有限标注样本。在指数高概率的草图事件上，联合分析近似、有限时间非线性学习与数据复用扰动，推导交叉熵超额风险与零一超额风险的谱尺度。

Result: 证明两类超额风险共享一个共同的谱尺度，由分辨率项与"有效学习维度/样本量"项构成；师生决策不一致率按该尺度的平方根变化。风险平衡导出速率最优的草图规模与累积优化时长的选取，合成实验验证了预测的各类区域及度量相关的指数。

Conclusion: 草图下梯度下降的学习速率由分辨率与有效学习维度/样本量之间的平衡决定，该框架统一刻画不同度量下的缩放行为，并为草图维度与训练时长的设计提供理论依据。

Abstract: We study scaling laws for full-batch gradient descent with general stable deterministic learning rates in sketched multiclass softmax regression. In a Gaussian teacher student model with power law feature and teacher spectra, the student observes a random feature sketch and reuses a finite labeled sample throughout optimization. Sketching generally makes the student misspecified, so the analysis must jointly account for approximation, nonlinear finite time learning, and the fixed empirical perturbation induced by data reuse. On an exponentially likely sketch event, we show that cross entropy excess and excess zero one risk share a common spectral scale, consisting of a resolution term and an effective learned dimension divided by sample size; teacher student decision disagreement follows the square root of that scale. The resulting balance gives rate optimal sketch and cumulative horizon choices, and synthetic experiments support the predicted regimes and metric dependent exponents.

</details>


### [527] [ADE: A Zero-Training Unlearning Method for Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31998)
*Sirui He,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ADE，一种零训练的闭式遗忘算法，仅用缓存预训练矩量即可在潜世界模型中切除后门触发与陈旧转移，避免自回归漂移与方差崩塌。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型虽能学习紧凑循环动力学，但部署后可能残留后门触发或过时物理状态下的陈旧转移；现有遗忘方法在自回归物理中失效：梯度更新扭曲潜流形并放大 rollout 漂移，简单输出置零会抑制触发时的合法控制响应，单步删除又无法清除循环隐状态中的污染。

Method: ADE 为确定性、零训练闭式遗忘框架：(1) 仅凭缓存预训练矩量，通过单遍矩阵 downdating 恢复 retain 协方差，无需原始保留数据；(2) 将闭式编辑级联至输入瓶颈、隐状态与下游头；(3) 结合正交切除、白化循环阻尼和保均值仿射校准，中和流形外后门并重对齐流形内偏移，同时防止方差坍缩。

Result: 在三个 MuJoCo 基准的四种设置上，ADE 在 DreamerV1 上优于七个调参基线：消除 HalfCheetah 与 Hopper 的速度翻转触发比微调快 4.4 倍，并可零样本迁移到 DreamerV3。

Conclusion: ADE 为首个针对潜世界模型的闭式遗忘方案，以极低代价高效移除后门与过时转移，兼顾稳定性和控制性能，并具跨模型泛化能力。

Abstract: Latent world models learn compact recurrent dynamics from offline trajectories, yet deployed simulators can retain backdoor triggers or stale transitions from outdated physical regimes. Existing unlearning methods fail in autoregressive physics: gradient updates distort latent manifolds and compound rollout drift, naive output zeroing suppresses valid control responses on trigger onset, and single-step deletion leaves corruption inside recurrent hidden states. We propose Analytical Dynamics Excision (ADE), a deterministic, zero-training closed-form unlearning algorithm for latent world models. Using only cached pretraining moments, ADE recovers retain covariances via single-pass matrix downdating without raw retain data and cascades closed-form edits across the input bottleneck, hidden states, and downstream heads. Pairing orthogonal excision with whitened recurrent damping and mean-preserving affine calibration neutralizes out-of-manifold backdoors and realigns in-manifold shifts without variance collapse. Across four regimes on three MuJoCo benchmarks, ADE outperforms seven tuned baselines on DreamerV1, eliminating HalfCheetah and Hopper velocity-flip triggers $4.4\times$ faster than fine-tuning, and transfers zero-shot to DreamerV3.

</details>


### [528] [To Critic Or Not To Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32013)
*Jason Wei,George Pu,Jingxuan Fan,Yuan Emily Xue,Yuan Christy Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究何时critic能提升强化学习效率，基于梯度方向的偏差-方差权衡，在控制任务、短程数学和长程终端智能体上比较GRPO与PPO（1200+次训练，含96次LLM实验），发现小批量时PPO占优、大批量时GRPO追平甚至反超，且critic在小算力预算下更划算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM处理更长更复杂的任务，需要理解critic何时真正提升RL效率。PPO用critic降方差并提供细粒度信用分配，GRPO则去掉critic以避免bootstrapping偏差。近期critic类方法报告优于GRPO，但各自适用条件仍不明确，作者主张不存在通用答案，需厘清交互因素。

Method: 从梯度方向的偏差-方差权衡切入，测量随batch size增大时各方法梯度估计与真实策略梯度的对齐程度。在共享actor目标下，于控制任务、短程数学任务和长程终端智能体上对比GRPO与PPO，考察batch size、critic依赖程度（bootstrapping强度）和任务复杂度等交互因素，共进行1200余次训练，其中96次涉及LLM。

Result: 小批量时PPO总体领先；大批量时GRPO常超越重度bootstrapping的PPO，并与轻度bootstrapping的PPO持平。在更长horizon和更复杂领域中，GRPO需要更大批量才能追上PPO。考虑训练算力后，小预算下critic收益明显，大预算下收益递减。

Conclusion: PPO与GRPO的优劣取决于batch size、critic依赖度与任务复杂度的共同作用，不存在普适最优选择；实践应结合算力预算与任务horizon选择critic或critic-free方法。

Abstract: As large language models tackle longer and more complex tasks, understanding when a critic improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes increasingly important. Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) trains a critic to reduce variance and provide fine-grained credit assignment, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) drops the critic and avoids the bias of bootstrapping from the critic's value estimates. Although recent critic-based methods have reported strong performance relative to GRPO, it remains unclear when each approach is preferable. We argue that there is no universal answer; instead, the choice depends on several interacting factors, including batch size, critic reliance, and task complexity. We study the bias-variance tradeoff in terms of gradient direction, measuring how closely each method's gradient estimates align with the true policy gradient as batch size grows. Under a shared actor objective, we compare GRPO with PPO in control tasks, short-horizon math, and long-horizon terminal agents. Across more than 1,200 training runs, including 96 with LLMs, we find that PPO generally leads at small batch sizes, while GRPO often overtakes heavily bootstrapped PPO and reaches parity with lightly bootstrapped PPO at larger batches. At longer horizons and in more complex domains, GRPO needs larger batches to catch up to PPO's performance. Accounting for training compute, critics pay off at small budgets, but their returns diminish at larger budgets.

</details>


### [529] [Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32018)
*Dongyu Cui,Jie Ding,Xuan Bi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PATH模型（层次感知注意力+父节点门控概率），预测个人AI代理的授权偏好，在模拟、AI生成简介及真实数据上表现优异且无层次违反。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人AI代理执行多步任务时产生大量权限请求，人工逐一审核耗时，全部放行则有隐私安全风险，因此需预测用户授权偏好以减负并保留控制权。难点在于请求具层次结构、观测决策稀疏且可能相关。

Method: PATH为新型神经网络架构：结合层次感知注意力掩码与父节点门控概率公式，保证层次一致性预测；层次级嵌入支持从稀疏观测和同层共享模式中学习；并建立有限样本风险界，给出授权概率一致估计与算法收敛的充分条件。

Result: 在模拟数据、AI生成的用户简介以及真实用户授权数据上均取得较强预测性能，且层次违反为零。

Conclusion: PATH能有效预测层次化授权偏好，兼具理论与实证支撑，可作为降低权限审核负担同时保留用户控制的可行方案。

Abstract: Personal AI agents can carry out complex, multi-step tasks on users' behalf, but doing so often involves numerous permission requests. Manually reviewing each request is time-consuming, while indiscriminate approval poses privacy and security risks. Predicting users' authorization preferences offers a way to reduce this burden while preserving user control. However, authorization prediction is challenging because permission requests are often hierarchical and observed user decisions are sparse and potentially correlated. To address these challenges, We propose the Parent-gated Authorization Transformer for Hierarchies (PATH) to predict users' authorization preferences for personal AI agents. PATH is a novel neural network architecture that combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation to ensure hierarchy-consistent predictions. Hierarchy-level embeddings further support learning from sparse observations and patterns shared within each authorization level. We establish finite-sample risk bounds and provide sufficient conditions for consistent authorization probability estimation and algorithmic convergence. Experiments on simulated data, AI-generated user profiles, and real user authorization data demonstrate strong predictive performance with zero hierarchy violations.

</details>


### [530] [PFedHASNet: A Personalized Federated Hybrid Analog-Spike Network for Multi-Subject Motor Imagery EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32019)
*Peijia Li,Ruidong Ma,Xianghong Lin,Xiangwen Wang,Guoyong Shi,Shuai Huang,Hongqi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PFedHASNet——一种个性化联邦混合模拟-脉冲网络，用于运动想象脑电解码，在四个公开数据集上取得最优的平均客户端宏F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MI-EEG数据按被试/机构分散收集且标注昂贵；仅用单被试数据训练信息有限，而集中原始EEG又带来隐私与数据治理问题。联邦学习虽可协作训练但不共享原始数据，仍需解决跨被试异质性下的个性化解码问题。

Method: 采用个性化联邦学习框架：共享编码器通过可学习融合权重整合连续值时间特征、LIF脉冲响应与通道级对数方差统计量（混合模拟-脉冲表示）；客户端私有的残差适配器进行被试特定特征精炼，私有分类器实现个性化预测。

Result: 在四个公开MI-EEG数据集的参与被试留出试次上，跨模型比较中18种模型配置里PFedHASNet取得最高平均客户端宏F1；在相同骨干网络比较下，以紧凑的客户端模型保持有竞争力的解码性能。消融实验验证了混合表示与个性化组件的贡献。

Conclusion: PFedHASNet在保护隐私的前提下有效利用多被试信息，实现高性能且轻量的个性化MI-EEG解码，为隐私约束下的跨被试脑机接口应用提供可行方案。

Abstract: Motor imagery electroencephalography (MI-EEG) data are often collected and stored separately across subjects or institutions, and EEG acquisition and annotation remain costly. Training models solely on individual subject data limits the use of information from other subjects, whereas centralizing raw EEG recordings raises privacy and data governance concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw EEG data, providing a practical approach to leveraging information from multiple subjects. Accordingly, we propose PFedHASNet, a personalized federated hybrid analog-spike network for MI-EEG decoding. The shared encoder integrates continuous-valued temporal features, leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) spike responses, and channel-wise log-variance statistics through learnable fusion weights. Client-private residual adapters and classifiers perform subject-specific feature refinement and personalized prediction, respectively. Experiments on held-out trials from participating subjects across four public MI-EEG datasets show that PFedHASNet achieves the highest mean client macro-F1 among 18 model configurations in cross-model comparisons, while maintaining competitive decoding performance with a compact client-side model in comparisons using the same backbone. Ablation studies further examine the contributions of hybrid representations and personalization components to decoding performance.

</details>


### [531] [Scale-Robust and Global-Aware Representation Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32033)
*Gyuwon Lee,Saejoon Park,Won-Seok Hwang,Bogoan Kim,Yunyong Ko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 STAGER，联合学习尺度鲁棒的时间表示与全局感知的关系表示，用于多元时间序列异常检测，在三个真实数据集上取得十种方法中的最佳平均排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 MTSAD 表示学习存在两个未被充分探索的挑战：C1 如何学习跨不同时间尺度捕捉异常的尺度鲁棒时间表示；C2 如何超越局部窗口、引入序列级全局特征来建模序列间依赖，获得全局感知的关系表示。

Method: STAGER 包含两个互补编码器：(1) 尺度鲁棒时间编码器，构建多尺度时间有向无环图（DAG）学习尺度鲁棒时间表示；(2) 全局感知关系编码器，将可学习的序列级全局嵌入融入时间表示，并用图神经网络建模序列间关系；另设两个互补的辅助目标增强全局嵌入的区分性。

Result: 在三个真实基准数据集上，STAGER 在三种评价指标下于十种 MTSAD 方法中取得最佳平均排名；消融与敏感性分析验证了各组件和辅助目标的有效性；效率评估显示其在检测性能与推理时间之间取得良好权衡。

Conclusion: 联合建模尺度鲁棒时间表示与全局感知关系表示能有效提升多元时间序列异常检测性能，且计算开销可接受，具备实际应用价值。

Abstract: Multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD) is an essential task for identifying abnormal system behaviors and supporting reliable operations across diverse real-world applications. Despite substantial advances in MTSAD, two key challenges in representation learning remain underexplored: (C1) how to learn scale-robust temporal representations that capture anomalies across different temporal scales and (C2) how to learn global-aware relational representations that capture inter-series dependencies by incorporating series-level global characteristics beyond local windows. To address these challenges, we propose STAGER, a novel method that jointly learns two complementary representations: scale-robust temporal and global-aware relational representations. Specifically, STAGER employs (1) a scale-robust temporal encoder that constructs a multi-scale temporal directed acyclic graph (DAG) to learn scale-robust temporal representations and (2) a global-aware relational encoder that incorporates learnable series-level global embeddings into the temporal representations and models inter-series relationships through graph neural networks. Two complementary auxiliary objectives further enhance the distinctiveness of the global embeddings. Extensive experiments on three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that STAGER achieves the best average rank among ten evaluated MTSAD methods across three evaluation metrics. Ablation and sensitivity analyses validate the effectiveness of the proposed components and auxiliary objectives, while efficiency evaluations demonstrate that STAGER achieves a favorable trade-off between detection performance and inference time compared with existing methods.

</details>


### [532] [FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32039)
*Xi Lin,Chengruidong Zhang,Huiqiang Jiang,Xiao Li,Zekun Wang,Junda Feng,Yunfei Mao,Siqi Zhang,Siyu Wang,Man Yuan,Rui Men,Bo Zheng,Dayiheng Liu,Bohan Zhuang,Jianwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlashQLA 是面向 Gated DeltaNet 的上下文并行执行框架，通过 decay-aware 预处理、Dual CP 跨 GPU 序列并行、Auto CP 与 kernel 协同设计，显著提升长上下文训练/推理并行度与速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GDN 虽具有线性复杂度，但 chunk 间存在顺序依赖，限制并行性，尤其在小 batch 或单 GPU 头级并行度有限的 长上下文场景下尤为突出；同时边界状态预处理开销较大。

Method: 提出 FlashQLA：1) 通过 decay-aware preparation 降低边界状态预处理开销；2) Dual CP 在 GPU 间扩展序列并行，并在不同并行层级共享 summary 计算；3) 引入 workload-adaptive Auto CP；4) 进行 CP-aware kernel 协同设计。

Result: 单 GPU 上相比 FLA 实现 1.7×–3.1× 前向加速、最高 4.4× 反向加速；八 GPU、上下文长达 1M token 时，Dual CP 相比 FLA KCP 前向最高 4.8×、前向+反向合计 4.4× 加速。

Conclusion: FlashQLA 有效释放 GDN 的序列级并行潜力，在大规模长上下文场景下明显优于现有 FLA/KCP 方案。

Abstract: Gated DeltaNet (GDN) achieves linear computational complexity through recurrent state updates, but sequential dependencies between chunks limit parallelism, particularly for long-context workloads with small batch sizes or limited head-level parallelism per GPU. We present FlashQLA, a context-parallel execution framework for GDN that exposes additional sequence-level parallelism while reducing boundary-state preprocessing overhead. FlashQLA reduces boundary-state preprocessing overhead through decay-aware preparation and extends sequence parallelism across GPUs with Dual CP, which shares summary computation across parallelism levels. Workload-adaptive Auto CP and CP-aware kernel co-design further improve execution efficiency. FlashQLA achieves $1.7\times$-$3.1\times$ forward speedup and up to $4.4\times$ backward speedup over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) on a single GPU. On eight GPUs with context lengths up to 1M tokens, Dual CP achieves up to $4.8\times$ forward speedup and $4.4\times$ speedup for combined forward and backward execution over FLA KCP.

</details>


### [533] [Spec-CoFrGeNet: Reparametrizing Continued Fraction Networks for Stable and Accurate Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32041)
*Soumyadeep Pal,Amit Dhurandhar,Vijil Chenthamarakshan,Dennis Wei,Karthikeyan Natesan Ramamurthy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种受物理中格林函数启发的部分分母变换，通过约束三对角哈密顿量的谱来消除连分数网络的极点问题，无需增量训练即可稳定训练，在语言与图像生成任务中以约30%-50%参数节省达到与原FFN架构相当甚至更优的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连分数（continued fraction）函数类可构建表达力强且参数高效的神经网络，但其有理形式在分母趋零时产生极点。先前工作通过强制一个小的正下界来规避，然而该下界取值敏感，且需要增量训练等复杂流程，影响性能与训练稳定性并增加对标准预训练流程的改动。

Method: 作者将部分分母的变换与三对角哈密顿量的格林函数建立联系，提出一种新的部分分母重参数化，通过约束该三对角哈密顿量的谱来从根本上抑制极点和病态问题；该重参数化消除了先前工作所需的增量训练，避免了对标准预训练流程的复杂修改。他们将FFN替换为此前提出的连分数架构，在GPT-2 XL、(nano) Llama-MoE、Granite等语言模型以及基于扩散目标的DiT上进行验证。

Result: 在GPT-2 XL、(nano) Llama-MoE、Granite等模型上，该方法性能与原FFN架构相当，同时保持约30%-50%的参数节省，且多数情况下优于更复杂的增量训练基线；在SOTA扩散Transformer（DiT）图像生成任务上，以约30%参数节省达到与原FFN模型相当的性能，并显著优于此前的增量训练方法，首次证明连分数网络在基于扩散目标的图像生成中同样有效。

Conclusion: 通过谱约束的部分分母重参数化可优雅地解决连分数网络的极点与训练稳定性问题，同时去掉增量训练需求，使连分数网络成为可直接用于标准预训练流程的参数高效替代方案，并在语言与图像生成两类任务上得到验证。

Abstract: Continued fractions have been shown to be a function class capable of constructing expressive yet parameter-efficient neural networks. These neural networks are not only effective for supervised learning, but also for training LLMs. However, the rational form of this function class introduces poles when the denominator approaches zero, which prior work has avoided by enforcing a small positive (non-smooth) lower bound. We show that performance and training stability can be highly sensitive to the choice of this lower bound. In this work, we introduce a novel transformation of the partial denominators, inspired by its connection to the Green's function in physics, that mitigates the above issue elegantly by constraining the spectra of the constructed tridiagonal Hamiltonian. Our approach further eliminates the need for incremental training used by previous works for stability, thus avoiding involved modifications to standard pre-training procedures. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our reparameterization by replacing FFNs with a previously proposed continued fraction architecture for both language and image generative modeling. Across diverse models, such as GPT-2 XL, (nano) Llama-MoE, and Granite, we show that our proposed method achieves performance comparable to the original (FFN-based) architectures while maintaining ~30%-50% parameter savings as before, and in most cases even outperforms the more complicated incremental training baseline. We further demonstrate, for the first time for continued fraction networks, that their effectiveness also carries over to image generative modeling, that utilize diffusion objectives. On a state-of-the-art Diffusion Transformer, we show that our approach again achieves performance comparable to the original FFN-based models with ~30% parameter savings and significantly outperforms the previous incremental training approach.

</details>


### [534] [Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32063)
*Junsoo Oh,Jihun Yun,Junhyuck Kim,Hanbaek Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Integral DeltaNet，通过维护"快速更新的 delta 状态"与"保留 delta 状态加权历史的积分状态"两个互补递归状态，在读出时自适应融合以跨时间尺度访问信息，缓解线性注意力固定大小状态导致的内存碰撞问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力以固定大小递归状态替代增长的 KV cache，实现线性时间计算与内存优势，但把历史压缩到固定状态会造成"内存碰撞"，损害长上下文理解。DeltaNet 用 delta 规则更新、Gated DeltaNet 再加门控来缓解碰撞，但这些机制可能丢弃对未来预测有用的信息。

Method: 设计双状态递归机制：一个快速更新的 delta 状态刻画当前键值关联，一个积分状态保存 delta 状态的加权历史；读出时自适应组合两状态以覆盖不同时间尺度。同时推导 chunkwise 并行公式以实现硬件高效训练。

Result: 用 340M 与 1.3B 参数模型、分别在 15B 与 100B FineWeb-Edu token 上从零训练；与强递归基线相比，在语言建模、常识推理、真实与合成检索、长上下文理解、长度外推上整体更优；并对比了训练吞吐、激活内存以及解码延迟与内存。

Conclusion: Integral DeltaNet 通过快慢双状态与自适应读出，在保持线性时间/内存优势的同时提升长上下文建模能力，且具备可高效训练的并行实现与良好的效率表现。

Abstract: Linear attention replaces softmax attention with a linear formulation, enabling linear-time computation with a fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value cache. These computational and memory advantages have attracted growing interest in linear attention for long-context language modeling. However, compressing past information into a fixed-size state causes memory collisions that hinder long-context understanding. Although DeltaNet mitigates memory collisions through delta-rule updates and Gated DeltaNet extends this approach with gating, these mechanisms may also discard information relevant to future predictions. To address this limitation, we introduce Integral DeltaNet, which maintains two complementary recurrent states: a fast-updating delta state that captures current key-value associations and an integral state that preserves a weighted history of the delta state. At readout, the model adaptively combines these states to access information across different timescales. We further derive a chunkwise parallel formulation that enables hardware-efficient training. We evaluate Integral DeltaNet using 340M and 1.3B parameter models trained from scratch on 15B and 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens, respectively. Comparisons with strong recurrent baselines show improved overall performance in language modeling, commonsense reasoning, real-world and synthetic retrieval, long-context understanding, and length extrapolation. We also compare training throughput and activation memory, as well as decoding latency and memory.

</details>


### [535] [Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32064)
*Sandeep Singh Sandha,Prann Bansal,Arvind Sundararajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"合并感知微调"(merge-aware fine-tuning)：训练时每步将基座权重与LoRA增量之和按发布存储格式(BF16/FP8/NVFP4)舍入并以之为损失输入，使小幅度"外科手术式"权重更新在量化发布版中得以保留，Nemotron-3.5的BF16与NVFP4版本均获提升，Terminal-Bench 2.1 最多+8.4分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放权重LLM的失败常非推理缺陷，而是长轨迹上的少量小失误（重复失败步骤、未满足要求就宣布完成），需小幅精准权重修正。但LoRA更新幅度极小（中位权重变化仅1.5%个舍入步长），合并进checkpoint时BF16丢失约2/3更新范数、FP8/NVFP4版丢失93%，导致微调效果在发布后被抹除。

Method: 不改增大更新幅度，而是直接训练"能存活"的部分：在每个训练步把 base weight + adapter 增量之和舍入到发布格式（保留厂商量化scale），在前向中与推理引擎数值对齐，梯度直通(straight-through)舍入算子，从而loss只优化模型动作、保持推理能力接近基座。

Result: 应用于Nemotron-3.5，智能体编程能力在BF16与NVFP4两个发布版本上均有提升，Terminal-Bench 2.1最高+8.4分，并公开释放两个模型。

Conclusion: LoRA微调的收益可能在量化合并中大量流失；让训练感知发布格式的舍入可显著提高更新存活率，"训练即发布"的数值一致性是部署小幅度行为修正的有效方案。

Abstract: Open-weight LLMs are competent software engineers, but they sometimes fail at tasks they are otherwise able to do. Often it is not a failure of reasoning. It is a few small missteps over a long trajectory (repeating a step that has already failed, or declaring the task done while a requirement is still unmet) that make the difference. Correcting this calls for a surgical weight update that steers the model toward the right actions without interfering with its reasoning. Such updates, typically learned with LoRA adapters, are often too small to survive merging into a released checkpoint. In our BF16 release, the median weight change is only 1.5% of a single rounding step, and merging loses roughly two thirds of the update's norm. When the same adapter is merged into the mixed FP8/NVFP4 release of the same model, 93% of the update disappears. Instead of increasing the size of the update, we directly train on the surviving part. We introduce merge-aware fine-tuning. Standard LoRA rounds the merged weights to the storage format only at export, so the loss never sees the rounded weights. We instead round the sum of base weights and adapter update to the release format at every training step, keeping the vendor's quantization scales, and compute the loss on these weights. The forward pass matches the serving engine numerics, and the gradient passes straight through the rounding, so the model we train is the model we ship. The loss optimizes only the model's actions and keeps its reasoning close to the base model. Applied to Nemotron-3.5, the recipe improves agentic coding in both the BF16 and the NVFP4 release, by up to 8.4 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and we publicly release both models.

</details>


### [536] [A Fused Gaussian Process Bandit Framework for Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32092)
*Muyun Lu,Jose E Aguilar Escamilla,Huazheng Wang,Ying Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将多保真贝叶斯优化建模为融合高斯过程bandit问题，并给出FGP-UCB算法，具备简单遗憾理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多保真BO方法要么过度简化保真层间依赖，要么依赖缺乏理论保证的启发式采集函数。

Method: 将MFBO表述为融合高斯过程bandit问题；用自回归GP模型融合多保真观测预测高保真函数，显式量化跨保真层参数估计带来的不确定性；提出FGP-UCB算法。

Result: 提供简单遗憾上界理论保证，并通过理论分析与实证实验验证方法有效性。

Conclusion: FGP-UCB兼顾保真层依赖建模与理论可证性能，克服现有MFBO缺乏可证明界的关键缺陷。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used to maximize expensive black-box functions when direct evaluation is costly. In many real-world applications, the high-fidelity objective can be approximated by a series of lower-fidelity models that provide partial but informative signals at substantially reduced cost. Multi-fidelity BO (MFBO) algorithms aim to strategically combine these information sources to achieve an optimal trade-off between accuracy and evaluation cost. However, existing MFBO methods often oversimplify the complex dependencies between fidelity levels or rely on heuristic acquisition functions that lack theoretical performance guarantees.
