To address these limitations, we introduce a new formulation of the MFBO problem as a fused Gaussian Process bandit and develop a corresponding Fused Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound (FGP-UCB) algorithm. Our approach accurately predicts the high-fidelity function by fusing multi-fidelity observations through an autoregressive Gaussian Process model and explicitly quantifies the uncertainty arising from parameter estimation across fidelity levels. The proposed method also provides theoretical simple-regret guarantees, overcoming a key limitation of existing MFBO algorithms that lack provable performance bounds. Effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated via both theoretical analysis and empirical studies.

</details>


### [537] [PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32113)
*Yicheng Huang,Feng Ke,Linhan Chen,Ziyi Jiang,Xiu Yin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PhysRF-WorldJEPA 提出一种流形解耦的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），将连续电磁状态预测与跨模态语言对齐分离，解决毫米波雷达-LLM 指令微调中检索近乎随机、遮挡时物理漂移的问题。冻结物理主干、仅训练解耦对齐头后，R→T R@10 从 5.95% 提升到 15.01%，MedRank 从 107.0 降至 60.0，同时物理读数保持不变（如 +3.0 s 躯干倾斜 3.37°、R²=0.961），并在 5 个 LLM 家族上优于 SFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将 LLM 适配到毫米波雷达可实现隐私保护、全天候的物理场景理解（暗光、烟尘、穿墙），但存在两大问题：标准指令微调把连续雷达流当作静态类文本 token，导致全局雷达-文本检索近乎随机、传感器遮挡下严重物理漂移；而把 SigLIP 类成对对比损失直接耦合进共享主干，虽提升检索却注入 O(B²) 斥力梯度，使连续坐标流形破裂（R²<0）。

Method: 提出 PhysRF-WorldJEPA：采用无衰减 1.0x 时钟锚点与并行双尺度 RF 编码器，驱动约 3% LoRA 的轻量 LLM；用两步状态空间 EMA-JEPA（去噪→推演）与沿样本轴的 Batch-VICReg 预测未来 +3.0 s 物理状态；随后用停止梯度的对齐头，结合假负例掩码，将冻结的提示状态映射到文本超球面，实现物理预测与语言对齐的解耦。

Result: 在 4,541 窗口、三频段（77/60.25/60 GHz）数据集上对比 10 个基线，仅训练解耦头即把 R→T R@10 从 5.95% 提升至 15.01%，MedRank 从 107.0 降至 60.0，且物理读数完全不变：遮挡 +3.0 s 躯干倾斜 3.37°（R²=+0.961）、杂乱 UAV 高度 1.89 m（R²=+0.679，RF 前端 1.19 m/+0.863）、穿墙 NLOS 距离 2.04 m（R²=+0.461）、虚拟 RIS 不变性 0.9976、跌倒召回 100%。在 5 个 0.5B–1.8B LLM 家族（15 个零开销模型）上，World-JEPA 在 10/10 次运行的检索与 75% 丢弃补全上优于 SFT，遮挡倾斜在 4/5（Span-Euc）、2/5（Scatter）、5/5（每家族最优）上优于 SFT。

Conclusion: 将连续物理状态预测与跨模态语言对齐显式解耦，可在不损害物理读数的前提下显著改善雷达-文本检索与遮挡鲁棒性，且方法对多种 LLM 家族具有良好泛化性。该解耦 JEPA 框架为毫米波雷达-LLM 融合提供了一条兼顾物理保真与语义对齐的有效路径。

Abstract: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 < 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. An unattenuated 1.0x clock anchor and parallel dual-scale RF encoder feed a lean ~3% LoRA LLM trained with two-step state-space EMA-JEPA (Denoise -> Rollout) and sample-axis Batch-VICReg to predict +3.0 s physical states; a stop-gradient alignment head then maps frozen prompt states onto the text hypersphere with false-negative masking. On a 4,541-window tri-domain suite (77/60.25/60 GHz) against 10 baselines, freezing the physical backbone and training only the decoupled head lifts R->T R@10 from 5.95% to 15.01% and improves MedRank from 107.0 to 60.0 while preserving identical physical readout: 3.37 deg ($R^2=+0.961$) blackout +3.0 s torso tilt, 1.89 m ($R^2=+0.679$; 1.19 m/+0.863 at the RF front-end) cluttered UAV altitude, 2.04 m ($R^2=+0.461$) behind-wall NLOS range, 0.9976 virtual-RIS invariance, and 100% fall recall. Across five 0.5B-1.8B LLM families (15 zero-overhead models), World-JEPA improves retrieval and 75%-drop completion in 10/10 runs and blackout tilt in 4/5 (Span-Euc), 2/5 (Scatter), and 5/5 (per-family best) over SFT.

</details>


### [538] [Monte Carlo Tree Search for Classifier Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32118)
*Romain Poggi,Jesse Read*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TSCC，用蒙特卡洛树搜索改进概率分类器链，在大规模多标签精确匹配任务中平衡标签空间探索与高质量预测集利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代多标签数据集标签数庞大且训练集标签有噪声或缺失；许多领域（如医学）需要优化精确多标签评价并给出置信度，这要求估计以输入为条件的标签联合概率。现有概率分类器链要么难以扩展到大规模标签，要么以边缘分布近似联合概率，损害了精确匹配下的不确定性估计。

Method: TSCC：以概率分类器链的推断为基础，引入蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）进行链式推断，在标签空间探索与有前景的标签集预测利用之间做高效平衡。

Result: 在预测性能与计算性能两方面均取得有希望的结果。

Conclusion: TSCC通过MCTS增强链推断，可在大规模标签场景下更好地支持精确匹配评价与不确定性估计，兼顾效果与效率。

Abstract: Multi-label classification continues to be relevant to a variety of modern tasks. Among other challenges, modern data sets are increasingly large with respect to the number of labels, and these labels may be noisy or missing in the training sets. Label-wise scores and ranking-based metrics have been popular, but optimising exact multi-label evaluation (where a predicted set of labels should match the true set exactly) is particularly relevant for many domains, e.g., in medicine; alongside some measure of confidence. This requires an estimation of joint probability across labels (a model of label dependence; conditioned on each input instance). A family of methods known as probabilistic classifier chains provides such inference. However, these existing varieties either do not scale to a large number of labels or do so by approximating joint via marginal distributions in a way that compromises the estimation of uncertainty for exact match accuracy. We overcome this issue by proposing TSCC; leveraging a Monte Carlo Tree Search methodology to enhance chain inference via an efficient balance between the exploration of label space and the exploration of promising label-set predictions. Results are promising both in terms of predictive and computational performance.

</details>


### [539] [Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32131)
*Tianliang Lv,Hao Li,Xinchao Xu,Zhengkun Zhang,Ju Huo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了"推理努力（reasoning effort）训练"，对比强化学习（RL）与在线策略蒸馏（OPD），发现推理压缩与努力分层由不同信号驱动，并提出可用单阶段RL实现分层的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型在复杂任务上能力强，但如何控制其推理努力（思考长度）仍是实际部署的难题，需要理解不同训练范式对"压缩"和"分层"的作用机制。

Method: 对比长度惩罚RL与多教师OPD：RL用序列级奖励压缩单一策略；OPD为每个访问状态提供分层的token级目标。进一步分析训练信号差异，提出在高层级加单个token级KL锚，并结合自然语言努力指令实现分层。

Result: 长度惩罚RL使AIME25思考量减少70%且不损精度，但联合训练时层级坍塌；多教师OPD在33个基准上使低/中层级比高层级少用58%/43%思考token，高层级较参考策略提升3.1分。单token级KL锚足以在单阶段RL学出分层；自然语言指令使分层从训练初期即显现，在匹配思考长度下媲美OPD。

Conclusion: 序列级奖励无法区分层级专属行为与共享行为，而OPD提供每状态的分层目标。但密集目标建立的分层仅在训练所见状态有效，无法迁移到未见agentic任务（努力主要通过交互轮数体现）；而序列级奖励诱导的压缩可迁移。

Abstract: Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD). We find that compressing reasoning and separating effort tiers are governed by different signals. Length-penalized RL reliably compresses a single policy, reducing thinking on AIME25 by 70\% without accuracy loss, but collapses the tiers when they are trained jointly. Multi-teacher OPD separates them: across 33 benchmarks, low and medium use 58\% and 43\% fewer thinking tokens than high, while high improves on the reference policy by 3.1 points. We trace this difference to the training signal. A sequence-level reward cannot tell tier-specific behavior from shared behavior, whereas OPD supplies a tier-specific target at every visited state, including the decision to stop. Building on this analysis, we show that a single token-level KL anchor on the high tier is sufficient to learn separated tiers within one RL stage, and that natural-language effort instructions make this separation emerge from the start of training, yielding a policy competitive with multi-teacher OPD at matched thinking length. Finally, the separation built by dense targets holds only on the states seen in training: it does not carry over to unseen agentic tasks, where effort acts mainly through the number of interaction turns, whereas the compression induced by sequence-level rewards does.

</details>


### [540] [Calibrated Reading of Latent Reasoning and Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32143)
*Zixi Wang,Gaohao Zhou,Yubo Huang,Xin Lai,Yushe Cao,Jingzehua Xu,Shuai Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Calibrated Latent Reader (CLR)，一个紧凑 transformer 读取器，通过任务条件化的状态-候选答案交互来预测推理结果与消息内容，并借助源适配器实现跨模型迁移、共形校准提供覆盖率与误报保证；在 CODI 模型上显著优于 MLP/注意力探针，且以极少 FLOPs 达到 1.7B LatentQA 语言化器的精度，还能以 5% 误报率检出 93.1% 的消息替换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐式推理与键值通信把中间信息存于连续表示中，使模型行为难以直接检查。现有激活读取器面临两难：任务专用探针成本低但灵活性差，语言模型解码器灵活但代价高。需要一种兼顾低成本与灵活性、并能提供可靠性保证的读取方法。

Method: CLR 为紧凑 transformer 读取器，通过对状态与候选答案做任务条件化交互，预测最终答案及消息内容（如参考值成员关系）；源适配器支持跨模型迁移；共形校准在可交换性假设下给出覆盖率与误报的统计保证。

Result: 在两个 CODI 模型上，最终答案预测与参考值成员判断的准确率较 MLP 和注意力探针提升 4–18 个百分点；在 CODI-GPT-2 上精度与 1.7B LatentQA 语言化器相当，但推理 FLOPs 少 437–648 倍；在合成 Qwen3-4B 通信中，对比解码事实与公开承诺，在 5% 名义误报率下检出 93.1% 的消息替换。

Conclusion: CLR 在小成本下实现了高精度、可迁移且带统计保证的隐空间读取，为隐式推理与键值通信提供了实用的可检查性与监控手段。

Abstract: Latent reasoning and key-value communication store intermediate information in continuous representations, limiting direct inspection of model behavior. Existing activation readers trade the low cost of task-specific probes against the flexibility of language-model decoders. We propose the Calibrated Latent Reader, CLR, a compact transformer that predicts reasoning outcomes and message content through task-conditioned interactions between states and candidate answers. Source adapters support transfer across models, while conformal calibration provides coverage and false-alarm guarantees under exchangeability. On two CODI models, CLR improves accuracy over MLP and attention probes by 4-18 percentage points for final-answer prediction and reference-value membership. On CODI-GPT-2, it achieves accuracy comparable to a 1.7B LatentQA-based verbalizer using 437-648 times fewer inference FLOPs. On synthetic Qwen3-4B communications, comparing decoded facts with public commitments detects 93.1% of message substitutions at a nominal 5% false-positive rate.

</details>


### [541] [RetraQ: Manifold-Constrained Critic Guidance for Flow Policies in RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32148)
*Xuanzhuo Liu,Wu Chen,Ruixiang Wu,Shuai Yuan,Chuankang Li,Tongxin Li,Maoqing Yao,Guanghui Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RetraQ 利用预训练 flow 的几何结构约束 critic 引导的方向与终点，避免 critic 外推误差带来的误导性梯度，在离线到在线 RL 和真实插孔任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习到的 critic 可通过将采样动作导向更高预测价值来改进预训练 flow-matching 策略，但即便 critic 能很好地拟合行为数据，其动作梯度仍可能具误导性：指向数据支撑区域之外的分量缺乏行为数据约束，引导容易利用 critic 的外推误差。

Method: 提出 RetraQ：用冻结 flow 的一次速度评估定义去噪映射；用该映射的 Jacobian 对 critic 梯度做滤波（近似切向投影），再用映射本身对更新后的动作做校正（近似拉回行为流形）。同一更新既用于测试时引导，也用于策略蒸馏与在线 RL 的目标构造。

Result: 受控实验中真实回报提升且精炼动作贴近数据支撑区，蒸馏目标比原始 critic 上升更稳定；LIBERO 与 OGBench 离线到在线训练中最终成功率高于对比的 critic 引导基线；真实插孔任务中 π0.5 策略成功率从 55.0% 提升到 76.7%（测试时），在线训练 30 分钟达 98.3%、1 小时内达 100%。

Conclusion: 以预训练 flow 的几何为先验约束 critic 引导，能有效抑制外推误差，是一种简单、通用且可同时服务测试时引导、蒸馏与在线 RL 的有效方案。

Abstract: A learned critic can improve a pretrained flow-matching policy by steering sampled actions toward higher predicted value. However, even a critic that fits the behavior data well can provide misleading action gradients. Gradient components pointing away from the data-supported region are weakly constrained by behavior data and can lead guidance to exploit critic extrapolation errors. We introduce RetraQ (Retraction-based Q-guidance), which uses geometry encoded by the pretrained flow to constrain both the direction and the destination of critic guidance. A single velocity evaluation of the frozen flow defines a denoising map. RetraQ filters the critic gradient with the map's Jacobian and applies the map itself to correct the updated action. Our analysis characterizes when these operations approximate tangent filtering and retraction onto the behavior manifold. The same update guides actions at test time and provides targets for policy distillation and online reinforcement learning. In controlled studies, RetraQ improves true return while keeping refined actions close to the data-supported region, and its distillation targets remain more stable than those of raw critic ascent. In offline-to-online training on LIBERO and OGBench, RetraQ achieves higher mean final success than the evaluated critic-guidance baselines. On a real-world plug-insertion task, test-time RetraQ improves the success rate of a behavior-cloned $π_{0.5}$ policy from 55.0% to 76.7%. Online training further increases success to 98.3% in only 30 minutes and 100% within one hour. Project page: https://2027ICLR.github.io/retraq/

</details>


### [542] [Multi-view Random-set Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32170)
*Mengchi Zuo,Tianyang Wang,Cai Xu,Ziyu Guan,Wei Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Multi-view Random-Set Learning (MRSL)范式，保留各视图对候选类集合的支撑直接做集合级融合，解决视图退化下证据扭曲问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图数据存在"视图退化"现象：单视图仅含部分判别信息，无法独立确定样本标签。强行让这类视图输出明确类证据会扭曲证据学习并误导融合。现有方法要么直接给单类分配证据而不显式表达未解决类组，要么在融合前就把复合信念投影到单类，无法通过跨视图集合交集直接精化候选组。

Method: 提出MRSL范式：量化类重叠以从指数级类子集中挑选紧凑集合；对集合交集分配联合支撑做集合级融合，使互补视图在概率转换前收窄候选类范围。

Result: 合成数据与8个真实数据集验证了重叠度量的有效性；MRSL在全部8个数据集上取得最高准确率，相较最强基线平均准确率提升4.71%，平均ECE降低6.33%。

Conclusion: 以随机集合建模保留未解决类组、并在集合层面融合，是缓解视图退化的有效途径，兼顾精度与校准；数据集与代码将公开。

Abstract: Trusted multi-view learning aims to integrate heterogeneous views for accurate and reliable predictions. However, multi-view data often exhibit the view degradation phenomenon: individual views contain only partial discriminative information and cannot independently determine the instance-level label. Requiring such views to produce unambiguous class evidence can distort evidence learning and mislead subsequent fusion. Existing methods addressing this problem have at least one of the following drawbacks: (1) assigning evidence to individual classes without explicitly representing unresolved class groups; (2) projecting composite beliefs onto individual classes before fusion, preventing direct refinement of candidate groups through cross-view set intersections.
  To address these limitations, we propose a new Multi-view Random-Set Learning (MRSL) paradigm, which preserves view-specific support for candidate class sets and refines candidate classes through cross-view fusion. Specifically, we quantify class overlap to select a compact collection of sets for each view, avoiding the exponential cost of modeling all class subsets. We then perform set-level fusion by assigning joint support to set intersections, allowing complementary views to narrow the candidate classes before probability conversion. Experiments on synthetic and eight real-world datasets validate the proposed overlap measure and demonstrate that MRSL achieves the highest accuracy on all eight datasets. Compared with the strongest baselines, MRSL improves average accuracy by 4.71% and reduces average expected calibration error by 6.33%. All datasets and code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [543] [A Unified Control Framework for Gradient Inversion Defense in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32174)
*Lianhai Ren,Chi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文统一了现有梯度扰动防御于"受控动力学"框架，并据此提出NODE方法——仅沿与原梯度正交的方向注入扰动，在保持固定余弦相似度的同时降低优化代价，实现更好的隐私-效用权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度扰动是防御联邦学习中梯度反演攻击的有效手段，但会损害优化，造成隐私与效用之间的持续张力；现有防御形式各异、缺乏统一理解，且需针对具体情形逐一分析。

Method: 将现有梯度扰动防御统一到受控动力学框架下，推导通用的收敛性与安全性条件；提出近正交梯度投影（NODE），仅沿与原始梯度正交的方向注入扰动，使防御后梯度与真实梯度保持固定余弦相似度，从而保留一阶下降方向。

Result: 在标准优化假设下证明NODE的收敛保证，并在梯度分布的温和条件下证明其仍能有效防止反演攻击；在CIFAR-10、ImageNet、Chest X-ray等基准数据集和多种梯度反演攻击上的实验表明，该框架在广泛训练设置下优于现有防御的隐私-效用权衡。

Conclusion: 通过统一框架理解梯度扰动的优化行为，NODE在保留下降方向的前提下以较低优化代价实现强扰动保护，理论上保证收敛与安全性，实验上取得更优的隐私-效用权衡。

Abstract: Gradient perturbations are widely recognized as an effective defense against gradient inversion attacks in federated learning, but they are equally known to impair optimization, creating a persistent tension between privacy and utility. In this paper, we show that existing gradient perturbation defenses, despite their different formulations, can be unified under a controlled dynamics framework, providing a cohesive understanding of their optimization behavior and enabling the derivation of universal convergence and safety conditions without relying on case-specific analyses. Leveraging this observation, we propose ``Near Orthogonal Gradient Projection (NODE)'', which injects perturbations only along directions orthogonal to the original gradient so that the defended gradient maintains a fixed cosine similarity with the true gradient. By preserving the first-order descent direction, NODE substantially reduces the optimization cost of strong perturbations while maintaining effective protection against gradient inversion attacks. We theoretically establish convergence guarantees under standard optimization assumptions and further show that, under mild conditions on the gradient distribution, NODE remains effective in preventing inversion attacks. Comprehensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets, including CIFAR-10, ImageNet, and Chest X-ray, together with a variety of gradient inversion attacks, demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves an improved privacy--utility trade-off over existing defenses across a broad range of training settings.

</details>


### [544] [Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32199)
*Henry Castillo,Yanchen Liu,Claudio Mayrink Verdun,Dylan Hadfield-Menell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将指令通道与数据通道在预训练阶段分离的架构，训练出 Mancelle-3B，实现内建式可控语言模型，抗越狱与软提示反控制能力优于提示/激活引导方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型用下一词预测预训练，把对齐与控制压到训练最后1%的token或推理时干预；且指令与数据共用单一输入通道，导致模型误把数据当指令（有意越狱、无意的上下文对齐漂移）。

Method: 提出新的预训练方法与架构：编码器提取即将生成文本的高层语义特征，通过交叉注意力注入，且token流无法回写该控制通道；预训练中模型被迫依赖这些特征预测下一token，使该通道成为有效的引导手柄。用 Mancelle-3B 验证，并用 Mancelle-400M 在更受控的基线上复现。

Result: 在同类开放模型上，引导强度高于基于提示和基于激活的方法，同时保持流畅性；并能抵御击败这些基线的黑盒对抗攻击与软提示反引导。

Conclusion: 若在早期且有意识地设计，稳健的控制能力可以被内建进语言模型。

Abstract: Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today's language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. These models repurpose a single input channel for both instructions and data, leading to common failure modes where the model mistakenly treats data as instructions such as intentional jailbreaks and unintentional in-context alignment drift. To correct this, we propose a pretraining method and architecture that separates the two from the very start, producing Mancelle-3B. An encoder processes high-level semantic features of upcoming text with cross-attention that prevents the token stream from writing back into this control channel. During pretraining, the model learns to rely on these features to predict the next token, turning the channel into an effective handle for steering the model. Mancelle-3B steers more strongly than prompt- and activation-based methods on comparable open models while maintaining fluency, and it withstands adversarial black-box and soft-prompt counter-steering that defeats those baselines. We reproduce this against a more controlled baseline with Mancelle-400M. Our results show that robust control can be built into language models if we do so early and intentionally.

</details>


### [545] [Who gets the information? An $α$-fair label-coverage framework for multi-label feature selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32200)
*Zhenzhi Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文把多标签特征选择中"相关性如何在标签间分配"的选择揭示为隐式的社会福利函数，提出 FLIC：以 α-公平福利贪心地最大化各标签的信息覆盖。单一参数 α 从功利主义（α=0）、比例公平（α=1）到 max-min（α→∞）连续过渡，统一了十余种已发表的相关性度量；目标在 α≥0 时为单调子模，贪心达到 (1-1/e) 近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多标签特征选择的信息论滤波器在"如何把相关性分配到各标签"上存在分歧：有的放大只对少数标签有信息的特征，有的追求每个标签的均衡收益。作者指出这些选择其实都是隐式的社会福利函数，但此前缺乏统一框架来解释与比较它们。

Method: 将标签视为"代理"，其效用为所获得的信息，把特征选择建模为社会福利最大化问题。提出 FLIC：贪心地最大化每标签信息覆盖的 α-公平福利。给出理论与实证分析：α 轴统一多种相关性项；目标对 α≥0 为单调子模，贪心为 (1-1/e) 近似（α<0 失效，max-min 极限不可近似）；用 Fano 与 Hellman-Raviv 不等式把原始覆盖联系到 Bayes Hamming 损失、把归一化覆盖联系到每标签相对误差。FLIC 采用偏差校正的标签级条件信息，且无需相关性-冗余权衡参数。

Result: 在 22 个数据集上，FLIC 在 9 个指标中的 7 个上优于 14 种信息论滤波器，117 次成对比较中 86 次显著胜出，无显著落败。与 17 种方法比较，在两种分类器下于 ranking loss、coverage、macro-AUC 上排名第一，平均排名最佳（与 ML-kNN 接近）；Hamming loss、one-error、micro-F1 上则落后于三种嵌入式方法。

Conclusion: FLIC 为多标签信息论特征选择提供了统一的福利经济学视角与可证明的近似保证，无需权衡参数即可在排序类指标上取得领先表现，但并未在所有指标上全面占优（嵌入式方法在部分分类指标上更好）。

Abstract: Recent information-theoretic filters for multi-label feature selection disagree on how to distribute relevance over labels: some amplify features that inform a few labels, others balance what every label receives. We show these choices are implicit social welfare functions. Treating labels as agents whose utility is the information they receive, we propose FLIC, which greedily maximises the $α$-fair welfare of per-label information coverage. A single parameter $α$ moves from utilitarian ($α=0$) through proportionally fair ($α=1$) to max-min selection ($α\to\infty$), and a dozen published relevance terms lie on this axis, most as special cases, first-order approximations or limits. The objective is monotone submodular for every $α\ge0$ whenever each label's information is, so greedy selection is a $(1-1/e)$-approximation; this fails for $α<0$, and the max-min limit is inapproximable. Fano's and the Hellman-Raviv inequalities tie raw coverage to the Bayes Hamming loss and normalised coverage to per-label relative error. FLIC uses bias-corrected, label-wise conditional information and has no relevance-redundancy trade-off parameter. On 22 data sets, FLIC is the best of 14 information-theoretic filters on seven of nine metrics, winning 86 of 117 pairwise comparisons significantly and losing none significantly. Among 17 methods it ranks first on ranking loss, coverage and macro-AUC with two classifiers and has the best mean rank (narrowly with ML-kNN), while three embedded methods lead on Hamming loss, one-error and micro-F1.

</details>


### [546] [Joint Classification and Generation on Tabular Data: an Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32225)
*Tim d'Hondt,Oleksii Furman,Damian Kwolek,Jan Poręba,Maciej Zieba,Mykola Pechenizkiy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该实证研究比较了四类表格深度模型（能量模型、概率电路、表格基础模型、表格扩散模型）构建的联合分类+生成模型，在29个分类数据集上按FLOPs和实际耗时衡量。结果显示小预算下概率电路最优，更大预算下TabICL最优；联合模型很少优于独立分类器+生成器组合，但通常非常接近且省去训两模型的麻烦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多表格机器学习应用同时需要分类器和生成逼真记录，默认做法是训练两个独立模型，而单一联合模型可从一套权重同时提供二者。已有多种表格深度模型族可改造为联合模型，但在不同计算预算下哪种联合模型更优尚不清楚，且不清楚联合模型是否值得替代常规的分离训练做法。

Method: 基于四类先进表格建模族（能量模型、概率电路、表格基础模型、表格扩散模型）引入并比较联合模型；在29个分类数据集上以实测FLOPs和wall-clock时间为计算预算，采用两个聚合分数（分别考虑预测与生成的不同方面）评估；并将联合模型与各分离分类器+生成器配对在不同预算下对比。

Result: 最小预算下最佳联合模型是概率电路；超过该预算后，最佳是基于回归器逐列生成的表格基础模型TabICL。与分离模型对相比，联合模型很少更优，但往往非常接近最佳配对。

Conclusion: 联合模型总体不如分离的分类器+生成器配对，但性能接近且无需训练与维护两套模型，因此在某些场景下是可辩护的选择；计算预算决定了应选概率电路还是TabICL。

Abstract: Many applications of machine learning on tabular data need both a classifier and a generator of realistic records. The default is to train two separate models, whereas a single joint model promises both from one set of weights. Several families of tabular deep learning models can be turned into such a joint model, which raises the question of which joint model is preferable at which computational budget. In this empirical study, we introduce and compare joint models based on four state-of-the-art tabular data modeling families (energy-based models, probabilistic circuits, tabular foundation models and tabular diffusion models) against measured FLOPs and wall-clock time, on 29 classification datasets. Methods are evaluated based on two defined aggregate scores that take into account different aspects of prediction and generation. We then also compare these joint models with every pair of a separate classifier and generator at different computational budgets, to see when a joint model may be a defendible choice against the regular practice of keeping a separate classifier and generator. We find that the best joint model is a probabilistic circuit at the smallest budgets and, beyond that, a tabular foundation model that generates column by column using a regressor (TabICL). Compared with pairs of separate models, this study finds a joint model is rarely preferable but often very close to the best pair, without the hassle of training and maintaining two separate models.

</details>


### [547] [Seldon TFM family: Seldon-Mini, Seldon and Seldon+](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32257)
*Stanislas Angebault,Nicolas Atienza,Nicola Cancedda,Aziz Fouché,Salomé Gobbi,Ekaterina Iakovleva,Nicolas Makaroff,Arthur Nahmias,Paul Novello,Alexandre Pasquiou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Seldon 系列表格基础模型，分类器 Seldon+ 在自有 TabBench（124个分类数据集）及缺失值变体上均排名第一，公开基准上亦领先，开放权重模型在场推理时间权衡上位于 Pareto 前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建适用于表格数据的基础模型，并在准确性与推理效率之间取得有竞争力的权衡，同时保持模型可开放权重发布。

Method: 采用与 Kumo-Tabular、TabFM、TabPFN-3.5 类似的架构，仅用合成表格数据训练；发布 Seldon-Mini（27M参数）和 Seldon（213M参数），均支持分类与回归；并提出 TabBench 基准（124个分类数据集）。

Result: Seldon+ 在 TabBench 及其缺失值变体的15个模型中排名第一；BeyondArena IID 分类与 TabBench-Bio 排名第一，TabArena 分类排名第二；TabArena 上 Seldon 第四、Seldon-Mini 第七（共109条目），BeyondArena IID 赛道第二（42条目）；两者均位于 Elo—推理时间 Pareto 前沿。

Conclusion: Seldon 系列以纯合成数据训练实现了强表格性能与高效推理，开放权重模型在多数基准上具竞争力，但部分前列排名基于作者自建基准或自跑结果，需第三方独立验证。

Abstract: We introduce Seldon, a family of tabular foundation models. Our classifier Seldon+ ranks first among 15 models on TabBench, our benchmark of 124 classification datasets, and on its variant with missing values. In our own runs of public benchmarks, it also ranks first on BeyondArena IID classification and TabBench-Bio, and second on TabArena classification. The open-weight models Seldon-Mini (27M parameters) and Seldon (213M parameters) both lie on the TabArena Pareto front of Elo against inference time: no entry is both more accurate and faster. On TabArena, Seldon ranks fourth and Seldon-Mini seventh among 109 leaderboard entries, and on the IID track of BeyondArena, Seldon ranks second among 42 entries. Seldon-Mini and Seldon handle both classification and regression, use an architecture similar to those of Kumo-Tabular, TabFM and TabPFN-3.5, and are trained on synthetic tables only.

</details>


### [548] [Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32269)
*Joren Dumoulin,Hyoukjun Kwon,Subhankar Pal,Steven Li,Vignesh Vivekraja,Marian Verhelst*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Pando 在并行草稿器之上构建动态草稿树，利用"噪声耦合剪枝"突破草稿链长度受块大小限制的问题，在边缘设备上实现相对自回归解码 5.3× 加速与 4.2× 能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归解码每次前向只生成一个 token，却要重载整个模型，导致边缘设备上推理受内存带宽限制、计算单元闲置。投机解码可用闲置算力一次验证多个草稿 token，但 DFlash、DSpark 等并行草稿器的草稿链长度被训练块大小封顶，验证阶段的计算预算大量浪费。

Method: 提出 Pando：在并行草稿器上构建动态草稿树以解除长度上限。核心是噪声耦合剪枝——在草稿前先抽取目标模型的采样噪声，并在该噪声下对候选分支排序，使树保留目标模型实际会采样的分支；该操作无损，无需重训练或额外模型前向。此外将算子级 roofline 归一化到 AR 解码，把各平台化为其 ridge point，用于跨硬件的配置优化与评估。

Result: 噪声耦合使接受长度在 Qwen3-8B 上最高提升 8.4%。代表性边缘设备上，16 节点 Pando 树相对 AR 解码达 5.3× 加速、4.2× 能耗降低；比 DSpark 已发布链快 25%，比 EAGLE-3 树快 27% 且能耗低 72%。

Conclusion: 动态草稿树可有效突破并行草稿器的块大小限制。所建模的边缘设备上最优配置仍受内存带宽约束，因此增加算力并不能降低其延迟——提升边缘 LLM 推理效率应聚焦内存瓶颈与接受长度优化。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) decoding emits one token per forward pass, reloading the full model each time, so LLM inference on edge devices is memory-bound while the compute units sit idle. Speculative decoding puts that idle compute to work by verifying several drafted tokens in a single pass. State-of-the-art parallel drafters such as DFlash and DSpark propose an entire block of draft tokens in one forward pass, which makes drafting compute-efficient. However, they are deployed with draft chains whose length is capped by the block size they are trained for, leaving most of the computational budget for verification unused.
  To tackle this problem, we propose Pando, which builds dynamic draft trees on top of a parallel drafter and thereby removes this cap. Pando employs noise-coupled pruning, which draws the target model's sampling noise before drafting and ranks candidate branches under that noise, so the tree retains the branches the target will actually sample. Noise coupling is lossless and requires no retraining or additional model pass, yet increases acceptance length by up to $8.4\%$ on Qwen3-8B. To optimize and evaluate Pando configurations across hardware, we normalize an operator-level roofline to AR decoding, reducing every platform to its ridge point. On a representative edge device, a 16-node Pando tree attains $5.3\times$ speedup and $4.2\times$ energy reduction over AR decoding: $25\%$ faster than DSpark's released chain, and $27\%$ faster and $72\%$ more energy-efficient than an EAGLE-3 tree. The best configurations remain memory-bound on every edge device we model, so added compute capacity does not reduce their latency.

</details>


### [549] [CoMNO: Commutator Memory Neural Operators for Long-Horizon PDE Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32274)
*Han Xiao,Xin Zhang,Yuhan Zou,Zhenzhong Wang,Donglin Cao,Dazhen Lin,Min Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Commutator Memory Neural Operator (CoMNO)，通过"先降采样再rollout"与"先rollout再降采样"两种算子之间的差距提取被降采样丢失的细尺度动力学细节，并用记忆模块沿轨迹存储与检索这些特征，生成空间自适应修正，从而提升长时程PDE预测的精度与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数值方法在长时程非线性PDE上计算代价高；神经算子虽高效，但在自回归rollout中会累积近似误差，根本原因在于难以捕捉细尺度细节，导致长期预测失真。

Method: 设计交换（commutator）式思路：比较"先对高分辨率场降采样再rollout"与"先rollout再降采样"两种操作，指出二者差异中编码了细尺度动力学信息；通过交换两操作捕获降采样中被丢弃的细尺度细节，并引入记忆模块沿轨迹存储这些特征、在rollout时检索，生成空间自适应修正项。

Result: 在五个系统上的实验表明，CoMNO提升了预测精度并改善了长时程rollout的稳定性。

Conclusion: 利用算子交换差距来显式建模被忽略的细尺度动态，并结合记忆机制的检索式修正，是缓解神经算子长期误差累积的一种有效且通用的策略。

Abstract: Solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs) over long time horizons is computationally expensive using traditional numerical methods. While neural operators provide an efficient alternative, they suffer from the accumulation of approximation errors along the predicted trajectory, typically caused by the failure to capture fine-scale details. In this work, we design a Commutator Memory Neural Operator that identifies fine-scale dynamical details by commuting two operations and leverages these details to enhance the neural operator's capability in capturing fine-scale features over long time horizons. Specifically, we identify a performance gap between two operations: downsampling the high-resolution field before rollout prediction versus performing rollout prediction before downsampling. We observe that fine-scale dynamical details are often encoded in this gap. By commuting these two operations, the fine-scale details removed during downsampling can be captured. Furthermore, we employ a memory module to store these fine-scale features along the trajectory and retrieve them during rollout, generating spatially adaptive corrections that enhance long-horizon fidelity. Empirical results across five systems demonstrate that CoMNO improves prediction accuracy and long-horizon rollout stability.

</details>


### [550] [DAiSy: Online Data Selection by Adaptive Utility Estimation for LLM Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32294)
*Simin Fan,Martin Jaggi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DAiSy 用轻量线性辅助模型从冻结的文档嵌入预测数据效用分数，替代逐候选文档的梯度计算，从而高效实现模型感知的在线数据选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线数据选择器需对每个候选文档做完整前向-反向传播来算梯度效用分，打分成本与训练该文档相当，但只有极少部分真正用于更新，计算与基础设施开销过高。

Method: 提出 DAiSy：一个以冻结文档嵌入为输入、学习预测数据效用分数的线性辅助模型；它与主语言模型同步更新，拟合常规训练步反向传播得到的精确梯度效用分。打分仅需一次线性变换，无需梯度对齐计算。

Result: 在英语及多语言 LLM 预训练中，配合多种 steering target 设计，验证了其有效性与效率；DAiSy 带来的提升可延续至指令微调阶段。

Conclusion: 用廉价线性代理替代梯度打分可在保持数据选择效果的同时大幅降低开销，是一种可扩展的模型感知在线数据选择方案。

Abstract: Model-aware online data selection prioritizes the training documents that contribute the most given the model's current state. Existing online selectors rank candidates upon gradient-based data utility scores, which requires the full forward-backward pass of the main model on every candidate document. Scoring each document therefore pays as much as training on it, yet only a small fraction is used for the real model update. We introduce DAiSy, a lightweight linear auxiliary model that learns to predict data utility scores from frozen document embeddings, which eliminates the computation overhead and infrastructure burdens. The linear estimator is updated alongside the main language model, fitting to the exact gradient-based utility scores obtained from the backward pass of regular training steps. Consequently, scoring a candidate requires only a linear transformation, bypassing the costly gradient-alignment computation. We demonstrate its effectiveness and efficiency for LLM pretraining in English and multilingual scenarios, with various steering target designs. The improvements from DAiSy can consistently survive the instruction-tuning phase.

</details>


### [551] [SPRUNN: Structural Proximity for Pruning in Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32317)
*Babak Rokha,Ali Azarpeyvanda,Alireza Khanteymoori,Tara Ghasempouri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于结构邻近性准则的滤波器剪枝方法SPRUNN，结合全连接层细粒度剪枝与学习率微调策略，在多种架构与数据集上实现高精度压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN参数与计算量巨大、耗时严重，参数剪枝可压缩网络，但核心难点在于选择合适参数剪枝而不显著损伤精度。

Method: SPRUNN：对卷积层计算Structural Proximity（SP），将每个滤波器与其余所有滤波器比较得到相似度，识别不重要滤波器进行剪枝；再对全连接层做细粒度剪枝以压缩含卷积与FC层的网络；并提出重训练阶段的学习率精调策略提升精度。

Result: 实验表明SPRUNN在多种网络架构和数据集上都能在保持高精度的同时实现显著压缩。

Conclusion: 结构邻近性可作为有效的滤波器重要性度量，配合全连接层细粒度剪枝与学习率精调，可在不显著损失精度的情况下有效压缩DNN。

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated significant accuracy across various machine learning tasks. However, these networks suffer from a huge number of parameters and computations, which leads to time-consuming processes. Consequently, parameter pruning approaches have been proposed to compress DNNs and efficiently implement them. The main challenge in pruning is selecting the appropriate parameters for pruning without significantly damaging the accuracy. In this paper, we propose SPRUNN, an algorithmic pruning approach based on the structural proximity criterion for filter pruning in convolutional layers of deep neural networks. Structural Proximity (SP) calculates filter similarity by considering all filters and comparing each one with the others, effectively identifying less important filters for pruning in the convolutional layers. Furthermore, we integrate this approach with fine-grained pruning in Fully Connected(FC)layerstocompresstheDNNsthatinclude both convolutional and FC layers.Toenhancetheaccuracyoftheprunedmodel,weproposealearning rate refinement strategy during the retraining phase. Experimental results demonstrate that SPRUNN achieves significant compression with high accuracy across diverse architectures and datasets.

</details>


### [552] [When Exact Token Importance Is Not Enough: Limits of Top-K Selection in LLM Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32324)
*Irmaan Mirzanejad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 长上下文模型的选择性注意力中，逐个打分再取Top-K并非最优：即便每个分数精确衡量"删除该位置"引起的下游KL变化，联合选出的K个位置也可能远差于最优组合（构造例子中差距达133.2倍KL，且该差距无上界）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力按token位置独立打分并保留得分最高的K个，但注意力权重在所选集合上重新归一化，使得位置间存在交互作用。作者希望检验：即使用最"正确"的单点重要性度量，独立排名是否仍然足够。

Method: 构造四位置反例与参数族证明差距可无界；给出一阶交换恒等式解释交互与偏好反转（所有K≥2）；在SmolLM2、Gemma、Qwen上做冻结模型的穷举审计（24位置候选池，精确单点Top-4对比全枚举最优）；提出SwapCert——同预算的一次交换审计方法；用KL-margin证书把支撑集保真度与下一token稳定性关联，并在K=128/256上做更大预算、多层缓存解码实验。

Result: 四位置构造中排序对KL是更优对的133.2倍，参数族证明该差距无上界；穷举审计中精确单点Top-4在55/60、49/60、60/60案例中可获≥10%相对改进；SwapCert在164个案例中检出157个并给出可直接检验的改进支撑集。

Conclusion: 稀疏注意力的"支撑集联合质量"是独立分析对象，独立打分不足，需在推理约束下进行下游感知的支撑集选择。

Abstract: Long-context language models often retain only a limited set of past token positions for an attention query. A common strategy scores positions individually and keeps the highest-ranked K. Yet attention weights are renormalized over the chosen set: two individually important positions need not form the best pair. We ask whether independent ranking suffices even when each importance score measures the exact downstream change in next-token predictions caused by deleting that position alone. It does not. A four-position construction makes the ranked pair incur 133.2 times the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the optimal pair, and a parametric family proves that this multiplicative gap is unbounded. An exact exchange identity and preference reversals for every K >= 2 explain the interaction. In exhaustive frozen-model audits of SmolLM2, Gemma, and Qwen, exact-singleton Top-4 leaves at least 10% relative improvement within a fully enumerated 24-position candidate pool in 55/60, 49/60, and 60/60 cases, respectively. SwapCert, a same-budget one-swap audit, detects 157/164 such cases and returns directly checkable improving supports. A KL-margin certificate relates support fidelity to next-token stability; larger-budget, multi-layer cached-decoding experiments measure predictive fidelity at K = 128 and 256. These results establish joint support quality as an essential object of analysis for sparse attention and motivate downstream-aware support selection under inference constraints.

</details>


### [553] [Beyond Hard Tokens: Predictive Memory for Multimodal Protein Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32347)
*Xiaoliang Shi,Zichen Wang,Zhijian Wei,Zhanpeng Shi,Zhenghong Zhou,Yunpeng Wang,Shuangjia Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练的自条件递推机制PredMem，通过跨迭代传递未确定位点的软信念，解决多模态蛋白语言模型掩码解码中的无状态转移问题，显著提升序列-结构联合生成成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态蛋白语言模型通过迭代掩码解码统一序列与离散结构token，但标准解码器每步都进行无记忆的掩码重置：只保留少量已确定硬token，其余未解位点全部重置为相同[MASK]嵌入。在无固定外部锚点的开放式联合生成中，这种无状态转移限制了单步细化深度，且两模态都缺少稳定的跨步软锚点，导致收敛慢或退化为重复模式坍塌。

Method: 作者观察到未确定预测在时间上具有显著一致性而非随机噪声，据此提出PredMem：一种无需训练的自我条件递推。每步将原始logits压缩为每残基的概率加权Top-k期望嵌入，并在下一步以仿射方式插值进合格的掩码输入中，且不增加去噪器计算成本。

Result: 在DPLM-2、DPLM-2.1和ESM3上，无条件序列-结构联合生成成功率分别提升3.6、17.7和48.7个百分点，同时改善质量-多样性权衡并抑制重复模式坍塌。对照诊断表明收益主要来自无锚跨模态协同进化中的早期轨迹稳定，而非额外算力或单纯熵降低。

Conclusion: PredMem是一种高效的多模态离散生成推理机制，以零额外去噪成本实现跨步软锚传递，有效稳定生成轨迹并提升开放域蛋白联合设计性能。

Abstract: Multimodal protein language models unify sequence and discrete structural tokens via iterative masked decoding, offering a promising paradigm for joint protein design. However, standard decoders rely on a memoryless mask reset at each iteration: only a sparse subset of newly committed hard tokens is carried forward, while all remaining unresolved sites are reset to an identical [MASK] embedding. In open-ended co-generation where neither modality provides a fixed external anchor, this stateless transition limits single-step refinement depth and deprives both tracks of stable cross-step soft anchors, leading to slow convergence or degenerative repetitive collapse. Observing that uncommitted predictions evolve with pronounced temporal coherence rather than erratic noise, we introduce Predictive Memory (PredMem), a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries these soft beliefs across steps. At each step, PredMem summarizes raw logits into a probability-weighted Top-$k$ expectation embedding at every residue and affinely interpolates it into eligible masked inputs on the next step at zero extra denoiser cost. Across DPLM-2, DPLM-2.1, and ESM3, PredMem raises unconditional sequence-structure co-generation success by 3.6, 17.7, and 48.7 percentage points, respectively, while improving the quality-diversity trade-off and suppressing repetitive mode collapse. Controlled diagnostics show that these gains stem primarily from early trajectory stabilization in unanchored cross-modal co-evolution rather than extra compute or simple entropy reduction, establishing PredMem as an efficient inference mechanism for multimodal discrete generation.

</details>


### [554] [CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32357)
*Xvyuan Liu,Jianjie Fang,Honglin Zhang,Zhaolu Wang,Xin Zhang,Wei Wu,Fengli Xu,Chen Gao,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CriticJEPA 用冻结的分层世界模型 + 目标条件流提案 + 转发选择来做规划，避免梯度优化的预测误差利用问题，在视觉导航与操作任务上以更少算力取得更高成功率并可跨模型/任务迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于梯度的规划器持续优化动作会利用世界模型的预测误差（执行已无改善仍被"刷分"），且需可比较的相对分数与可靠的更新方向，而冻结分层世界模型在长时间梯度搜索产生的候选间排序不可靠。

Method: 学习目标条件的流（flow）提案，来自无奖励轨迹；在每一层级用冻结世界模型的 rollout 对提案进行前向选择，形成完整规划器；并在选择前用短程锚定更新精炼候选。

Result: 在视觉导航与操作任务上，成功率提升且规划算力仅为一小部分；共享超参可迁移到独立训练的模型、不同层级深度与未见任务，且世界模型权重全程冻结。

Conclusion: 有效规划的关键在于将目标导向候选与能区分其结果的预测配对，前向选择优于无信息的梯度搜索排序；CriticJEPA 提供了高效、可迁移、无需微调世界模型的规划方案。

Abstract: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.

</details>


### [555] [From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32372)
*Jan Rohleff,Johannes Schropp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对VAE-NLME（将变分自编码器用于非线性混合效应模型）算法进行收敛性分析：ELBO版本几乎必然收敛到ELBO的驻点集；最终算法以ELBO训练编码器并作为重要性加权充分统计量的提议分布，几乎必然收敛到边际对数似然的驻点集，且无需假设编码器被精确训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLME模型是药物计量学的核心统计模型，用于剂量选择、个体化给药与监管决策。其建模本质是边际似然问题。VAE可分摊不可解后验的近似并允许在NLME中引入AI组件，但此前缺乏对该算法收敛性的理论保证。

Method: 提供VAE-NLME算法的收敛性分析。首先证明其ELBO版本在不对编码器精确训练作假设的情况下，几乎必然收敛到ELBO的驻点集；其次分析最终算法——用基于梯度的优化在ELBO上训练编码器，并将其作为重要性加权充分统计量的提议分布——证明其几乎必然收敛到边际对数似然的驻点集，同样不依赖编码器训练的额外假设。

Result: 两个版本均获得几乎必然收敛性保证：ELBO版本收敛到ELBO驻点集；完整算法收敛到边际对数似然驻点集。且无需假设编码器被精确训练。

Conclusion: VAE-NLME结合了VAE的快速梯度训练与最大似然估计的极限性质，为在药物计量学NLME建模中引入AI组件提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) models are the central statistical models of pharmacometrics, where they support dose selection, individualized dosing and regulatory decisions in drug development. Statistically, NLME modeling is a marginalized likelihood problem. Variational autoencoders (VAEs) solve such problems with a neural network encoder that amortizes the approximation of the intractable posterior distribution, and allow the integration of AI components into NLME modeling. This paper provides the convergence analysis of the VAE-NLME algorithm. First, its version for the evidence lower bound (ELBO) is proven to converge almost surely to the set of stationary points of the ELBO, without assuming that the encoder is trained exactly. Second, the final VAE-NLME algorithm trains the encoder on the ELBO by gradient-based optimization and uses it as proposal for importance-weighted sufficient statistics. It converges almost surely to the set of stationary points of the marginal log-likelihood, without any assumption on the training of the encoder. Thus, it combines the fast gradient-based training of VAEs with the limit of maximum likelihood estimation.

</details>


### [556] [Metamorphic Testing of Learned Spatial Surrogates for Transit Accessibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32373)
*Till Zacher,Markus Lienkamp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 训练神经代理模型快速近似公交网络可达性变化，以取代优化循环中过慢的详细可达性计算；但仅有预测精度不足，必须同时进行受控行为测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通网络设计需要评估大量候选方案，而详细的可达性计算太慢，无法在优化循环内反复执行，因此需要快速的代理模型。

Method: 训练神经代理模型：输入候选公交网络及固定的轨道服务与周边机会信息，预测可达性的空间变化；在地理留出区域上与路径规划目标对比，并在受控输入变化下检验指定的定性关系，另用构造网络上的参考计算评估具有路径层面对应关系的性质。

Result: 具有正预测能力的模型仍可能通不过基本的连通性测试；某项针对性干预在提升两个连通性关系通过率的同时也提高了预测精度。

Conclusion: 当学习模型成为优化目标时，平均预测误差不足以为据；应分别报告预测一致性与受控行为测试结果。

Abstract: Transit-network design requires evaluating many candidates, but detailed accessibility calculations are too slow to repeat inside an optimization loop. We therefore train a neural surrogate to approximate them. Given a candidate bus network and fixed information about rail service and nearby opportunities, it predicts the calculated spatial change in accessibility. We compare its predictions with routing-derived targets in geographically held-out regions and test specified qualitative relations under controlled input changes. Reference calculations on constructed networks assess the applicability of relations that have a routing-level counterpart. Models with positive predictive skill can still fail basic connectivity tests. One targeted intervention substantially increases pass rates for two connectivity relations while predictive skill also improves. Average prediction error is therefore insufficient when a learned model becomes an optimization objective. Predictive agreement and controlled behavioral tests should be reported separately.

</details>


### [557] [The Activity Geometry of Discrete Generative Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32380)
*Xinlong Guo,Jie Zhang,Lingyou Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"Activity Geometry"框架，用期望转移代价（activity）刻画离散扩散/流模型中有限步采样的耦合自由度，并将其分解为边际传输所需最小值与耦合产生的超额项，据此提出无需重训练的MAFTC方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代精炼（允许修正已生成token）日益成为离散扩散与流模型采样器设计的关键，但其对相邻采样状态之间耦合的自由度缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 引入Activity Geometry，通过期望转移代价（activity）分析有限步耦合；证明activity可分解为诱导边际传输的最小必要值与耦合引起的超额项；以该最小值为参考提出Minimal-Activity Finite-Time Coupling (MAFTC)，在无需重训练或额外模型评估下实现最小activity的指定边际；分析连续时间极限下的最小期望跳率，并对度量诱导的Gibbs路径给出kinetic-optimal flux的几何分解。

Result: 总activity会掩盖耦合超额：采样器可能已接近边际传输所需最小activity，却仍保留大量耦合超额。语言生成中，随模型评估次数增加，精炼型采样器累积额外轨迹activity而多样性收益有限；MAFTC在保持可比生成质量的同时降低轨迹activity并提升词汇多样性。

Conclusion: Activity为离散扩散/流模型的耦合设计提供了可量化、可分解的几何分析工具，MAFTC能在不增加成本的情况下实现最小activity采样，兼顾质量与多样性。

Abstract: Iterative refinement is a key capability of diffusion-based generation and has motivated growing efforts to bring similar behavior to discrete diffusion and flow models. A growing line of work enables such refinement by allowing previously generated tokens to be revised during sampling, thereby shaping the coupling between successive sampling states. Despite its growing role in sampler design, this coupling freedom remains insufficiently characterized. We introduce Activity Geometry to study these finite-step couplings through expected transition cost, which we call activity. We show that activity decomposes into the minimum required by the induced marginal transport and an excess term arising from the coupling. Using this minimum as a reference, we propose Minimal-Activity Finite-Time Coupling (MAFTC) to realize prescribed marginals with minimum activity without retraining or additional model evaluations. In the continuous-time limit, the minimum activity per unit time converges to the minimum expected jump rate compatible with the prescribed path. For metric-induced Gibbs paths, we further show that the activity of the kinetic-optimal flux admits a geometric decomposition. We find that total activity alone can obscure coupling excess: a sampler may approach the minimum activity required by the prescribed marginal transport while still retaining substantial coupling excess. In language generation, as the number of model evaluations increases, refinement-based samplers accumulate additional trajectory activity with limited diversity gains, whereas MAFTC reduces trajectory activity while maintaining comparable generation quality and higher lexical diversity.

</details>


### [558] [Evolve to Learn: Gradient-aligned experience evolution for model self-improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32390)
*Haoyuan Li,Gangyi Zhang,Dong Wang,Yang Liu,Daoxuan Liu,Jiancan Wu,Shiu-hong Kao,Wu Liu,Yicong Li,Yongdong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出E2L自进化框架，通过"生成-评估-蒸馏"闭环，依据训练效用（梯度对齐度）筛选经验并进行在线自我蒸馏，使语言模型自主积累可提升自身能力的学习经验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化语言模型可通过测试时交互、反思与提示优化积累经验，但把经验内化为模型参数仍困难。在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）提供了自然机制，却默认"生成的测试时经验值得学习"——作者指出该假设不成立：提升测试时表现的经验可能带来有限甚至有害的训练信号。

Method: 系统分析多任务、多反思模型下各类变异经验，比较不同指标预测下游蒸馏增益的可靠性；发现梯度对齐优于即时测试时提升，据此构建E2L框架，按估计的训练效用来迭代地生成、评估、蒸馏经验，将经验生成与参数学习闭环。

Result: 实验表明，即时测试时提升与蒸馏增益不总一致，而基于梯度的对齐度是更可靠的下游蒸馏增益指标，可作为经验筛选依据。

Conclusion: 自进化应关注经验的"可学习性"而非仅测试时收益；以梯度对齐为准则的E2L可实现自主生成适合自我提升的经验，为经验内化提供有效路径。

Abstract: Self-evolving language models can continuously acquire useful experience through test-time interaction, reflection, and prompt optimization, yet turning such experience into model itself to ensure self improvement remains challenging. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides a natural mechanism for internalizing test-time information into model parameters, yet it largely assumes that the gener- ated experience is worth learning. We show that this assumption does not always hold: experiences that improve test-time performance may provide limited or even harmful training signals. To better characterize which experience should be inter- nalized, we systematically analyze diverse mutated experiences across multiple tasks and reflection models, and find that gradient-based alignment is a more reli- able indicator of downstream distillation gains than immediate test-time improve- ment. Based on this finding, we propose E2L, a self-evolution framework that iteratively generates, evaluates, and distills experiences according to their esti- mated training utility. E2L closes the loop between experience generation and parameter learning, enabling agents to autonomously produce experience suitable for self-improvement.

</details>


### [559] [Not All Pairs Align: Caption-Guided Audio-Visual Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32399)
*Omar Emara,Nan Lu,Dima Damen,Hazel Doughty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CGAAL，一种模型无关的对齐感知对比损失，用模态专属caption估计音视频语义一致度并对正样本对加权，在三个基线一致提升音视频检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态对比学习默认配对观测共享同一底层信息，但真实音视频常因离屏声音等导致内容不一致；标准对比目标却把所有配对样本视为同等对齐。

Method: 利用音频与视频各自的caption估计语义一致度分数，用该分数加权每个正样本对的贡献；并采用warm-up与渐进阈值策略逐步引入对齐感知训练信号，可套用于任意对比框架。

Result: 将CGAAL应用于三个对比基线，均稳定提升其在音视频检索任务上的表现，验证其通用性。

Conclusion: 对齐感知加权是缓解弱对齐配对噪声的有效手段，CGAAL作为model-agnostic目标可广泛集成于多模态对比学习。

Abstract: We address the problem of learning audio-visual representations from co-occurring modalities. Multimodal contrastive learning typically assumes that paired observations provide shared views of the same underlying information. While this may be true for datasets collected in constrained environments, it does not always hold. For instance, co-occurring audio and visual signals can differ substantially in their content due to off-screen sounds. Nevertheless, standard contrastive objectives treat all paired samples as equally aligned. In this work, we propose Caption Guided Alignment Aware Loss (CGAAL), a model-agnostic objective that leverages modality-specific captions to estimate semantic agreement between audio and video. CGAAL uses these agreement scores to weight the contribution of each positive pair. A warm-up period and gradual thresholding strategy progressively introduce this alignment-aware training signal. We demonstrate the generality of CGAAL by applying it to three contrastive baselines, consistently improving their performance on audio-visual retrieval.

</details>


### [560] [Optimal Transport Meets t-SNE: Integrated Visualization without Batch Effects in OT-tSNE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32402)
*Azhar Akhmetova,Edward Eichhorn,Boris Landa,Dmitry Kobak,Sebastian Damrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出OT-tSNE，用熵正则最优传输的全局耦合亲和力替代t-SNE中的最近邻匹配，实现批次效应下的联合可视化，在批次混合与生物信息保留上取得帕累托最优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 批次效应（不同条件采集数据间的系统性差异）会掩盖共享结构、复杂化联合可视化。现有整合方法依赖跨批次最近邻关系，但这种局部对应在困难跨批次几何下不可靠。

Method: 用基于熵正则最优传输（entropic optimal transport）的全局耦合亲和力替换t-SNE中基于最近邻的匹配，构建OT-tSNE方法；并以受控合成实验和7个真实单细胞数据集，与多种整合与可视化方法广泛对比。

Result: 受控合成实验中，最近邻方法会退化，而最优传输亲和力与OT-tSNE嵌入保持稳健；7个真实单细胞数据集上，OT-tSNE在批次混合与生物保守性之间实现帕累托高效权衡，批次整合效果尤为出色。

Conclusion: 全局耦合的最优传输亲和力优于局部最近邻对应，可作为批次效应下稳健的联合可视化方案。

Abstract: Visual exploration is an integral step in understanding the structure of datasets. However, systematic variation between datasets collected under different conditions, known as batch effects, can obscure shared structure and complicate their joint visualization. Existing methods often rely on cross-batch nearest-neighbor relations to integrate the batches. Yet, these local correspondences can be unreliable for challenging cross-batch geometries. We propose optimal-transport t-SNE (OT-tSNE), which replaces nearest-neighbor-based matching with globally coupled affinities derived from entropic optimal transport. Controlled synthetic experiments demonstrated that nearest-neighbor-based methods can deteriorate, while optimal-transport affinities and OT-tSNE embeddings remain robust. Across seven real single-cell datasets, we benchmarked OT-tSNE against a broad range of integration and visualization methods and found that it achieves a Pareto-efficient trade-off between batch mixing and biological conservation, and integrates batches particularly well.

</details>


### [561] [A Framework for Graph Node Symmetric Quantification under Dataset Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32403)
*Alessio Micheli,Alejandro Moreo,Marco Podda,Fabrizio Sebastiani,Domenico Tortorella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GSQ 框架，实现图节点量化中的“对称量化”：训练仅需带类别分布的节点样本标签，直接预测类别流行度，无需节点级分类器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图节点量化沿用聚合范式，依赖中间节点分类器和节点级监督，训练与预测对象类型不一致（非对称）。作者希望摆脱节点级监督和预测，使训练样本与待预测样本同为节点样本。

Method: GSQ 流水线由节点编码器、嵌入池化器、流行度预测器和可选的事后缩放步骤组成；各组件可选不同可训练或 reservoir 编码器、不同池化算子与预测目标，直接估计类别流行度。

Result: 在二元与多类数据集、不同同质性水平下，于先验概率漂移和结构协变量漂移条件下进行评估。

Conclusion: GSQ 提供了无需节点分类器的对称图节点量化框架，组件可灵活组合，并在多种数据漂移场景下得到验证。

Abstract: Graph node quantification is the supervised learning task of estimating the prevalence of different classes within an arbitrary sample of unlabelled nodes from a graph, subject to some form of dataset shift. Existing approaches to graph node quantification typically follow the standard aggregative paradigm, i.e., they use labelled nodes from the graph to train an intermediate node classifier, and obtain an estimated class distribution for the sample by aggregating the classifier's predictions for the individual nodes and then correcting the result via some adjustment strategy that accounts for dataset shift. In this work we propose a framework for graph node quantification that does away with both node-level supervision, since its training phase only requires node samples labelled by their class distribution, and node-level predictions, since it estimates class prevalence values directly, without the need of any intermediate node classifier. The framework thus allows symmetric quantification, since (unlike in standard ``asymmetric'' quantification methods) the labelled items used for training and the unlabelled items on which predictions must be issued are of the same type (i.e., node samples). This framework (that we dub GSQ, for Graph Node Symmetric Quantification) allows building pipelines consisting of a node encoder, an embedding pooler, a prevalence predictor, and an optional post-hoc scaling step. These components can be instantiated by choosing from different trainable and reservoir-based encoders, different pooling operators, and different prediction objectives. We evaluate the GSQ framework on binary and multi-class datasets with different levels of homophily, under prior probability shift and under structural covariate shift.

</details>


### [562] [The Teacher Is Already Inside: Self-Distilling Looped Language Models Beyond Their Last Loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32452)
*Linghua Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ELPSD利用循环语言模型首尾两层外推得到的分布作为自蒸馏目标，让最后一层在自己rollout上向其对齐，无需奖励、外部教师或特权上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型的训练后优化困难：仅奖励RL需要验证器且信号稀疏；把奖励分摊到各循环会使所有循环熵崩塌；跨循环自蒸馏（如LoopOPD）只能教中间循环，最后一循环无法从冻结副本学习（初始化时loss为零）。

Method: 观察到循环模型已含一个优于最后一层的策略：由第一层到最后一层外推的下一词分布。冻结模型副本计算该外推分布作教师，在自身rollout的每个访问前缀上用精确reverse KL蒸馏最后一层，不会改变rollout与解码。并分析该目标以权重1+w拉向基模型最后一层、以权重w推离其第一层，且教师必须冻结，否则理想化教师会无界外推。

Result: 在Ouro-1.4B-Thinking的五个数学基准上，与Base、GRPO、RLTT、OPSD比较。不使用任何奖励，平均avg@8从61.15提升到63.69，五个基准均最优，超过使用验证器的GRPO（62.32）和需要参考解的OPSD（61.77）。

Conclusion: ELPSD为循环语言模型提供了一种无需奖励的自我蒸馏微调方法，通过外推分布目标显著提升性能并优于需外部信号的基线。

Abstract: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop is readable through the shared language-model head. Post-training them is hard. Reward-only reinforcement learning needs a verifier and learns from one sparse signal per response; spreading the reward over loops collapses the entropy of every loop; and cross-loop self-distillation, as in LoopOPD, can only teach intermediate loops, because the last loop cannot learn from its own frozen copy: the loss is zero at initialisation. We observe that a looped model already contains a policy that decodes better than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELPSD (Extrapolated-Loop Policy Self-Distillation) turns this distribution into a self-distillation target: a frozen copy of the model computes it, and the model's own last loop is distilled towards it on its own rollouts, using the exact reverse KL at every visited prefix. Teacher and student are the same model, so ELPSD needs no reward, no external teacher and no privileged context, and it leaves rollouts and decoding unchanged. We show that the objective pulls the last loop towards the base model's last loop with weight 1+w and away from the base model's first loop with weight w, and that the teacher must stay frozen, since an idealised teacher recomputed from the current model extrapolates without bound. We evaluate ELPSD on Ouro-1.4B-Thinking across five math benchmarks against the base model, GRPO, RLTT and OPSD. Without any reward, ELPSD raises the average avg@8 from 61.15 to 63.69 and is the best method on all five benchmarks, ahead of GRPO (62.32), which uses a verifier, and the self-distillation method OPSD (61.77), which needs reference solutions.

</details>


### [563] [When Knowledge-Tracing Rankings Depend on Available History: A Source-Correction and Matched-Information Audit on ASSISTments 2009 and 2015](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32489)
*Devis Wawan Saputra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究考察知识追踪（knowledge tracing）基准中数据来源、历史窗口长度与表示方式如何影响模型比较，发现当把模型约束到相同的历史事件流后，顺序感知的逻辑回归在ASSISTments 2015预测中优于GRU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识追踪基准常比较"可访问的历史信息不一致"的模型（数据版本不同、历史窗口不同、表示不同），导致比较不公平，因此需要厘清数据溯源、历史长度与表示对结论的影响。

Method: 1) 对比固定版ASSISTments 2009序列镜像与官方修正版，量化学习者和事件层面的差异；2) 保留此前在2009/2015上的学习者不重叠评估，区分探索性结果与2015纠错复现；3) 在4,000名新的、不重叠的2015学习者上，用三种模型（计数式逻辑回归、顺序感知逻辑回归、GRU）在相同的1事件或20事件先验响应窗口下比较Brier分数，并做学习者簇自助法区间估计。

Result: 在共同出现的4,148名学习者中，817名技能-响应有序序列不同，镜像版标注事件更少。新样本582名学习者、20,592条测试响应上，20事件窗口Brier分数为：计数式LR 0.17667、顺序感知LR 0.17389、GRU 0.17514；GRU减顺序感知LR差异为0.00125（95%区间[0.00008, 0.00243]），1事件窗口差异为0.00212 [0.00120, 0.00301]。

Conclusion: 早期比较曾偏向GRU，但新的、受同等信息约束的分析反而偏向用同一事件流编码顺序逻辑回归。结论仅适用于特定历史队列与模型设置，既不能分离架构效应，也不能推广到当代课堂。

Abstract: Knowledge-tracing benchmarks often compare models that have different access to a learner's previous responses. We examine how data provenance, history length, and representation affect those comparisons. First, we compare a pinned ASSISTments 2009 sequence mirror against the corrected official release. Of 4,148 learners represented in both, 817 have different ordered skill-response sequences; the mirror also contains fewer labeled events. Second, we retain earlier learner-disjoint model evaluations on the 2009 and 2015 datasets, distinguishing exploratory results from a corrective 2015 replication. Finally, we evaluate a new, nonoverlapping sample of 4,000 ASSISTments 2015 learners using three models constrained to the same one-event or 20-event prior-response window. On 20,592 test responses from 582 learners, the 20-event Brier scores were 0.17667 for count-based logistic regression, 0.17389 for an order-aware logistic model, and 0.17514 for a GRU. The GRU-minus-order-aware difference was 0.00125 (95% learner-cluster bootstrap interval [0.00008, 0.00243]); at one prior event, the corresponding difference was 0.00212 [0.00120, 0.00301]. Earlier comparisons had favored the GRU against simpler history summaries. The newer analysis instead favors a logistic comparator that represents order using the same permitted event stream. These results concern predictive performance on particular historical cohorts and model settings. They neither isolate an architectural effect nor establish generalization to contemporary classrooms.

</details>


### [564] [Assessing Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32496)
*Kim N. Nolle,Ivana Dusparic,Rhodri Cusack,Vinny Cahill*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在非平稳自主泊车环境中比较了PPO（无模型on-policy）、SAC（无模型off-policy）和Drama（基于模型）三类RL算法抵抗遗忘的鲁棒性，发现off-policy因经验回放更鲁棒，基于模型方法无明显优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL在信息物理系统中广泛应用，智能体需适应环境变化以维持安全可靠。持续学习中的灾难性遗忘是关键问题，但不同类别RL算法在非平稳环境下的抗遗忘鲁棒性尚不清楚。

Method: 在非平稳自主泊车环境中，依次呈现四个停车位角度不同的场景，让三类代表性算法（PPO、SAC、Drama）学习停车并评估其保持已学行为的能力。

Result: off-policy算法因使用经验回放而比on-policy算法更鲁棒；基于模型的算法相比无模型算法未表现出直接优势；实验还揭示了寻找环境鲁棒抽象表示以及超参数敏感性的额外挑战。

Conclusion: 在非平稳环境中，off-policy设计（经验回放）是缓解遗忘的有效因素，而基于模型的方法不必然带来鲁棒性收益；同时需要关注状态抽象与超参数选择问题。

Abstract: As the use of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes more widespread in cyber-physical systems, it becomes increasingly important to design RL agents that are able to adapt to changes in their environments in order to maintain safety and reliability. This paper addresses the question of whether different classes of RL algorithm are more robust against forgetting previously learned behaviours, a critical issue in continual learning, in non-stationary environments. We evaluate the robustness of representative examples of three important classes of RL algorithm in a non-stationary autonomous parking environment. These are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which is a model-free on-policy algorithm, Soft-Actor-Critic (SAC), which is a model-free off-policy algorithm, and Drama, which is a model-based algorithm. The agents must learn to successfully park in four different scenarios, which are presented successively, with parking spaces oriented at varying angles. We find off-policy algorithms appear to be more robust compared to on-policy algorithms due to their use of replay, while model-based algorithms do not appear to offer any direct advantage over model-free algorithms. These experiments also highlight the additional challenges of finding robust abstractions of the environment, and oversensitivity to hyperparameters.

</details>


### [565] [InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32504)
*Salome Gobbi,Nicolas Atienza,Nicola Cancedda,Michael Arbel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 InducedTFM，用 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力替换双维表格基础模型的两个注意力阶段，使样本和特征方向的成本均线性化，在精度不变的前提下大幅提升大表推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型（TFM）依赖上下文学习一次前向预测，但注意力对样本数和特征数均呈二次复杂度，导致预训练只能用小规模合成表、大表推理需要分块或子采样；行压缩模型虽降低特征方向成本却丢弃了单元格级表示，且对样本数仍是二次的。

Method: 将双维 TFM（如 TabICLv2）的两个注意力阶段都替换为 Set Transformer 的诱导注意力（inducing points），在保留单元格级表示的同时，把对样本和对特征的计算成本都降到线性。与同等训练预算下的完整注意力 TabICLv2 复现对比，并与同渐近复杂度的核线性注意力基线比较。

Result: 在与完整注意力 TabICLv2 复现匹配的训练预算下，InducedTFM 在 TabArena 及更大数据集基准上精度与之一致，且明显优于同成本核线性注意力基线；在窄表推理上超过 TabICLv2，64万行时实现 30 倍加速。

Conclusion: 诱导注意力可有效消除 TFM 的双向二次瓶颈而不损失精度；但在宽表场景下行压缩方法仍更可取，说明不同形状表格适用不同压缩策略。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel linear-attention baseline of the same asymptotic cost. It overtakes TabICLv2 in inference time on narrow tables, reaching a 30x speed-up at 640K rows, although row compression remains preferable on wide tables.

</details>


### [566] [Branch and Consolidate: A Unified Recipe for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32515)
*Zihan Liang,Zikun Qu,Ben Chen,Fan Yang,Wenwu Ou,Min Zhang,Zhongxiang Dai,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多模态多教师on-policy蒸馏(MOPD)的统一配方，用于将偏离共享checkpoint较大的专家模型能力合并回单一学生模型，工业与开源设置下均优于IM-MOPD。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有能力合并方法（权重合并、MOPD）在专家与共享checkpoint偏离较大时效果不佳，而以往研究多只考察接近共享checkpoint的专家场景。

Method: 统一的MOPD配方，涵盖初始化、数据选择、跨教师均衡监督、已有能力保持，以及针对落后能力的定向精炼阶段；并通过机制消融与训练动态分析全流程。

Result: 工业六专家场景：学生接近各专家本域表现并超越感知专家，恢复专家平均增益97.0%（IM-MOPD为79.8%）；Qwen3-4B五域开放场景：合并后恢复95.7%，精炼后97.5%（IM-MOPD为94.1%）。

Conclusion: 该配方能在专家显著偏离共享checkpoint时有效合并能力，并提供诊断合并不充分的实践指导，代码将开源。

Abstract: Specialists post-trained from a shared checkpoint acquire complementary capabilities, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) can consolidate them into a single model. However, we find that existing consolidation methods, from weight merging to MOPD, fall short when specialists diverge substantially from the shared checkpoint, whereas prior studies mostly examine specialists that remain close to it. We present a unified recipe for multimodal MOPD that consolidates such specialists back into the single student they branched from. The recipe specifies initialization, data selection, balanced supervision across teachers, and preservation of existing capabilities for consolidation, together with a targeted refinement stage for capabilities that still lag behind their specialists. In an industrial setting with six specialists, the student closely approaches each specialist in its own domain and surpasses the perception specialist. It recovers 97.0% of their average gain, compared with 79.8% for IM-MOPD. In the fully open five-domain setting with Qwen3-4B, our method recovers 95.7% of the specialists' average gain after consolidation and 97.5% after refinement, compared with 94.1% for IM-MOPD. We further analyze the full pipeline through mechanism ablations and training dynamics, providing practical guidance for diagnosing incomplete consolidation. Code will be released.

</details>


### [567] [Beyond Robust Algorithmic Recourse: Sharing the Burden of Validity through Model Multiplicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32543)
*Prakhar Ganesh,Afaf Taïk,Golnoosh Farnadi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 稳健反事实建议虽保证有效性，却将可行建议局限在高密度（多数群体）区域，造成系统性不公平；作者提出用模型多重性让模型方分担负担，从而兼顾有效性与公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法反事实建议（recourse）需个体付出大量时间精力，因此强调建议在未来模型更新下仍有效的"稳健性"。但论文揭示稳健性会带来系统性伤害：它把可行建议约束到过度反映多数群体行为的区域，削弱个体灵活性并放大群体差距。于是形成两难——非稳健建议易失效，稳健建议引入不公平。

Method: 指出该权衡源于"有效性负担应完全由个体承担"的隐含假设，进而提出让系统所有者通过策略性模型选择分担负担：利用多重性（多个同等优秀但相互竞争的模型并存），放宽对个体的稳健性要求，同时保持建议有效性。

Result: 理论分析表明稳健性对可行建议区域的约束偏好高密度区域，进而导致不公平；而利用竞争模型的多重性可在放宽个体稳健性要求的条件下维持有效性。

Conclusion: 有效性与公平性之间的张力并非不可避免，而是由负担分配假设造成的；系统所有者通过策略性模型选择与个体共担有效性责任，可缓解该矛盾。

Abstract: Algorithmic recourse provides actionable recommendations that enable individuals to achieve favourable outcomes. Implementing recourse for individuals requires significant time and effort, thus emphasizing robust recourse: recommendations that remain valid even under future model updates. While robustness preserves validity, we show it introduces systematic harms by constraining feasible recommendations to regions that disproportionately reflect majority behavior, reducing individual flexibility and amplifying disparities. Thus, non-robust recourse risks invalidation, whereas robust recourse creates a preference for high-density regions in the data that induces unfairness. However, this trade-off is driven by an implicit assumption that individuals alone should bear the burden of validity. We challenge this narrative and show that strategic model selection can help maintain validity while relaxing robustness requirements for individuals. By leveraging multiplicity, the existence of equally good yet competing models, system owners can share this burden with individuals, thus resolving the tension between validity and unfairness.

</details>


### [568] [Contact Geometry for Generative Models: An Unbalanced Optimal Transport Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32547)
*Andrea Testa,Søren Hauberg,Andras Gabor Kupcsik,Tamim Asfour,Leonel Rozo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CuOT（Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport），基于接触几何的解耦密度传输方向与质量增长，消除WFR几何对高密度区的结构偏置，实现稳定可扩展的路径长度最小化求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的生物、医学影像、机器人生成问题少有完美配对的数据；现有基于Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao几何的非平衡最优传输（uOT）存在对高密度区域的结构性偏置，易导致模式崩塌。

Method: 引入Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport：以接触几何（contact geometry）为基础，将密度传输方向与质量增长解耦，从而消除结构偏置；采样步长可随局部数据自适应，在高密度区自动缩小步长以避免过冲。

Result: 形成稳定、可扩展的路径长度最小化求解器，在生物动力学重建、非配对图像到图像翻译、视频生成三项任务上持续优于基于WFR的方法。

Conclusion: CuOT通过接触几何解耦传输与质量变化，有效缓解模式崩塌并获得稳定收敛，在多个非配对生成任务上优于WFR方法。

Abstract: Real-world generative problems in biology, medical imaging, or robotics, rarely come with perfectly paired source and target distributions. While unbalanced Optimal Transport (uOT) provides a robust framework to bridge unpaired datasets via minimum-length paths in probability space, existing formulations based on the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) geometry introduce a structural bias toward high density regions, often triggering mode collapse. We introduce Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT), a novel uOT formulation grounded in contact geometry that decouples density transport direction from mass growth to eliminate structural bias. This allows CuOT to adapt sampling steps to the local data structure, naturally reducing step sizes in high-density regions to prevent overshooting and ensuring stable convergence. The result is a stable, scalable path-length minimization solver that consistently outperforms WFR-based methods on biological dynamics reconstruction, unpaired image-to-image translation, and video generation.

</details>


### [569] [Representation and Model Contributions on Small Molecular Benchmarks: Controlled Comparisons and External Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32568)
*Nora A. M. A. Talkhan,Ibrahim Abdelbaky,Fatma A. Omara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 分子性质预测的提升常归因于模型，但表示也可能贡献增益。作者用2×2因子设计（RF与CatBoost/TabPFN/TabFM × 指纹与RDKit描述符），配合配对scaffold bootstrap，将"模型效应"与"表示效应"分离。在7个MoleculeNet小数据集上发现：溶解度与亲脂性中表示效应在各主设计中均超过模型效应；水合自由能结果依赖起始指纹；分类任务上两效应多无显著差异。以RDKit描述符替换指纹后，RF基线甚至超过DGT发表的溶解度分数。建议基线应使用多种表示并分别报告两类效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新模型常与"指纹+随机森林(RF)"基线比较，这种比较同时改变了模型和表示，导致性能增益来源不清——究竟是模型创新还是分子表示带来的改进无法区分。作者希望定量拆分模型效应与表示效应对分子性质预测性能的各自贡献。

Method: 采用2×2因子设计：{RF, 第二模型(CatBoost或表格基础模型TabPFN/TabFM)} × {分子指纹, RDKit描述符}，两两组合训练；用配对scaffold bootstrap检验各效应显著性。评估7个小型MoleculeNet数据集（3回归、4分类），使用DGT图transformer的公开划分、额外10个scaffold划分以及外部数据集。

Result: 溶解度与亲脂性任务中，三种评估设置下表示效应在所有主设计里都大于模型效应；水合自由能上取决于起始指纹：ECFP4下表示效应更大，MACCS下两者无显著差异；分类数据集中仅一个主设计出现两效应显著差异。模型效应虽较小，但同用RDKit描述符时TabFM在7个数据集上均优于RF；用RDKit描述符替代指纹后，RF基线超过DGT发表的溶解度分数。

Conclusion: 分子预测性能增益中表示效应的贡献常被低估，模型比较存在混淆。建议模型评估中使用不止一种分子表示训练经典基线，并分别报告表示效应与模型效应，以获得更公平、可解释的基准对比。

Abstract: Improvements in molecular property prediction are usually attributed to the model, although part of the gain may come from the molecular representation. New models are commonly benchmarked against a random forest (RF) trained on a molecular fingerprint, a comparison that changes the model and the representation at the same time. We separate the two contributions with a two-by-two factorial design in which the RF and a second model (CatBoost or the tabular foundation models TabPFN and TabFM) are each trained on a fingerprint and on RDKit descriptors, and each effect is tested with a paired scaffold bootstrap. Seven small MoleculeNet datasets (3 regression, 4 classification) are evaluated on the published split of a recent graph transformer (DGT), on 10 additional scaffold splits and on external datasets. For solubility and lipophilicity, the representation effect exceeds the model effect in every main factorial design, in all three evaluations. For hydration free energy, the result depends on the starting fingerprint: from ECFP4 the representation effect is larger, and from MACCS neither effect is significantly larger. On the classification datasets, only one main factorial design has a significant difference between the two effects. Although the model effect is smaller on solubility and lipophilicity, TabFM outperforms the RF on all 7 datasets when both use RDKit descriptors. With RDKit descriptors in place of a fingerprint, the RF baseline reported for DGT surpasses the transformer's published solubility score. We recommend that model comparisons evaluate classical baselines on more than one representation and report the representation and model effects separately.

</details>


### [570] [Boiling Down Uncertainty: Deep Generative Scenario Search with Decision-Guided Evolution Strategies for Two-Stage Stochastic Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32573)
*Atefeh Hemmati Golsefidi,David Pisinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为Deep Generative Scenario Search补上解析基础：从recourse对偶性与正则化reduced问题的伴随求解导出闭式梯度，并将决策导向方向（对偶不可用时用启发式方向兜底）用作引导进化策略的采样子空间，证明任意引导子空间下的期望更新都是平滑目标函数的下降方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两阶段随机规划中场景数选择需在不确定性表达与计算成本间权衡；已有方法Deep Generative Scenario Search通过决策诱导学习改进合成场景，但因决策对场景分段常值只能使用黑盒梯度估计，缺乏解析基础。

Method: 从recourse对偶性和正则化reduced问题的adjoint solve推导闭式梯度；将决策导向方向（对偶不可用时以启发式方向备份）作为引导进化策略的采样���空间而非直接更新；理论上分析任意引导子空间下期望更新均为平滑目标函数的下降方向，不准确引导只增加方差。

Result: 在六个问题族上，两种引导估计器均优于基线；决策导向版本将平均gap降低四分之三；在两个整数变量最多的族上，缩减场景集在多数运行中超过精确求解器两小时的incumbent，且仅用五分之一时间。

Conclusion: 闭式梯度与引导进化策略结合为场景生成提供有理论保证的实用框架，在保持下降性质的同时显著降低gap与计算时间。

Abstract: One of the most common models for handling uncertainty is two-stage stochastic programming. Choosing the right number of scenarios is a trade-off between the uncertainty that can be represented and computational cost. A recent method, Deep Generative Scenario Search, generates synthetic scenarios and improves them by learning from the decisions they induce. The original approach used a black-box gradient estimate, since decisions are piecewise constant across scenarios. This paper provides the missing analytical foundation by deriving the gradient in closed form from recourse duality and an adjoint solve of the regularized reduced problem. The decision-focused direction, with a heuristic direction as a backup when duals are unavailable, defines the sampling subspace of a guided evolution strategy rather than being used as a direct update. For any guiding subspace, the expected update is a descent direction of the smoothed objective, so an inaccurate guide adds variance while the expected step still descends. For six problem families, both guided estimators outperform the baseline. The decision-focused version reduces the mean gap by three-quarters, and on the two families with the most integer variables the reduced sets beat the exact solver's two-hour incumbent in most runs, using a fifth of the time.

</details>


### [571] [Understanding the Importance of Massive Activations through Adversarial Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32585)
*Tigran Fahradyan,Riccardo Ali,Sergio Calvo-Ordoñez,José Miguel Hernández-Lobato,Pietro Liò,Álvaro Arroyo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将大模型中的"巨型激活"(massive activations)与延迟鲁棒性中的"区域迁移"(region migration)现象联系起来，从样条理论角度解释其作用，并在多种架构与数据集上验证二者与对抗鲁棒性的共现关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 巨型激活在LLM中普遍出现，已有研究将其与attention sink、表征压缩、信号传播等相关联，但其产生原因与后果仍不清楚，缺乏理论解释。

Method: 基于深度网络的样条理论解释：论证巨型激活将表征推离网络非线性边界，从而降低数据点附近输入-输出映射的复杂度；并在残差MLP、ResNet18、ViT、GPT等架构及MNIST、CIFAR10、Imagenette、Shakespeare文本等数据集上开展大量实验验证。

Result: 在多种架构与数据集上一致观察到巨型激活与区域迁移共同出现，并与对抗鲁棒性相关联；在LLM大规模预训练中，巨型激活的上升与token embedding扰动下的对抗准确率变化紧密同步。

Conclusion: 巨型激活并非Transformer独有，而是普遍存在于执行简单监督学习的常见架构中；其作用是推动表征远离非线性边界、降低局部映射复杂度，并与延迟鲁棒性/区域迁移现象密切相关。

Abstract: A common occurrence in Large Language Models (LLMs) is the emergence of so-called massive activations. This phenomenon is well known in the literature and has been connected to attention sinks, representational compression, as well as signal propagation. However, the reasons and consequences for their appearance are not yet well understood. In this paper, we explain the role of massive activations in deep learning by showing that they are connected to the region migration phenomenon in delayed robustness. Under the spline theoretic interpretation of deep networks, we show that massive activations push the representations away from the nonlinearity boundaries of the network, decreasing the complexity of its input-output map around data points. Furthermore, we uncover for the first time that this phenomenon is not unique to transformers and actually appears in a number of common architectures performing simple supervised learning tasks. We validate this connection through extensive experiments on a diverse set of architectures including residual MLP, ResNet18, Vision Transformers and GPT and datasets including MNIST, CIFAR10, Imagenette and Shakespeare Text. We consistently observe that massive activations and region migration co-occur with adversarial robustness. Furthermore, we illustrate that this connection holds in the large-scale pretraining of LLMs by showing that the rise of massive activations in LLMs closely tracks the adversarial accuracy of the model under perturbations of the token embeddings.

</details>


### [572] [On the Effectiveness of Resampling for Supervised Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32598)
*Cyril Perosino,Rino Di Chiara,Hamida Seba*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在GADBench低标注设定下系统比较类加权与六种过采样策略，发现过采样(ROSE)的收益仅出现在注入异常数据集且依赖注入配方，建议调优基线而非过采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图异常检测存在类别不平衡和异常标签稀缺，实践中广泛使用过采样，但其在不同检测器与基准上的真实收益缺乏严格验证。

Method: 在GADBench低标注设定(20个异常+80个正常节点)下，17个数据集、三大类共10种检测器配置(GNN、基于邻域聚合特征的树集成、表格基础模型)上比较类加权与最多六种过采样策略；区分有机异常(8个)与注入异常(9个)数据集，并分析注入配方、调优与标签无关基线的影响。

Result: 有机异常数据集上任何策略均无统计显著平均增益，标注哪些节点与策略同等重要；注入异常数据集上ROSE在四/六个树与基础模型配置中最多提升5.2 AUPRC点，所有六种配置仅在属性交换异常上有效，四种GNN上增益与零不可区分；该增益源于交换节点的异常特征范数，改用单一随机供体或保持范数后消失；调优树检测器约增益3点、与ROSE相当并使ROSE收益减半以上；采样图视图与普通复制节点不可区分。

Conclusion: 过采样的收益脆弱且高度依赖注入配方，不应作为默认手段；建议调优基线、重复标注划分、分别报告有机与注入异常，并报告无标签的度与特征范数基线。

Abstract: Class imbalance and scarce anomaly labels motivate oversampling in supervised graph anomaly detection (GAD), but its benefits across detectors and benchmarks remain unclear.
