In the low-label setting of GADBench, with 20 labelled anomalies and 80 labelled normal nodes, we compare class weighting and up to six oversampling strategies in ten detector configurations from three families: graph neural networks (GNNs), tree ensembles on neighbourhood-aggregated features, and tabular foundation models, on 17 datasets. On the eight datasets with organic anomalies, no strategy has a statistically resolved average gain in any configuration, and which nodes are labelled matters as much as the strategy. On the nine datasets with injected anomalies, Gaussian-noise oversampling (ROSE) gains up to 5.2 AUPRC points in four of the six tree and tabular foundation model configurations, and in all six only on attribute-swap anomalies; in four GNNs its gain is not distinguishable from zero. This gain depends on the injection recipe, which gives swapped nodes an atypical feature norm: it is no longer distinguishable from zero when the swap uses a single random donor or preserves the norm, although most detectors then also stop detecting the swaps. Over the 17 datasets, tuning the tree detectors adds about three points, as much as ROSE, and cuts ROSE's gain by about half or more. With the same source nodes and class weight, sampled graph views are not distinguishable from plain copies of those nodes. We recommend tuning baselines, repeating labelled splits, reporting organic and injected anomalies separately, and checking label-free degree and feature-norm baselines.

</details>


### [573] [Gated Concept Adapters: Layer-Wise Concept Bottlenecks for Auditable Text Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32600)
*Niloofar Ranjbar,Saeedeh Momtazi,Mohammad Mehdi Homayounpoor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Gated Concept Adapters (GCA)，一种分层概念瓶颈框架，将预训练Transformer的隐状态映射为可检查、可干预的低维概念激活，以提升文本理解系统的可审计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向人类文本的理解系统（情感推断、有害内容审核、社会敏感决策）依赖Transformer，但其预测源于高维隐状态，缺乏紧凑、可检查的接口，难以审计与干预。

Method: 在预训练Transformer若干层的输出上附加带门控的低维概念读出适配器：token表示→概念激活→学习门控过滤→层级池化→作为概念中介接口输入预测头；支持用法统计、签名n-gram、事后概念命名和定向概念干预。

Result: 在细粒度情绪分类、毒性检测、主题分类及受控动词填空压力测试上评估：情感与安全相关任务中概念表示冗余度较低且对干预敏感；毒性检测接近无约束ModernBERT基线；GoEmotions上端到端模型macro-F1下降，但任务初始化冻结变体显著缩小差距；AG News与近期概念基线相当；Qwen动词填空实验揭示概念中介全词表预测的局限。

Conclusion: GCA为文本理解提供了可审计的神经概念接口，以透明度、诊断与干预为优先，而非无约束的精度最大化。

Abstract: Human-facing text understanding systems are used to infer affect, moderate harmful content, and support socially sensitive decisions. However, Transformer predictions are difficult to audit because they are produced from high-dimensional hidden states that do not provide a compact, inspectable interface for human analysis or intervention. We introduce Gated Concept Adapters (GCA), a layer-wise concept bottleneck framework that attaches gated, low-dimensional concept-producing readout adapters to selected outputs of pretrained Transformers. Token representations are mapped into concept activations, filtered by learned gates, pooled into layer-level summaries, and exposed to the prediction head as a concept-mediated interface. The dimensions can be inspected through usage statistics, signature n-grams, post-hoc concept names, and targeted concept interventions. We evaluate GCA on fine-grained emotion classification, toxicity detection, topic classification, and a controlled verb-cloze stress test. In the affective and safety-relevant classification settings, GCA learns comparatively low-redundancy and intervention-sensitive concept representations while retaining useful predictive performance. On toxicity detection, it remains close to an unconstrained ModernBERT baseline while enabling concept-level inspection, targeted intervention, and lightweight post-hoc control. On GoEmotions, the end-to-end concept model incurs a macro-F1 cost relative to unconstrained RoBERTa, while a task-initialized frozen variant substantially reduces this gap. On AG News, GCA remains competitive with recent concept-based baselines, and the Qwen verb-cloze experiment clarifies the limits of concept-mediated full-vocabulary prediction. Overall, GCA provides a neural concept interface for auditable text understanding, prioritizing transparency, diagnosis, and intervention over unconstrained accuracy maximization.

</details>


### [574] [Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLMs via PCA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32782)
*Daehee Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现LLM各层FFN的内在维度呈"中间重、两端轻"的分布，并据此用非均匀宽度分配代替传统均匀宽度，在同等参数预算下提升蒸馏学生模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代LLM沿用原始Transformer惯例，所有层FFN中间宽度相同；但机制可解释性研究表明不同深度层做性质不同的事，其容量需求可能并不均匀，因此固定的参数预算或许可以更聪明地分配。

Method: 对每个FFN down-projection的输入做PCA，以重建激活达到固定余弦相似度所需的主成分数定义该层内在维度；扫描58个开放权重LLM（14个家族，70M–72B参数）。随后用该信号指导知识蒸馏学生的宽度剪枝，在匹配参数预算下与均匀宽度约定对比，并设置预算匹配的"反向控制"组，同时用指标σ99量化教师内在维度分布的不均匀程度。

Result: 发现普遍存在的middle-heavy分布（中间层内在维度高于边缘层），对校准语料（含中英文）稳健，并在后训练微调后基本保留。PCA引导的宽度分配在Qwen3-8B上+2.3分、Qwen2.5-3B上+2.5分优于均匀宽度；分散度较低的教师差距较小（Gemma-3-4B +0.9、LLaMA-3-8B +0.5）；反向控制在四个教师上均最差。差距大小与教师内在维度的分布不均匀度σ99相关，且优势在监督微调后仍保持。

Conclusion: 各层FFN容量需求确实非均匀且可由PCA内在维度刻画，middle-heavy结构具有跨模型、跨语料、跨后训练的稳健性，并能直接转化为匹配预算下更优的宽度分配，说明均匀宽度并非最优默认设定。

Abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) keep the feed-forward network (FFN) intermediate width identical across every layer, a convention inherited from the original Transformer. Yet mechanistic work suggests layers at different depths do qualitatively different work, raising a natural question: are their capacity demands also non-uniform, and if so, can a fixed parameter budget be allocated more wisely than uniformly? To probe this, we apply principal component analysis (PCA) to the input of each FFN down-projection and measure, for every layer, its intrinsic dimensionality as the smallest number of principal components needed to reconstruct the activation up to a fixed cosine similarity. Scanning 58 open-weight LLMs spanning 14 families and 70M to 72B parameters, we find a recurring middle-heavy profile in which middle layers carry higher intrinsic dimensionality than edge layers; the profile is robust to the calibration corpus, even across English and Chinese, and is largely preserved through post-training fine-tuning. As a direct test that this signal is structurally meaningful, we use it to guide width pruning in a knowledge-distilled student under a matched parameter budget: the PCA-guided allocation outperforms the uniform-width convention by +2.3 points on Qwen3-8B and +2.5 on Qwen2.5-3B, while lower-dispersion teachers show smaller gaps (+0.9 on Gemma-3-4B, +0.5 on LLaMA-3-8B), and a budget-matched inverted control does worst on all four teachers. Across these four teachers, the size of the gap tracks how unevenly the teacher's intrinsic dimensionality is distributed across layers (a single-number summary we call $σ_{99}$), and the advantage persists through downstream supervised fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/naver-ai/lidf.

</details>


### [575] [ST-GNN-AAAS: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection in the Traveling Salesman Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32602)
*Zeyu Zhang,Mustafa Misir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ST-GNN-AAAS，一个用于TSP随时算法选择（AAAS）的时空图神经网络框架，利用求解器执行过程中的动态信息做求解器选择，达到76.59%选择准确率并缩小SBS与VBS间46.05%的平均排名差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AAAS方法主要依赖静态实例特征，对求解器执行过程中随时间显现的时序信息利用不足，难以在不同时间预算下做出准确的选择。

Method: 用随时间变化的节点特征（当前巡回中各节点到其邻居的距离）刻画不断演化的incumbent tour，并结合短历史窗口内的求解器性能观测，构建时空图神经网络；以短历史输入预测更长未来时域内的求解器选择。

Result: 在NATIONAL、TNM、TSPLIB和VLSI的多样TSP基准子集上评测，选择准确率76.59%，缩小了SBS与VBS之间平均排名差距的46.05%；同时公开求解器执行数据以支持可复现性。

Conclusion: 融合执行期时空信息的GNN能有效提升TSP随时算法选择的性能，且动态特征优于静态特征；公开数据有助于后续可复现研究。

Abstract: Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection (AAAS) aims to make solver choices under varying time budgets. The existing AAAS approaches largely rely on static instance characteristics and make limited use of temporal information revealed during solver execution. We propose ST-GNN-AAAS, a Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network framework for AAAS in the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The framework represents evolving incumbent tours using time-varying node features, including distances from each node to its neighbors in the current tour, and combines these features with solver performance observations over a short history window. Given this short history, ST-GNN-AAAS predicts solver selections over a longer future horizon. We evaluate the method on a subset of diverse TSP benchmarks from NATIONAL, TNM, TSPLIB, and VLSI, releasing the corresponding solver execution data to support reproducibility. Our model achieves a selection accuracy of 76.59% and closes 46.05% of the average rank gap between the single best solver (SBS) and the virtual best solver (VBS).

</details>


### [576] [Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32802)
*Sangyun Lee,Zhang Enyan,Michael Xu,Hao Tang,Zinan Lin,Weijia Xu,Chris Quirk,Jianfeng Gao,Giulia Fanti,Xiaodong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究"睡眠"机制（对上下文做N次循环前向传播）能否提升Transformer语言模型的上下文内适应能力，并通过预训练实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作仅在SSM-注意力混合模型和合成任务上发现"睡眠"能改善长上下文推理，尚不清楚该方法对通用Transformer模型和真实非合成任务是否同样有效，而样本效率是智能的核心能力。

Method: 在最多1.2B参数、最多100B token上预训练带睡眠机制的Transformer语言模型；睡眠即对一段上下文执行N次循环前向传播以精炼表示，比较不同N（如N=2、N=4）与无睡眠基线在少样本算法任务、问答任务、分布外预测及代码任务上的表现。

Result: 更长的睡眠（更大的N）使模型在多个少样本算法与问答任务上上下文学习更快，分布外下一词预测损失更低；在留出代码上，N=2和N=4模型分别以2.10倍和2.39倍更少的上下文token达到无睡眠基线相同损失。

Conclusion: 睡眠机制可在通用Transformer模型和真实任务上提升上下文内适应与样本效率，是实现上下文适应与解码延迟间更优权衡的一步。

Abstract: The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with $N=2$ and $N=4$ match the no-sleep baseline's loss using $2.10\times$ and $2.39\times$ fewer tokens in-context, respectively. More broadly, we view our work as a step toward building models that have better tradeoffs between in-context adaptation and decoding latency.

</details>


### [577] [HiCal: Offline Calibration for Hierarchical Scale Encoding in Accurate HiF4 Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32624)
*Zhiyuan Zhang,Yanzhao Li,Hui Dong,Sifan Cheng,Mingen Zheng,Hui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出离线校准方法HiCal，改进HiF4三级块缩放编码的舍入偏置与扩展阈值，在无推理额外开销下降低量化MSE 9.91%-23.50%，端到端平均分提升0.91-1.25个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HiF4采用全局E6M2+两级二进制扩展的层次化缩放编码，但其常规舍入规则与固定扩展阈值难以匹配实际张量统计特性，导致缩放表示次优、量化精度受限。

Method: 离线校准：为Level-1的E6M2缩放引入校准舍入偏置，并基于局部组幅值的经验分布优化Level-2/3的扩展阈值；校准参数离线确定、推理时固定，保持原有确定性编码，避免逐块多候选缩放搜索。

Result: 在五种合成与真实激活分布上，量化MSE相对原始HiF4降低9.91%-23.50%（真实Qwen3-8B激活上降低13.00%）；六个基准端到端评测中，Qwen3-8B与Qwen3-30B-A3B平均分分别提升0.91与1.25个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过轻量离线校准即可显著提升HiF4量化精度，且不引入推理开销，兼容原有确定性编码流程，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: Block floating-point (BFP) quantization is widely adopted for efficient low-bit large language model (LLM) inference, where the choice of block scales plays a critical role in quantization accuracy. HiFloat4 (HiF4) employs a hierarchical scale encoding scheme consisting of a global E6M2 scale and two levels of binary scale extensions. However, its conventional rounding rule and fixed scale extension thresholds may not fully capture the statistical characteristics of the quantized tensors in practice, leading to suboptimal scale representations. In this work, we propose HiCal, an offline calibration approach that improves HiF4 quantization accuracy by refining the encoding decisions across all three scale levels. Specifically, we introduce a calibrated rounding bias for the Level-1 E6M2 scale and optimize the scale-extension thresholds at Levels 2 and 3 based on the empirical distributions of local group magnitudes. The resulting calibration parameters are determined offline and remain fixed during inference, while the hierarchical encoding continues to adapt to individual blocks through their local values. This design eliminates the need for per-block multi-candidate scale search while preserving the original deterministic HiF4 encoding procedure. Experiments across five synthetic and real activation distributions show that the proposed method reduces quantization MSE by 9.91%-23.50% relative to the original HiF4 scheme, including a 13.00% reduction on real Qwen3-8B activations. End-to-end evaluations across six benchmarks further show average-score improvements of 0.91 and 1.25 percentage points on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, respectively, without per-block multi-candidate search during inference.

</details>


### [578] [TeamFlowRL: Online Policy Optimization of Decentralized Flow Policies for Multi-Agent Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32645)
*Guowei Zou,Beiwen Zhang,Haitao Wang,Hong Hong,Zhiquan Chen,Hejun Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TeamFlowRL是一个两阶段框架：先用离线数据预训练多智能体流策略，再通过在线强化学习微调；它把团队策略优化定义在完整去噪轨迹上以避开不可解的动作似然，并在51个配对配置中平均提升47.3%归一化得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂协作任务需要多智能体协调行为。离线生成策略虽能学到表达性强的协作行为，但受限于固定数据集；在线RL可通过环境交互改进，但微调流策略困难，因为动作似然难以计算。

Method: 提出两阶段框架：离线预训练多智能体流策略，再在线微调。将团队策略优化构建在去中心化流策略的完整去噪轨迹上，避免不可解的动作似然；所得目标函数用共享的团队优势对每个智能体的轨迹比率加权，并分别裁剪各比率，使局部策略更新与共同团队回报对齐。

Result: 在七个仿真组的51个配对配置中，TeamFlowRL对每个离线初始化都有提升，归一化得分平均增益47.3%；在6个双臂任务上，探索噪声下平均成功率比高斯策略微调高33.1%。

Conclusion: 基于完整去噪轨迹的团队策略优化可有效在线微调多智能体流策略，兼顾表达性与团队回报对齐，性能显著优于离线初始化和高斯策略微调基线。

Abstract: Complex cooperative tasks require coordinated multi-agent behavior. Offline generative policies learn expressive cooperative behaviors from trajectories but remain limited by fixed datasets. Online reinforcement learning can improve them through environment interaction. However, fine-tuning flow policies is difficult because action likelihoods are hard to compute. We propose TeamFlowRL, a two-stage framework that pretrains multi-agent flow policies offline and fine-tunes them online. We formulate team policy optimization over the complete denoising trajectories of decentralized flow policies, avoiding intractable action likelihoods. The resulting objective weights each agent's trajectory ratio with a shared team advantage and clips each ratio separately, aligning local policy updates with the common team return. Across 51 paired configurations in seven simulation groups, TeamFlowRL improves every offline initialization, with a 47.3% average gain in normalized score. It also achieves 33.1% higher average success under exploration noise than Gaussian-policy fine-tuning across 6 bimanual tasks.

</details>


### [579] [LATEC: Learned Axial TEnsor Compression for High-Dimensional Scientific Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32651)
*Hippolyte Verninas,Hadrien Hendrikx,Thomas Moreau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LATEC，一种基于GNN的维度无关学习型预测器压缩方法，在保持逐点误差界的同时，跨3-5维科学张量压缩中平均优于SZ3达18.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学模拟规模增长使分析存储负担加重，压缩需保证用户指定的逐点误差界。现有学习型编解码器多优化聚合失真、难以满足误差界标准，且仅针对固定维度，导致适配/重训练成本高。

Method: LATEC采用基于GNN架构的维度无关学习预测器，在合成2-D和4-D场上预训练，并在13个3-D至5-D科学场上评估（含/不含领域微调）。

Result: LATEC持续与SZ3具有竞争力，平均改进18.1%，且在各领域一致性更好。

Conclusion: 共享的学习预测器可作为跨张量维度的单一误差界编解码器，媲美专用压缩器并保留逐点误差保证。

Abstract: With the growing scale of scientific simulation and infrastructure, part of the burden has shifted from producing scientific data to analyzing and storing it. Compression is a key step to expanding storage capacity, but requires dedicated techniques to enforce user-specified pointwise error bounds that ensure the validity of downstream scientific workflows. To further push the limits of compression, novel learned codecs have been developed, in particular for images and videos, but these methods often optimize for aggregated distortion and fail to meet error bound standards. Moreover, these methods often target fixed field dimensionality, failing to account for many scientific data use cases, or at the expense of large adaptation or retraining costs. In this work, we introduce the Learned Axial TEnsor Compression (LATEC) method, an error-bounded codec with a dimension-agnostic learned predictor based on a GNN architecture. LATEC is pretrained on synthetic 2-D and 4-D fields, and evaluated with and without domain fine-tuning on 13 scientific fields in 3-D to 5-D. Results show that LATEC is consistently competitive with SZ3, achieving an 18.1% average improvement and greater consistency across all domains than other compressors. These results demonstrate that a shared learned predictor can serve as a single error-bounded codec across tensor dimensionalities, competitive with specialized compressors, while retaining pointwise error guarantees.

</details>


### [580] [Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32708)
*Kyoungeui Hong,Zijun Gao,Ruishan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CPF通过学习治疗侧和结局侧多模态记录之间共享的信息来构造近端因果推断中的代理变量，从而在保留完整性的同时去除模态特有风格，并将代理传入近端因果森林估计条件效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近端因果推断需要两个满足排除限制且完整的代理变量来控制未测量混杂，但实践中手选少量变量信息不足，而高维临床记录（如笔记、波形）又无法直接使用，PCA等通用压缩可能保留模态特有风格而非混杂因子，破坏完整性。

Method: 核心观察：在近端条件下，混杂因子是治疗侧模态与结局侧模态在协变量之外唯一的联系。CPF在独立无标签样本上，给定协变量对两种模态做对比学习以提取共享信息，该对比目标有精确闭式解即岭典型相关分析（ridge CCA），再将学到的代理输入近端因果森林。

Result: 理论证明CPF精确保持排除限制，并在所刻画条件下继承原始记录的完整性；实证中在风格较强时相比PCA代理将条件效应误差降低10-22%；在MIMIC-IV上，CPF是唯一使华法林对中风效应的点估计落在随机试验范围内的方法。

Conclusion: 利用跨模态共享信息构造代理变量是一种有效且理论保证的近端因果推断方法，可处理高维多模态数据中的未测量混杂。

Abstract: Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies by contrasting the two modalities, given the covariates, on a separate unlabeled sample, and passes them to a proximal causal forest. This contrastive objective has an exact closed-form solution, ridge canonical correlation analysis. We prove that CPF preserves the exclusion restrictions exactly and that its proxies inherit the completeness of the raw records under conditions we characterize. Where style is strong, CPF lowers the error of conditional effects by 10-22% relative to PCA proxies, and on MIMIC-IV it is the only method whose point estimate of warfarin's effect on stroke falls inside the range of randomized trials.

</details>


### [581] [On Potentiality and Actuality Of Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32991)
*Fabian Gröger,Shuo Wen,Maria Brbić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出"潜能原理"：基础模型已包含任务所需能力，适配只需通过与输入无关的常量位移(layer-wise shift adapter)即可复现LoRA和全量微调的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究适配(post-training/微调)究竟是带来了真正的新能力，还是仅仅激活了基座模型本就具备的能力，从而重新审视适配的本质。

Method: 将不同适配方法引入的更新分解为两部分：所有输入共享的常量分量，以及随输入变化的残差；并据此设计shift adapter——每层学习一个对所有输入相同的常量向量。

Result: 共享常量分量足以解释大部分适配增益；仅学习常量位移的shift adapter即可复现LoRA与全量微调的行为。原理还揭示了参数高效适配、steering、收敛性方面的影响，并解释了"neural thickets"现象。

Conclusion: 适配并非赋予新能力，而是沿特定方向"实现(actualize)"基座模型已有的潜能；常量、输入无关的位移足以完成有效适配。

Abstract: Foundation models are built through large-scale pretraining, often followed by post-training, and are then adapted to specific tasks and behaviors. But, does the adaptation add truly new capabilities, or the base model already holds it? We decompose the update induced by different adaptations into a component shared across all inputs and a residual that varies with the input. We find that the shared component suffices for most of the adaptation gain and can be learned directly: a shift adapter that learns a constant vector per layer, identical for every input, reproduces the behavior of LoRA and full fine-tuning. We call this the potentiality principle of foundation models: the base model already contains the capacity needed for task-specific expertise. To adapt to a new task, the model just needs to be actualized, i.e., pushed in a certain direction via a constant, input-independent shift. We show the implications of this principle on parameter-efficient adaptation, steering, and convergence across models, and how it explains the neural thickets phenomenon.

</details>


### [582] [FourStat: A Dual AutoEncoder Leveraging Frequency and Stationarity for Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32714)
*Saman Hadian,Ramtin Moslemi,Mohammad Mohammadi,Sarina Heshmati,Siavash Ahmadi,Babak Hossein Khalaj,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FourStat是一个针对单变量时间序列异常检测的双模型框架，结合傅里叶自编码器（FAE，频域捕捉季节性等全局模式）与平稳性自编码器（SAE，通过强制统计平稳性关注局部结构），并提出Perfect Point新指标以消除阈值选择的主观性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多变量时间序列异常检测方法在单变量场景下表现差或无法直接适用，同时传统基于阈值的评估存在主观性问题。

Method: 提出双模型框架：FAE基于频域分析捕捉全局模式（如季节性）；SAE通过强制统计平稳性关注局部结构；两模型互补结合。另提出Perfect Point评价指标，检验能否直接从异常分数获得完美F1，避免阈值设定的主观性。

Result: FourStat优于现有基线方法，在困难异常类型上优势尤为明显；新指标能更清晰地揭示模型性能差距与优势。

Conclusion: 频域与平稳性双视角的互补建模对单变量时间序列异常检测有效，且Perfect Point指标为评估提供了更客观清晰的标准。

Abstract: While numerous studies have focused on multivariate time series anomaly detection, many existing methods perform poorly or are not directly applicable to univariate settings. We introduce FourStat, a dual-model framework for univariate time series anomaly detection that combines two complementary approaches. The Fourier Autoencoder (FAE) captures global patterns like seasonality through frequency-domain analysis, while the Stationary Autoencoder (SAE) focuses on local structures by enforcing statistical stationarity. We also propose a new evaluation metric called Perfect Point that assesses whether perfect F1-scores can be achieved directly from anomaly scores, eliminating thresholding subjectivity. Results demonstrate that FourStat outperforms existing baselines, particularly on challenging anomaly types, while the new metric provides clearer insights into model performance gaps and advantages.

</details>


### [583] [SGD with Large Learning Rates: General Analysis & Improved Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32762)
*Konstantinos Emmanouilidis,Ziqing Xu,Salma Tarmoun,Lachlan MacDonald,Rene Vidal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在交叉熵损失下（线性预测器与两层神经网络），即使存在随机梯度噪声，选取合适的大步长仍能使 SGD 获得 O(T^{-2}) 的加速收敛率，说明大步长加速机制在随机情形下依然成立且可推广到非线性模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 SGD 分析通常要求步长低于曲率相关的稳定性阈值；近期确定性优化研究表明大步长可加速 GD，但这一现象在随机梯度噪声下是否仍然存在（Wu et al., 2024 提出的开放问题）尚不清楚。

Method: 针对交叉熵损失下的线性预测器和两层神经网络，给出随机大步长动力学的细致刻画（fine-grained characterization of stochastic large-stepsize dynamics），以此获得对轨迹更精确的控制，并据此分析收敛性。

Result: 建立了 O(T^{-2}) 的加速收敛率；同时该轨迹控制在稳定区域内给出更紧的收敛保证，甚至改进了确定性情形下的已有界；数值实验验证了大学习率在实践中的优势。

Conclusion: 大步长诱导的加速机制能够抵抗随机性，并可超越线性模型推广到两层神经网络，肯定性回答了此前的开放问题。

Abstract: Stochastic Gradient Descent lies at the core of modern machine learning. However its classical analysis typically restricts the stepsize to be below a curvature-dependent stability threshold. Recent developments in deterministic optimization have challenged this paradigm, showing that suitably chosen large stepsizes can not only preserve convergence, but also accelerate Gradient Descent (GD). Whether this phenomenon persists in the presence of stochastic gradient noise has remained an open question (Wu et al., 2024). In this work, we answer this question affirmatively for the cross-entropy loss with linear predictors and two-layer neural networks, establishing an accelerated $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2})$ convergence rate. At the core of our analysis is a fine-grained characterization of the stochastic large-stepsize dynamics. This sharper control of the trajectory further yields tight convergence guarantees within the stable regime, improving existing bounds even in the deterministic setting. Taken together, our results show that the acceleration mechanism induced by large stepsizes survives stochasticity and extends beyond linear models. Numerical experiments demonstrate the benefits of large learning rates in practice.

</details>


### [584] [Can a Frontier LLM Repair a Quantized Network by Tool-Free Weight-Space Programming?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33031)
*Steffen Urban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究者把20k参数CIFAR-10 CNN的完整权重以文本形式交给Claude家族的四个LLM，让其无工具、无数据地输出4-bit量化网络。结果表明前沿LLM能靠逐层推理恢复大部分精度：Opus 5.5将4-bit网络从RTN的60.4%提升到77.95%（差浮点模型3.5pp、差AdaRound 2.8pp）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准RTN 4-bit量化使测试精度从81.4%掉到60.4%，损失巨大；作者想探究前沿LLM是否能在纯"权重空间"内、不借助工具/校准数据/推理执行的情况下完成高质量量化，并区分"LLM是否会自发优化"还是只会退化为RTN。

Method: 设计四种评估协议：前两种同时给出浮点网络与4-bit RTN网络并告知精度显著下降；后两种只给浮点网络和量化任务。对四种协议下四个Claude模型的回答进行详细分析。

Result: Opus 5.5在每层只给一个答案的设置下，通过在每个3×3卷积核内平衡舍入误差（在整数权重上推理）把精度提到77.95%。仅给浮点网络时LLM会说出误差抵消修正的思路但不实际应用，退化为RTN（最多带轻微clip），Fable 5.2由此仍达70.0%。

Conclusion: 前沿LLM具备在权重空间中做量化误差平衡的推理能力，可作为无数据的post-training量化方案，但需要显式误差信号提示；自发优化倾向弱，倾向于保守回退RTN。

Abstract: We give four large language models (LLMs) of the Claude family the complete weights of a 20k-parameter CIFAR-10 CNN as text and ask them to produce a 4-bit network without tools, data or the ability to run inference. Standard round-to-nearest (RTN) quantization to 4 bit lowers the test accuracy from 81.4% to 60.4%. We design four evaluation protocols that differ in the input and task description given to the LLMs and analyze their responses. In the first two protocols the LLMs are given the float and the 4-bit RTN network and are told that the accuracy has dropped significantly. In the last two they receive only the float network and the task to quantize it, which tests whether they apply an optimization on their own or fall back to plain RTN. Our analysis shows that a frontier LLM can recover most of the lost accuracy. Given one answer per layer, Opus 5.5 raises the accuracy of the 4-bit network to 77.95% by balancing the rounding errors within each 3x3 kernel, reasoning over the integer weights without tools. This is 3.5 pp below the float network and 2.8 pp below AdaRound, which learns the rounding from calibration data. Given only the float network, the LLMs name error-cancelling corrections but do not apply them and fall back to plain RTN, at most with mildly clipped scales, which still lifts Fable 5.2's quantized network to 70.0%. We analyze in detail what the LLMs did and why it works. Code and prompts can be found at https://github.com/urbste/weight-space-programming-ptq

</details>


### [585] [Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33048)
*Yanlai Yang,Minki Kang,Divyam Madaan,Sung Ju Hwang,Mengye Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究超网络生成的LoRA适配器的组合问题（流式场景下无法为每篇文档单独存储适配器），发现其几何性质与直接微调的LoRA显著不同（谱集中度更高、跨文档对齐更强），据此提出"潜空间LoRA合并"：先合并超网络中间潜变量，再通过冻结的LoRA生成头解码，性能一致优于权重空间与因子空间基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超网络可将文档一次前向转换为低秩参数更新（LoRA），实现向冻结LLM快速注入新知识；但流式设置下为每篇文档单独存储LoRA适配器不可持续，因此需要研究如何组合这些超网络生成的LoRA。

Method: 以Doc-to-LoRA和SHINE两个代表性系统为对象，先分析超网络生成LoRA的几何特性（谱集中度、跨文档对齐度），并与next-token prediction及QA微调得到的LoRA对比；基于观察提出潜空间LoRA合并——合并超网络的中间潜变量，再经由冻结的LoRA生成头解码合并后的潜变量，从而保持单一固定秩适配器。

Result: 超网络生成的LoRA表现出更强的谱集中度和跨文档对齐，而直接微调的适配器较为弥散且跨文档近乎正交；潜空间合并在多个对比中一致优于权重空间与因子空间基线，同时保持单一固定秩适配器。

Conclusion: 潜空间组合是在固定输出秩预算下合并超网络生成LoRA的一种有前景机制。

Abstract: Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed output-rank budget.

</details>


### [586] [A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33133)
*Hussamuddin Syed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文补上了"梯度基线"，用极小规模梯度微调提升 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的思考模式准确率，并证明它与免梯度的 Astra 权值编辑互补，二者叠加可达 62.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期有演示称 GPT-6 Astra 可在无梯度情况下编辑 131,072 个权重，把 MATH-500 从 7.9% 提升到 48.1%，但缺少梯度方法的对照基线；同时该小模型在思考模式下几乎无法闭合 think 块、准确率极低。作者希望提供这一缺失的基线并检验两种编辑能否结合。

Method: 只微调梯度最大的 140–139,750 个权重，训练数据取自模型自身在 MATH 训练题上的正确回答，单 GPU 训练 2–9 分钟，最少 50 个样本即可。分析发现梯度集中在最前三层各自"最接近常数"的通道上；由于模型无偏置项，该编辑等价于向残差流加一个常数向量，故可用三个固定向量复现。随后与 Astra 编辑组合，在 Astra 协议（32k token、presence penalty 1.5）及不同预算下对比评测。

Result: 梯度编辑在 4k token 预算下把思考模式 MATH-500 提到 39.0–45.5%（基线 15.4%），随机选 1,398 个位置仅 16.3%。复现中 Astra 编辑得 52.1%，本文全强度编辑 45.6–45.7%，但在 16k 以内每个预算都更优（4k 时 39.5% vs 6.7%）。组合后 Astra 编辑 + 半强度本文编辑在 32k 得 62.2%，比单独 Astra 高 10 分（p=3e-9）且节省一半 token；半强度单独为 46.7%。

Conclusion: 梯度基线是可行且高效的（分钟级、单 GPU、50 样本），其本质近似于对残差流加常数向量；该编辑与 Astra 的免梯度编辑互补，组合方案在准确率和 token 效率上均显著优于任一单独方法。

Abstract: Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits reach 45.6-45.7%, but ours win at every budget up to 16k tokens (39.5% against 6.7% at 4k). The two edits are complementary. The Astra edit plus our 139,750-weight edit at half strength scores 62.2% at 32k, 10 points above the Astra edit alone (p = 3e-9), with half as many tokens; our half-strength edit alone scores 46.7%.

</details>


### [587] [EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32810)
*Yibo Wang,Changyi Yang,Yuanxin Liu,Zhaoran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出EPRO框架，把RL训练中"执行策略无法直接观测"的问题建模为通过不完美预测器优化未观测执行策略，并用可微预测器+稳健优化加以解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL训练LLM时rollout生成与策略训练分离，两个数值引擎虽共享参数却产生不同策略。这不只是已知的训练-推断失配，而是学习者更新期间当前参数对应的执行策略根本无法直接观测，需要修正的估计对象本身是未知的。

Method: 从rollout时观测到的执行策略出发，用训练策略的变化构造当前执行策略的可微预测器，其得分导出Transported Score Centering (TSC)；稳健改进分析揭示预测误差如何限制可被可靠辩护的更新幅度；引入Policy Shift作为预测风险的可观测代理，用Shift-Aware Soft Clipping (SSC) 削弱高风险更新。

Result: 在四个Qwen3模型设置、七个数学推理基准上，EPRO在对比方法中取得最高的平均留出准确率。

Conclusion: 将训练-推断失配重新表述为对未观测执行策略的稳健优化是有效的，预测误差有理论上限约束更新幅度，配合可观测风险代理的软裁剪即可稳定提升推理性能。

Abstract: RL for LLMs often separates rollout generation from policy training. Although the two numerical engines share model parameters, they can induce different policies. This creates a challenge beyond correcting a known training-inference mismatch: during learner updates, the execution policy corresponding to the current parameters cannot be directly observed. We view this as optimizing an unobserved execution policy through an imperfect predictor of its evolution. This perspective raises two fundamental questions: how can we estimate the execution policy's response to learner updates, and how much should we trust that estimate when optimizing the actual execution policy? We introduce Execution-Policy Robust Optimization (EPRO) to address these challenges. Starting from the observed rollout-time execution policy, we use training-policy changes to construct a differentiable predictor of the current execution policy, whose score yields Transported Score Centering (TSC). Our robust-improvement analysis reveals how prediction error limits the magnitude of reliably justified updates. For practical implementation, we introduce Policy Shift as an observable proxy for prediction risk and use Shift-Aware Soft Clipping (SSC) to attenuate risky updates. Across four Qwen3 model settings, EPRO achieves the highest average held-out accuracy among the compared methods on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [588] [Breaking the Joint Action Space Dependence in Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32812)
*Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究分布鲁棒马尔可夫博弈中鲁棒粗相关均衡(CCE)的样本复杂度，提出仅依赖最大单人动作集规模A_*的算法，避免了依赖联合动作数∏A_i的多智能体维度灾难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对(s,a)-矩形TV不确定集下鲁棒CCE的生成模型保证，样本复杂度随联合动作数∏_i A_i增长，该数随玩家数量指数增长，导致"多智能体维度灾难"。作者希望在不修改不确定集的前提下消除这一依赖。

Method: 设计新算法，其复杂度仅通过最大单人动作集A_*:=max_i A_i 依赖动作集。关键两要素：(1) 鲁棒备份(robust backup)的插件式估计，其平均误差与状态数无关；(2) 每轮仅用单批样本同时作为所有玩家的带宽反馈(bandit feedback)。

Result: 算法使用Õ(SA_*H^5D^4/ε^4)个转移样本，以至少1-δ的概率返回一个马尔可夫策略，使其从任意初始状态都是ε-鲁棒CCE。其中S为状态数，H为时域，D:=max_i min{H,1/ρ_i}，ρ_i为玩家i的TV半径。

Conclusion: 结果表明，即使不修改(s,a)-矩形不确定集，也能避免对联合动作数∏_i A_i的指数依赖，实现与玩家数量无关的样本复杂度。

Abstract: We study the sample complexity of learning robust coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) in finite-horizon, general-sum, distributionally robust Markov games with known rewards and a generative model of the nominal transitions. Each player evaluates a policy by its worst-case return over total-variation (TV) balls centered at the nominal transition distribution of every stage, state, and joint action; this is the standard $(s,a)$-rectangular uncertainty set. Existing generative-model guarantees for this model scale with the number $\prod_iA_i$ of joint actions, where $A_i$ is the number of actions of player~$i$. Since this number grows exponentially with the number of players, these guarantees suffer from the curse of multiagency. We design an algorithm whose sample complexity depends on the action sets only through the largest individual action-set size $A_*:=\max_iA_i$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde O(SA_*H^5D^4/\varepsilon^4)$ transition samples and, with probability at least $1-δ$, returns a Markov policy that is an $\varepsilon$-robust CCE from every initial state. Here $S$ is the number of states, $H$ is the horizon, and $D:=\max_i\min\{H,1/ρ_i\}$, where $ρ_i$ is the TV radius of player~$i$. Two ingredients make this possible: a plug-in estimate of the robust backup whose mean error does not depend on the number of states, and a single batch of samples per round that serves as bandit feedback for all players at once. The result shows that the dependence on $\prod_iA_i$ can be avoided without modifying the $(s,a)$-rectangular uncertainty set.

</details>


### [589] [E(n)-Equivariant Spherical Decision Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32815)
*Pavlo Melnyk,Michael Felsberg,Kostas Daniilidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种构造性方法，将已有的 O(n)-等变超球面神经元扩展为包含平移的精确 E(n)-等变球面决策面，并给出显式闭式矩阵表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 O(n)-等变超球面神经元只处理旋转/反射，缺乏平移等变性；常见做法依赖输入中心化或显式成对差，破坏精确等变性并牺牲表示简洁性。

Method: 分解 O(n)-等变神经元特征，分别构造平移与 E(n)-变换的显式表示，以满足等变约束，推导出闭式矩阵形式的 E(n)-等变球面决策面。

Result: 所得决策面无需输入中心化或显式成对差分即实现精确 E(n)-等变，具有显式闭式矩阵表示；数值实验验证推导正确性，并进行了下游任务检验。

Conclusion: 为构建精确 E(n)-等变几何基元提供了构造性方案，简化了等变网络中层设计的实现。

Abstract: We present a constructive derivation of exactly E(n)-equivariant spherical decision surfaces by extending prior O(n)-equivariant hypersphere neurons to include translations. To achieve this, we present a decomposition of the features of the O(n)-equivariant neurons and provide explicit representations for translation and E(n)-transformations to fulfil the respective equivariance constraints. The resulting decision surfaces are exactly E(n)-equivariant without input centring or explicit pairwise differences, and admit explicit closed-form matrix representations. In addition, we numerically verify the correctness of the derivations and perform a downstream check of the resulting geometric primitives.

</details>


### [590] [PtychoFM: A Foundation Model for Ptychographic Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32830)
*Aileen Luo,Emon Dey,Ming Du,Tao Zhou,Peco Myint,Himanshu Goel,Shashank Subramanian,Xiangyu Yin,Tekin Bicer,Siniša Veseli,Cheng-Chu Chung,Jeffrey A. Klug,Aldo Peña Pérez,Llorenç Fanals-i-Batllori,Christopher Kenney,Henry Shi,Lorenzo Rota,Angelo Dragone,Zirui Gao,Douglas A. Bennett,John A. B. Mates,Leila R. Vale,Michael R. Vissers,Yi Jiang,Junjing Deng,Tejas Guruswamy,Varuni K. Sastry,Bowen Zheng,Takenori Shimamura,Oliver Hoidn,Aashwin Mishra,Hannah Parraga,Brandon Stone,Jonathan Baldwin,Aaron Michelson,Michael Wojcik,Xiaoyin Zheng,Robert Underwood,Yijiang Li,Jinxing Jiang,Nicholas Schwarz,Apurva Mehta,Johanna Nelson Weker,Hassina Bilheux,Joel N. Ullom,Alexander Hexemer,Antonino Miceli,Kibaek Kim,Hanfei Yan,Mathew J. Cherukara,Alec R. Sandy,Stefan Vogt,Laurent C. Chapon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理感知基础模型PtychoFM，可从单帧衍射图直接重建复振幅物体图像，并以200帧/秒实时同步环实验可视化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 叠层衍射成像(Ptychography)虽能实现X射线、电子与光学显微镜的高分辨无透镜成像，但传统迭代相位重建计算量大且需针对实验专门调参，难以在数据采集速率提升时提供实时反馈。

Method: 构建物理感知基础模型PtychoFM：结合大规模预训练与实验特定微调；使用可微前向模型进行训练，无需物体空间标签；从步扫(step-scan)单样品训练数据迁移到其他样品的飞行扫描(fly-scan)测量（不同特征尺寸、形貌与折射率）。

Result: 在同步辐射线站上，将衍射帧从探测器流式传输至单块GPU进行推理，速度达200帧/秒，并回传实现实时可视化；模型成功跨样品、跨扫描模式迁移。

Conclusion: PtychoFM为快速、可迁移的叠层衍射重建及非理想条件下的实时实验反馈提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: Ptychography provides high-resolution lensless imaging across X-ray, electron, and optical microscopy, but reconstructing images from diffraction measurements generally requires computationally intensity iterative phase retrieval. These methods often require experiment-specific analysis, limiting real-time feedback as data acquisition rates increase. Here, we demonstrate PtychoFM, a physics-aware foundation model for ptychographic imaging that combines large-scale pre-training with experiment-specific fine-tuning to reconstruct complex object images directly from individual diffraction patterns. Trained using a differentiable forward model without object-space labels, PtychoFM transfers from step-scan training data on one sample to fly-scan measurements of other samples with different feature sizes, morphologies, and refraction indices. At a synchrotron beamline, diffraction frames were streamed from the detector to a single GPU for inference at up to 200 frames per second and returned for real-time visualization. PtychoFM provides a practical route to rapid, transferable ptychographic reconstruction and live experimental feedback under nonideal conditions.

</details>


### [591] [Tabra Blends: Improving the Accuracy--Latency Trade-off with Complementary Tabular Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32859)
*Jing Jia,Guanyang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究紧凑集成能否在更短时间内取得更高精度，提出由4个Kumo估计器与1个LimiX组成的混合管线，在816个TabArena划分上达2063.8 Elo，较同次拟合的最佳已发表方案高45.4分，归一化拟合+预测时间比Kumo-16低15%、比完整LimiX低98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型在预测精度与延迟之间存在不同的权衡取舍，作者希望考察：一个紧凑的集成方案是否能在更短时间内获得更高准确率，即同时改善精度与效率。

Method: 构建一个紧凑的混合集成管线：4个Kumo估计器加1条LimiX管线，并在816个TabArena数据划分上评测，同时比较归一化的拟合加预测时间；还分析了两种模型之间的预测多样性对误差下降的解释作用。

Result: 混合集成达到2063.8 Elo，较同一拟合条件下的最佳已发表条目高45.4分；归一化拟合+预测时间比Kumo-16低15%，比完整LimiX低98%。分析显示，两个模型之间更大的预测多样性有助于解释误差的降低。

Conclusion: 紧凑的异构集成可以同时在精度和延迟上优于单一基础模型方案，且性能增益与模型间的预测多样性相关，说明互补性而非单纯规模是提升来源。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models make different trade-offs between prediction accuracy and latency. We study whether a compact ensemble can deliver higher accuracy in less time. Across 816 TabArena splits, our blend of four-estimator Kumo and one LimiX pipeline reaches 2063.8 Elo, 45.4 points above the top published entry in the same fit. Its normalized fit + predict time is 15% lower than Kumo-16's and 98% lower than full LimiX's. We find that greater prediction diversity between the two models helps explain the reduction in error.

</details>


### [592] [Weight Scale Rebalancing: Transferable Training Recipes for Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32866)
*Yikun Hou,Naomi Graham,Alp Yurtsever*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出UDV-Rebalance (UDVR) 重参数化方法，在Transformer中天然成对的权重矩阵(U,V)之间插入辅助对角矩阵D，并周期性重平衡以保持U列向量和V行向量单位范数、由D吸收尺度，从而得到一个仅依赖矩阵维度的免调参规则，跨模型规模、架构和数据分布均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练Transformer需要仔细调超参数，而大模型上调参代价越来越高，希望找到一种无需逐模型调参、能泛化到不同规模/架构/数据的训练方案。

Method: UDVR在成对权重矩阵(U,V)间插入对角矩阵D；周期性重平衡因子，使U的列和V的行保持单位范数，尺度被D吸收；由此给出一个只依赖各权重矩阵维度的免调参规则，只需在ViT+CIFAR上拟合一次。

Result: 该规则在更换激活函数或优化器后仍有效；可迁移到DomainNet新图像域、ImageNet上的ViT/Swin/MaxViT，以及最高1.3B参数的语言模型预训练。UDVR稳定优于Weight Normalization和σReparam，并能匹敌在每个目标模型上逐一扫描超参数的vanilla基线。

Conclusion: UDVR提供了一个简单、可迁移的免调参重参数化方案，显著降低Transformer训练的超参数调优成本，且在视觉与语言任务上保持与精心调参基线相当的性能。

Abstract: Training Transformers requires careful hyperparameter tuning, which becomes increasingly costly for large models. We introduce UDV-Rebalance (UDVR), a reparameterization that inserts an auxiliary diagonal matrix $D$ between naturally paired weight matrices $(U,V)$ appearing throughout Transformer architectures. UDVR periodically rebalances the factors to maintain unit-norm columns in $U$ and unit-norm rows in $V$, with $D$ absorbing the corresponding scales. With rebalancing, a single hyperparameter setting of UDVR remains effective across model scales, architectures, and data distributions. This yields a tuning-free rule that adapts to each weight matrix using only its dimensions. We fit this rule once on ViT models trained on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and it remains valid when the activation function or the optimizer is changed. The same rule transfers to new image domains in DomainNet, to ViT, Swin, and MaxViT on ImageNet, and to language-model pretraining with up to 1.3B parameters. UDVR consistently outperforms Weight Normalization and $σ$Reparam and matches a vanilla baseline whose hyperparameters are swept on each target model.

</details>


### [593] [MXFP4 for LLM Inference: Complementary Post-Training Quantization Techniques and Their Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32873)
*Natalia Frumkin,Alireza Khodamoradi,Kristof Denolf,Eric Dellinger,Stuart Biles*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究MXFP6/MXFP4/NVFP4三种微缩放格式与Hadamard旋转、PTQ算法、尺度选择策略的可组合性，发现有效量化配方依格式而异，并提出免校准的Midmax尺度选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微缩放格式（16/32元素共享尺度因子）可低损低精度量化LLM，但其精度依赖于数值格式与旋转、PTQ、尺度选择的交互方式，而现有实践缺乏对跨格式可组合性的系统认识。

Method: 在6个LLM与3种格式（MXFP6、MXFP4、NVFP4）上系统变化Hadamard旋转粒度、PTQ算法和尺度选择策略进行组合实验；提出免校准尺度选择方法Midmax以缓解2的幂块尺度的截断误差；并测试MXFP6激活+MXFP4权重混合方案及MXFP4加逐张量宏观尺度的效果。

Result: MXFP4与NVFP4均支持准确4-bit推理但技巧不可互换：MXFP4显著受益于旋转与纠错PTQ，NVFP4受益较小（其更细粒度尺度已捕捉块内变化）；Midmax在多数MXFP4配置上提升精度；MXFP6激活+MXFP4权重可挽回大部分4-bit精度损失，在Llama-3.1-8B上达到或超过BF16基线；为MXFP4增加逐张量宏观尺度无平均精度收益。

Conclusion: 量化配方具有格式依赖性，需按格式搭配旋转、PTQ与尺度选择；Midmax与MXFP6/MXFP4混合方案是实用改进，而全局重缩放无法弥补E8M0块尺度本身的局限。

Abstract: Recent advances in low-precision representation have introduced several microscaling numerical formats for LLM quantization. By sharing a scale factor across groups of 16 or 32 elements, these formats enable aggressive low-precision quantization with minimal accuracy degradation, particularly when combined with modern PTQ algorithms. Their accuracy depends on how the numerical format interacts with rotation, PTQ, and scale selection. We study the composability of PTQ configurations across six LLMs and three microscaling formats: MXFP6, MXFP4, and NVFP4, systematically varying Hadamard rotation granularity, PTQ algorithm, and scale-selection strategy. Our central finding is that effective quantization recipes are format dependent: both MXFP4 and NVFP4 support accurate 4-bit inference, but techniques that benefit one do not necessarily transfer to the other. MXFP4 benefits substantially from rotation and error-correcting PTQ, whereas NVFP4 gains less from rotation, consistent with its finer-grained scales capturing more within-block variation. Building on these findings, we introduce Midmax, a calibration-free scale-selection strategy that mitigates clipping error in power-of-two block scales and improves accuracy across a majority of the evaluated MXFP4 configurations. We show that pairing MXFP6 activations with MXFP4 weights recovers most of the accuracy lost at 4-bit and, on Llama-3.1-8B, matches or exceeds our in-house BF16 baseline. An additional study finds that augmenting MXFP4 with a per-tensor macroscale, a mechanism intrinsic to NVFP4, does not improve average accuracy, suggesting that global rescaling alone does not address the limitations of E8M0 block scales for MXFP4 quantization. Together, these results provide practical guidance for combining numerical formats, rotation, PTQ, and scale selection for accurate low-precision LLM inference.

</details>


### [594] [Shared information governs multi-view planted matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32892)
*Ruiqi Wang,Jingtong Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究K个打乱视图的行匹配问题：行可精确（近精确）匹配取决于对象共享信息J是否超过log n阈值，并给出弱相关下的4/K与4/(K-1)阈值及各视图二分条件的刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图数据中同一对象的行被打乱，需要判断何时能把K个视图中的行正确对应起来；此前Wee、Yang、Fan、Mao提出的弱相关高斯信号阈值问题尚未解决，且缺乏对K>2一般情形的完整刻画。

Method: 以高斯特征向量（已知协方差）建模，用共享信息J（一个对象K次观测的互信息）刻画；分析视图的最弱二分（weakest bipartition），引入Rényi条件处理稀有子群；提出分层筛选（layered screening）算法与递归解码器。

Result: 固定K时，J>(1+ε)log n可匹配至o(n)错误，J<(1-ε)log n不可，且可无任两视图单独可匹配；J低于阈值时，若包含二者的某组视图共享信息>log n仍可匹配，否则任何估计器重叠趋于零。弱相关下阈值为2log n；弱公共信号经独立噪声时阈值为4/K与4/(K-1)（以∑ρ_ℓ²/log n为单位），回答了Wee等的问题。等相关时K=3,4可达4/K，复杂度O(Kn²d)。

Conclusion: 给出多视图行匹配的精确阈值刻画：弱相关下由最弱二分决定，非弱相关需额外Rényi条件；猜想两条件合起来刻画高斯律的精确恢复，并在三视图等及相关等情形证明；算法达到信息阈值，结论可推广到乘积律与随机子集观测。

Abstract: We study when the rows of $K$ shuffled views of the same $n$ objects can be matched, where each object is observed once in every view through a Gaussian feature vector with known covariance. For every fixed $K$, all views can be matched up to $o(n)$ errors if the shared information $J$ of one object's $K$ observations exceeds $(1+ε)\log n$, and not if it is below $(1-ε)\log n$; this can hold although no two views can be matched on their own. Below the threshold, two views can still be matched if some set of views containing both has shared information above $\log n$; otherwise every estimator, even one that reads all views, has vanishing overlap between them. Matching every row is governed by the weakest bipartition of the views: with weak correlations the threshold is $2\log n$ for the mutual information across it. For a weak common signal observed through independent noise, the two thresholds are $4/K$ and $4/(K-1)$ in units of $\sum_\ellρ_\ell^2/\log n$, which answers a question of Wee, Yang, Fan and Mao. Beyond weak correlations the bipartition condition is not sufficient: rare subpopulations impose a Rényi condition for every partition into at least three blocks. We conjecture that the two conditions together characterize exact recovery for Gaussian laws, and prove this for three views with equal correlations and in several further cases, in part with computer assistance. With equal correlations, layered screening attains $4/K$ for $K=3,4$ in $O(Kn^2d)$ operations, and for general laws a recursive decoder attains $J$. The almost-exact thresholds extend to known product laws and to objects observed in random subsets of the views.

</details>


### [595] [Polynomial-Time Learning of Random Automata from One Label per Word](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32959)
*Yilin Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究随机二元确定有限自动机的学习问题，给出多项式时间算法，在几乎所有转移表上能以小误差预测长度为m的均匀单词的接受性；同时否证了Fish和Reyzin关于会合时间的猜想4，并用Lean形式化部分证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从仅含单个接受比特标签的均匀随机单词中学习随机自动机，信息量极其有限（每个单词只揭示一个输出），需要找到可行算法并厘清随机自动机的会合（meeting）时间行为，纠正已有的猜想。

Method: 利用相邻两个历史长度的标签矩比较，估计同一隐藏状态下两条延续的带符号输出乘积的期望，从而绕过单词只给出单比特的限制；对随机转移表建模为随机DFA，分析不同状态间会合时间的分布，并以Lean对部分步骤形式化。

Result: 对每个固定β>0，给出多项式时间算法，除概率o(n^{-β})的转移表外均有效；误差≤ε、置信1-γ，样本复杂度与时间关于n,m,1/ε,log(2/γ)为多项式，次数仅依赖β。反对猜想4：两个固定不同状态在长度floor(cn)的单词下被送至不同状态的比例依概率收敛到e^{-c}；典型表上把该比例降到1/n渐近需n log n个字母。

Conclusion: 随机DFA在极端弱的观测模型下仍可多项式时间学习，且其状态会合时间具有可预测的指数/对数规律，给出Fish–Reyzin猜想4的反例，并提供了形式化验证的证明片段。

Abstract: We study a binary deterministic finite automaton whose $2n$ transitions are chosen independently and uniformly from its $n$ states. The learner observes independent uniform words of length $m$, each labeled with a single bit indicating acceptance. For every fixed $β>0$ we give a polynomial-time algorithm that works outside a set of transition tables of probability $o(n^{-β})$. On each remaining table, for any start state and accepting set, the predictor has error at most $ε$ on fresh uniform words of length $m$ with probability at least $1-γ$ over the training sample and the learner's random choices. Its sample size and running time are polynomial in $n$, $m$, $1/ε$ and $\log(2/γ)$, with degree depending only on $β$. Although each word reveals only one output, comparing label moments at two consecutive history lengths lets us estimate the expected product of the signed outputs of two continuations from the same hidden state.
  We also refute Conjecture 4 of Fish and Reyzin on meeting times. For two distinct states fixed before the table is drawn and every fixed $c>0$, the fraction of words of length $\lfloor cn\rfloor$ that send them to different states converges in probability to $e^{-c}$. On a typical table, driving this fraction down to $1/n$ takes asymptotically $n\log n$ letters. Selected proof steps are formalized in Lean.

</details>


### [596] [Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32969)
*Johan Lindqvist,Antonio Orvieto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 线性注意力在联想回忆上弱于softmax注意力，但其召回能力主要因训练缺乏专门激励而未被开发；通过句内重复与上下文敏感损失重加权可显著缩小差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力模型在语言建模的联想回忆（AR）上相对softmax注意力存在不成比例的缺陷，作者希望厘清这一差距的来源（是状态容量限制还是训练信号不足）。

Method: 结合自然语言评测、合成回忆任务与针对性训练干预；在合成设定下量化状态大小与可回忆条目数的关系，并对多种线性注意力架构做经验缩放分析；随后在训练中强化回忆监督：上下文句内重复（in-context sentence repetition）与上下文敏感损失重加权。

Result: 即使单层模型在大规模下也能跨长距离检索数千条关联；各线性注意力架构呈现相似的经验缩放规律。但标准LM训练不能可靠地教会线性模型从上下文复制，而softmax模型可以。两种训练干预提升了回忆密集型基准表现，在不改架构、不改token预算与优化步数的前提下将长距离AR差距缩小到softmax基线水平，仅以轻微通用语言建模性能为代价。

Conclusion: 线性注意力架构本身具备大量但未被充分利用的检索容量；其归纳偏置与语言模型训练的需求使该能力难以自然发展，需专门激励才能激发。

Abstract: Linear attention models exhibit a disproportionate deficit relative to softmax attention in associative recall (AR) in language modeling. We investigate this gap through natural language evaluations, synthetic recall tasks, and targeted training interventions. Using a synthetic setting, we quantify the role of state-size in how many items can be recalled from memory and find a similar empirical scaling across the tested linear-attention architectures. Testing this relationship reveals that even a single layer at scale can learn to retrieve thousands of associations across long distances. Yet, standard language model training does not reliably teach a linear model to copy from context, whereas a comparable softmax model learns to do so. Considering this, we strengthen recall supervision during training through in-context sentence repetition and context-sensitive loss reweighting. Both methods improve recall-intensive benchmark performance and narrow the long-distance AR gap to the softmax baseline without changing the architecture, token budget, or number of optimization steps, at a slight cost to general language modeling. These targeted changes to training can thus elicit substantial but underutilized retrieval capacity in linear-attention models. These findings suggest that, although linear-attention architectures have substantial capacity for recall, their inductive biases and the demands of language model training make it difficult to develop this capability without dedicated incentives.

</details>


### [597] [File Size as a Potential Dataset Bias in Audio-Visual Deepfake Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32979)
*Marcella Astrid,Niki Maria Foteinopoulou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文发现两个常用视听深度伪造数据集存在文件大小偏差：仅凭文件大小派生的分数在1M-Deepfakes验证集上达到70.13% AUC，结合文件大小与视频时长后，简单文件级方法在1M上超过90% AUC、FakeAVCeleb上超过85% AUC，提示基准评测可能被非内容性线索污染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度伪造检测基准通常假定模型是在区分真实与被篡改内容，但数据集构建管线可能无意中在类别标签与简单文件属性（如文件大小）之间引入关联，导致评测结果虚高，故需检验此类捷径线索是否存在。

Method: 在两个广泛使用的视听深度伪造数据集（1M-Deepfakes Detection Challenge、FakeAVCeleb）以及DFDC上进行文件级统计分析：用仅由文件大小派生的分数做分类评测，再将文件大小与视频时长联合作为简单特征，计算AUC并与现有基准结果比较，并讨论编码、压缩、源数据、篡改流程与后处理等可能解释。

Result: 仅文件大小派生分数在1M-Deepfakes验证集上AUC为70.13%；文件大小+时长组合在1M上超过90% AUC、FakeAVCeleb上超过85% AUC；DFDC中未观察到相同模式，说明该关联是数据集依赖的而非深度伪造视频的固有属性。

Conclusion: 研究未确定成因，但强调构建与评估深度伪造数据集/基准时必须检查简单文件级属性，并建议后续研究这些与文件大小相关的因素是否在解码后的视频或音频中留下痕迹、从而影响基于内容的检测。

Abstract: Deepfake detection benchmarks are commonly designed to evaluate whether models can distinguish authentic from manipulated audiovisual content. However, benchmark construction pipelines may introduce unintended associations between class labels and simple file-level properties. In this work, we identify a potential file-size bias in two widely used audio-visual deepfake datasets. In the 1M-Deepfakes Detection Challenge dataset, a score derived from file size alone achieves 70.13% AUC on the validation set. When file size is considered together with video duration, simple file-level methods exceed 90% AUC on 1M and 85% AUC on FakeAVCeleb. Although the same pattern is not observed in DFDC, the results suggest that the observed association is dataset-dependent rather than an inherent property of deepfake videos. We discuss several possible explanations, including differences in encoding, compression, source data, manipulation procedures, and post-processing, although the present analysis does not establish the underlying cause. We further discuss whether the factors associated with file size may also leave traces in decoded video or audio, and consequently whether they could influence content-based deepfake detection, as an important direction for future work. Our findings highlight the importance of examining simple file-level properties when constructing and evaluating deepfake datasets and benchmarks.

</details>


### [598] [AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32989)
*Winfried van den Dool,Patrick Forré,Amir Habibian,Yuki M. Asano,Max Welling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AVQ-Attention-2 将自适应向量量化注意力与精确局部注意力结合，并以簇内键均值代替码字，实现训练与推理均为 O(NM) 且质量接近甚至媲美精确稠密注意力，速度超过 FlashAttention。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准注意力对 token 数 N 的复杂度为 O(N^2)，代价过高；现有向量量化注意力虽降至 O(NM)，但训练仍为 O(N^2)，且近似质量不足以直接嵌入预训练模型而无需微调。

Method: 提出 AVQ-Attention-2：把自适应向量量化注意力（AVQ-attention，将码本分辨率集中在查询注意力质量密集处）与精确局部注意力合并；注意力目标由码字改为每个簇内键的均值。

Result: 三项改进：在相当代价下质量一致更优；训练复杂度也降为 O(NM) 而非 O(N^2)；近似精度足够高，可将该层直接插入预训练 Transformer 而无需微调。在不同序列长度下不仅优于其他近似注意力，也媲美精确稠密注意力，速度超过 FlashAttention 且质量几乎无损。

Conclusion: AVQ-Attention-2 是一种高效且高保真的注意力近似方案，兼顾 O(NM) 训练/推理成本、可即插即用性和与稠密注意力相当的质量，具备替代精确注意力的实用潜力。

Abstract: Attention costs $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.

</details>


### [599] [LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33004)
*Hanzhen Wang,Jiaming Xu,Guohao Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LEGOSpec 可组合框架，将投机解码的草稿模型拆解为 Context/Backbone/Proposal/Objective 四组件并统一训练，据此得出三条设计规律，并推出平衡型草稿模型 DFlux。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有投机解码方法整体比较不同训练配置下的完整方案，导致各组件的独立作用、交互关系与组合收益不清晰，无法指导面向具体负载的草稿模型设计。

Method: LEGOSpec 将草稿模型分解为四个可替换组件（Context、Backbone、Proposal、Objective），在统一训练基础设施上做受控实验，逐一变化组件并匹配训练条件以隔离效应与交互；同时引入元数据感知调度与异步执行以提升训练效率。基于结论构建 DFlux：卷积增强的 SWA–GQA 混合骨干 + Residual Corrector + 分层监督。

Result: 发现三点：(1) 不同负载偏好不同骨干，长上下文依懒于块内依赖建模；(2) Proposal 需权衡接受率与延迟；(3) 训练目标应局部匹配 token 分布并优化整块接受长度。在 Qwen 与 Gemma 上，DFlux 相对最强基线接受长度提升至多 13.7%（常规）与 34.7%（长上下文）；训练吞吐提升至多 79%，离线监督准备加速至多 3.11×（对比 SpecForge）。

Conclusion: 组件化的受控分析能有效揭示投机解码草稿设计的规律，并可直接转化为负载感知配置与通用型草稿模型；DFlux 在性能与训练效率上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. (2) Proposal design must balance acceptance and latency. (3) The training objective should match token distributions locally and optimize acceptance length across the block. These findings guide workload-aware configurations and DFlux, a balanced general-purpose draft combining a convolution-equipped SWA--GQA hybrid backbone, Residual Corrector, and hierarchical supervision. Across Qwen and Gemma models, DFlux improves acceptance length over the strongest baseline by up to 13.7% on regular benchmarks and 34.7% on long-context workloads. To support efficient training, LEGOSpec integrates metadata-aware scheduling and asynchronous execution, increasing training throughput by up to 79% and accelerating offline supervision preparation by up to $3.11\times$ over SpecForge.

</details>


### [600] [PAC-style Bounds on the Conditional Validity of Conformal Predictors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33023)
*Nicolo Colombo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文无需对数据分布作假设，给出任意 conformal predictor 输入条件覆盖率（input-conditional coverage）的 PAC 型概率下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Conformal prediction 只在边际上保证覆盖有效性，局部（条件）覆盖可能与目标 1-α 偏离；而在有限校准数据下，对一般数据分布构造条件有效的预测集是不可能的。因此需要可量化、可估计的条件覆盖保证。

Method: 基于 Markov 与 Cantelli 不等式推导条件覆盖率的 PAC 型概率下界，适配 calibration-marginal 与 calibration-conditional 两种设定；并提出一个依赖模型、更紧的 Cantelli 下界，其依赖条件覆盖方差，可通过完全非渐近的 Hoeffding 论证从数据中估计。

Result: 得到无需分布假设的条件覆盖率下界；更紧的界由条件覆盖方差决定，且该方差可由有限样本非渐近估计，从而给出可计算的条件有效性度量。

Conclusion: 条件覆盖方差可作为条件有效性的可扩展且有理论依据的经验度量，为实践中的局部覆盖评估提供工具。

Abstract: Conformal prediction sets are guaranteed to be marginally valid over the attribute space, but local coverage can diverge from the user-defined target $1-α$. Constructing conditionally valid prediction sets with finite calibration data is impossible for a general data-generating distribution. We derive PAC-type probabilistic lower bounds on the input-conditional coverage of any conformal predictor, without assumptions on the data distribution. They are based on the Markov and Cantelli inequalities and adapt to both calibration-marginal and calibration-conditional setups. A tighter, model-dependent Cantelli bound depends on the variance of the conditional coverage and is estimable from data using a fully non-asymptotic Hoeffding argument. The results suggest conditional-coverage variance as a scalable and theoretically motivated empirical measure of conditional validity.

</details>


### [601] [Best Arm Identification with Unknown Post-Action Context Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33024)
*Amir Mohammad Abouei,Mohammad Shahverdikondori,Emad Emamjomeh,Negar Kiyavash*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究固定置信度下带后动作上下文（post-action context）的最佳臂识别问题，在上下文分布未知的更困难情形下给出实例相关样本复杂度下界，并提出渐近最优的 Track-and-Stop 算法及凸松弛实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择动作后观察到的后动作上下文与奖励相关，利用这一中间信息可显著降低识别最佳臂的样本复杂度。已有工作仅分析上下文分布已知的情形，而实际中该分布通常未知，因此需要研究未知分布下的 BAI 问题。

Method: 1）推导实例相关的样本复杂度下界；2）提出 Track-and-Stop 算法，在可访问优化预言机时渐近匹配该下界；3）设计新的集中不等式，联合控制上下文分布不确定性与奖励均值不确定性，消除分别使用两个界带来的因子 2 损失；4）针对非凸优化难题提出带实例相关近似保证的凸松弛，并在困难高斯实例上实现渐近紧致。

Result: 理论上算法样本复杂度渐近达到下界；凸松弛具备实例相关近似保证并在高难高斯实例上渐近紧致；实验显示即使上下文分布未知，利用后动作上下文仍能比忽略它的基线降低样本复杂度。

Conclusion: 在后动作上下文分布未知的设定下，利用上下文信息可有效降低最佳臂识别的样本复杂度，所提算法与凸松弛在理论与实验上均表现良好。

Abstract: We study best arm identification (BAI) with post-action context in the fixed-confidence setting. After choosing an action, the learner observes a post-action context together with a reward whose distribution depends only on this context. Incorporating such intermediate information can substantially reduce the sample complexity of identifying the best arm. While Shahverdikondori et al. (2026a) analyzed the case where the distribution of contexts given actions is known, we address the more challenging and practically relevant case where this distribution is unknown. We derive an instance-dependent sample complexity lower bound and propose a Track-and-Stop algorithm that matches it asymptotically with access to an optimization oracle. Our stopping rule uses a new concentration inequality that jointly controls uncertainty in the context distributions and reward means, removing the factor of two incurred by separate concentration bounds. Implementing the algorithm generally requires solving nonconvex optimization problems. We propose a convex relaxation with instance-dependent approximation guarantees, including asymptotic tightness on hard Gaussian instances. Experiments demonstrate that exploiting post-action context reduces the sample complexity relative to baselines that ignore it, even when the context distributions are unknown.

</details>


### [602] [Score-Based Diffusion for Hypergraph Signals in the t-Spectral Domain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33026)
*Zhiyuan Dong,Carlos Mundo-Levano,Daniel L. Lau,Gonzalo R. Arce*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个超图信号的分数生成模型，在t-HGSP谱域中构建良定的前向OU扩散与稳定采样，在生成、统计匹配与缺失节点恢复上显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超图信号缺乏基于分数的生成建模工具；直接使用张量热半群因回文对称化后拉普拉斯张量谱切片非半正定而不适定，需要修正才能构建有效扩散过程。

Method: 在t-HGSP谱域引入逐模式频率偏移修复不适定性，得到解耦的OU前向扩散（闭式边际、精确分数、各向同性平稳分布）；训练轻量切片条件去噪器；采样在数据活跃模式用学习分数、其余用闭式分数；以闭式余弦观测算子将缺失节点恢复转为线性高斯引导的后验采样。

Result: 500节点超图上，协方差误差比clique-expansion基线优2×至27×；图谱统计匹配优于图基模型；旋转数据达到有限样本估计下限；后验采样NMSE 0.28–0.64（经典基线0.87–1.1），较自身去噪基线最优3.6×。

Conclusion: 频率偏移使t-HGSP谱域分数扩散良定且可稳定扩展，统一支持生成与线性逆问题求解，验证了超图谱生成建模的有效性。

Abstract: We introduce the first score-based generative model for signals on a fixed hypergraph, formulated in the spectral domain of t-product hypergraph signal processing (t-HGSP). The naive tensor heat semigroup is ill-posed, since after palindromic symmetrization the spectral slices of the Laplacian tensor are no longer positive semidefinite. A per-mode frequency shift repairs it, yielding a forward Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion that decouples per (eigenmode, slice) pair with closed-form marginals, exact score targets, and an exactly isotropic stationary law. A lightweight slice-conditioned denoiser is trained on the resulting real spectral grid. Sampling combines its score on data-active modes with the closed-form score elsewhere, which proves essential for stability at scale. A closed cosine-form observation operator turns missing-node recovery into linear-Gaussian guidance with stabilized posterior sampling. On hypergraphs of up to 500 nodes, our model beats a clique-expansion baseline by margins growing from $2\times$ to $27\times$ in covariance error, matches the graph-spectral statistics of the data better than the graph-basis model itself, and reaches the finite-sample estimation floor on data rotated off the t-spectral axes. Posterior sampling reduces missing-node NMSE to 0.28-0.64 (classical baselines 0.87-1.1) at conservative coverage, and cuts the framework's own denoising baseline by up to $3.6\times$.

</details>


### [603] [When Is Product Decoding of ECOC MAP-Consistent? Pair Structure and the n-vs-Rest Codes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33044)
*Gendo Kumoi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究ECOC两种解码器（sum与product）在无噪声条件下是否与MAP最优类一致，证明了sum解码器需等距码（已知结果），而product解码器的MAP一致性当且仅当码是n-vs-Rest码的并，从而排除Hadamard等距码；所有定理用Lean 4机器验证，并在六个真实数据集上做了实验对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ECOC通过sum解码器（累加概率）或product解码器（累加对数似然）组合二分类器。无噪声下二分类器输出真实后验时，哪些码矩阵能保证解码器恒与Bayes最优(MAP)类一致，sum解码器的答案已知（需等距码），但product解码器的对应问题尚不清楚，本文填补这一空白。

Method: 将两类比较转化为它们不同列上的投票：sum解码器用样本均值判定，product解码器用影响函数为artanh的M估计判定，每个投票等于MAP margin加上仅由其他类决定的偏置。据此给出product解码器MAP一致性的充要条件，并用Lean 4对全部定理进行机器验证。

Result: 主定理：product解码器MAP一致，当且仅当对每个类对，两类不同的列与交换两类（或其补）所得的列相匹配；等价地，当且仅当码是n-vs-Rest码的并。因此等距码被排除：Hadamard码(M≥8，M-1列达到Plotkin界)不存在这样的类对，Sylvester型的反转margin至少为与M无关的常数0.0182。

Conclusion: product解码器的MAP一致性严格等价于码为n-vs-Rest码之并，与sum解码器要求的等距码互不相容。真实数据实验中，各列校准良好时product解码器略优，而各列校准误差不同时sum解码器更优，两者仅在接近平局时产生分歧。

Abstract: Error-Correcting Output Codes (ECOC) combine binary classifiers by the sum decoder, which totals probabilities, or the product decoder, which totals log-likelihoods. In the noiseless setting, where the binary classifiers output the true posteriors, we ask on which code matrices each decoder always agrees with the Bayes-optimal (MAP) class. For the sum decoder the answer is known: the code must be equidistant (James and Hastie, 1998). We answer the question for the product decoder. Two classes are compared through the votes of the columns on which they differ: the sum decoder decides by their sample mean, the product decoder by an M-estimator with influence function artanh, and each vote is the MAP margin plus a bias determined by the other classes alone. Our main theorem states that the product decoder is MAP-consistent if and only if, for every class pair, the columns on which the two classes differ are matched with the columns obtained by swapping the two classes (or their complements), and equivalently if and only if the code is a union of n-vs-Rest codes. Efficient equidistant codes are therefore excluded: Hadamard codes ($M\ge 8$), which meet the Plotkin bound with $M-1$ columns, have no such pairs, and for the Sylvester type the reversal margin can be at least a constant 0.0182 independent of $M$. All theorems are machine-checked in Lean 4. On six real datasets with estimated probabilities, the product decoder is slightly more accurate when each column is calibrated, and the sum decoder is better when the calibration error differs across columns; in either case the decoders disagree only near ties.

</details>


### [604] [Local Indices Are Not Enough: Synchrony and Global Information in Bandit Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33056)
*Aakash Gore,Shivaram Kalyanakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究局部索引算法的理论极限：异步（仅在拉动某臂时重算其索引、仅用该臂历史与局部随机预算）无法达到 O(log T) 遗憾；其可达遗憾处于次多项式、超多对数区间，并给出了达到该区间的异步策略；而同步局部算法（如 Thompson Sampling，每步采样所有臂）只需每臂局部随机预算即可保持 O(log T)，说明"同步性"是 TS 最优性的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最优算法 KL-UCB 依赖全局时间步构造索引，Thompson Sampling 每步对所有臂进行采样。"全局信息"与"同步索引更新"是否为达到 O(log T) 最优遗憾的必要条件，此前未被系统考察。

Method: 形式化定义异步局部索引算法（仅用单臂历史+局部随机预算、被拉动时才更新索引）；证明不存在此类算法能在所有 bandit 实例上达到 O(log T)；通过分析异步更新导出的函数方程刻画可达遗憾所在的区间；据此设计一个异步局部索引策略并给出其上界；再分析同步局部算法在每臂局部随机预算下的遗憾。

Result: 负面结果：异步局部索引算法无法对所有实例达到 O(log T) 遗憾。正面结果：其可达遗憾落在次多项式、超多对数（sub-polynomial, super-polylog）区间，且所提异步策略达到该量级；同步局部算法只要每臂具备局部随机预算即可保持 O(log T) 遗憾。

Conclusion: 同步索引更新（即便仅配合局部随机性）对最优 O(log T) 遗憾是不可或缺的，这解释了 Thompson Sampling 最优性的根源；而完全异步、仅依赖单臂信息的局部索引在一般情况下必然付出比对数更高的遗憾代价。

Abstract: Standard index-based stochastic bandit algorithms such as KL-UCB and Thompson Sampling achieve optimal $O(\log T)$ regret over a horizon $T$. The former uses the global timestep to construct each arm's index, while the latter samples each arm's belief distribution at every timestep. The necessity of global information and synchronous index updates for achieving optimal regret has not been examined yet. In this paper, we investigate the fundamental limits of asynchronous local index algorithms---those that recalculate an arm's index only upon pulling it, using solely that arm's own reward history and a local randomness budget. We prove that no such algorithm can achieve $O(\log T)$ regret across all bandit instances. We then analyse the functional equations arising from asynchronous updates, and show that the achievable regret lies in a sub-polynomial, super-polylogarithmic regime. We propose an asynchronous local index policy whose regret upper bound also lies in this regime. Turning to synchronous local algorithms, which sample every arm's index at all timesteps as in Thompson Sampling, we show that a locally determined randomness budget per arm suffices to retain $O(\log T)$ regret, demonstrating that synchrony, albeit with some randomness, is essential to the optimality of Thompson Sampling.

</details>


### [605] [Understanding Clipping In Zeroth-Order Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33062)
*Saket Gollapudi,Elisa Bertino,Sewoong Oh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了零阶优化中逐样本裁剪(per-sample clipping)意外提升模型性能的现象，揭示学习率与裁剪阈值成反比关系，裁剪引导优化到更高测试精度的解，机制是隐式降权难拟合样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作偶然发现，在DP-Zero（差分隐私零阶优化）中设置极大隐私参数ε（即极少隐私）时，逐样本裁剪反而提升了训练模型性能。作者希望系统性地解释这一反直觉现象及其背后机制。

Method: 基于两点梯度估计的零阶优化微调LLM，加入逐样本裁剪；实验分析学习率η与裁剪阈值c的关系；对比其他提供稳健梯度估计的零阶方法；并人工注入标签噪声进行机制验证。

Result: (i) 最优学习率η与裁剪阈值c成反比，满足ηc=常数；(ii) 裁剪使零阶优化收敛到测试精度更高的不同解；(iii) 该现象仅在逐样本裁剪的零阶优化中出现，其他稳健估计方法无此效果；标签噪声实验表明裁剪带来更稳健预测，源于对难拟合样本的隐式降权。

Conclusion: 逐样本裁剪在零阶优化微调LLM中可稳定提升泛化性能，其本质是对困难样本的隐式降权，效果依赖于ηc=常数的学习率-阈值耦合关系。

Abstract: Zeroth-order optimization has emerged as a resource-efficient alternative to Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) when fine-tuning LLMs, thanks to the inherent low dimensionality of the loss landscape. It relies on a two-point estimate of the gradient that only accesses the function value and not the gradient, bypassing the resource-heavy backpropagation. Recently, it was accidentally discovered that per-sample clipping can improve the performance of the trained model, while running a differentially private version of zeroth-order optimization \cite{zhang2024dpzero} with a very large privacy parameter $ε$ (corresponding to very little privacy). In this paper, we systematically investigate this phenomenon and demonstrate that ($i$) the optimal choice of learning rate $η$ is inversely proportional to the clipping threshold $c$, satisfying $ηc =$ constant; ($ii$) clipping drives the zeroth-order optimization to a different solution with higher test accuracy; and ($iii$) this phenomenon is only observed with per-sample clipped zeroth-order optimization and not other zeroth-order alternatives that also provide robust estimates of the gradient. Further analyses with artificially injected label noise reveals that clipping leads to more robust predictions, which stems from the implicit down weighting of hard-to-fit training examples. Our code is available at https://github.com/SewoongLab/ClipZero

</details>


### [606] [U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33064)
*Shijin Gong,Kai Ye,Victor Chernozhukov,Xinyu Zhang,Chengchun Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文把GRPO中group size的选择问题重构为方差比估计的统计问题，并提出一种"悲观比率估计器"（jackknife-based pessimistic rule）来克服小分母时朴素估计不稳定的问题，实现自适应group size选择，降低策略梯度MSE并改善优化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO及其变体中，group size是关键超参数，但目前仍主要靠试错（trial and error）选择，缺乏理论指导与自适应方法。

Method: 利用GRPO策略梯度的U-统计量结构，将group size选择重新表述为方差比估计问题；针对分母较小时朴素plug-in估计器不稳定的问题，提出考虑分母估计不确定性的悲观比率估计器，并在三种样本量情形下刻画其统计性质；实证中采用基于jackknife的悲观规则进行自适应group size选择。

Result: 在Reasoning Gym合成任务以及数学推理和代码生成的真实基准上，自适应group size选择降低了策略梯度的均方误差，相比固定group size基线改善了策略优化效果，且额外计算开销有限。

Conclusion: 将group size选择形式化为方差比估计是一个有效且有理论支撑的视角，悲观比率估计器可在小额外开销下带来稳定的自适应group size，提升GRPO-type算法的训练效果。

Abstract: Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. Empirically, using %a jackknife-based pessimistic rule on synthetic tasks from Reasoning Gym and real-world benchmarks covering both mathematical reasoning and code generation, we show that our adaptive group size selection reduces the mean squared error of the resulting policy gradient and improves policy optimisation over fixed-group-size baselines, with modest additional computational cost.

</details>


### [607] [Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33080)
*Yufeng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Shifter Quantization (SQ) 及 INT4 变体 SHI，用"拼接+移位共享位"重构原生位宽整数操作数，兼顾分组量化的精度与标准整数 MMA 的 GPU 推理效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分组量化（groupwise quantization）能在低位宽下提升 LLM 精度，但权重分组使标准整数 MMA 无法覆盖完整点积，阻碍高效 GPU 推理，精度与速度难以兼得。

Method: SQ 通过追加并移位共享比特，将分组量化结果重构为原生位宽整数操作数，使标准整数 MMA 可完整执行点积；并派生 SHI 变体以直接利用 INT4 kernel。分别对应 2/4/8 位形成 SQ2、SQ4、SQ8。

Result: 以投影误差和 KL 散度衡量质量。SQ2/SHI2 的 4096-token prefill 吞吐达 llama.cpp Q2_K 的 2.71–3.77 倍，WikiText-2 KL 降低 6.6–7.8%；SQ4 吞吐为 NInfer 分组整数基线的 1.43–2.47 倍，KL 低 24–40%；SQ8 相比 vLLM 在线 FP8，batch-one prefill 吞吐高 27.4%，KL 低 72.7%。

Conclusion: SQ/SHI 在低、中、高精度三档上同时优于标准分组量化及现有主流实现（llama.cpp、NInfer、vLLM）的质量与速度，验证了用位操作兼容整数 MMA 的量化路线可行。

Abstract: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.

</details>


### [608] [GREMLIN: Generating Random Environments for Meta-Learning with Interacting Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33101)
*Octave Gaspard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在 DiscoRL 规则发现框架中，用16个随机参数化的神经环境替代人工设计的训练游戏，验证随机神经环境能否为强化学习规则的学习提供有用经验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究随机参数化的神经网络环境是否能提供有用经验来学习强化学习算法，从而减少对人工设计训练游戏的依赖。

Method: 采用 DiscoRL 的规则发现框架，将人工设计训练游戏替换为16个选定的神经环境；每个游戏由有界向量动力学、基于随机策略的奖励和一个独立的结果奖励组成。经过 2.248 亿步智能体-环境交互后冻结教师模型，并训练全新的智能体进行评测。

Result: 在大多数游戏（无论生成还是人工设计）上，DQN 的得分高于 GREMLIN；但 GREMLIN 在全部26个游戏上均优于未训练的教师，说明生成的经验能够改进学习规则。

Conclusion: 随机神经环境产生的经验可以改进学习规则，但能否通过更长的元训练得到有竞争力的规则仍不确定。

Abstract: Can randomly parameterized neural environments supply useful experience for learning a reinforcement learning algorithm? We investigate this question using DiscoRL's rule-discovery framework, replacing human-designed training games with sixteen selected neural environments. Each game combines bounded vector dynamics with a random strategy-based reward and an independent outcome reward. After 224.8 million agent-environment steps, we froze the teacher and trained fresh agents. DQN outscored GREMLIN on most games, both generated and human-designed. GREMLIN nevertheless outperformed the untrained teacher on all 26 games, showing that generated experience can improve a learning rule. It remains unclear whether this approach can yield a competitive rule with longer meta-training.

</details>


### [609] [Reinforcement Learning Can Be Recovered From Its Own Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33102)
*Jiayi Sheng,Jingwen Gu,Guanning Zeng,Zhaoyi Zhou,Stefano Viel,Qianqian Wang,Fahim Tajwar,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究RL后训练中"知识"多少留存于rollout本身：结果表明，对归档rollout按生成顺序做最大似然训练即可复现在线RL的性能，在线RL的大部分算力实际用于发现更好的采样分布而非学习该分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规RL后训练在每次更新后丢弃rollouts，所学知识只被隐含地存储在模型权重中。作者希望探究这些rollout数据本身保留了多少知识，即是否可以用归档数据替代在线采样。
