Method: 直接对归档rollout重放原始RL算法会导致灾难性崩溃；作者给出简单解释并提出补救方案——对归档rollout做最大似然（MLE）训练。具体做法：从同一基座模型出发，按rollout生成的时间顺序回放，且不区分正确与错误回答；进一步测试仅用最后若干RL步的rollout做MLE的效果。

Result: 按生成顺序逐步回放并做MLE即可恢复在线RL的性能；每个rollout批次仅一次MLE更新就能紧密跟踪在线RL的完整学习曲线；仅用最后几步RL的rollout做MLE往往就能恢复最终模型性能。

Conclusion: RL后训练中投入的大量算力主要花在"发现一个更好的采样分布"上，而非"从样本中学习它"；learnability（可学习性）与discovery（发现难度）可分离，rollout数据本身携带了绝大部分在线RL获得的能力。

Abstract: Broadly speaking, reinforcement learning (RL) post-training converts compute into model capabilities by training on model-generated data. Typically, the rollouts are discarded after each update, and the knowledge acquired during RL resides in the model weights. In this work, we investigate how much of this knowledge is retained in the rollouts themselves. A natural first attempt is to replay the original RL algorithm on archived rather than freshly generated rollouts, but this leads to catastrophic collapse. We provide a simple explanation for this phenomenon, which in turn suggests a remedy: maximum likelihood on the archived rollouts. Surprisingly, starting from the same base model and replaying the rollouts in the order in which they were generated, without any distinction between correct and incorrect responses, is sufficient to recover the performance of online RL. In fact, a single maximum likelihood update per rollout batch closely tracks the entire learning curve of online RL. Furthermore, maximum likelihood on the rollouts of the last few RL steps often suffices to recover the final model's performance. This suggests that much of the compute invested in RL goes into discovering an improved sampling distribution rather than learning it from samples.

</details>


### [610] [Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33111)
*Yuxing Liu,Wei Zuo,Walid Krichene,Tong Zhang,Li Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过事后温度缩放校准草稿模型分布，可缓解Mismatch，将投机解码的接受长度提升约10%，几乎零额外开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码的加速依赖于草稿token在目标模型验证中的接受概率，而接受率直接取决于目标分布p与草稿分布q之间的\(\|p-q\|_1\)差距。作者观察到开源草稿模型虽常能正确预测top候选token，但相对于目标模型普遍欠自信，存在一致性的分布不匹配，限制了加速效果。

Method: 提出对投机解码进行草稿校准（draft calibration），采用事后（post-hoc）方法缩小分布差距。具体尝试了标准温度缩放（temperature scaling）和逐token校准（token-wise calibration）等多种方法，在目标任务上评估各自对接受率和吞吐量的影响。

Result: 标准温度缩放应用于草稿分布后，在不同任务上接受长度最多提升约10%，且几乎无额外成本；吞吐量分析进一步证实了服务效率的提升。更一般的校准方法分析显示出进一步的改进空间。

Conclusion: 简单的事后温度缩放是一种低成本、有效的草稿校准手段，能显著提升投机解码的接受长度与吞吐效率；更通用的校准方法仍有进一步优化的潜力。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by employing a lightweight draft model to propose draft tokens and allowing the target model to verify the new tokens in parallel to improve inference-time compute utilization. The speedup relies on the acceptance probability of draft tokens in target verification, which is directly related to the gap $\|p-q\|_1$ between the target distribution $p$ and the draft distribution $q$. In this paper, we study draft calibration of speculative decoding to improve the speedup of speculative decoding, where we employ post-hoc methods to calibrate the draft distribution to mitigate the distribution gap. We observe that though current community open-source draft models may learn the top candidate token correctly, they are generally underconfident compared to the target model, suggesting a consistent distribution mismatch. To mitigate the effect of this mismatch on the acceptance rate of the draft models, we try various post-hoc calibration methods, including standard temperature scaling and token-wise calibration. Our results suggest that a standard temperature scaling applied to the draft distribution improves the acceptance length by up to approximately 10\% with almost no additional cost across different tasks. Throughput analysis further verifies that this improvement in serving efficiency. Analysis of more general calibration methods reveals further potential room for improvement.

</details>


### [611] [UniCon: Unified Framework for Efficient Contrastive Alignment via Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.16678)
*Hangke Sui,Yuqing Wang,Minh N Do*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UniCon提出了一个统一的高效对比对齐框架，通过对比相似度权重矩阵S(γ)实现闭式全局解，用精确更新替代小批量反向传播，并在RKHS视角下统一了线性/非线性编码器与一对一/多对多对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对比目标驱动着当前最先进的多模态模型，但其训练缓慢，依赖长时间的随机优化，效率成为瓶颈。

Method: 提出UniCon统一框架：引入对比相似度权重矩阵S(γ)，得到可证明精确替代小批量反向传播的闭式全局解；框架覆盖线性与非线性编码器、一对一与多对多对齐；借助再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）给出核化视角，统一对比对齐并揭示其与谱方法的联系。

Result: 在合成、单模态、多模态及零样本任务上的实验表明，UniCon在保持通用性和较强实证性能的同时，取得了显著的效率提升。

Conclusion: UniCon通过闭式解与核化视角，将对比对齐从慢速随机优化转为精确高效求解，统一了多种设置并验证了理论与实用性。

Abstract: Contrastive objectives power state-of-the-art multimodal models, but their training remains slow, relying on long stochastic optimization. We propose a Unified Framework for Efficient Contrastive Alignment via Kernels (UniCon), which spans linear and nonlinear encoders as well as one-to-one and many-to-many alignments. At its core, UniCon introduces the contrastive similarity weight matrix $S(γ)$, which enables closed-form global solutions that provably replace minibatch back-propagation with exact updates. Through the lens of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHS), UniCon provides a kernelized perspective that unifies contrastive alignment and reveals its connection to spectral methods. To validate the theory, we conduct experiments on synthetic, unimodal, multimodal, and zero-shot tasks, demonstrating that UniCon achieves substantial efficiency gains while preserving generality and strong empirical performance.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [612] [Optimal Signaling Mechanisms for One-round Matching Markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31517)
*Varsha Dani,David G. Harris,Thomas P. Hayes,Seth Pettie*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文为一对一（n申请者/n企业）单轮匹配市场设计最优信号机制，允许申请者向k家企业发信号，并在更丰富的信号空间与随机化机制下求解最优效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信号机制已在就业与婚恋市场改善匹配结果，理论上也有成效，但既有工作所用信号空间较窄、且随机化机制未被系统研究，故希望刻画更一般情形下的最优信号机制及其效率上限。

Method: 针对n个申请者与n家企业的单轮匹配市场，对每个k≥1分别求解最优确定性信号机制与随机化信号机制（申请者各向k家企业发信号），考察更丰富的信号空间；并对k→∞取极限得到最优保证比例，同时讨论企业遵循机制的激励相容性。

Result: k→∞时，最优确定性机制保证期望约75.4504%的申请者获得offer且该比例最优；最优随机化机制保证约78.197%且同样最优。最优k信号随机机制为非构造性、描述复杂，作者另给出若干简单随机机制，其效率超过极限最优确定性机制。

Conclusion: 随机化信号机制在理论上明显优于确定性机制（约78.2% vs 75.45%），简单随机机制即可超越最优确定性极限，并讨论了企业侧激励相容问题。

Abstract: Signaling mechanisms are used in various types of matching markets so that applicants may credibly signal interest in firms. They have been observed to improve outcomes in job markets and dating markets, and proven to improve outcomes in several stylized theoretical models.
  In this paper we develop optimal signaling mechanisms for a simple one-round matching market consisting of $n$ applicants and $n$ firms. We consider a much richer space of signals than have been used previously, in theory or practice, and also consider randomized signaling mechanisms, which have not been systematically studied.
  For each $k \geq 1$, we determine the optimal deterministic and randomized signaling mechanisms in which applicants signal $k$ firms. In the limit as $k\to \infty$, our deterministic mechanism guarantees that in expectation, $\approx 75.4504\%$ of the applicants receive job offers, and this is optimal. Likewise, for $k \to \infty$, our randomized mechanism guarantees that $\approx 78.197\%$ of the applicants receive offers, which is also optimal.
  The optimal $k$-signal randomized mechanism is non-constructive, and has a rather complex description. We describe some simple randomized signaling mechanisms whose efficiency surpasses that of the limiting optimal deterministic mechanism. Finally, we also discuss incentive-compatibility for the firms to follow the mechanism.

</details>


### [613] [Collateral Architecture and Correlated Slashing in Liquid Restaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31700)
*Zhejun Zhang,Justin Cho,Francisco Marmolejo-Cossío*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文构建统一模型刻画流动再质押中资本在多种可罚没承诺间的配置与复用风险,揭示组合方差由总敞口、敞口集中度与失效相关性共同决定,并分析风险敏感配置者的均衡行为与激励设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流动再质押允许同一份质押资本支撑多个可罚没承诺,如何在高额奖励与相关性罚没风险之间做配置权衡,缺乏统一分析框架。

Method: 建立从"专属质押(资本分割)"到"共享抵押(同一资本支撑多承诺)"的统一风险模型;推导组合方差结构;研究单配置者最优解及对称基准下的风险敏感度效应;在多配置者博弈中证明正背景质押下存在唯一纯纳什均衡并给出全局收敛的投影算法;用可复现合成压力测试验证机制。

Result: 分散固定资本可将风险降至与相关性相关的下限,而复用同一抵押可使风险随广度二次增长。最强共因子情境下,放宽复用上限使均衡奖励提升2.47倍,但99%条件风险价值上升3.77倍;竞争导致相对规划者的过度敞口;忽略协方差使真实方差高估低6.3%。

Conclusion: 该框架统一解释了抵押复用、相关操作风险与激励设计,为去中心化安全市场的资本配置与监管上限设定提供理论与量化依据。

Abstract: Liquid restaking protocols allow pooled stake to support multiple slashable commitments, creating an allocation problem in which additional rewards must be balanced against correlated slash claims. This risk depends not only on dependence between slash events, but also on how collateral is allocated or reused across commitments. We develop a unified model ranging from unique stake, where capital is divided among positions, to shared collateral, where the same capital supports multiple commitments. We show that portfolio variance is governed jointly by gross exposure, exposure concentration, and failure dependence. Spreading fixed capital reduces risk toward a correlation-dependent floor, whereas repeatedly pledging the same collateral can make risk grow quadratically with breadth.
  We then study risk-sensitive allocators competing for fixed reward pools distributed proportionally to committed exposure. A single allocator has a unique optimum, and in a symmetric benchmark greater risk sensitivity encourages diversification under unique stake but discourages additional commitments under shared collateral. With multiple allocators, positive background stake guarantees a unique pure Nash equilibrium and supports a globally convergent projected method.
  Reproducible synthetic stress tests support these mechanisms. In the strongest common-factor environment, relaxing the reuse cap raises equilibrium reward by 2.47 times but aggregate 99% conditional value at risk by 3.77 times. Competition creates overexposure relative to a planner, while ignoring covariance raises true variance by 6.3%. The results provide a unified framework for collateral reuse, correlated operational risk, and incentive design in decentralized security markets.

</details>


### [614] [Query-Sample Tradeoffs for Revenue Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31982)
*Yaonan Jin,Wei Tang,Yifan Wang,Mengxiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究单买家收益最大化中"价值样本"与"定价查询"两类信息源之间的完整权衡曲线，为MHR、regular、quasi-MHR分布给出紧界，为quasi-regular给出近似紧界，并刻画了各分布族仅样本与单样本查询复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际学习中，揭示完整价值的样本昂贵，而仅揭示是否接受价格的查询更廉价。现有文献分别研究样本复杂度与查询复杂度，但缺乏对两者可互换性的系统刻画：减少样本预算究竟需要增加多少查询？

Method: 将样本与查询视为可自适应交错的信息源，目标是学习达到(1-ε)最优收益的价格。通过构造上界算法（先收集全部样本再查询）与下界论证（即使任意自适应交错也成立），建立样本-查询权衡的紧界，并刻画仅样本和单样本查询复杂度。

Result: quasi-MHR存在平滑中间权衡，额外样本可将查询需求降低多项式因子；MHR与regular则呈"断崖"：即便保留仅样本需求的一个足够小常数比例，查询代价仍与仅用一个样本时 asymptotically 相同。上界由先采样后查询的算法实现，下界对任意自适应交错成立；同时消除文献中关于1/ε的额外对数依赖。

Conclusion: 两类信息源的价值因分布族而差异显著：quasi-MHR可有效互补，MHR与regular几乎不可替代。结果为样本与查询预算的分配提供了紧的指导，并厘清了各分布族的复杂度图景。

Abstract: We introduce and study the full query-sample tradeoff for revenue maximization with a single buyer whose value follows an unknown distribution. A learner may adaptively combine value samples, which reveal full buyer values, with pricing queries, which reveal only whether a fresh buyer accepts a selected price. The goal is to learn a price that achieves a $(1-\varepsilon)$-multiplicative approximation to optimal revenue with high probability. We ask when, and by how much, reducing the sample budget increases the number of pricing queries required.
  We establish tight tradeoff bounds for monotone-hazard-rate (MHR), regular, and quasi-monotone-hazard-rate (quasi-MHR) distributions, and almost tight bounds for quasi-regular distributions. Our results reveal sharply different benefits from combining the two information sources. Quasi-MHR distributions admit a smooth intermediate tradeoff: additional samples can reduce the query requirement by polynomial factors. For MHR and regular distributions, however, a sufficiently small constant fraction of the sample-only requirement still leaves the learner facing the full asymptotic query cost attainable with one sample. Our upper bounds are achieved by algorithms that collect all value samples before making queries, while our lower bounds hold even under arbitrary adaptive interleaving of the two forms of access. Along the way, we also fully characterize the sample-only and single-sample query complexities for all four families, eliminating the extra logarithmic dependence on $1/\varepsilon$ in the literature.

</details>


### [615] [Approximate MMS allocations for large number of agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33051)
*Uriel Feige,Vadim Grinberg*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文证明：对任意 ρ<1，存在 n_ρ，使得任何代理数 n≥n_ρ 的不可分物品分配实例都存在 ρ-MMS 分配，从而解决了作者此前提出的猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前仅证明当物品数不超过 (2-ε)n（且 n≥n_{ρ,ε}）时 ρ-MMS 分配存在，作者曾显式提出对所有充分大的 n 均成立的猜想，本文旨在证明这一猜想。

Method: 沿用前作技术，构造序数 MMS 分配使 n - O(log² n) 个代理获得完整 MMS；新引入两代理 MMS 划分之间的“块匹配”（block-matchings）概念，并证明当物品类型数较少时必然存在小宽度的块匹配。

Result: 对每个 ρ<1，存在 n_ρ，使所有 n≥n_ρ 的实例均存在 ρ-MMS 分配，且不依赖物品数量相对于代理数的比例限制。

Conclusion: 在大规模代理情形下 MMS 的近似保证具有渐近最优性，猜想得证；块匹配成为分析 MMS 分配的新工具。

Abstract: We consider allocation of indivisible items to agents with non-negative additive valuations, under the maximin share (MMS) fairness benchmark. We prove that for every $ρ< 1$, there exists some $n_ρ$ such that every allocation instance with $n \ge n_ρ$ agents has a $ρ$-MMS allocation. This was explicitly stated as a conjecture in a recent paper of the authors, where it was shown to hold if the number of items is at most $(2 - ε)n$ (and $n \ge n_{ρ, ε}$). We build on some techniques from that earlier paper, including the construction of $\textit{ordinal MMS}$ allocations that give $n - O(\log^2 n)$ agents their full MMS. Among the new techniques that we introduce is the definition of $\textit{block-matchings}$ between the MMS partitions of two agents, and a proof that if the number of item types is small, then block-matchings of small width necessarily exist.

</details>


### [616] [$(1-\varepsilon)$-MMS Allocations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33052)
*Zehan Lin,Shengxin Liu,Biaoshuai Tao,Xiaowei Wu,Yuhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究可加估值下不可分物品的MMS分配，证明随着代理人数n增大，MMS近似因子最优值收敛到1；对任意固定ε，给出了多项式时间的(1-ε)-MMS（物品）和(1+ε)-MMS（杂务）分配算法，且只需多项式次束比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 最大化最小份额(MMS)分配在n固定时存在常数级近似鸿沟，既有结果多为常数因子近似。作者希望探究当代理人数n趋于无穷时，近似因子能否任意接近1，从而刻画MMS的可实现极限。

Method: 针对物品与杂务两类可加估值，构造多项式时间算法：对任意固定ε∈(0,1)，当n足够大时分别输出(1-ε)-MMS（物品）与(1+ε)-MMS（杂务）分配；算法以束比较为基本操作，且比较次数为多项式。

Result: 证明最优MMS近似因子随n增大收敛到1；给出多项式时间算法达到任意接近1的近似，且物品与杂务均适用，束比较次数为多项式。

Conclusion: 代理人数足够多时，MMS公平性可以任意精度高效近似，物品与杂务均成立，说明MMS的近似差距本质上来源于agent数量有限，而非计算复杂性。

Abstract: We study maximin share (MMS) allocations of $m$ indivisible items among $n$ agents with additive valuations. We prove that for both goods and chores, the optimal MMS approximation factor converges to $1$ as $n$ grows. In particular, for every fixed $\varepsilon\in(0,1)$, sufficiently large $n$, and any $m$, we give polynomial-time algorithms that compute a $(1-\varepsilon)$-MMS allocation for goods and a $(1+\varepsilon)$-MMS allocation for chores. Furthermore, both algorithms can be implemented using a polynomial number of bundle comparisons.

</details>


### [617] [Breaking the Square-Root Barrier for Linear Swap Regret in Polyhedral Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33081)
*Vasilis Pollatos,Alberto Marchesi*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究自博弈中对所有仿射自映射的线性交换遗憾，给出确定性非耦合动力学达到 O~(poly(D)T^{1/3}) 的界，并推广到扩展式博弈的 O(n²M⁴log T) 对数遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对仿射自映射类的高效对抗界为 √T 量级，且此前对数级触发遗憾界（AFS23）覆盖的偏离类有限；本文希望在紧多面体与扩展式博弈上得到更强（次线性、独立于顶点数）的线性交换遗憾界。

Method: 在紧致多面体上将问题提升为紧凑矩阵形式，采用乐观对数障碍学习（optimistic log-barrier），并结合 Gordon 不动点的稳定性分析；扩展式博弈部分利用 treeplex 几何与完美回忆结构。

Result: 确定性非耦合动力学在由线性不等式给出的紧多面体上取得 O~(poly(D)T^{1/3}) 累积遗憾，独立于顶点数；在每玩家至多 M 个终止序列的完美回忆 n 人扩展式博弈中取得 O(n²M⁴log T) 的对所有线性偏离的遗憾，严格包含触发偏离（FP23），且恰等于无时序通信（UTC）可实现的偏离类。

Conclusion: 该工作把线性交换遗憾从 √T 提升到次线性 T^{1/3}，并在扩展式博弈中将对数遗憾从触发偏离推广到更广的线性/UTC 偏离类，统一了机制设计视角下的偏离刻画。

Abstract: We study linear swap regret in self-play against all affine self-maps of each player's strategy polytope. Efficient adversarial bounds for this class scale as $\sqrt{T}$. On compact polytopes given by linear inequalities, our deterministic uncoupled dynamics achieve $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\mathrm{poly}(D)T^{1/3})$ cumulative regret, where $D$ is the binary length of the game description. The bound is independent of the number of vertices. In perfect-recall $n$-player extensive-form games with at most $M$ terminal sequences per player, we obtain $\mathcal{O}(n^2M^4\log T)$ regret against all linear deviations, extending the logarithmic trigger-regret bound of Anagnostides, Farina, and Sandholm [AFS23]. This class can strictly contain the trigger deviations [FP23] and consists exactly of the deviations implementable by untimed communication (UTC), in which a player interleaves moves with mediator queries along a separate feasible path [ZFS24]. The proof combines optimistic log-barrier learning on a compact matrix lift with stability of the Gordon fixed point, using treeplex geometry in extensive form.

</details>


### [618] [Improved Downward-Closed Delegation Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33095)
*Hamed Abdi,Kiarash Banihashem,MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi,Danny Mittal*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文研究向下闭包可行性约束下的委托选择问题，给出了一个仅依赖可行族与委托人价值分布的确定性、对代理人不敏感的菜单，在代理人任意最优反应（含对委托人不利的平局规则）下保证超过 29/70≈0.41429 的离线最优期望，远超此前 0.1098 的最好保证；同时给出拟阵情形紧的 1/2 保证、向下闭包情形的上界（500/1011、30/61、0.48105），并通过反证法与精确有理数证书证明该保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前向下闭包约束下的委托选择最优保证仅 0.1098，且一般价值相关、项独立的情形缺乏有效的确定性菜单设计方法；论文希望大幅提升该保证并厘清拟阵与一般向下闭包约束之间的本质差距。

Method: 构造一个确定性的、agent-oblivious 的菜单：只依赖可行族与委托人价值分布，仅用提案所含项及其委托人价值来验证；保证通过反证法证明——若固定族内每个菜单收益都不超过 29/70，则归一化实例的截断最优解的生存函数、stop-loss 变换与超调均值满足有限仿射不等式系统，用精确有理数证书证明该系统不可行；另给出基于报告总值的单阈值解析证明得 3/10。

Result: 向下闭包约束下保证 >29/70≈0.41429（平局对委托人不利时仍成立）；拟阵约束保证 1/2 且在秩一即紧；向下闭包存在五项背包实例将所有确定性菜单上界压至 500/1011，随机接受规则（即便知晓代理人效用）也不超过 30/61，计算机辅助实例族进一步将上界降至 0.48105；单阈值规则保证 3/10。

Conclusion: 向下闭包委托选择中确定性菜单可达到约 0.414 的近似保证，显著优于以往结果，且该保证与拟阵的 1/2 之间存在实质差距；上下界之间仍有空隙（约 0.414 与 0.481），精确证书化的反证框架为后续收紧界提供了工具。

Abstract: We study delegated choice under a downward-closed feasibility constraint, where the principal and agent values of each item may be arbitrarily correlated but items are independent. We give a deterministic, agent-oblivious menu that guarantees the principal more than $29/70\approx0.41429$ of the expected offline optimum under every best response, including ties resolved against the principal. The menu depends only on the feasible family and the principal's value distributions, and verifies a proposal using only its items and their principal values. The previous best guarantee for downward-closed constraints was $0.1098$.
  Matroid constraints admit a guarantee of one half, which is tight already in rank one, but downward-closed constraints do not: a five-item knapsack instance bounds every deterministic menu by $500/1011$ of the optimum, and no rule with randomized acceptance, even one that knows the agent's utilities, can guarantee more than $30/61$. An explicit computer-assisted family of instances lowers the bound to $0.48105$ for all such rules.
  The guarantee is proved by contradiction. If every menu in a fixed family earns at most a $29/70$ fraction of the optimum, then a normalized instance satisfies a finite system of affine inequalities among the survival functions, stop-loss transforms and overshoot means of its clipped optima. An exact rational certificate shows that the system is infeasible. We also give a short analytic proof that a single threshold on the reported total value guarantees $3/10$.

</details>


### [619] [Envy-Free Cake-Cutting for Five Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.33149)
*Aris Filos-Ratsikas,Alexandros Hollender,Mohamad Latifian,Giannis Tyrovolas*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究带连通性约束的无嫉妒蛋糕切分问题，针对五个代理提出首个高效算法，用 O(log^3(1/ε)) 次查询得到连通的 ε-无嫉妒分割，并给出不依赖不动点定理（除介值定理外）的存在性新证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作在单调估值下对至多四个代理可用 poly(log(1/ε)) 次查询得到连通 ε-无嫉妒分割，但五个及以上代理的情形仍开放；作者希望填补五代理这一缺口，并寻求更简单的方法。

Method: 提出一种新的、更简单的构造性方法：将查询复杂度控制在对数多项式级别，针对五个代理设计算法，复杂度为 O(log^3(1/ε)) 次查询；存在性证明仅使用介值定理，不依赖其他不动点定理。

Result: 给出了五代理情形下连通的 ε-无嫉妒分割的高效算法，查询复杂度为 O(log^3(1/ε))；同时提供了五代理存在性的新证明。

Conclusion: 将单调估值下连通 ε-无嫉妒分割的高效可计算性从四代理推广到五代理，简化了方法并弱化了对不动点理论的依赖，为更多代理的情形提供了新思路。

Abstract: We study the envy-free cake-cutting problem, in which a divisible resource must be divided among a set of agents with heterogeneous preferences in a way that ensures that no agent envies the piece obtained by another. Remarkably, under some mild continuity assumptions on the agent valuations, it is known that an envy-free division where each agent receives a \emph{connected} piece of the cake is always guaranteed to exist.
  When the valuations are monotone, prior work has shown that a connected $\varepsilon$-envy-free division can be obtained using $\poly(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries for up to four agents, leaving the case of five or more agents open. In this work, we develop a new simpler approach that yields such an efficient algorithm for five agents. Our algorithm uses $\mathcal{O}(\log^3(1/\varepsilon))$ queries and also yields a novel proof of existence for five agents that does not rely on any fixed-point theorems beyond the intermediate value theorem.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [620] [Agentic Optimization: LLM Agents Select and Configure Algorithms for Engineering Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31275)
*Dominic Mashak,Jacob Schrum*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 论文提出"智能体式优化"：让LLM智能体置于优化循环之外，仅凭自然语言问题描述来配置并启动多目标进化算法（MOEA），在4个工程基准和真实SARS-CoV-2分子对接任务上验证。GPT、DeepSeek、Qwen三个模型在HV与IGD+组合指标上全面超越基线，且各自至少在一个基准上显著优于最佳基线，有时甚至是用被其超越的同一基线算法实现的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程师面对新的多目标设计问题时，往往在见到结果前就选定某个MOEA，而"最佳MOEA"因基准而异，缺乏可参考的性能历史。作者希望利用LLM的参数化知识，从自然语言问题描述直接推断合适的算法配置与选择，从而避免盲目承诺单一算法。

Method: 将LLM智能体置于优化循环之外：智能体读取自然语言形式的问题描述，据此配置并调用算法（算法配置+算法选择）。在固定测试框架下比较5个LLM，评测对象为4个工程基准与1个真实世界的SARS-CoV-2分子对接任务；指标采用超体积HV与IGD+，并使用经多重比较校正的统计检验。

Result: GPT、DeepSeek、Qwen三个模型在HV与IGD+综合表现上优于所有基线，且每个模型至少在1个基准上显著优于最佳基线；部分优势来自与被超越基线相同的算法，说明算法配置与算法选择都重要。智能体行为高度依赖模型，但即使最弱智能体也在4个基线中的3个上整体占优。

Conclusion: LLM智能体可作为多目标优化的"外部决策层"，以自然语言驱动算法选择与配置，并已在工程基准与真实分子对接任务上取得有统计意义的提升；但性能对模型选择敏感，是主要局限与实践注意点。

Abstract: Engineers solving new multi-objective design problems commonly commit to a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) before seeing a result. The best MOEA differs from benchmark to benchmark. We propose agentic optimization, placing an LLM agent outside the optimization loop, where it reads a natural-language problem description to configure and launch algorithms, drawing on parametric knowledge rather than on a performance history that a novel problem lacks. We compare five LLMs in a fixed harness on four engineering benchmarks and a real-world SARS-CoV-2 molecular docking task, using hypervolume (HV) and IGD+ with multiple comparison-corrected tests. Three models (GPT, DeepSeek, Qwen) dominate every baseline on combined HV and IGD+, and each is significantly better than the best baseline on at least one benchmark, sometimes by applying the same baseline algorithm they surpass, showing the importance of both algorithm configuration and selection. Agent behavior is strongly model-dependent, but even the weakest agents dominate three of the four baselines overall.

</details>


### [621] [LLM Genetic Feature Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31277)
*Jonathan Thompson,Razvan Stefanescu,Manoj Varma Namburi,Liuxia Wang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出一种在单个特征层面进行选择、交叉和变异的遗传算法，结合LLM自动特征工程，提升预测性能与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统特征工程依赖人工，耗时且依赖领域知识；已有LLM+元启发式方法虽有进展，但多在整体特征集层面操作，无法对新生成特征进行过程中统计分析。

Method: 设计新的遗传算法，将选择、交叉、变异作用于单个特征而非整个特征集，从而支持对新生成特征的在线统计分析，并将个体与群体级特征指标同时纳入选择过程；使用先进的特征重要性度量进行验证。

Result: 获得更优的预测性能，并在特征相关性、算法稳健性和模型整体可解释性方面取得显著提升。

Conclusion: 在特征粒度上运行的遗传算法可更有效地整合LLM自动特征工程与统计评估，兼顾性能与可解释性。

Abstract: Feature Engineering is the (traditionally manual) process of constructing derived variables from an existing dataset by combining, transforming, or otherwise manipulating the original data fields to reduce statistical noise and extract meaningful, domain-specific quantities of interest from the raw dataset. Recent work demonstrates promising progress toward the au tomation of this process through the integration of large language models (LLMs) and various metaheuristics to guide the search for useful features. We build on this approach by introducing a novel genetic algorithm that implements selection, crossover, and mutation at the individual feature level, rather than at the level of the entire engineered feature set. In doing so, we enable in-process statistical analysis of newly-generated features, thereby enabling the genetic algorithm to simultaneously integrate individual and group-level feature metrics into its selec tion process. We demonstrate this capability using state-of-the-art feature importance metrics, and show that this approach yields superior predictive performance while driving meaningful improvements in feature relevance, algorithm robustness, and overall model interpretability.

</details>


### [622] [Differential evolution with perturbation for continuous function optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31305)
*Takuya Muto,Michiharu Maeda*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种带扰动机制的差分进化算法（DEP），用于连续函数优化，并在CEC2017数据集上与现有算法对比验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分进化简单高效，但易陷入局部最优、搜索多样性不足；受"主作用力运动受次作用力扰动"现象的启发，希望引入扰动机制改善其搜索行为。

Method: 在差分进化框架中引入扰动（perturbation）机制，即主搜索运动叠加由次作用力带来的扰动，据此构建DEP算法。

Result: 在CEC2017基准数据集上与现有算法进行对比实验，用于展示所提算法的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值结果）。

Conclusion: DEP在连续优化问题上是有效的；但摘要信息有限，缺少具体实验数据与扰动机制细节，需正文进一步验证。

Abstract: This paper presents differential evolution with perturbation (DEP) for continuous function optimization. Differential evolution is a simple and efficient algorithm. Perturbation is the phenomenon that the motion by the contribution of the main force is disturbed by the influence subsidiary power. In order to show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, we compare it to existing algorithms by CEC2017 datasets.

</details>


### [623] [Set-based comprehensive learning and particle swarm optimization with memory for discrete optimization problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31306)
*Yuta Chikuba,Takahiro Hino,Michiharu Maeda*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出一种带记忆的集合式综合学习粒子群优化算法，用于离散优化问题，通过参考当前位置在集合中搜索最优位置来更新解，并用数值实验验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对离散优化问题，现有粒子群与综合学习类算法在解的更新方式上存在不足，需要在离散空间中更有效地利用当前位置信息进行搜索。

Method: 设计集合式综合学习与带记忆的粒子群优化算法（set-based comprehensive learning PSO with memory）。更新解时，通过参考粒子当前位置，在一个集合（候选位置集合）中搜索最佳位置，从而在离散空间中完成位置更新。

Result: 通过与其他现有算法的数值实验对比，验证了所提算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该带记忆的集合式综合学习粒子群算法可有效求解离散优化问题，并在实验中表现出优于/可比于现有算法的性能。

Abstract: This paper describes a novel algorithm of set-based comprehensive learning and particle swarm optimization with memory for discrete optimization problem. Our algorithm is an approach of searching for the best position in a set by referring to the current position when updating the solution. In order to show the validity of our algorithm, we examine numerical experiments compared to existing algorithms.

</details>


### [624] [A steady-state genetic algorithm with multi-ratio seeding and pair exchange for the quadratic knapsack problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31529)
*Gaurav Srivastava,Rahul Verma,Alok Singh*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: SSGA-P：一种带成对交换的稳态遗传算法，解决二次背包问题中比值排序误导与局部最优被"无利可图单次交换"隔离的难题，在经典与大规模基准上几乎全部达到或刷新最优已知值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数QKP启发式按"利润/重量"比值排序物品，作者在基准实例上证明这种排序会把搜索引离最优解；且在接近满载的背包中，一个局部最优与更优解之间可能被"每一次单交换都损失利润"的交换所隔开，因此需要能跨越这一障碍的机制。

Method: 提出SSGA-P稳态遗传算法：初始种群用权重指数在0.5~3之间的网格构造多组比值贪心解；成对交换算子把一次违反容量但提高利润的交换与第二次交换或删除组合起来以恢复可行性；使用增量贡献向量，使其可扩展到10000个物品。

Result: 在100个经典实例上每次运行都找到最优解；在1000/2000物品的80个实例上99.8%的运行达到全部最好已知值，在5000/6000物品的40个实例上达99.75%，显著高于迭代超平面探索算法的87.7%，并改进了1个最好已知值；在144个Large-QKP实例（120秒限时）上改进20个已知最优值、其余124个持平。消融实验表明多比值种子与成对交换贡献了主要性能。

Conclusion: 比值排序的偏差与单交换不可达陷阱是QKP搜索的关键障碍，多比值初始化和成对交换能有效克服；SSGA-P在小、中、大规模实例上均达到或刷新最好已知结果，是当前表现突出的QKP启发式。

Abstract: The quadratic knapsack problem (QKP) seeks a subset of items of maximum total linear and pairwise profit whose total weight does not exceed a given capacity. Most QKP heuristics rank items by a profit-to-weight ratio. We show on benchmark instances that this ranking can steer the search away from the best known solutions, and that on an almost full knapsack a local optimum can be separated from a better solution by an exchange where every single swap loses profit. We propose SSGA-P, a steady-state genetic algorithm with pair exchange that addresses both effects. Its initial population contains greedy solutions built with a grid of exponents between 0.5 and 3 applied to the item weights, and its pair exchange move combines an improving swap violating the capacity with a second swap or removal that restores feasibility. Incremental contribution vectors keep the method practical up to 10{,}000 items. SSGA-P finds optimal solutions in every run on the 100 classical instances and reaches all best known values in 99.8\% of the runs on the 80 instances with 1000 and 2000 items and in 99.75\% on the 40 instances with 5000 and 6000 items, significantly above the 87.7\% of the iterated hyperplane exploration algorithm, improving one best known value. On the 144 Large-QKP instances of Hochbaum et al. (2025), with the same 120-second limit, it improves 20 best known values and matches the other 124. An ablation study shows that the multi-ratio seeding and the pair exchange account for most of this performance.

</details>


### [625] [The Self-Assembling Brain: Emergent Routing and Its Open Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.31629)
*Dongsung Huh*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 该评论文章讨论了Liao等人(PNAS, 2026)提出的"自组装基序"(SAM)，将信用分配重新表述为由局部突触规则驱动的自组织过程，从而绕开固定前馈-反馈配对带来的"架构循环性"问题，并指出了该方向的算法、生物物理与时间尺度挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反馈对齐等生物启发的反向传播替代方案虽放宽了精确突触权重对称性要求，但仍预设前馈与反馈通路之间存在固定、预接线的对应关系，即"架构循环性"这一僵局，文章以此为出发点审视SAM如何突破该限制。

Method: SAM通过初始随机的跨流连接，将上行推理流与下行反馈流联系起来，支持局部桥接对齐以及在稳定训练中涌现的通路对齐，无需固定的神经元对神经元配对；其学习动力学还具有自适应预条件特性。

Result: SAM在无固定配对的前提下实现了涌现式通路对齐与自适应预条件，为信用分配提供了一种自组织的替代框架。

Conclusion: 评论指出了下一研究前沿的关键挑战：直通估计下神经元特异性非线性门控的缺失、深层层级中路由误差的复合、低维路由瓶颈、非驱动性调制连接的皮层实现，以及从交替推理-更新阶段向连续感觉处理的转变。

Abstract: Biologically inspired alternatives to backpropagation, such as feedback alignment, relax the requirement for exact synaptic weight symmetry but still presuppose a fixed, pre-wired correspondence between forward and feedback pathways, an impasse Liao et al. (PNAS, 2026) term "architectural circularity." This commentary examines their Self-Assembling Motif (SAM), which reframes credit assignment as a self-organizing process driven by local synaptic rules. By linking ascending inference and descending feedback streams through initially random cross-stream connections, SAM supports local bridge alignment and emergent pathway alignment during stable training without fixed neuron-to-neuron pairing. Its resulting learning dynamics also exhibit adaptive preconditioning. The commentary highlights the algorithmic, biophysical, and temporal challenges that define the next research frontier: loss of neuron-specific nonlinear gating under straight-through approximation, compounding routing errors in deeper hierarchies, low-dimensional routing bottlenecks, the cortical implementation of non-driving modulatory connections, and the shift from alternating inference-update phases to continuous sensory processing.

</details>


### [626] [Accelerating Dynamic Route Re-solving via Robust Solver Evolution in Automatic Heuristic Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32576)
*Yizhuo Ma,Haoran Sun,Shuang Liang,Muquan Li,Qizhi Chen,Renzhong Wang,Nan Chen,Lunxu Liu,Ke Qin*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出即插即用框架ERDR，缓解AHD（自动启发式设计）求解器在动态路线规划中的"静态过拟合"，实现重求解平均加速2.2×（GLS）和4.4×（ILS）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标路线规划可建模为TSP，基于LLM的自动启发式设计（AHD）能构造高效求解器，但当地点变化、新增或取消请求导致请求数据动态改变时，现有方法重求解效率极低。作者实证分析发现"静态过拟合"是主因：进化出的求解器在动态变化后反复将搜索导向重叠的局部邻域；该现象与现有进化过程局限相关——某些实例上目标值更低却求解时间更长。

Method: ERDR为可插拔框架，嵌入现有AHD流程，含两项策略：1）验证引导的重选（validation-guided reselection），在常规进化未使用的实例上重新评估候选，降低对固定训练实例的专门化；2）运行时鲁棒性增强评估（runtime robustness-augmented evaluation），在原目标之外加入组间波动性与求解时间尾部风险，抑制代价高且不均衡的搜索。

Result: 在多种TSP规模与动态场景实验中，ERDR在引导局部搜索（GLS）下平均重求解加速2.2×，在迭代局部搜索（ILS）下加速4.4×。

Conclusion: "静态过拟合"是AHD求解器动态重求解低效的关键成因，通过验证重选与鲁棒性增强评估两项轻量策略即可显著提升重求解速度，且可作为插件与现有AHD流水线兼容。

Abstract: Multi-goal route planning uses spatial data on service locations and pairwise travel costs to determine a visiting order that minimizes total travel cost. This task can be formulated as the traveling salesman problem (TSP) and has benefited from large language model-based automatic heuristic design (AHD) for constructing effective solvers. Despite their effectiveness in static settings, existing methods exhibit substantial re-solving inefficiency when location changes, new requests, or request cancellations alter the underlying request data during execution. Our empirical analysis suggests that ``static-overfitting'' contributes to this inefficiency, as evolved solvers may repeatedly direct search toward overlapping local neighborhoods after dynamic changes. We further find that this ``overfitting'' is associated with limitations in existing evolutionary processes, where lower objective values on some instances coincide with longer solving times. In this paper, we therefore propose ERDR, a plug-and-play framework that integrates two strategies into existing AHD pipelines to guide evolution toward solvers that re-solve dynamically changed instances faster. Specifically, 1) ERDR uses validation-guided reselection to reevaluate candidates on instances excluded from routine evolution, reducing specialization to fixed training instances. 2) ERDR applies runtime robustness-augmented evaluation, supplementing the original evaluation objective of AHD methods with inter-group variability and tail risk in solving time to discourage costly and uneven search. Experiments across multiple TSP scales and dynamic scenarios show that ERDR achieves average re-solving speedups of $2.2\times$ under guided local search and $4.4\times$ under iterated local search.

</details>


### [627] [NCPU: Towards Cell-Inspired Spatial Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32750)
*Iliya Zhechev,Piotr Walas*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 用梯度下降训练神经细胞自动机(NCA)，使其在2D网格上实现精确的数字逻辑：逻辑门、4/8位行波进位加法器及初步8位ALU，多数模型达到100%正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统细胞自动机虽具备计算通用性，但其规则需人工设计。作者希望让局部更新规则通过梯度下降自动学习，从而精确实现数字逻辑计算。

Method: 将比特编码为2D网格上的细胞簇，结果需经中间细胞传播到达输出。每个任务训练一个模型（逻辑门、4位和8位行波进位加法器、初步8位ALU），用梯度下降学习局部更新规则。

Result: 所有门与加法器模型在10个随机种子中均达100%比特正确率；穷举所有输入对测试，4位最多1/256错误，8位最多7/65,536错误。仅用≤3位操作数训练的加法器可泛化到8位。进位以波的形式传播，每比特进位链约需3.5步延迟。

Conclusion: NCA能够学习实现精确逻辑计算并具一定泛化能力，但输出仅在训练所用的rollout长度内正确，存在时序依赖的局限。

Abstract: Simple cellular automata (CAs) can be computationally universal, but their rules are designed by hand. We train Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs), which learn a local update rule by gradient descent, to compute exact digital logic. Bits are encoded as clusters of cells on a 2D grid, and a result reaches the output only by propagating through intermediate cells. One model is trained per task: logic gates, 4- and 8-bit ripple-carry adders, and a preliminary 8-bit arithmetic logic unit (ALU). All gate and adder models reach 100% bit correctness in 10 of 10 seeds, and exhaustive tests over all input pairs find at most 1 error in 256 (4-bit) and 7 in 65,536 (8-bit). Adders trained on operands of up to 3 bits generalize to 8 bits. The adders propagate the carry as a wave, with a delay of about 3.5 steps per bit of the carry chain. Outputs are correct only within the trained rollout length.

</details>


### [628] [Low-Power Spiking Neural Network Acceleration with Differential Time Representation: A Modular Hardware Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32758)
*Daniel Windhager,Lothar Ratschbacher,Bernhard A. Moser,Michael Lunglmayr*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出差分时间表示(DTR)编码脉冲序列，比AER和1-bit采样更省比特，证明可低复杂度合并，并提供模块化硬件流组件与Python框架，自动生成FPGA/ASIC SNN加速器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN的能效优势主要来自脉冲序列的稀疏性，但现有脉冲表示（AER、等距1-bit采样）编码效率不高，且缺乏灵活构建定制SNN加速器的工具链。

Method: 用差分时间表示(DTR)编码脉冲，严格证明多路DTR序列可低复杂度合并；设计一组模块化硬件流式组件，可用Python框架灵活拼接为完整SNN实现；针对SHD、SSC、PSMNIST生成吞吐优化并行版与资源缩减时分复用版共三个加速器，并在FPGA及开源流程合成ASIC（ASAP7 PDK）上评估。

Result: SHD上ASIC达92.46%准确率，约12,027次推理/秒、20.37μJ/次，相比Loihi吞吐高109×、能效高1.8×；FPGA约6,023次推理/秒且不使用DSP块；三个数据集上ASIC较FPGA降低每次推理能耗27–37×。

Conclusion: DTR编码在效率与可合并性上具优势，模块化框架能有效生成定制SNN加速器；证明完全基于开源设计流程也能实现有竞争力的SNN加速器。

Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer promising energy efficiency, making them well suited for energy-constrained applications. Much of their energy savings stems from the sparse encoding of spike trains. We show that spike trains can be represented more efficiently using Differential Time Representation (DTR), which requires fewer bits than Address-Event Representation (AER) or equidistantly sampled 1-bit spike trains. To support multiple input spike trains, we provide a rigorous proof that DTR sequences can be merged with low complexity. We also provide a set of modular hardware streaming components using this representation that can be flexibly connected to construct custom accelerator architectures for specific SNNs. Tailoring the hardware architecture to the selected SNN is streamlined by a Python framework combining the modular hardware components into a full SNN implementation. We use the framework to generate three accelerators for the Spiking Heidelberg Digits (SHD), Spiking Speech Commands (SSC), and PSMNIST benchmarks, each in a throughput-optimized parallel variant and a resource-reduced time-multiplexed variant. We report results for FPGA and ASIC implementations, the latter synthesized with a fully open-source flow targeting the predictive ASAP7 PDK. On the SHD dataset, the ASIC implementation reaches 92.46% classification accuracy, while sustaining $\approx{}$12,027 inferences per second at 20.37$μ$J per inference, exceeding the neuromorphic Loihi processor by 109$\times$ in throughput and 1.8$\times$ in energy efficiency. The corresponding FPGA implementation achieves $\approx{}$6,023 inferences per second without using DSP blocks. Across all three datasets, the synthesized ASICs reduce energy per inference by 27-37$\times$ relative to their FPGA counterparts, demonstrating that competitive SNN accelerators can be realized entirely within an open-source design flow.

</details>

### [629] [A User-Item Aware Encoding Framework for Short Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32187)
*Weihui Deng,He Liu,Bin Wang,Xiaocheng Li,Deliang Fu,Zhen Wang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 该论文提出UIAE（用户-物品感知编码）方法，通过建立用户-视频关系、针对子群体的局部QoE优化与分层全局整合，实现多码率阶梯组编码，以应对海量短视频上传与异构消费关系带来的传统编码挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PGC时代的编码方法难以适用用户生成短视频的两大特性：每日上亿级的海量上传，以及视频质量各异、消费场景多样的异构内容-消费者关系。因此需要新的编码方案以在规模化转码中保障终端用户体验质量（QoE）。

Method: UIAE包含三个组件：1）通过基于规则或基于DNN的模型建立用户-物品关系；2）基于上下文消费模式，为各子群体构建最大化QoE的局部优化模型；3）通过分层模型整合推导全局最优编码策略。

Result: 实验结果表明，UIAE框架能针对具有不同上下文画像的不同用户群体自适应调整编码结果，保障终端观众的最优QoE。该方法已部署于在线流水线，每天处理数千万级视频转码任务。

Conclusion: UIAE能够有效应对UGC短视频的规模化与异构性挑战，实现面向用户群体的自适应多码率编码，并已在工业级在线系统中验证其可行性与实效性。

Abstract: Traditional encoding methods from the Professional Generated Content (PGC) era face significant challenges due to two unique characteristics of user-generated short videos: massive daily uploads (reaching hundreds of millions) and heterogeneous content-consumer relationships (varying video quality and diverse consumer contexts). To address these challenges, we propose UIAE (User-Item Aware Encoding), a novel multiple bitrate ladder group encoding method comprising three key components: 1) Establishing user-item relationships via rule-based or DNN-based models; 2) Developing local optimization models maximizing Quality of Experience (QoE) for sub-populations based on contextual consumption patterns; 3) Deriving globally optimal encoding strategies through hierarchical model integration. Experimental results demonstrate that the UIAE framework adaptively adjusts encoding outcomes for distinct user groups with varying context profiles, ensuring optimal QoE for end viewers. We have deployed the UIAE method into the online pipeline, handling tens of millions of video transcoding tasks daily.

</details>


### [630] [Residual Guidance for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32820)
*NaHyeon Park,Kyeong-Hwan Moon,Youjin Jeon,Hyunjung Shim*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出免训练的Residual Guidance(RG)方法，通过缓存外的残差校正对抗"上下文惯性"，提升流式视频生成的提示词切换能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时交互视频生成允许用户在生成过程中修改提示词以引导视频演化，但现有逐块生成的流式模型在提示词切换后往往仍延续旧提示词。作者将这一失败归因于"上下文惯性"：上一块作为强先验压制了新提示词。且该惯性即使缓存仅保留上一块仍存在，而直接丢弃上下文又会破坏视觉连续性，使缓存编辑类方法受限。

Method: Residual Guidance(RG)是一种简单、免训练的方法，不编辑缓存，而在缓存之外测量校正量。具体做法：在无缓存条件下，用新提示词对重新加噪的上一块进行一次去噪，得到残差；将该残差加到下一块的早期去噪步骤中——此时内容基本确定且新提示词受压最强。

Result: 在从单次切换到长序列多次切换的设置中，RG显著提升了现有流式模型（包括带有专门切换机制的模型）的提示词切换能力，同时基本保持视觉质量。无需训练或逐模型调参，每块仅增加一次前向传播，易于集成到现有实时视频生成流程。

Conclusion: RG通过缓存外残差校正有效缓解上下文惯性，是一种轻量、通用、即插即用的提示词切换增强方案，兼顾切换能力与视觉质量，适合实时视频生成管线。

Abstract: Real-time interactive video generation allows users to change the prompt during generation to steer the evolving video. However, existing streaming models, which generate videos chunk by chunk, often keep following the previous prompt after a switch. We trace this failure to context inertia, where the previous chunk acts as a strong prior that suppresses the new prompt. Furthermore, we find that this inertia persists even when the cache retains only the previous chunk, yet discarding the context breaks visual continuity, which limits approaches that edit the cache. Rather than editing the cache, we propose Residual Guidance (RG), a simple, training-free method that counteracts context inertia with a correction measured outside the cache. Specifically, RG denoises the re-noised previous chunk once under the new prompt without the cache and adds the resulting residual to the early denoising steps of the next chunk, where its content is largely decided and the new prompt is most suppressed. Across settings ranging from a single switch to long multi-switch generation, RG substantially improves prompt switching capability on existing streaming models, including those with dedicated switching mechanisms, while largely retaining visual quality. As it requires no training or per-model tuning and adds only one forward pass per chunk, RG can be easily integrated into existing real-time video generation pipelines.

</details>


### [631] [MSRGF: Multi-Source Reconstruction with Reference-Guided Fusion for Incomplete Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.32860)
*Yan Zhuang,Minhao Liu,Yanru Zhang,Li Ma,Weilong Chen,Xingyu Wu,Jiawen Deng,Fuji Ren*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出MSRGF框架用于不完整多模态情感分析，通过保留多源重建估计并利用其关系进行参考引导融合，在三个数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不完整多模态情感分析的重建方法从可用模态估计缺失特征后直接融合，但不同模态会对同一模态产生不同估计，直接融合未能充分利用这些估计间的关系。

Method: MSRGF含三部分：(1) Source-Wise Reconstruction (SWR)：用模态特定查询与共享生成器，从每个可用模态为各模态产生独立估计；(2) Reference-Guided Fusion (RGF)：利用估计间关系与可用观测构造加权参考，按其差异选择性精炼，并在可用时纳入观测特征；(3) Global Context Modulation (GCM)：用全局上下文调整模态摘要用于情感预测。

Result: 在三个数据集上优于现有方法，MOSEI上随机模态内缺失平均准确率提升1.9%，随机整模态缺失提升0.6%，固定整模态缺失提升1.3%。

Conclusion: 保留并显式利用多源重建估计间的关系，配合参考引导融合与全局上下文调制，能有效提升不完整多模态情感分析性能。

Abstract: Incomplete multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) predicts sentiment from textual, acoustic, and visual features when some observations are missing. Existing reconstruction methods estimate missing features from available modalities and combine the resulting information for sentiment prediction. However, different available modalities can produce distinct estimates of the same modality, while direct fusion often leaves the relationships among these estimates underused. We propose MSRGF (Multi-Source Reconstruction with Reference-Guided Fusion), which retains separate estimates and exploits their relationships during fusion. Specifically, MSRGF comprises three components: (1) Source-Wise Reconstruction (SWR), which uses modality-specific queries and a shared generator to produce a separate estimate of each modality from every available modality; (2) Reference-Guided Fusion (RGF), which uses relationships among estimates and available observations to construct a weighted reference, selectively refines it using their differences, and incorporates observed features when available; and (3) Global Context Modulation (GCM), which uses global context to adjust modality summaries for sentiment prediction. Extensive experiments on three datasets show that MSRGF outperforms existing methods, achieving average accuracy improvements of 1.9% on MOSEI under random within-modality missingness, 0.6% under random whole-modality missingness and 1.3% under fixed whole-modality missingness.

</details>
